  83: fn run() -> Result<(), String> {
  84:     let args = std::env::args().skip(1).collect::<Vec<_>>();
  85: 
  86:     if args.is_empty() {
  87:         return Err(help_text());
  88:     }
  89: 
  90:     match select_host_entry(&args)? {
  91:         HostEntrySelection::WindowsService(options) => {
  92:             run_windows_service_host(options, run_service_daemon_args)
  93:         }
  94:         HostEntrySelection::Standard(selected_args) => match selected_args.as_slice() {
  95:             [flag, output_path] if flag == "--emit-phase1-baseline" => {
  96:                 perf::write_phase1_baseline_report(output_path)?;
  97:                 println!("phase1 baseline report emitted: {output_path}");
  98:                 Ok(())
  99:             }
 100:             [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "daemon" => {
 101:                 let config = parse_daemon_config(rest)?;
 102:                 run_daemon(config).map_err(|err| err.to_string())
 103:             }

 172: fn run_service_daemon_args(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {

 174:     run_daemon(config).map_err(|err| err.to_string())

 177: fn run_key_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
 178:     if args.is_empty() {
 179:         return Err(
 180:             "key subcommand is required (supported: init, migrate, store-passphrase)".to_string(),
 181:         );
 182:     }
 183:     match args[0].as_str() {
 184:         "init" => run_key_init(&args[1..]),
 185:         "migrate" => run_key_migrate(&args[1..]),
 186:         "store-passphrase" => run_key_store_passphrase(&args[1..]),
 187:         other => Err(format!("unknown key subcommand: {other}")),
 188:     }
 189: }

 191: fn run_privileged_helper_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
 192:     let mut config = PrivilegedHelperConfig::default();
 193:     let mut index = 0usize;
 194:     while index < args.len() {
 195:         match args.get(index).map(String::as_str) {
 196:             Some("--socket") => {
 197:                 let value = args
 198:                     .get(index + 1)
 199:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--socket requires a value".to_string())?;
 200:                 config.socket_path = value.into();
 201:                 index += 2;
 202:             }
 203:             Some("--allowed-uid") => {
 204:                 let value = args
 205:                     .get(index + 1)
 206:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--allowed-uid requires a value".to_string())?;
 207:                 config.allowed_uid = value
 208:                     .parse::<u32>()
 209:                     .map_err(|err| format!("invalid --allowed-uid value: {err}"))?;
 210:                 index += 2;
 211:             }
 212:             Some("--allowed-gid") => {
 213:                 let value = args
 214:                     .get(index + 1)
 215:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--allowed-gid requires a value".to_string())?;
 216:                 let gid = value
 217:                     .parse::<u32>()
 218:                     .map_err(|err| format!("invalid --allowed-gid value: {err}"))?;
 219:                 config.allowed_gid = Some(gid);
 220:                 index += 2;
 221:             }
 222:             Some("--timeout-ms") => {
 223:                 let value = args
 224:                     .get(index + 1)
 225:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--timeout-ms requires a value".to_string())?;
 226:                 let timeout_ms = value
 227:                     .parse::<u64>()
 228:                     .map_err(|err| format!("invalid --timeout-ms value: {err}"))?;
 229:                 if timeout_ms == 0 {
 230:                     return Err("--timeout-ms must be greater than zero".to_string());
 231:                 }
 232:                 config.io_timeout = std::time::Duration::from_millis(timeout_ms);
 233:                 index += 2;
 234:             }
 235:             Some(flag) => return Err(format!("unknown privileged-helper argument: {flag}")),
 236:             None => break,
 237:         }
 238:     }
 239:     run_privileged_helper(config)
 240: }

 242: fn run_windows_runtime_boundary_check_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
 243:     #[cfg(not(windows))]
 244:     {
 245:         let _ = args;
 246:         Err("windows-runtime-boundary-check is only available on Windows hosts".to_string())
 247:     }
 248: 
 249:     #[cfg(windows)]
 250:     {
 251:         let mut state_root = PathBuf::from(r"C:\ProgramData\RustyNet");
 252:         let mut index = 0usize;
 253:         while index < args.len() {
 254:             match args.get(index).map(String::as_str) {
 255:                 Some("--state-root") => {
 256:                     let value = args
 257:                         .get(index + 1)
 258:                         .ok_or_else(|| "--state-root requires a value".to_string())?;
 259:                     state_root = PathBuf::from(value);
 260:                     index += 2;
 261:                 }
 262:                 Some(flag) => {
 263:                     return Err(format!(
 264:                         "unknown windows-runtime-boundary-check argument: {flag}"
 265:                     ));
 266:                 }
 267:                 None => break,
 268:             }
 269:         }
 270:         let report = run_windows_runtime_boundary_check(state_root.as_path())?;
 271:         println!(
 272:             "{}",
 273:             serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)
 274:                 .map_err(|err| format!("serialize runtime-boundary report failed: {err}"))?
 275:         );
 276:         Ok(())
 277:     }
 278: }

 280: fn run_windows_mesh_status_check_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
 281:     let mut fail_on_drift = true;
 282:     let mut state_path: Option<std::path::PathBuf> = None;
 283:     let mut expected_peer_ids: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
 284:     let mut max_age_seconds: Option<i64> = None;
 285:     let mut index = 0usize;
 286:     while index < args.len() {
 287:         match args.get(index).map(String::as_str) {
 288:             Some("--no-fail-on-drift") => {
 289:                 fail_on_drift = false;
 290:                 index += 1;
 291:             }
 292:             Some("--state-path") => {
 293:                 let value = args
 294:                     .get(index + 1)
 295:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--state-path requires a value".to_string())?;
 296:                 state_path = Some(std::path::PathBuf::from(value));
 297:                 index += 2;
 298:             }
 299:             Some("--expected-peer-id") => {
 300:                 let value = args
 301:                     .get(index + 1)
 302:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--expected-peer-id requires a value".to_string())?;
 303:                 expected_peer_ids.push(value.clone());
 304:                 index += 2;
 305:             }
 306:             Some("--max-age-seconds") => {
 307:                 let value = args
 308:                     .get(index + 1)
 309:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--max-age-seconds requires a value".to_string())?;
 310:                 let parsed: i64 = value
 311:                     .parse()
 312:                     .map_err(|err| format!("invalid --max-age-seconds value: {err}"))?;
 313:                 if parsed < 0 {
 314:                     return Err("--max-age-seconds must be non-negative".to_string());
 315:                 }
 316:                 max_age_seconds = Some(parsed);
 317:                 index += 2;
 318:             }
 319:             Some(flag) => {
 320:                 return Err(format!(
 321:                     "unknown windows-mesh-status-check argument: {flag}"
 322:                 ));
 323:             }
 324:             None => break,
 325:         }
 326:     }
 327:     let options = WindowsMeshStatusOptions {
 328:         state_path,
 329:         expected_peer_ids,
 330:         max_age_seconds,
 331:     };
 332:     let report = collect_windows_mesh_status_report(&options);
 333:     println!(
 334:         "{}",
 335:         serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)

 352: fn run_windows_authenticode_check_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
 353:     let mut fail_on_drift = true;
 354:     let mut binary_path: Option<std::path::PathBuf> = None;
 355:     let mut index = 0usize;
 356:     while index < args.len() {
 357:         match args.get(index).map(String::as_str) {
 358:             Some("--no-fail-on-drift") => {
 359:                 fail_on_drift = false;
 360:                 index += 1;
 361:             }
 362:             Some("--binary-path") => {
 363:                 let value = args
 364:                     .get(index + 1)
 365:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--binary-path requires a value".to_string())?;
 366:                 binary_path = Some(std::path::PathBuf::from(value));
 367:                 index += 2;
 368:             }
 369:             Some(flag) => {
 370:                 return Err(format!(
 371:                     "unknown windows-authenticode-check argument: {flag}"
 372:                 ));
 373:             }
 374:             None => break,
 375:         }
 376:     }
 377:     let target_path = binary_path
 378:         .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from(r"C:\Program Files\RustyNet\rustynetd.exe"));
 379:     let report = inspect_authenticode_signature(target_path.as_path());
 380:     println!(
 381:         "{}",
 382:         serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)
 383:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize authenticode report failed: {err}"))?
 384:     );
 385:     if fail_on_drift && !report.overall_ok {
 386:         return Err(format!(
 387:             "windows-authenticode-check failed for {}: {}",
 388:             report.binary_path,
 389:             if report.drift_reasons.is_empty() {
 390:                 "no signature present".to_string()
 391:             } else {
 392:                 report.drift_reasons.join("; ")
 393:             }
 394:         ));
 395:     }
 396:     Ok(())
 397: }

 615: fn run_linux_mesh_status_check_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
 616:     let mut fail_on_drift = true;
 617:     let mut state_path: Option<std::path::PathBuf> = None;
 618:     let mut expected_peer_ids: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
 619:     let mut max_age_seconds: Option<i64> = None;
 620:     let mut index = 0usize;
 621:     while index < args.len() {
 622:         match args.get(index).map(String::as_str) {
 623:             Some("--no-fail-on-drift") => {
 624:                 fail_on_drift = false;
 625:                 index += 1;
 626:             }
 627:             Some("--state-path") => {
 628:                 let value = args
 629:                     .get(index + 1)
 630:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--state-path requires a value".to_string())?;
 631:                 state_path = Some(std::path::PathBuf::from(value));
 632:                 index += 2;
 633:             }
 634:             Some("--expected-peer-id") => {
 635:                 let value = args
 636:                     .get(index + 1)
 637:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--expected-peer-id requires a value".to_string())?;
 638:                 expected_peer_ids.push(value.clone());
 639:                 index += 2;
 640:             }
 641:             Some("--max-age-seconds") => {
 642:                 let value = args
 643:                     .get(index + 1)
 644:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--max-age-seconds requires a value".to_string())?;
 645:                 let parsed: i64 = value
 646:                     .parse()
 647:                     .map_err(|err| format!("invalid --max-age-seconds value: {err}"))?;
 648:                 if parsed < 0 {
 649:                     return Err("--max-age-seconds must be non-negative".to_string());
 650:                 }
 651:                 max_age_seconds = Some(parsed);
 652:                 index += 2;
 653:             }
 654:             Some(flag) => {
 655:                 return Err(format!("unknown linux-mesh-status-check argument: {flag}"));
 656:             }
 657:             None => break,
 658:         }
 659:     }
 660:     let options = LinuxMeshStatusOptions {
 661:         state_path,
 662:         expected_peer_ids,
 663:         max_age_seconds,
 664:     };
 665:     let report = collect_linux_mesh_status_report(&options);
 666:     println!(
 667:         "{}",
 668:         serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)
 669:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize linux mesh-status report failed: {err}"))?
 670:     );
 671:     if fail_on_drift && !report.overall_ok {
 672:         return Err(format!(
 673:             "linux-mesh-status-check failed for {}: {}",
 674:             report.state_path,
 675:             if report.drift_reasons.is_empty() {
 676:                 "no drift_reasons recorded".to_string()
 677:             } else {
 678:                 report.drift_reasons.join("; ")
 679:             }
 680:         ));
 681:     }
 682:     Ok(())
 683: }

 935:     let mut index = 0usize;
 936:     while index < args.len() {
 937:         match args.get(index).map(String::as_str) {
 938:             Some("--no-fail-on-drift") => {
 939:                 fail_on_drift = false;
 940:                 index += 1;
 941:             }
 942:             Some(flag) => {
 943:                 return Err(format!(
 944:                     "unknown windows-dns-failclosed-check argument: {flag}"
 945:                 ));
 946:             }
 947:             None => break,
 948:         }
 949:     }
 950:     let snapshot = collect_windows_dns_failclosed_snapshot()?;
 951:     let report = build_windows_dns_failclosed_report(snapshot);
 952:     println!(
 953:         "{}",
 954:         serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)
 955:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize dns-failclosed report failed: {err}"))?
 956:     );
 957:     if fail_on_drift && !report.overall_ok {
 958:         return Err(
 959:             "windows-dns-failclosed-check reported drift in the live RustyNet DNS fail-closed state"
 960:                 .to_string(),
 961:         );
 962:     }
 963:     Ok(())
 964: }

 998: fn ensure_cli_path_absolute(path: &str, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 999:     if std::path::Path::new(path).is_absolute() {
1000:         return Ok(());
1001:     }
1002:     Err(format!("{label} must be absolute: {path}"))

1005: fn run_key_init(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
1006:     let mut runtime_path = DEFAULT_WG_RUNTIME_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.to_string();
1007:     let mut encrypted_path = DEFAULT_WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.to_string();
1008:     let mut public_path = DEFAULT_WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH.to_string();
1009:     let mut passphrase_path = DEFAULT_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH.to_string();
1010:     let mut force = false;
1011: 
1012:     let mut index = 0usize;
1013:     while index < args.len() {
1014:         match args.get(index).map(String::as_str) {
1015:             Some("--runtime-private-key") => {
1016:                 let value = args
1017:                     .get(index + 1)
1018:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--runtime-private-key requires a value".to_string())?;
1019:                 runtime_path = value.clone();
1020:                 index += 2;
1021:             }
1022:             Some("--encrypted-private-key") => {
1023:                 let value = args
1024:                     .get(index + 1)
1025:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--encrypted-private-key requires a value".to_string())?;
1026:                 encrypted_path = value.clone();
1027:                 index += 2;
1028:             }
1029:             Some("--public-key") => {
1030:                 let value = args
1031:                     .get(index + 1)
1032:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--public-key requires a value".to_string())?;
1033:                 public_path = value.clone();
1034:                 index += 2;
1035:             }
1036:             Some("--passphrase-file") => {
1037:                 let value = args
1038:                     .get(index + 1)
1039:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--passphrase-file requires a value".to_string())?;
1040:                 passphrase_path = value.clone();
1041:                 index += 2;
1042:             }
1043:             Some("--force") => {
1044:                 force = true;
1045:                 index += 1;
1046:             }
1047:             Some(flag) => return Err(format!("unknown key init argument: {flag}")),
1048:             None => break,
1049:         }
1050:     }
1051: 
1052:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&runtime_path, "path")?;
1053:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&encrypted_path, "path")?;
1054:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&public_path, "path")?;
1055:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&passphrase_path, "path")?;
1056: 
1057:     initialize_encrypted_key_material(
1058:         std::path::Path::new(&runtime_path),
1059:         std::path::Path::new(&encrypted_path),
1060:         std::path::Path::new(&public_path),
1061:         std::path::Path::new(&passphrase_path),
1062:         Some(std::path::Path::new(&passphrase_path)),
1063:         force,
1064:     )?;
1065: 
1066:     println!(
1067:         "key init complete: runtime_private_key={runtime_path} encrypted_private_key={encrypted_path} public_key={public_path}",
1068:     );
1069:     Ok(())
1070: }

1072: fn run_key_migrate(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
1073:     let mut existing_private_key_path = String::new();
1074:     let mut runtime_path = DEFAULT_WG_RUNTIME_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.to_string();
1075:     let mut encrypted_path = DEFAULT_WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.to_string();
1076:     let mut public_path = DEFAULT_WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH.to_string();
1077:     let mut passphrase_path = DEFAULT_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH.to_string();
1078:     let mut force = false;
1079: 
1080:     let mut index = 0usize;
1081:     while index < args.len() {
1082:         match args.get(index).map(String::as_str) {
1083:             Some("--existing-private-key") => {
1084:                 let value = args
1085:                     .get(index + 1)
1086:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--existing-private-key requires a value".to_string())?;

1090:             Some("--runtime-private-key") => {
1091:                 let value = args
1092:                     .get(index + 1)
1093:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--runtime-private-key requires a value".to_string())?;
1094:                 runtime_path = value.clone();
1095:                 index += 2;
1096:             }
1097:             Some("--encrypted-private-key") => {
1098:                 let value = args
1099:                     .get(index + 1)
1100:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--encrypted-private-key requires a value".to_string())?;
1101:                 encrypted_path = value.clone();
1102:                 index += 2;
1103:             }
1104:             Some("--public-key") => {
1105:                 let value = args
1106:                     .get(index + 1)
1107:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--public-key requires a value".to_string())?;
1108:                 public_path = value.clone();
1109:                 index += 2;
1110:             }
1111:             Some("--passphrase-file") => {

1114:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--passphrase-file requires a value".to_string())?;
1115:                 passphrase_path = value.clone();
1116:                 index += 2;
1117:             }
1118:             Some("--force") => {
1119:                 force = true;
1120:                 index += 1;
1121:             }
1122:             Some(flag) => return Err(format!("unknown key migrate argument: {flag}")),
1123:             None => break,
1124:         }
1125:     }
1126: 
1127:     if existing_private_key_path.is_empty() {
1128:         return Err("--existing-private-key is required".to_string());
1129:     }
1130: 
1131:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&existing_private_key_path, "path")?;
1132:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&runtime_path, "path")?;
1133:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&encrypted_path, "path")?;
1134:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&public_path, "path")?;
1135:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&passphrase_path, "path")?;
1136: 
1137:     migrate_existing_private_key_material(
1138:         std::path::Path::new(&existing_private_key_path),
1139:         std::path::Path::new(&runtime_path),
1140:         std::path::Path::new(&encrypted_path),
1141:         std::path::Path::new(&public_path),
1142:         std::path::Path::new(&passphrase_path),
1143:         Some(std::path::Path::new(&passphrase_path)),
1144:         force,
1145:     )?;
1146: 
1147:     println!(
1148:         "key migrate complete: existing_private_key={existing_private_key_path} runtime_private_key={runtime_path} encrypted_private_key={encrypted_path} public_key={public_path}",
1149:     );
1150:     Ok(())
1151: }

1153: fn run_key_store_passphrase(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
1154:     let mut passphrase_path = String::new();
1155:     let mut keychain_account: Option<String> = None;
1156: 
1157:     let mut index = 0usize;
1158:     while index < args.len() {
1159:         match args.get(index).map(String::as_str) {
1160:             Some("--passphrase-file") => {
1161:                 let value = args
1162:                     .get(index + 1)
1163:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--passphrase-file requires a value".to_string())?;
1164:                 passphrase_path = value.clone();
1165:                 index += 2;
1166:             }
1167:             Some("--keychain-account") => {
1168:                 let value = args
1169:                     .get(index + 1)
1170:                     .ok_or_else(|| "--keychain-account requires a value".to_string())?;
1171:                 keychain_account = Some(value.clone());
1172:                 index += 2;
1173:             }
1174:             Some(flag) => return Err(format!("unknown key store-passphrase argument: {flag}")),
1175:             None => break,
1176:         }
1177:     }
1178: 
1179:     if passphrase_path.is_empty() {
1180:         return Err("--passphrase-file is required".to_string());
1181:     }
1182:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&passphrase_path, "path")?;
1183: 
1184:     store_passphrase_in_os_secure_store(
1185:         std::path::Path::new(&passphrase_path),
1186:         keychain_account.as_deref(),
1187:     )?;
1188: 
1189:     println!(
1190:         "key passphrase store complete: passphrase_file={} keychain_account={}",
1191:         passphrase_path,
1192:         keychain_account.as_deref().unwrap_or("<env>")
1193:     );
1194:     Ok(())
1195: }

1715:                 config.fail_closed_ssh_allow = match value.as_str() {
1716:                     "true" | "1" | "yes" => true,
1717:                     "false" | "0" | "no" => false,
1718:                     _ => {
1719:                         return Err(
1720:                             "invalid fail-closed-ssh-allow value: expected true/false".to_string()
1721:                         );
1722:                     }
1723:                 };
1724:                 index += 2;
1725:             }
1726:             Some("--fail-closed-ssh-allow-cidrs") => {
1727:                 if let Some(value) = args.get(index + 1) {
1728:                     if value.starts_with("--") {
1729:                         config.fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs.clear();
1730:                         index += 1;
1731:                     } else {
1732:                         config.fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs = value
1733:                             .split(',')
1734:                             .map(str::trim)
1735:                             .filter(|entry| !entry.is_empty())
1736:                             .map(str::parse::<ManagementCidr>)
1737:                             .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
1738:                             .map_err(|err| {
1739:                                 format!("invalid --fail-closed-ssh-allow-cidrs value: {err}")
1740:                             })?;
1741:                         index += 2;
1742:                     }
1743:                 } else {
1744:                     config.fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs.clear();
1745:                     index += 1;
1746:                 }
1747:             }
1748:             Some(flag) => {
1749:                 return Err(format!("unknown daemon argument: {flag}"));
1750:             }
1751:             None => break,
1752:         }
1753:     }
1754:     Ok(config)
1755: }
1756: 
1757: fn parse_optional_socket_addr_csv_arg(
1758:     args: &[String],
1759:     index: usize,
1760:     flag: &str,
1761: ) -> Result<(Vec<SocketAddr>, usize), String> {
1762:     if let Some(value) = args.get(index + 1) {
1763:         if value.starts_with("--") {
1764:             return Ok((Vec::new(), index + 1));
1765:         }
1766:         let parsed = value
1767:             .split(',')
1768:             .map(str::trim)
1769:             .filter(|entry| !entry.is_empty())
1770:             .map(str::parse::<SocketAddr>)
1771:             .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
1772:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid {flag} value: {err}"))?;
1773:         Ok((parsed, index + 2))
1774:     } else {
1775:         Ok((Vec::new(), index + 1))
1776:     }
1777: }
1778: 
1779: fn run_membership_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
1780:     match args.first().map(String::as_str) {
1781:         Some("init") => run_membership_init(&args[1..]),
1782:         Some(other) => Err(format!("unknown membership subcommand: {other}")),
1783:         None => Err("membership subcommand required (supported: init)".to_string()),
1784:     }
1785: }
1786: 
1787: fn run_membership_init(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
1788:     use ed25519_dalek::SigningKey;
1789:     use rustynet_control::membership::{
1790:         MEMBERSHIP_SCHEMA_VERSION, MembershipApprover, MembershipApproverRole,
1791:         MembershipApproverStatus, MembershipNode, MembershipNodeStatus, MembershipState,
1792:         persist_membership_snapshot,
1793:     };
1794:     use std::io::Write;
1795:     #[cfg(unix)]
1796:     use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
1797:     use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
1798:     use zeroize::Zeroize;
1799: 
1800:     let mut snapshot_path = DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH.to_string();
1801:     let mut log_path = DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH.to_string();
1802:     let mut watermark_path = DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK_PATH.to_string();
1803:     let mut owner_signing_key_path = DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH.to_string();
1804:     let mut owner_signing_key_passphrase_path =
1805:         std::env::var(MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_FILE_ENV).ok();
1806:     let mut node_id = read_hostname_short();
1807:     let mut network_id = "local-net".to_string();
1808:     let mut force = false;
1809: 
1810:     let mut index = 0usize;
1811:     while index < args.len() {
1812:         match args.get(index).map(String::as_str) {
1813:             Some("--snapshot") => {
1814:                 snapshot_path = args
1815:                     .get(index + 1)
1816:                     .ok_or("--snapshot requires a value")?
1817:                     .clone();
1818:                 index += 2;
1819:             }
1820:             Some("--log") => {
1821:                 log_path = args.get(index + 1).ok_or("--log requires a value")?.clone();
1822:                 index += 2;
1823:             }
1824:             Some("--watermark") => {
1825:                 watermark_path = args
1826:                     .get(index + 1)
1827:                     .ok_or("--watermark requires a value")?
1828:                     .clone();
1829:                 index += 2;
1830:             }
1831:             Some("--owner-signing-key") => {
1832:                 owner_signing_key_path = args
1833:                     .get(index + 1)
1834:                     .ok_or("--owner-signing-key requires a value")?
1835:                     .clone();
1836:                 index += 2;
1837:             }
1838:             Some("--owner-signing-key-passphrase-file") => {
1839:                 let value = args
1840:                     .get(index + 1)
1841:                     .ok_or("--owner-signing-key-passphrase-file requires a value")?
1842:                     .clone();
1843:                 owner_signing_key_passphrase_path = Some(value);
1844:                 index += 2;
1845:             }
1846:             Some("--node-id") => {
1847:                 node_id = args
1848:                     .get(index + 1)
1849:                     .ok_or("--node-id requires a value")?
1850:                     .clone();
1851:                 index += 2;
1852:             }
1853:             Some("--network-id") => {
1854:                 network_id = args
1855:                     .get(index + 1)
1856:                     .ok_or("--network-id requires a value")?
1857:                     .clone();
1858:                 index += 2;
1859:             }
1860:             Some("--force") => {
1861:                 force = true;
1862:                 index += 1;
1863:             }
1864:             Some(flag) => return Err(format!("unknown membership init argument: {flag}")),
1865:             None => break,
1866:         }
1867:     }
1868: 
1869:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&snapshot_path, "snapshot path")?;
1870:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&log_path, "log path")?;
1871:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&watermark_path, "watermark path")?;
1872:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(&owner_signing_key_path, "owner signing key path")?;
1873:     let owner_signing_key_passphrase_path =
1874:         owner_signing_key_passphrase_path.ok_or_else(|| {
1875:             format!(
1876:                 "owner signing key passphrase path is required; pass --owner-signing-key-passphrase-file or set {MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_FILE_ENV}",
1877:             )
1878:         })?;
1879:     ensure_cli_path_absolute(
1880:         &owner_signing_key_passphrase_path,
1881:         "owner signing key passphrase path",
1882:     )?;
1883: 
1884:     if !force
1885:         && (std::path::Path::new(&snapshot_path).exists()
1886:             || std::path::Path::new(&log_path).exists()
1887:             || std::path::Path::new(&watermark_path).exists()
1888:             || std::path::Path::new(&owner_signing_key_path).exists())
1889:     {
1890:         return Err(format!(
1891:             "membership files already exist at {snapshot_path}, {log_path}, {watermark_path}, or {owner_signing_key_path}; use --force to overwrite"
1892:         ));
1893:     }
1894: 
1895:     for path_str in [
1896:         &snapshot_path,
1897:         &log_path,
1898:         &watermark_path,
1899:         &owner_signing_key_path,
1900:     ] {
1901:         if let Some(parent) = std::path::Path::new(path_str.as_str()).parent() {
1902:             std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)
1903:                 .map_err(|e| format!("failed to create directory {}: {e}", parent.display()))?;
1904:         }
1905:     }
1906: 
1907:     if std::path::Path::new(&watermark_path).exists() {
1908:         std::fs::remove_file(&watermark_path)
1909:             .map_err(|e| format!("failed to remove membership watermark {watermark_path}: {e}"))?;
1910:     }
1911: 
1912:     let mut node_key_bytes = [0u8; 32];
1913:     let mut approver_key_bytes = [0u8; 32];
1914:     fill_random_bytes(&mut node_key_bytes)
1915:         .map_err(|e| format!("failed to generate node identity key: {e}"))?;
1916:     fill_random_bytes(&mut approver_key_bytes)
1917:         .map_err(|e| format!("failed to generate approver key: {e}"))?;
1918: 
1919:     let init_result = (|| -> Result<String, String> {
1920:         let approver_signing = SigningKey::from_bytes(&approver_key_bytes);
1921:         let approver_pubkey_hex = encode_hex(approver_signing.verifying_key().as_bytes());
1922:         let node_pubkey_hex = encode_hex(&node_key_bytes);
1923:         let owner_approver_id = format!("{node_id}-owner");
1924: 
1925:         persist_owner_signing_key_encrypted(
1926:             std::path::Path::new(&owner_signing_key_path),
1927:             &approver_key_bytes,
1928:             std::path::Path::new(&owner_signing_key_passphrase_path),
1929:             force,
1930:         )?;
1931: 
1932:         let now = SystemTime::now()
1933:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
1934:             .map(|d| d.as_secs())
1935:             .unwrap_or(0);
1936: 
1937:         let state = MembershipState {
1938:             schema_version: MEMBERSHIP_SCHEMA_VERSION,
1939:             network_id: network_id.clone(),
1940:             epoch: 1,
1941:             nodes: vec![MembershipNode {
1942:                 node_id: node_id.clone(),
1943:                 node_pubkey_hex,
1944:                 owner: node_id.clone(),
1945:                 status: MembershipNodeStatus::Active,
1946:                 roles: vec![],
1947:                 joined_at_unix: now,
1948:                 updated_at_unix: now,
1949:             }],
1950:             approver_set: vec![MembershipApprover {
1951:                 approver_id: owner_approver_id.clone(),
1952:                 approver_pubkey_hex,
1953:                 role: MembershipApproverRole::Owner,
1954:                 status: MembershipApproverStatus::Active,
1955:                 created_at_unix: now,
1956:             }],
1957:             quorum_threshold: 1,
1958:             metadata_hash: None,
1959:         };
1960: 
1961:         persist_membership_snapshot(&snapshot_path, &state)
1962:             .map_err(|e| format!("failed to write membership snapshot: {e}"))?;
1963: 
1964:         let mut opts = std::fs::OpenOptions::new();
1965:         opts.write(true).create(true).truncate(true);
1966:         #[cfg(unix)]
1967:         opts.mode(0o600);
1968:         let mut log_file = opts
1969:             .open(&log_path)
1970:             .map_err(|e| format!("failed to create membership log: {e}"))?;
1971:         log_file
1972:             .write_all(format!("version={MEMBERSHIP_SCHEMA_VERSION}\n").as_bytes())
1973:             .map_err(|e| format!("failed to write membership log: {e}"))?;
1974:         Ok(owner_approver_id)
1975:     })();
1976: 
1977:     node_key_bytes.zeroize();
1978:     approver_key_bytes.zeroize();
1979:     let owner_approver_id = init_result?;
1980: 
1981:     println!(
1982:         "membership init complete: snapshot={snapshot_path} log={log_path} watermark_reset={watermark_path} owner_signing_key={owner_signing_key_path}"
1983:     );
1984:     println!("  node_id={node_id} network_id={network_id} owner_approver_id={owner_approver_id}");
1985:     Ok(())
1986: }
1987: 
1988: fn fill_random_bytes(buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
1989:     use rand::TryRngCore;
1990:     rand::rngs::OsRng
1991:         .try_fill_bytes(buf)
1992:         .map_err(std::io::Error::other)
1993: }
1994: 
1995: fn encode_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
1996:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
1997:     for byte in bytes {
1998:         out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
1999:     }
2000:     out
2001: }
2002: 
2003: fn encrypted_secret_permission_policy(path: &std::path::Path) -> KeyCustodyPermissionPolicy {
2004:     let mut policy = KeyCustodyPermissionPolicy::default();
2005:     if matches!(path.parent(), Some(parent) if parent == std::path::Path::new("/etc/rustynet")) {
2006:         // Encrypted signing artifacts currently coexist with daemon-readable verifier
2007:         // material under /etc/rustynet on Linux.
2008:         policy.required_directory_mode = 0o750;
2009:     }
2010:     policy
2011: }
2012: 
2013: fn persist_owner_signing_key_encrypted(
2014:     path: &std::path::Path,
2015:     key_bytes: &[u8; 32],
2016:     passphrase_path: &std::path::Path,
2017:     force: bool,
2018: ) -> Result<(), String> {
2019:     use std::io::ErrorKind;
2020: 
2021:     match std::fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
2022:         Ok(metadata) => {
2023:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
2024:                 return Err(format!(
2025:                     "owner signing key path must not be a symlink: {}",
2026:                     path.display()
2027:                 ));
2028:             }
2029:             if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
2030:                 return Err(format!(
2031:                     "owner signing key path must reference a regular file: {}",
2032:                     path.display()
2033:                 ));
2034:             }
2035:             if !force {
2036:                 return Err(format!(
2037:                     "owner signing key already exists at {}; use --force to overwrite",
2038:                     path.display()
2039:                 ));
2040:             }
2041:             remove_file_if_present(path)?;
2042:         }
2043:         Err(err) if err.kind() == ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
2044:         Err(err) => {
2045:             return Err(format!(
2046:                 "failed to inspect owner signing key {}: {err}",
2047:                 path.display()
2048:             ));
2049:         }
2050:     }
2051: 
2052:     let passphrase = read_passphrase_file_explicit(passphrase_path).map_err(|err| {
2053:         format!(
2054:             "owner signing key passphrase source invalid ({}): {err}",
2055:             passphrase_path.display()
2056:         )
2057:     })?;
2058:     let parent = path
2059:         .parent()
2060:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("owner signing key path has no parent: {}", path.display()))?;
2061:     let permission_policy = encrypted_secret_permission_policy(path);
2062:     write_encrypted_key_file(
2063:         parent,
2064:         path,
2065:         key_bytes,
2066:         passphrase.as_str(),
2067:         permission_policy,
2068:     )
2069:     .map_err(|err| {
2070:         format!(
2071:             "failed to persist encrypted owner signing key {}: {err}",
2072:             path.display()
2073:         )
2074:     })?;
2075:     Ok(())
2076: }
2077: 
2078: fn read_hostname_short() -> String {
2079:     std::fs::read_to_string("/etc/hostname")
2080:         .ok()
2081:         .and_then(|s| s.trim().split('.').next().map(str::to_string))
2082:         .or_else(|| std::env::var("HOSTNAME").ok())
2083:         .unwrap_or_else(|| "local".to_string())
2084: }

2467:     #[cfg(not(windows))]
2468:     #[test]
2469:     fn run_windows_dns_failclosed_check_command_no_fail_on_drift_still_blocks_off_windows() {
2470:         // Off-Windows the collector itself returns a blocker error
2471:         // (not a "drift" outcome), so --no-fail-on-drift cannot
2472:         // smuggle a passing exit out of a host that physically
2473:         // cannot run the probe. This is the difference between an
2474:         // architectural "cannot probe" and a contractual "drift".
2475:         let err = run_windows_dns_failclosed_check_command(&["--no-fail-on-drift".to_string()])
2476:             .expect_err("collector blocker must surface even with --no-fail-on-drift");
2477:         assert!(
2478:             err.contains("requires a Windows runtime host"),
2479:             "unexpected error: {err}"
2480:         );
2481:     }

  316: 
  317: // Minimal network-based signed state fetcher (B1 - pull based). This implements a
  318: // conservative pull path: if a URL environment variable is provided for a state
  319: // artifact, attempt a minimal HTTP GET, verify the returned artifact using the
  320: // existing verification functions, and only persist watermark after success.
  321: // If the endpoint is not configured or the network is unreachable, fall back to
  322: // existing disk-based behavior (do not fail). Any signature/freshness/watermark
  323: // verification failure is treated as a hard error and will be returned.
  324: 
  325: #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
  326: pub enum FetchDecision {
  327:     Skipped, // endpoint not configured or network unreachable -> fallback to disk
  328:     Applied, // fetched and verified; persisted
  329: }
  330: 
  331: pub struct StateFetcher {
  332:     // The daemon paths are passed in for verifier keys and watermark locations.
  333:     trust_verifier_key_path: PathBuf,
  334:     trust_watermark_path: PathBuf,
  335:     trust_evidence_path: PathBuf,
  336:     traversal_verifier_key_path: PathBuf,
  337:     traversal_watermark_path: PathBuf,
  338:     traversal_bundle_path: PathBuf,
  339:     assignment_verifier_key_path: Option<PathBuf>,
  340:     assignment_watermark_path: Option<PathBuf>,
  341:     assignment_bundle_path: Option<PathBuf>,
  342:     dns_zone_verifier_key_path: PathBuf,
  343:     dns_zone_watermark_path: PathBuf,
  344:     dns_zone_bundle_path: PathBuf,
  345:     dns_zone_max_age_secs: NonZeroU64,
  346:     dns_zone_name: String,
  347:     local_node_id: String,
  348:     _auto_tunnel_enforce: bool,
  349:     trust_url: Option<String>,
  350:     traversal_url: Option<String>,
  351:     assignment_url: Option<String>,
  352:     dns_zone_url: Option<String>,
  353: }
  354: 
  355: impl StateFetcher {
  356:     pub fn new_from_daemon(cfg: &DaemonConfig) -> Self {
  357:         Self {
  358:             trust_verifier_key_path: PathBuf::from(&cfg.trust_verifier_key_path),
  359:             trust_watermark_path: PathBuf::from(&cfg.trust_watermark_path),
  360:             trust_evidence_path: PathBuf::from(&cfg.trust_evidence_path),
  361:             traversal_verifier_key_path: PathBuf::from(&cfg.traversal_verifier_key_path),
  362:             traversal_watermark_path: PathBuf::from(&cfg.traversal_watermark_path),
  363:             traversal_bundle_path: PathBuf::from(&cfg.traversal_bundle_path),
  364:             assignment_verifier_key_path: cfg.auto_tunnel_verifier_key_path.clone(),
  365:             assignment_watermark_path: cfg.auto_tunnel_watermark_path.clone(),
  366:             assignment_bundle_path: cfg.auto_tunnel_bundle_path.clone(),
  367:             dns_zone_verifier_key_path: PathBuf::from(&cfg.dns_zone_verifier_key_path),
  368:             dns_zone_watermark_path: PathBuf::from(&cfg.dns_zone_watermark_path),
  369:             dns_zone_bundle_path: PathBuf::from(&cfg.dns_zone_bundle_path),
  370:             dns_zone_max_age_secs: cfg.dns_zone_max_age_secs,
  371:             dns_zone_name: cfg.dns_zone_name.clone(),
  372:             local_node_id: cfg.node_id.clone(),
  373:             _auto_tunnel_enforce: cfg.auto_tunnel_enforce,
  374:             // Hardened daemon paths only consume pinned local custody artifacts.
  375:             trust_url: None,
  376:             traversal_url: None,
  377:             assignment_url: None,
  378:             dns_zone_url: None,
  379:         }
  380:     }
  381: 
  382:     // Minimal HTTP GET using TcpStream. Returns Ok(body_bytes) on success, Err on network error.
  383:     fn http_get_raw(url: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
  384:         // Expect form: http://host[:port]/path
  385:         let url = url.trim();
  386:         if !url.starts_with("http://") {
  387:             return Err("only http:// URLs are supported in this minimal fetcher".to_string());
  388:         }
  389:         let without_proto = &url[7..];
  390:         let parts: Vec<&str> = without_proto.splitn(2, '/').collect();
  391:         let host_port = parts.first().ok_or_else(|| "invalid url".to_string())?;
  392:         let path = format!("/{}", parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&""));
  393:         let mut host = host_port.to_string();
  394:         let mut port = 80u16;
  395:         if host_port.contains(':') {
  396:             let mut hp = host_port.splitn(2, ':');
  397:             host = hp.next().unwrap_or("").to_string();
  398:             if let Some(p) = hp.next() {
  399:                 port = p
  400:                     .parse::<u16>()
  401:                     .map_err(|_| "invalid port in url".to_string())?;
  402:             }
  403:         }
  404:         let addr = format!("{host}:{port}");
  405:         let mut stream = match std::net::TcpStream::connect_timeout(
  406:             &addr
  407:                 .to_socket_addrs()
  408:                 .map_err(|_| "resolve failed".to_string())?
  409:                 .next()
  410:                 .ok_or_else(|| "resolve returned no addresses".to_string())?,
  411:             Duration::from_secs(3),
  412:         ) {
  413:             Ok(s) => s,
  414:             Err(_) => return Err("network unreachable".to_string()),
  415:         };
  416:         stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).ok();
  417:         let request = format!("GET {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {host}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n");
  418:         stream
  419:             .write_all(request.as_bytes())
  420:             .map_err(|_| "write to socket failed".to_string())?;
  421:         let mut buf = Vec::new();
  422:         stream
  423:             .read_to_end(&mut buf)
  424:             .map_err(|_| "read from socket failed".to_string())?;
  425:         // Very minimal HTTP response parsing: look for \r\n\r\n and take the rest as body.
  426:         if let Some(idx) = buf.windows(4).position(|w| w == b"\r\n\r\n") {
  427:             let body = buf.split_off(idx + 4);
  428:             Ok(body)
  429:         } else {
  430:             Err("malformed http response".to_string())
  431:         }
  432:     }
  433: 
  434:     pub fn fetch_trust(&self) -> Result<FetchDecision, String> {
  435:         if let Some(url) = &self.trust_url {
  436:             match Self::http_get_raw(url.as_str()) {
  437:                 Ok(body) => {
  438:                     let tmp = write_secure_staged_artifact(
  439:                         &self.trust_evidence_path,
  440:                         &body,
  441:                         "trust evidence",
  442:                     )?;
  443: 
  444:                     // Load previous watermark (may be missing)
  445:                     let previous_watermark = match load_trust_watermark(&self.trust_watermark_path)
  446:                     {
  447:                         Ok(val) => val,
  448:                         Err(err) => return Err(format!("read previous watermark failed: {err}")),
  449:                     };
  450: 
  451:                     // Use the existing loading/verification routine which enforces signature, age, clock skew, and replay checks.
  452:                     match load_trust_evidence(
  453:                         &tmp,
  454:                         &self.trust_verifier_key_path,
  455:                         TrustPolicy {
  456:                             max_signed_data_age_secs: DEFAULT_TRUST_MAX_AGE_SECS,
  457:                             max_clock_skew_secs: DEFAULT_SIGNED_STATE_MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_SECS,
  458:                         },
  459:                         previous_watermark,
  460:                     ) {
  461:                         Ok(envelope) => {
  462:                             // Atomically persist artifact then persist watermark only after full validation success
  463:                             std::fs::rename(&tmp, &self.trust_evidence_path)
  464:                                 .map_err(|e| format!("persist trust evidence failed: {e}"))?;
  465:                             persist_trust_watermark(&self.trust_watermark_path, envelope.watermark)
  466:                                 .map_err(|e| format!("persist trust watermark failed: {e}"))?;
  467:                             eprintln!(
  468:                                 "statefetch: applied trust bundle: nonce={}",
  469:                                 envelope.watermark.nonce
  470:                             );
  471:                             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied)
  472:                         }
  473:                         Err(err) => {
  474:                             let _ = fs::remove_file(&tmp);
  475:                             Err(format!("trust fetch verification failed: {err}"))
  476:                         }
  477:                     }
  478:                 }
  479:                 Err(_network_err) => Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped),
  480:             }
  481:         } else {
  482:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped)
  483:         }
  484:     }
  485: 
  486:     pub fn fetch_traversal(&self) -> Result<FetchDecision, String> {
  487:         if let Some(url) = &self.traversal_url {
  488:             match Self::http_get_raw(url.as_str()) {
  489:                 Ok(body) => {
  490:                     let tmp = write_secure_staged_artifact(
  491:                         &self.traversal_bundle_path,
  492:                         &body,
  493:                         "traversal bundle",
  494:                     )?;
  495: 
  496:                     let previous_watermark =
  497:                         match load_traversal_watermark(&self.traversal_watermark_path) {
  498:                             Ok(val) => val,
  499:                             Err(err) => {
  500:                                 return Err(format!(
  501:                                     "read previous traversal watermark failed: {err}"
  502:                                 ));
  503:                             }
  504:                         };
  505: 
  506:                     match load_traversal_bundle_set(
  507:                         &tmp,
  508:                         &self.traversal_verifier_key_path,
  509:                         DEFAULT_TRAVERSAL_MAX_AGE_SECS,
  510:                         TrustPolicy {
  511:                             max_signed_data_age_secs: DEFAULT_TRAVERSAL_MAX_AGE_SECS,
  512:                             max_clock_skew_secs: DEFAULT_SIGNED_STATE_MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_SECS,
  513:                         },
  514:                         previous_watermark,
  515:                     ) {
  516:                         Ok(envelope) => {
  517:                             std::fs::rename(&tmp, &self.traversal_bundle_path)
  518:                                 .map_err(|e| format!("persist traversal bundle failed: {e}"))?;
  519:                             persist_traversal_watermark(
  520:                                 &self.traversal_watermark_path,
  521:                                 envelope.watermark,
  522:                             )
  523:                             .map_err(|e| format!("persist traversal watermark failed: {e}"))?;
  524:                             eprintln!(
  525:                                 "statefetch: applied traversal bundle: nonce={}",
  526:                                 envelope.watermark.nonce
  527:                             );
  528:                             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied)
  529:                         }
  530:                         Err(err) => {
  531:                             let _ = fs::remove_file(&tmp);
  532:                             Err(format!("traversal fetch verification failed: {err}"))
  533:                         }
  534:                     }
  535:                 }
  536:                 Err(_network_err) => Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped),
  537:             }
  538:         } else {
  539:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped)
  540:         }
  541:     }
  542: 
  543:     pub fn fetch_assignment(&self) -> Result<FetchDecision, String> {
  544:         if let Some(url) = &self.assignment_url {
  545:             // require assignment paths configured
  546:             let bundle_path = match &self.assignment_bundle_path {
  547:                 Some(p) => p,
  548:                 None => return Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped),
  549:             };
  550:             let verifier_path = match &self.assignment_verifier_key_path {
  551:                 Some(p) => p,
  552:                 None => return Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped),
  553:             };
  554:             let watermark_path = match &self.assignment_watermark_path {
  555:                 Some(p) => p,
  556:                 None => return Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped),
  557:             };
  558:             match Self::http_get_raw(url.as_str()) {
  559:                 Ok(body) => {
  560:                     let tmp =
  561:                         write_secure_staged_artifact(bundle_path, &body, "assignment bundle")?;
  562: 
  563:                     let previous_watermark = match load_auto_tunnel_watermark(watermark_path) {
  564:                         Ok(val) => val,
  565:                         Err(err) => {
  566:                             return Err(format!(
  567:                                 "read previous assignment watermark failed: {err}"
  568:                             ));
  569:                         }
  570:                     };
  571: 
  572:                     match load_auto_tunnel_bundle(
  573:                         &tmp,
  574:                         verifier_path,
  575:                         self.assignment_bundle_path
  576:                             .as_deref()
  577:                             .map(|_| DEFAULT_AUTO_TUNNEL_MAX_AGE_SECS)
  578:                             .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_AUTO_TUNNEL_MAX_AGE_SECS),
  579:                         TrustPolicy {
  580:                             max_signed_data_age_secs: self
  581:                                 .assignment_bundle_path
  582:                                 .as_deref()
  583:                                 .map(|_| DEFAULT_AUTO_TUNNEL_MAX_AGE_SECS)
  584:                                 .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_AUTO_TUNNEL_MAX_AGE_SECS),
  585:                             max_clock_skew_secs: DEFAULT_SIGNED_STATE_MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_SECS,
  586:                         },
  587:                         previous_watermark,
  588:                     ) {
  589:                         Ok(envelope) => {
  590:                             std::fs::rename(&tmp, bundle_path)
  591:                                 .map_err(|e| format!("persist assignment bundle failed: {e}"))?;
  592:                             persist_auto_tunnel_watermark(watermark_path, envelope.watermark)
  593:                                 .map_err(|e| format!("persist assignment watermark failed: {e}"))?;
  594:                             eprintln!(
  595:                                 "statefetch: applied assignment bundle: nonce={}",
  596:                                 envelope.watermark.nonce
  597:                             );
  598:                             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied)
  599:                         }
  600:                         Err(err) => {
  601:                             let _ = fs::remove_file(&tmp);
  602:                             Err(format!("assignment fetch verification failed: {err}"))
  603:                         }
  604:                     }
  605:                 }
  606:                 Err(_network_err) => Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped),
  607:             }
  608:         } else {
  609:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped)
  610:         }
  611:     }
  612: 
  613:     pub fn fetch_dns_zone(
  614:         &self,
  615:         auto_bundle: Option<&AutoTunnelBundle>,
  616:     ) -> Result<FetchDecision, String> {
  617:         if let Some(url) = &self.dns_zone_url {
  618:             match Self::http_get_raw(url.as_str()) {
  619:                 Ok(body) => {
  620:                     let tmp = write_secure_staged_artifact(
  621:                         &self.dns_zone_bundle_path,
  622:                         &body,
  623:                         "dns zone bundle",
  624:                     )?;
  625: 
  626:                     // parse verifier key
  627:                     let verifier_key = std::fs::read_to_string(&self.dns_zone_verifier_key_path)
  628:                         .map_err(|e| format!("read dns verifier key failed: {e}"))?;
  629:                     let _verifier = parse_dns_zone_verifying_key(&verifier_key)
  630:                         .map_err(|e| format!("parse dns verifier key failed: {e}"))?;
  631: 
  632:                     // load previous watermark (may be missing)
  633:                     let previous = load_dns_zone_watermark(&self.dns_zone_watermark_path)
  634:                         .map_err(|e| format!("read previous dns watermark failed: {e}"))?;
  635: 
  636:                     let dummy_bundle = AutoTunnelBundle {
  637:                         node_id: String::new(),
  638:                         mesh_cidr: String::new(),
  639:                         assigned_cidr: String::new(),
  640:                         peers: Vec::new(),
  641:                         routes: Vec::new(),
  642:                         selected_exit_node: None,
  643:                     };
  644:                     let context_bundle = auto_bundle.unwrap_or(&dummy_bundle);
  645: 
  646:                     match load_dns_zone_bundle(DnsZoneLoadContext {
  647:                         path: &tmp,
  648:                         verifier_key_path: &self.dns_zone_verifier_key_path,
  649:                         max_age_secs: self.dns_zone_max_age_secs.get(),
  650:                         trust_policy: TrustPolicy {
  651:                             max_signed_data_age_secs: self.dns_zone_max_age_secs.get(),
  652:                             max_clock_skew_secs: DEFAULT_SIGNED_STATE_MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_SECS,
  653:                         },
  654:                         previous_watermark: previous,
  655:                         expected_zone_name: &self.dns_zone_name,
  656:                         local_node_id: &self.local_node_id,
  657:                         auto_tunnel: context_bundle,
  658:                     }) {
  659:                         Ok(envelope) => {
  660:                             std::fs::rename(&tmp, &self.dns_zone_bundle_path)
  661:                                 .map_err(|e| format!("persist dns zone bundle failed: {e}"))?;
  662:                             persist_dns_zone_watermark(
  663:                                 &self.dns_zone_watermark_path,
  664:                                 envelope.watermark,
  665:                             )
  666:                             .map_err(|e| format!("persist dns zone watermark failed: {e}"))?;
  667:                             eprintln!(
  668:                                 "statefetch: applied dns zone bundle: updated_at={}",
  669:                                 envelope.watermark.generated_at_unix
  670:                             );
  671:                             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied)
  672:                         }
  673:                         Err(err) => {
  674:                             let _ = fs::remove_file(&tmp);
  675:                             Err(format!("dns zone fetch verification failed: {err}"))
  676:                         }
  677:                     }
  678:                 }
  679:                 Err(_network_err) => Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped),
  680:             }
  681:         } else {
  682:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped)
  683:         }
  684:     }
  685: }
  686: 
  687: fn write_secure_staged_artifact(
  688:     destination: &Path,
  689:     body: &[u8],
  690:     label: &str,
  691: ) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
  692:     let parent = destination.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
  693:         format!(
  694:             "{label} destination must have a parent directory: {}",
  695:             destination.display()
  696:         )
  697:     })?;
  698:     let basename = destination
  699:         .file_name()
  700:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
  701:         .unwrap_or("artifact");
  702:     for attempt in 0..32u32 {
  703:         let salt = rand::random::<u64>();
  704:         let candidate = parent.join(format!(
  705:             ".{basename}.incoming.{}.{}.{}",
  706:             std::process::id(),
  707:             salt,
  708:             attempt
  709:         ));
  710:         let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
  711:         options.write(true).create_new(true);
  712:         #[cfg(not(windows))]
  713:         {
  714:             options.mode(0o600);
  715:         }
  716:         match options.open(&candidate) {
  717:             Ok(mut file) => {
  718:                 file.write_all(body).map_err(|err| {
  719:                     let _ = fs::remove_file(&candidate);
  720:                     format!(
  721:                         "write staged {label} failed ({}): {err}",
  722:                         candidate.display()
  723:                     )
  724:                 })?;
  725:                 file.flush().map_err(|err| {
  726:                     let _ = fs::remove_file(&candidate);
  727:                     format!(
  728:                         "flush staged {label} failed ({}): {err}",
  729:                         candidate.display()
  730:                     )
  731:                 })?;
  732:                 return Ok(candidate);
  733:             }
  734:             Err(err) if err.kind() == ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
  735:             Err(err) => {
  736:                 return Err(format!(
  737:                     "create staged {label} failed ({}): {err}",
  738:                     candidate.display()
  739:                 ));
  740:             }
  741:         }
  742:     }
  743:     Err(format!(
  744:         "failed to allocate unique staged {label} near {}",
  745:         destination.display()
  746:     ))
  747: }

  749: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
  750: pub enum DaemonDataplaneMode {
  751:     #[default]
  752:     Shell,
  753:     HybridNative,
  754: }
  755: 
  756: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
  757: pub enum DaemonBackendMode {
  758:     InMemory,
  759:     LinuxWireguard,
  760:     LinuxWireguardUserspaceShared,
  761:     MacosWireguard,
  762:     MacosWireguardUserspaceShared,
  763:     WindowsWireguardNt,
  764:     WindowsUnsupported,
  765: }
  766: 
  767: #[allow(clippy::derivable_impls)]
  768: impl Default for DaemonBackendMode {
  769:     fn default() -> Self {
  770:         #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
  771:         {
  772:             return DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard;
  773:         }
  774:         #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
  775:         {
  776:             return DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguard;
  777:         }
  778:         #[cfg(windows)]
  779:         {
  780:             return DaemonBackendMode::WindowsUnsupported;
  781:         }
  782:         #[allow(unreachable_code)]
  783:         DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard
  784:     }
  785: }
  786: 
  787: impl DaemonBackendMode {
  788:     fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
  789:         match self {
  790:             DaemonBackendMode::InMemory => "in-memory",
  791:             DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard => "linux-wireguard",
  792:             DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguardUserspaceShared => "linux-wireguard-userspace-shared",
  793:             DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguard => "macos-wireguard",
  794:             DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguardUserspaceShared => "macos-wireguard-userspace-shared",
  795:             DaemonBackendMode::WindowsWireguardNt => WINDOWS_WIREGUARD_NT_BACKEND_LABEL,
  796:             DaemonBackendMode::WindowsUnsupported => WINDOWS_UNSUPPORTED_BACKEND_LABEL,
  797:         }
  798:     }
  799: 
  800:     fn userspace_shared_blocker(self) -> Option<&'static str> {
  801:         match self {
  802:             DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguardUserspaceShared => Some(
  803:                 "macos-wireguard-userspace-shared backend is not implemented: crates/rustynet-backend-wireguard currently contains only the command-only macOS wireguard-go adapter plus the in-memory shared-transport test backend, and the repository does not yet provide a backend-owned Rust userspace WireGuard engine or TUN/runtime datapath that can own the authoritative peer UDP socket for peer traffic, STUN, and relay control on the same transport identity",
  804:             ),
  805:             _ => None,
  806:         }
  807:     }
  808: 
  809:     fn requires_runtime_wireguard_key_material(self) -> bool {
  810:         matches!(
  811:             self,
  812:             DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard
  813:                 | DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguardUserspaceShared
  814:                 | DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguard
  815:                 | DaemonBackendMode::WindowsWireguardNt
  816:         )
  817:     }
  818: }

  820: #[cfg(not(windows))]
  821: fn validate_control_socket_path(path: &Path) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
  822:     if !path.is_absolute() {
  823:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
  824:             "socket path must be absolute".to_string(),
  825:         ));
  826:     }
  827:     Ok(())
  828: }

  832:     validate_windows_pipe_path(path, WindowsLocalIpcRole::DaemonControl)
  833:         .map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)

  837: fn validate_privileged_helper_control_path(path: &Path) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {

  846: #[cfg(windows)]
  847: fn validate_privileged_helper_control_path(path: &Path) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
  848:     validate_windows_pipe_path(path, WindowsLocalIpcRole::PrivilegedHelper)
  849:         .map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)
  850: }
  851: 
  852: #[cfg(not(windows))]
  853: fn validate_runtime_file_path(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
  854:     if !path.is_absolute() {
  855:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
  856:             "{label} path must be absolute"
  857:         )));
  858:     }
  859:     Ok(())
  860: }
  861: 
  862: #[cfg(windows)]
  863: fn validate_runtime_file_path(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
  864:     validate_windows_runtime_file_path(path, label).map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)
  865: }
  866: 
  867: #[cfg(not(windows))]
  868: fn validate_backend_supported_on_current_host(
  869:     backend_mode: DaemonBackendMode,
  870: ) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
  871:     if matches!(
  872:         backend_mode,
  873:         DaemonBackendMode::WindowsUnsupported | DaemonBackendMode::WindowsWireguardNt
  874:     ) {
  875:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
  876:             "backend '{}' is only valid on Windows daemon hosts and remains outside non-Windows daemon support",
  877:             backend_mode.as_str()
  878:         )));
  879:     }
  880:     Ok(())
  881: }
  882: 
  883: #[cfg(windows)]
  884: fn validate_backend_supported_on_current_host(
  885:     backend_mode: DaemonBackendMode,
  886: ) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
  887:     match backend_mode {
  888:         DaemonBackendMode::WindowsUnsupported => {
  889:             require_supported_windows_backend(WindowsBackendMode::Unsupported)
  890:                 .map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)
  891:         }
  892:         DaemonBackendMode::WindowsWireguardNt => {
  893:             require_supported_windows_backend(WindowsBackendMode::WireguardNt)
  894:                 .map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)
  895:         }
  896:         _ => Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
  897:             "backend '{}' is not supported on Windows daemon hosts; the Windows service/config host is present, but reviewed backend/dataplane support remains unavailable on the current branch",
  898:             backend_mode.as_str()
  899:         ))),
  900:     }
  901: }
  902: 
  903: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
  904: pub enum NodeRole {
  905:     #[default]
  906:     Admin,
  907:     Client,
  908:     BlindExit,
  909: }
  910: 
  911: impl NodeRole {
  912:     fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
  913:         match self {
  914:             NodeRole::Admin => "admin",
  915:             NodeRole::Client => "client",
  916:             NodeRole::BlindExit => "blind_exit",
  917:         }
  918:     }
  919: 
  920:     fn is_blind_exit(self) -> bool {
  921:         matches!(self, NodeRole::BlindExit)
  922:     }
  923: 
  924:     fn is_admin(self) -> bool {
  925:         matches!(self, NodeRole::Admin)
  926:     }
  927: 
  928:     fn allows_command(self, command: &IpcCommand) -> bool {
  929:         match self {
  930:             NodeRole::Admin => true,
  931:             NodeRole::Client => matches!(
  932:                 command,
  933:                 IpcCommand::Status
  934:                     | IpcCommand::Netcheck
  935:                     | IpcCommand::StateRefresh
  936:                     | IpcCommand::ExitNodeSelect(_)
  937:                     | IpcCommand::ExitNodeOff
  938:                     | IpcCommand::LanAccessOn
  939:                     | IpcCommand::LanAccessOff
  940:                     | IpcCommand::DnsInspect
  941:             ),
  942:             NodeRole::BlindExit => matches!(
  943:                 command,
  944:                 IpcCommand::Status
  945:                     | IpcCommand::Netcheck
  946:                     | IpcCommand::StateRefresh
  947:                     | IpcCommand::DnsInspect
  948:             ),
  949:         }
  950:     }
  951: }
  952: 
  953: impl std::str::FromStr for NodeRole {
  954:     type Err = String;
  955: 
  956:     fn from_str(value: &str) -> Result<Self, Self::Err> {
  957:         match value {
  958:             "admin" => Ok(NodeRole::Admin),
  959:             "client" => Ok(NodeRole::Client),
  960:             "blind_exit" | "blind-exit" => Ok(NodeRole::BlindExit),
  961:             _ => Err("invalid node role: expected admin, client, or blind_exit".to_string()),
  962:         }
  963:     }
  964: }
  965: 
  966: fn sanitize_dataplane_routes_for_node_role(node_role: NodeRole, routes: Vec<Route>) -> Vec<Route> {
  967:     if !node_role.is_blind_exit() {
  968:         return routes;
  969:     }
  970: 
  971:     routes
  972:         .into_iter()
  973:         .filter(|route| {
  974:             !matches!(
  975:                 route.kind,
  976:                 RouteKind::ExitNodeDefault | RouteKind::ExitNodeLan
  977:             )
  978:         })
  979:         .collect()
  980: }
  981:

 1470: fn format_stun_local_addrs(observations: &[StunResult]) -> String {
 1471:     if observations.is_empty() {
 1472:         return "none".to_string();
 1473:     }
 1474:     observations
 1475:         .iter()
 1476:         .map(|result| result.local_addr.to_string())
 1477:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 1478:         .join(",")
 1479: }
 1480: 
 1481: fn stun_local_port_match_state(observations: &[StunResult], wg_listen_port: u16) -> &'static str {
 1482:     let mut any_match = false;
 1483:     let mut any_mismatch = false;
 1484:     for observation in observations {
 1485:         if observation.local_addr.port() == wg_listen_port {
 1486:             any_match = true;
 1487:         } else {
 1488:             any_mismatch = true;
 1489:         }
 1490:     }
 1491:     match (any_match, any_mismatch) {
 1492:         (false, false) => "none",
 1493:         (true, false) => "all_match_wg_listen_port",
 1494:         (false, true) => "all_mismatch_wg_listen_port",
 1495:         (true, true) => "mixed",
 1496:     }
 1497: }

 1610: pub struct SignedTraversalVerificationReport {
 1611:     pub generated_at_unix: u64,
 1612:     pub expires_at_unix: u64,
 1613:     pub nonce: u64,
 1614:     pub payload_digest_sha256: String,
