 1620: pub fn verify_signed_trust_state_artifact(
 1621:     evidence_path: &Path,
 1622:     verifier_key_path: &Path,
 1623:     watermark_path: &Path,
 1624:     max_age_secs: u64,
 1625:     max_clock_skew_secs: u64,
 1626: ) -> Result<SignedTrustVerificationReport, String> {
 1627:     if max_age_secs == 0 {
 1628:         return Err("trust max age seconds must be greater than zero".to_string());
 1629:     }
 1630:     if max_clock_skew_secs == 0 {
 1631:         return Err("trust max clock skew seconds must be greater than zero".to_string());
 1632:     }
 1633: 
 1634:     let previous_watermark = load_trust_watermark(watermark_path).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 1635:     let previous_watermark = previous_watermark
 1636:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("trust watermark is missing: {}", watermark_path.display()))?;
 1637:     let trust_policy = TrustPolicy {
 1638:         max_signed_data_age_secs: max_age_secs,
 1639:         max_clock_skew_secs,
 1640:     };
 1641:     let envelope = load_trust_evidence(
 1642:         evidence_path,
 1643:         verifier_key_path,
 1644:         trust_policy,
 1645:         Some(previous_watermark),
 1646:     )
 1647:     .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 1648:     if !envelope.evidence.tls13_valid {
 1649:         return Err("trust evidence tls13_valid=false".to_string());
 1650:     }
 1651:     if !envelope.evidence.signed_control_valid {
 1652:         return Err("trust evidence signed_control_valid=false".to_string());
 1653:     }
 1654:     if envelope.evidence.signed_data_age_secs > max_age_secs {
 1655:         return Err(format!(
 1656:             "trust evidence signed_data_age_secs exceeds max age: {} > {}",
 1657:             envelope.evidence.signed_data_age_secs, max_age_secs
 1658:         ));
 1659:     }
 1660:     if envelope.evidence.clock_skew_secs > max_clock_skew_secs {
 1661:         return Err(format!(
 1662:             "trust evidence clock_skew_secs exceeds max skew: {} > {}",
 1663:             envelope.evidence.clock_skew_secs, max_clock_skew_secs
 1664:         ));
 1665:     }
 1666:     let payload_digest = envelope
 1667:         .watermark
 1668:         .payload_digest
 1669:         .ok_or_else(|| "trust watermark payload digest is missing".to_string())?;
 1670: 
 1671:     Ok(SignedTrustVerificationReport {
 1672:         updated_at_unix: envelope.watermark.updated_at_unix,
 1673:         nonce: envelope.watermark.nonce,
 1674:         payload_digest_sha256: encode_hex(&payload_digest),
 1675:         tls13_valid: envelope.evidence.tls13_valid,
 1676:         signed_control_valid: envelope.evidence.signed_control_valid,
 1677:         signed_data_age_secs: envelope.evidence.signed_data_age_secs,
 1678:         clock_skew_secs: envelope.evidence.clock_skew_secs,
 1679:     })
 1680: }
 1681: 
 1682: pub fn verify_signed_assignment_state_artifact(
 1683:     bundle_path: &Path,
 1684:     verifier_key_path: &Path,
 1685:     watermark_path: &Path,
 1686:     max_age_secs: u64,
 1687:     max_clock_skew_secs: u64,
 1688:     expected_node_id: Option<&str>,
 1689: ) -> Result<SignedAssignmentVerificationReport, String> {
 1690:     if max_age_secs == 0 {
 1691:         return Err("assignment max age seconds must be greater than zero".to_string());
 1692:     }
 1693:     if max_clock_skew_secs == 0 {
 1694:         return Err("assignment max clock skew seconds must be greater than zero".to_string());
 1695:     }
 1696: 
 1697:     let previous_watermark =
 1698:         load_auto_tunnel_watermark(watermark_path).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 1699:     let previous_watermark = previous_watermark.ok_or_else(|| {
 1700:         format!(
 1701:             "assignment watermark is missing: {}",
 1702:             watermark_path.display()
 1703:         )
 1704:     })?;
 1705:     let trust_policy = TrustPolicy {
 1706:         max_signed_data_age_secs: max_age_secs,
 1707:         max_clock_skew_secs,
 1708:     };
 1709:     let envelope = load_auto_tunnel_bundle(
 1710:         bundle_path,
 1711:         verifier_key_path,
 1712:         max_age_secs,
 1713:         trust_policy,
 1714:         Some(previous_watermark),
 1715:     )
 1716:     .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 1717:     if let Some(expected_node_id) = expected_node_id
 1718:         && envelope.bundle.node_id != expected_node_id
 1719:     {
 1720:         return Err(format!(
 1721:             "assignment bundle node_id mismatch: expected {}, got {}",
 1722:             expected_node_id, envelope.bundle.node_id
 1723:         ));
 1724:     }
 1725:     let payload_digest = envelope
 1726:         .watermark
 1727:         .payload_digest
 1728:         .ok_or_else(|| "assignment watermark payload digest is missing".to_string())?;
 1729: 
 1730:     Ok(SignedAssignmentVerificationReport {
 1731:         node_id: envelope.bundle.node_id,
 1732:         generated_at_unix: envelope.watermark.generated_at_unix,
 1733:         nonce: envelope.watermark.nonce,
 1734:         payload_digest_sha256: encode_hex(&payload_digest),
 1735:         peer_count: envelope.bundle.peers.len(),
 1736:         route_count: envelope.bundle.routes.len(),
 1737:         selected_exit_node: envelope.bundle.selected_exit_node,
 1738:     })
 1739: }
 1740: 
 1741: pub fn verify_signed_traversal_state_artifact(
 1742:     bundle_path: &Path,
 1743:     verifier_key_path: &Path,
 1744:     watermark_path: &Path,
 1745:     max_age_secs: u64,
 1746:     max_clock_skew_secs: u64,
 1747:     expected_source_node_id: Option<&str>,
 1748: ) -> Result<SignedTraversalVerificationReport, String> {
 1749:     if max_age_secs == 0 {
 1750:         return Err("traversal max age seconds must be greater than zero".to_string());
 1751:     }
 1752:     if max_clock_skew_secs == 0 {
 1753:         return Err("traversal max clock skew seconds must be greater than zero".to_string());
 1754:     }
 1755: 
 1756:     let previous_watermark =
 1757:         load_traversal_watermark(watermark_path).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 1758:     let previous_watermark = previous_watermark.ok_or_else(|| {
 1759:         format!(
 1760:             "traversal watermark is missing: {}",
 1761:             watermark_path.display()
 1762:         )
 1763:     })?;
 1764:     let trust_policy = TrustPolicy {
 1765:         max_signed_data_age_secs: max_age_secs,
 1766:         max_clock_skew_secs,
 1767:     };
 1768:     let envelope = load_traversal_bundle_set(
 1769:         bundle_path,
 1770:         verifier_key_path,
 1771:         max_age_secs,
 1772:         trust_policy,
 1773:         Some(previous_watermark),
 1774:     )
 1775:     .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 1776:     if envelope.bundles.is_empty() {
 1777:         return Err("verified traversal bundle set is empty".to_string());
 1778:     }
 1779: 
 1780:     let mut source_node_ids = BTreeSet::new();
 1781:     let mut target_node_ids = BTreeSet::new();
 1782:     for bundle in &envelope.bundles {
 1783:         if let Some(expected_source_node_id) = expected_source_node_id
 1784:             && bundle.bundle.source_node_id != expected_source_node_id
 1785:         {
 1786:             return Err(format!(
 1787:                 "traversal bundle source_node_id mismatch: expected {}, got {}",
 1788:                 expected_source_node_id, bundle.bundle.source_node_id
 1789:             ));
 1790:         }
 1791:         source_node_ids.insert(bundle.bundle.source_node_id.clone());
 1792:         target_node_ids.insert(bundle.bundle.target_node_id.clone());
 1793:     }
 1794: 
 1795:     let first_bundle = envelope
 1796:         .bundles
 1797:         .first()
 1798:         .ok_or_else(|| "verified traversal bundle set is empty".to_string())?;
 1799:     let payload_digest = envelope
 1800:         .watermark
 1801:         .payload_digest
 1802:         .ok_or_else(|| "traversal watermark payload digest is missing".to_string())?;
 1803: 
 1804:     Ok(SignedTraversalVerificationReport {
 1805:         generated_at_unix: first_bundle.bundle.generated_at_unix,
 1806:         expires_at_unix: first_bundle.bundle.expires_at_unix,
 1807:         nonce: first_bundle.bundle.nonce,
 1808:         payload_digest_sha256: encode_hex(&payload_digest),
 1809:         bundle_count: envelope.bundles.len(),
 1810:         source_node_ids: source_node_ids.into_iter().collect(),
 1811:         target_node_ids: target_node_ids.into_iter().collect(),
 1812:     })
 1813: }

 1815: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 1816: enum MembershipBootstrapError {
 1817:     MissingSnapshot,
 1818:     MissingLog,
 1819:     SnapshotLoad(String),
 1820:     LogLoad(String),
 1821:     Replay(String),
 1822:     InvalidRoot,
 1823:     WatermarkReplay,
 1824:     LocalNodeNotActive,
 1825:     ExitNodeNotActive(String),
 1826:     Io(String),
 1827: }
 1828: 
 1829: impl fmt::Display for MembershipBootstrapError {
 1830:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
 1831:         match self {
 1832:             MembershipBootstrapError::MissingSnapshot => {
 1833:                 f.write_str("membership snapshot is missing")
 1834:             }
 1835:             MembershipBootstrapError::MissingLog => f.write_str("membership log is missing"),
 1836:             MembershipBootstrapError::SnapshotLoad(msg) => {
 1837:                 write!(f, "membership snapshot load failed: {msg}")
 1838:             }
 1839:             MembershipBootstrapError::LogLoad(msg) => {
 1840:                 write!(f, "membership log load failed: {msg}")
 1841:             }
 1842:             MembershipBootstrapError::Replay(msg) => {
 1843:                 write!(f, "membership replay failed: {msg}")
 1844:             }
 1845:             MembershipBootstrapError::InvalidRoot => {
 1846:                 f.write_str("membership root verification failed")
 1847:             }
 1848:             MembershipBootstrapError::WatermarkReplay => {
 1849:                 f.write_str("membership replay/rollback detected by watermark")
 1850:             }
 1851:             MembershipBootstrapError::LocalNodeNotActive => {
 1852:                 f.write_str("local node is not active in membership state")
 1853:             }
 1854:             MembershipBootstrapError::ExitNodeNotActive(node_id) => {
 1855:                 write!(f, "selected exit node is not active: {node_id}")
 1856:             }
 1857:             MembershipBootstrapError::Io(msg) => write!(f, "membership io failure: {msg}"),
 1858:         }
 1859:     }
 1860: }

 1898: 
 1899:     fn helper_program_for(program: &str) -> Result<PrivilegedCommandProgram, BackendError> {
 1900:         match program {

 1902:             "wg" => Ok(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Wg),
 1903:             "ifconfig" => Ok(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ifconfig),
 1904:             "route" => Ok(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Route),
 1905:             "wireguard-go" => Ok(PrivilegedCommandProgram::WireguardGo),
 1906:             "kill" => Ok(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Kill),
 1907:             _ => Err(BackendError::invalid_input(
 1908:                 "unsupported privileged wireguard backend command",
 1909:             )),
 1910:         }
 1911:     }
 1912: }
 1913: 
 1914: #[cfg(any(target_os = "linux", target_os = "macos"))]
 1915: impl WireguardCommandRunner for PrivilegedHelperWireguardRunner {
 1916:     fn run(&mut self, program: &str, args: &[String]) -> Result<(), BackendError> {
 1917:         let _ = self.run_capture(program, args)?;
 1918:         Ok(())
 1919:     }
 1920: 
 1921:     fn run_capture(
 1922:         &mut self,
 1923:         program: &str,
 1924:         args: &[String],
 1925:     ) -> Result<WireguardCommandOutput, BackendError> {
 1926:         let helper_program = Self::helper_program_for(program)?;
 1927:         let arg_refs = args.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 1928:         let output = self
 1929:             .helper_client
 1930:             .run_capture(helper_program, &arg_refs)
 1931:             .map_err(|err| {
 1932:                 BackendError::internal(format!(
 1933:                     "privileged helper {program} invocation failed: {err}"
 1934:                 ))
 1935:             })?;
 1936: 
 1937:         if output.success() {
 1938:             return Ok(WireguardCommandOutput {
 1939:                 stdout: output.stdout,
 1940:                 stderr: output.stderr,
 1941:             });
 1942:         }
 1943: 
 1944:         let stderr = output.stderr.trim();
 1945:         if stderr.is_empty() {
 1946:             return Err(BackendError::internal(format!(
 1947:                 "privileged helper {program} exited with status {}",
 1948:                 output.status
 1949:             )));
 1950:         }
 1951: 
 1952:         Err(BackendError::internal(format!(
 1953:             "privileged helper {program} exited with status {}: {stderr}",
 1954:             output.status
 1955:         )))
 1956:     }
 1957: }
 1958: 
 1959: #[cfg(windows)]
 1960: impl WireguardCommandRunner for WindowsHostWireguardRunner {
 1961:     fn run(&mut self, program: &str, args: &[String]) -> Result<(), BackendError> {
 1962:         let _ = self.run_capture(program, args)?;
 1963:         Ok(())
 1964:     }
 1965: 
 1966:     fn run_capture(
 1967:         &mut self,
 1968:         program: &str,
 1969:         args: &[String],
 1970:     ) -> Result<WireguardCommandOutput, BackendError> {
 1971:         let program_path = Path::new(program);
 1972:         if !program_path.is_absolute() {
 1973:             return Err(BackendError::invalid_input(
 1974:                 "windows backend command path must be absolute",
 1975:             ));
 1976:         }
 1977:         let output = Command::new(program_path)
 1978:             .args(args)
 1979:             .output()
 1980:             .map_err(|err| {
 1981:                 BackendError::internal(format!(
 1982:                     "windows backend command spawn failed ({}): {err}",
 1983:                     program_path.display()
 1984:                 ))
 1985:             })?;
 1986:         Ok(WireguardCommandOutput {
 1987:             stdout: String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string(),
 1988:             stderr: String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string(),
 1989:         })
 1990:     }
 1991: }

 1993: impl DaemonBackend {
 1994:     fn from_config(config: &DaemonConfig) -> Result<Self, DaemonError> {
 1995:         match config.backend_mode {
 1996:             DaemonBackendMode::InMemory => {
 1997:                 #[cfg(test)]
 1998:                 {
 1999:                     Ok(Self::InMemory(WireguardBackend::default()))
 2000:                 }
 2001:                 #[cfg(not(test))]
 2002:                 {
 2003:                     Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2004:                         "in-memory backend is disabled in production daemon paths".to_string(),
 2005:                     ))
 2006:                 }
 2007:             }
 2008:             DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard => {
 2009:                 #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
 2010:                 {
 2011:                     let helper_socket = config
 2012:                         .privileged_helper_socket_path
 2013:                         .as_ref()
 2014:                         .ok_or_else(|| {
 2015:                             DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2016:                                 "privileged helper socket path is required for linux-wireguard backend"
 2017:                                     .to_string(),
 2018:                             )
 2019:                         })?;
 2020:                     let private_key = config.wg_private_key_path.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
 2021:                         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2022:                             "wg private key path is required for linux-wireguard backend"
 2023:                                 .to_string(),
 2024:                         )
 2025:                     })?;
 2026:                     validate_private_key_permissions(private_key)?;
 2027:                     let helper_client = PrivilegedCommandClient::new(
 2028:                         helper_socket.clone(),
 2029:                         Duration::from_millis(config.privileged_helper_timeout_ms.get()),
 2030:                     )
 2031:                     .map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)?;
 2032:                     let backend = LinuxWireguardBackend::new(
 2033:                         PrivilegedHelperWireguardRunner::new(helper_client),
 2034:                         config.wg_interface.clone(),
 2035:                         private_key.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 2036:                         config.wg_listen_port,
 2037:                     )
 2038:                     .map_err(|err| DaemonError::InvalidConfig(err.to_string()))?;
 2039:                     Ok(Self::Linux(backend))
 2040:                 }
 2041:                 #[cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))]
 2042:                 {
 2043:                     Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2044:                         "linux-wireguard backend is only supported on linux".to_string(),
 2045:                     ))
 2046:                 }
 2047:             }
 2048:             DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguardUserspaceShared => {
 2049:                 let private_key = config.wg_private_key_path.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
 2050:                     DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2051:                         "wg private key path is required for linux-wireguard-userspace-shared backend"
 2052:                             .to_string(),
 2053:                     )
 2054:                 })?;
 2055:                 validate_private_key_permissions(private_key)?;
 2056:                 #[cfg(test)]
 2057:                 {
 2058:                     let backend = LinuxUserspaceSharedBackend::new_for_test(
 2059:                         config.wg_interface.clone(),
 2060:                         private_key.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 2061:                         config.wg_listen_port,
 2062:                     )
 2063:                     .map_err(|err| DaemonError::InvalidConfig(err.to_string()))?;
 2064:                     Ok(Self::LinuxUserspaceShared(backend))
 2065:                 }
 2066:                 #[cfg(all(not(test), target_os = "linux"))]
 2067:                 {
 2068:                     let helper_socket = config
 2069:                         .privileged_helper_socket_path
 2070:                         .as_ref()
 2071:                         .ok_or_else(|| {
 2072:                             DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2073:                                 "privileged helper socket path is required for linux-wireguard-userspace-shared backend"
 2074:                                     .to_string(),
 2075:                             )
 2076:                         })?;
 2077:                     let helper_client = PrivilegedCommandClient::new(
 2078:                         helper_socket.clone(),
 2079:                         Duration::from_millis(config.privileged_helper_timeout_ms.get()),
 2080:                     )
 2081:                     .map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)?;
 2082:                     let backend = LinuxUserspaceSharedBackend::new_with_helper_runner(
 2083:                         config.wg_interface.clone(),
 2084:                         private_key.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 2085:                         config.wg_listen_port,
 2086:                         PrivilegedHelperWireguardRunner::new(helper_client),
 2087:                         Uid::effective().as_raw(),
 2088:                         Gid::effective().as_raw(),
 2089:                     )
 2090:                     .map_err(|err| DaemonError::InvalidConfig(err.to_string()))?;
 2091:                     Ok(Self::LinuxUserspaceShared(backend))
 2092:                 }
 2093:                 #[cfg(all(not(test), not(target_os = "linux")))]
 2094:                 {
 2095:                     Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2096:                         "linux-wireguard-userspace-shared backend is only supported on linux"
 2097:                             .to_string(),
 2098:                     ))
 2099:                 }
 2100:             }
 2101:             DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguard => {
 2102:                 #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
 2103:                 {
 2104:                     let helper_socket = config
 2105:                         .privileged_helper_socket_path
 2106:                         .as_ref()
 2107:                         .ok_or_else(|| {
 2108:                             DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2109:                                 "privileged helper socket path is required for macos-wireguard backend"
 2110:                                     .to_string(),
 2111:                             )
 2112:                         })?;
 2113:                     let private_key = config.wg_private_key_path.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
 2114:                         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2115:                             "wg private key path is required for macos-wireguard backend"
 2116:                                 .to_string(),
 2117:                         )
 2118:                     })?;
 2119:                     validate_private_key_permissions(private_key)?;
 2120:                     let helper_client = PrivilegedCommandClient::new(
 2121:                         helper_socket.clone(),
 2122:                         Duration::from_millis(config.privileged_helper_timeout_ms.get()),
 2123:                     )
 2124:                     .map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)?;
 2125:                     let backend = MacosWireguardBackend::new(
 2126:                         PrivilegedHelperWireguardRunner::new(helper_client),
 2127:                         config.wg_interface.clone(),
 2128:                         private_key.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 2129:                         config.egress_interface.clone(),
 2130:                         config.wg_listen_port,
 2131:                     )
 2132:                     .map_err(|err| DaemonError::InvalidConfig(err.to_string()))?;
 2133:                     Ok(Self::Macos(backend))
 2134:                 }
 2135:                 #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
 2136:                 {
 2137:                     Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2138:                         "macos-wireguard backend is only supported on macos".to_string(),
 2139:                     ))
 2140:                 }
 2141:             }
 2142:             DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguardUserspaceShared => Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2143:                 DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguardUserspaceShared
 2144:                     .userspace_shared_blocker()
 2145:                     .expect("macos shared backend blocker should exist")
 2146:                     .to_string(),
 2147:             )),
 2148:             DaemonBackendMode::WindowsWireguardNt => {
 2149:                 #[cfg(windows)]
 2150:                 {
 2151:                     let private_key = config.wg_private_key_path.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
 2152:                         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2153:                             "wg private key path is required for windows-wireguard-nt backend"
 2154:                                 .to_string(),
 2155:                         )
 2156:                     })?;
 2157:                     validate_private_key_permissions(private_key)?;
 2158:                     let config_path =
 2159:                         default_windows_tunnel_service_config_path(config.wg_interface.as_str());
 2160:                     validate_runtime_file_path(config_path.as_path(), "windows tunnel config")?;
 2161:                     let backend = WindowsWireguardBackend::new(
 2162:                         WindowsHostWireguardRunner,
 2163:                         config.wg_interface.clone(),
 2164:                         config_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 2165:                         private_key.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 2166:                         DEFAULT_WINDOWS_WIREGUARD_EXE_PATH,
 2167:                         DEFAULT_WINDOWS_WG_EXE_PATH,
 2168:                         DEFAULT_WINDOWS_NETSH_EXE_PATH,
 2169:                         config.wg_listen_port,
 2170:                     )
 2171:                     .map_err(|err| DaemonError::InvalidConfig(err.to_string()))?;
 2172:                     Ok(Self::Windows(backend))
 2173:                 }
 2174:                 #[cfg(not(windows))]
 2175:                 {
 2176:                     Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2177:                         "windows-wireguard-nt backend is only supported on Windows".to_string(),
 2178:                     ))
 2179:                 }
 2180:             }
 2181:             DaemonBackendMode::WindowsUnsupported => Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 2182:                 require_supported_windows_backend(WindowsBackendMode::Unsupported)
 2183:                     .expect_err("windows unsupported backend must fail closed"),
 2184:             )),
 2185:         }
 2186:     }

 2743: fn load_relay_client(config: &DaemonConfig) -> Result<Option<RelayClient>, DaemonError> {
 2744:     match (
 2745:         config.relay_session_signing_secret_path.as_ref(),
 2746:         config.relay_session_signing_secret_passphrase_path.as_ref(),
 2747:     ) {
 2748:         (None, None) => Ok(None),
 2749:         (Some(_), None) => Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 2750:             "{ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_PASSPHRASE_ENV} is required when {ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_ENV} is set"
 2751:         ))),
 2752:         (None, Some(_)) => Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 2753:             "{ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_ENV} is required when {ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_PASSPHRASE_ENV} is set"
 2754:         ))),
 2755:         (Some(secret_path), Some(passphrase_path)) => {
 2756:             let signing_secret =
 2757:                 decrypt_private_key(secret_path, passphrase_path).map_err(DaemonError::Io)?;
 2758:             let signing_key = derive_endpoint_hint_signing_key(signing_secret);
 2759:             let relay_client = RelayClient::new(
 2760:                 NodeId::new(config.node_id.clone())
 2761:                     .map_err(|err| DaemonError::InvalidConfig(err.to_string()))?,
 2762:                 Arc::new(signing_key),
 2763:                 RelayClientConfig::default(),
 2764:             );
 2765:             Ok(Some(relay_client))
 2766:         }
 2767:     }
 2768: }

 2770: impl DaemonRuntime {
 2771:     fn new(config: &DaemonConfig) -> Result<Self, DaemonError> {
 2772:         NodeId::new(config.node_id.clone())
 2773:             .map_err(|err| DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("invalid node id: {err}")))?;
 2774:         let policy = ContextualPolicySet {
 2775:             rules: vec![ContextualPolicyRule {
 2776:                 src: "user:local".to_string(),
 2777:                 dst: "*".to_string(),
 2778:                 protocol: Protocol::Any,
 2779:                 action: RuleAction::Allow,
 2780:                 contexts: vec![TrafficContext::Mesh, TrafficContext::SharedExit],
 2781:             }],
 2782:         };
 2783:         let trust_policy = TrustPolicy {
 2784:             max_signed_data_age_secs: config.trust_max_age_secs.get(),
 2785:             max_clock_skew_secs: TrustPolicy::default().max_clock_skew_secs,
 2786:         };
 2787:         let backend = DaemonBackend::from_config(config)?;
 2788:         let relay_client = load_relay_client(config)?;
 2789:         let transport_socket_identity_blocker = backend
 2790:             .transport_socket_identity_blocker()
 2791:             .filter(|_| !config.traversal_stun_servers.is_empty() || relay_client.is_some());
 2792:         let transport_socket_identity_blocked = transport_socket_identity_blocker.is_some();
 2793:         let controller = Phase10Controller::new(
 2794:             backend,
 2795:             daemon_system(config)?,
 2796:             policy.clone(),
 2797:             trust_policy,
 2798:         );
 2799:         let privileged_helper_client = config
 2800:             .privileged_helper_socket_path
 2801:             .as_ref()
 2802:             .map(|path| {
 2803:                 PrivilegedCommandClient::new(
 2804:                     path.clone(),
 2805:                     Duration::from_millis(config.privileged_helper_timeout_ms.get()),
 2806:                 )
 2807:             })
 2808:             .transpose()
 2809:             .map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)?;
 2810:         let remote_ops_verifying_key = config
 2811:             .remote_ops_token_verifier_key_path
 2812:             .as_ref()
 2813:             .map(|path| load_remote_ops_access_token_verifying_key(path))
 2814:             .transpose()?;
 2815:         Ok(Self {
 2816:             controller,
 2817:             policy,
 2818:             backend_mode: config.backend_mode,
 2819:             node_role: config.node_role,
 2820:             local_node_id: config.node_id.clone(),
 2821:             wg_interface: config.wg_interface.clone(),
 2822:             wg_listen_port: config.wg_listen_port,
 2823:             wg_private_key_path: config.wg_private_key_path.clone(),
 2824:             wg_encrypted_private_key_path: config.wg_encrypted_private_key_path.clone(),
 2825:             wg_key_passphrase_path: config.wg_key_passphrase_path.clone(),
 2826:             wg_public_key_path: config.wg_public_key_path.clone(),
 2827:             relay_client,
 2828:             relay_session_token_ttl_secs: config.relay_session_token_ttl_secs.get(),
 2829:             relay_session_refresh_margin_secs: config.relay_session_refresh_margin_secs.get(),
 2830:             relay_session_idle_timeout_secs: config.relay_session_idle_timeout_secs.get(),
 2831:             privileged_helper_client,
 2832:             state_fetcher: StateFetcher::new_from_daemon(config),
 2833:             #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
 2834:             egress_interface: config.egress_interface.clone(),
 2835:             state_path: config.state_path.clone(),
 2836:             trust_evidence_path: config.trust_evidence_path.clone(),
 2837:             trust_verifier_key_path: config.trust_verifier_key_path.clone(),
 2838:             trust_watermark_path: config.trust_watermark_path.clone(),
 2839:             membership_snapshot_path: config.membership_snapshot_path.clone(),
 2840:             membership_log_path: config.membership_log_path.clone(),
 2841:             membership_watermark_path: config.membership_watermark_path.clone(),
 2842:             auto_tunnel_enforce: config.auto_tunnel_enforce,
 2843:             auto_tunnel_bundle_path: config.auto_tunnel_bundle_path.clone(),

 2846:             auto_tunnel_max_age_secs: config.auto_tunnel_max_age_secs.get(),

 2927:             _endpoint_monitor: EndpointMonitor::new(vec![config.wg_interface.clone()]),
 2928:             auto_port_forward_exit: config.auto_port_forward_exit,
 2929:             #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
 2930:             auto_port_forward_lease_secs: config.auto_port_forward_lease_secs.get(),
 2931:             exit_port_forward_last_error: None,
 2932:             #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
 2933:             exit_port_forward_lease: None,
 2934:         })
 2935:     }

 2937:     fn load_verified_trust(&self) -> Result<TrustEvidence, TrustBootstrapError> {
 2938:         let previous_watermark = load_trust_watermark(&self.trust_watermark_path)?;
 2939:         let envelope = load_trust_evidence(
 2940:             &self.trust_evidence_path,
 2941:             &self.trust_verifier_key_path,
 2942:             self.trust_policy,
 2943:             previous_watermark,
 2944:         )?;
 2945:         persist_trust_watermark(&self.trust_watermark_path, envelope.watermark)?;
 2946:         Ok(envelope.evidence)

 2949:     fn load_verified_membership(&self) -> Result<MembershipState, MembershipBootstrapError> {
 2950:         if !self.membership_snapshot_path.exists() {
 2951:             return Err(MembershipBootstrapError::MissingSnapshot);
 2952:         }
 2953:         if !self.membership_log_path.exists() {
 2954:             return Err(MembershipBootstrapError::MissingLog);
 2955:         }
 2956: 
 2957:         let snapshot = load_membership_snapshot(&self.membership_snapshot_path)
 2958:             .map_err(|err| MembershipBootstrapError::SnapshotLoad(err.to_string()))?;
 2959:         let entries = load_membership_log(&self.membership_log_path)
 2960:             .map_err(|err| MembershipBootstrapError::LogLoad(err.to_string()))?;
 2961:         let replayed = replay_membership_snapshot_and_log(&snapshot, &entries, unix_now())
 2962:             .map_err(|err| MembershipBootstrapError::Replay(err.to_string()))?;
 2963:         let state_root = replayed
 2964:             .state_root_hex()
 2965:             .map_err(|_| MembershipBootstrapError::InvalidRoot)?;
 2966:         let watermark = MembershipWatermark {
 2967:             epoch: replayed.epoch,
 2968:             state_root: state_root.clone(),
 2969:         };
 2970:         let previous = load_membership_watermark(&self.membership_watermark_path)
 2971:             .map_err(|err| MembershipBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 2972:         if let Some(previous) = previous {
 2973:             if watermark.epoch < previous.epoch
 2974:                 || (watermark.epoch == previous.epoch
 2975:                     && watermark.state_root != previous.state_root)
 2976:             {
 2977:                 return Err(MembershipBootstrapError::WatermarkReplay);
 2978:             }
 2979:         }
 2980:         persist_membership_watermark(&self.membership_watermark_path, &watermark)
 2981:             .map_err(|err| MembershipBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 2982: 
 2983:         let local_active = replayed.nodes.iter().any(|node| {
 2984:             node.node_id == self.local_node_id && node.status == MembershipNodeStatus::Active
 2985:         });
 2986:         if !local_active {
 2987:             return Err(MembershipBootstrapError::LocalNodeNotActive);
 2988:         }
 2989:         if let Some(exit_node) = self.selected_exit_node.as_deref() {
 2990:             let exit_active = replayed.nodes.iter().any(|node| {
 2991:                 node.node_id == exit_node && node.status == MembershipNodeStatus::Active
 2992:             });
 2993:             if !exit_active {
 2994:                 return Err(MembershipBootstrapError::ExitNodeNotActive(
 2995:                     exit_node.to_string(),
 2996:                 ));
 2997:             }
 2998:         }
 2999: 
 3000:         Ok(replayed)
 3001:     }

 3003:     fn auto_tunnel_paths(&self) -> Result<(&Path, &Path, &Path), AutoTunnelBootstrapError> {
 3004:         // if !self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 3005:         //     return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Disabled);
 3006:         // }
 3007:         let bundle_path = self.auto_tunnel_bundle_path.as_deref().ok_or(
 3008:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::MissingConfig("auto_tunnel_bundle_path"),
 3009:         )?;
 3010:         let verifier_path = self.auto_tunnel_verifier_key_path.as_deref().ok_or(
 3011:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::MissingConfig("auto_tunnel_verifier_key_path"),
 3012:         )?;
 3013:         let watermark_path = self.auto_tunnel_watermark_path.as_deref().ok_or(
 3014:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::MissingConfig("auto_tunnel_watermark_path"),
 3015:         )?;
 3016:         Ok((bundle_path, verifier_path, watermark_path))
 3017:     }

 3019:     fn load_verified_auto_tunnel(
 3020:         &self,
 3021:         membership_directory: &MembershipDirectory,
 3022:     ) -> Result<AutoTunnelBundleEnvelope, AutoTunnelBootstrapError> {
 3023:         let (bundle_path, verifier_path, watermark_path) = self.auto_tunnel_paths()?;
 3024:         let previous_watermark = load_auto_tunnel_watermark(watermark_path)?;
 3025:         let envelope = load_auto_tunnel_bundle(
 3026:             bundle_path,
 3027:             verifier_path,
 3028:             self.auto_tunnel_max_age_secs,
 3029:             self.trust_policy,
 3030:             previous_watermark,
 3031:         )?;
 3032:         if envelope.bundle.node_id != self.local_node_id {
 3033:             return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::WrongNode);
 3034:         }
 3035:         self.policy_gate_auto_tunnel(&envelope.bundle, membership_directory)?;
 3036:         persist_auto_tunnel_watermark(watermark_path, envelope.watermark)?;
 3037:         Ok(envelope)
 3038:     }
 3039: 
 3040:     fn policy_gate_auto_tunnel(
 3041:         &self,
 3042:         bundle: &AutoTunnelBundle,
 3043:         membership_directory: &MembershipDirectory,
 3044:     ) -> Result<(), AutoTunnelBootstrapError> {
 3045:         let subject = DEFAULT_REMOTE_OPS_EXPECTED_SUBJECT;
 3046: 
 3047:         for peer in &bundle.peers {
 3048:             let decision = self.policy.evaluate_with_membership(
 3049:                 &ContextualAccessRequest {
 3050:                     src: subject.to_string(),
 3051:                     dst: format!("node:{}", peer.node_id.as_str()),
 3052:                     protocol: Protocol::Any,
 3053:                     context: TrafficContext::Mesh,
 3054:                 },
 3055:                 membership_directory,
 3056:             );
 3057:             if decision != Decision::Allow {
 3058:                 return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::PolicyDenied(format!(
 3059:                     "peer {} denied",
 3060:                     peer.node_id
 3061:                 )));
 3062:             }
 3063:         }
 3064: 
 3065:         for route in &bundle.routes {
 3066:             let context = match route.kind {
 3067:                 RouteKind::Mesh => TrafficContext::Mesh,
 3068:                 RouteKind::ExitNodeDefault | RouteKind::ExitNodeLan => TrafficContext::SharedExit,
 3069:             };
 3070:             let cidr_decision = self.policy.evaluate_with_membership(
 3071:                 &ContextualAccessRequest {
 3072:                     src: subject.to_string(),
 3073:                     dst: route.destination_cidr.clone(),
 3074:                     protocol: Protocol::Any,
 3075:                     context,
 3076:                 },
 3077:                 membership_directory,
 3078:             );
 3079:             if cidr_decision != Decision::Allow {
 3080:                 return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::PolicyDenied(format!(
 3081:                     "route {} denied",
 3082:                     route.destination_cidr
 3083:                 )));
 3084:             }
 3085:             let via_decision = self.policy.evaluate_with_membership(
 3086:                 &ContextualAccessRequest {
 3087:                     src: subject.to_string(),
 3088:                     dst: format!("node:{}", route.via_node.as_str()),
 3089:                     protocol: Protocol::Any,
 3090:                     context,
 3091:                 },
 3092:                 membership_directory,
 3093:             );
 3094:             if via_decision != Decision::Allow {
 3095:                 return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::PolicyDenied(format!(
 3096:                     "route via node {} denied",
 3097:                     route.via_node
 3098:                 )));
 3099:             }
 3100:         }
 3101: 
 3102:         Ok(())
 3103:     }

 3105:     fn refresh_dns_zone_state(&mut self, auto_tunnel: Option<&AutoTunnelBundleEnvelope>) {
 3106:         self.dns_zone = None;
 3107:         self.dns_zone_error = None;
 3108: 
 3109:         if !self.dns_zone_bundle_path.exists() {
 3110:             return;
 3111:         }
 3112: 
 3113:         let Some(auto_tunnel) = auto_tunnel else {
 3114:             self.dns_zone_error = Some(
 3115:                 "dns zone bundle present but signed assignment context is unavailable".to_string(),
 3116:             );
 3117:             return;
 3118:         };
 3119: 
 3120:         let previous_watermark = match load_dns_zone_watermark(&self.dns_zone_watermark_path) {
 3121:             Ok(value) => value,
 3122:             Err(err) => {
 3123:                 self.dns_zone_error = Some(err.to_string());
 3124:                 return;
 3125:             }
 3126:         };
 3127: 
 3128:         match load_dns_zone_bundle(DnsZoneLoadContext {
 3129:             path: &self.dns_zone_bundle_path,
 3130:             verifier_key_path: &self.dns_zone_verifier_key_path,
 3131:             max_age_secs: self.dns_zone_max_age_secs,
 3132:             trust_policy: self.trust_policy,
 3133:             previous_watermark,
 3134:             expected_zone_name: &self.dns_zone_name,
 3135:             local_node_id: &self.local_node_id,
 3136:             auto_tunnel: &auto_tunnel.bundle,
 3137:         }) {
 3138:             Ok(envelope) => {
 3139:                 if let Err(err) =
 3140:                     persist_dns_zone_watermark(&self.dns_zone_watermark_path, envelope.watermark)
 3141:                 {
 3142:                     self.dns_zone_error = Some(err.to_string());
 3143:                     return;
 3144:                 }
 3145:                 self.dns_zone = Some(envelope);
 3146:             }
 3147:             Err(err) => {
 3148:                 self.record_dns_zone_bootstrap_error(&err);
 3149:                 self.dns_zone_error = Some(err.to_string());
 3150:             }
 3151:         }
 3152:     }

 3154:     fn record_dns_zone_bootstrap_error(&mut self, err: &DnsZoneBootstrapError) {
 3155:         match err {
 3156:             DnsZoneBootstrapError::Stale => {
 3157:                 self.dns_zone_stale_rejections = self.dns_zone_stale_rejections.saturating_add(1);
 3158:             }
 3159:             DnsZoneBootstrapError::ReplayDetected => {
 3160:                 self.dns_zone_replay_rejections = self.dns_zone_replay_rejections.saturating_add(1);
 3161:             }
 3162:             DnsZoneBootstrapError::FutureDated => {
 3163:                 self.dns_zone_future_dated_rejections =
 3164:                     self.dns_zone_future_dated_rejections.saturating_add(1);
 3165:             }
 3166:             DnsZoneBootstrapError::Missing
 3167:             | DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(_)
 3168:             | DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(_)
 3169:             | DnsZoneBootstrapError::KeyInvalid
 3170:             | DnsZoneBootstrapError::SignatureInvalid
 3171:             | DnsZoneBootstrapError::WrongNode
 3172:             | DnsZoneBootstrapError::AssignmentMismatch(_) => {}
 3173:         }
 3174:     }

 3176:     fn dns_zone_next_preexpiry_refresh_target(&self, now_unix: u64) -> Option<u64> {
 3177:         let envelope = self.dns_zone.as_ref()?;
 3178:         let expires_at_unix = envelope.bundle.expires_at_unix;
 3179:         if expires_at_unix <= now_unix {
 3180:             return Some(now_unix);
 3181:         }
 3182:         let ttl_window = expires_at_unix.saturating_sub(now_unix);
 3183:         let margin = ttl_window.saturating_div(4).clamp(
 3184:             MIN_DNS_ZONE_REFRESH_MARGIN_SECS,
 3185:             MAX_DNS_ZONE_REFRESH_JITTER_SECS,
 3186:         );
 3187:         Some(expires_at_unix.saturating_sub(margin))
 3188:     }
 3189: 
 3190:     fn dns_zone_refresh_jitter_offset_secs(&self) -> u64 {
 3191:         let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
 3192:         hasher.update(self.local_node_id.as_bytes());
 3193:         hasher.update(self.wg_interface.as_bytes());
 3194:         hasher.update(b"dns-zone-refresh");
 3195:         let digest = hasher.finalize();
 3196:         u64::from(digest[0]) % MAX_DNS_ZONE_REFRESH_JITTER_SECS
 3197:     }
 3198: 
 3199:     fn dns_zone_preexpiry_refresh_due(&self, now_unix: u64) -> bool {
 3200:         let Some(target_unix) = self.dns_zone_next_preexpiry_refresh_target(now_unix) else {
 3201:             return false;
 3202:         };
 3203:         let scheduled_unix = target_unix.saturating_sub(self.dns_zone_refresh_jitter_offset_secs());
 3204:         if now_unix < scheduled_unix {
 3205:             return false;
 3206:         }
 3207:         if let Some(last_refresh_unix) = self.dns_zone_last_preexpiry_refresh_unix
 3208:             && now_unix.saturating_sub(last_refresh_unix) < MIN_DNS_ZONE_REFRESH_COOLDOWN_SECS
 3209:         {
 3210:             return false;
 3211:         }
 3212:         true
 3213:     }
 3214: 
 3215:     fn maybe_preexpiry_refresh_dns_zone(
 3216:         &mut self,
 3217:         now_unix: u64,
 3218:         auto_tunnel: Option<&AutoTunnelBundleEnvelope>,
 3219:     ) {
 3220:         if !self.dns_zone_preexpiry_refresh_due(now_unix) {
 3221:             return;
 3222:         }
 3223:         self.dns_zone_preexpiry_refresh_events =
 3224:             self.dns_zone_preexpiry_refresh_events.saturating_add(1);
 3225:         self.dns_zone_last_preexpiry_refresh_unix = Some(now_unix);
 3226:         self.refresh_dns_zone_state(auto_tunnel);
 3227:     }

 3229:     fn dns_zone_status_summary(&self) -> (String, String, String) {
 3230:         let state = if self.dns_zone.is_some() {
 3231:             "valid"
 3232:         } else if self.dns_zone_error.is_some() {
 3233:             "invalid"
 3234:         } else {
 3235:             "absent"
 3236:         };
 3237:         let record_count = self
 3238:             .dns_zone
 3239:             .as_ref()
 3240:             .map(|envelope| envelope.bundle.records.len().to_string())
 3241:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "0".to_string());
 3242:         let error = self
 3243:             .dns_zone_error
 3244:             .as_deref()
 3245:             .map(sanitize_netcheck_value)
 3246:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string());
 3247:         (state.to_string(), record_count, error)
 3248:     }

 3250:     fn dns_inspect_message(&self) -> String {
 3251:         let Some(envelope) = self.dns_zone.as_ref() else {
 3252:             if let Some(error) = self.dns_zone_error.as_deref() {
 3253:                 return format!(
 3254:                     "dns inspect: state=invalid error={}",
 3255:                     sanitize_netcheck_value(error)
 3256:                 );
 3257:             }
 3258:             return "dns inspect: state=absent".to_string();
 3259:         };
 3260: 
 3261:         let mut message = format!(
 3262:             "dns inspect: state=valid zone_name={} subject_node_id={} generated_at_unix={} expires_at_unix={} record_count={}",
 3263:             sanitize_netcheck_value(&envelope.bundle.zone_name),
 3264:             sanitize_netcheck_value(&envelope.bundle.subject_node_id),
 3265:             envelope.bundle.generated_at_unix,
 3266:             envelope.bundle.expires_at_unix,
 3267:             envelope.bundle.records.len()
 3268:         );
 3269:         for (index, record) in envelope.bundle.records.iter().enumerate() {
 3270:             let aliases = if record.aliases.is_empty() {
 3271:                 "none".to_string()
 3272:             } else {
 3273:                 sanitize_netcheck_value(
 3274:                     &record
 3275:                         .aliases
 3276:                         .iter()
 3277:                         .map(|alias| format!("{alias}.{}", envelope.bundle.zone_name))
 3278:                         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 3279:                         .join(","),
 3280:                 )
 3281:             };
 3282:             message.push('\n');
 3283:             message.push_str(&format!(
 3284:                 "record.{index}.fqdn={} target_node_id={} rr_type={} target_addr_kind={} expected_ip={} ttl_secs={} aliases={}",
 3285:                 sanitize_netcheck_value(&record.fqdn),
 3286:                 sanitize_netcheck_value(&record.target_node_id),
 3287:                 record.rr_type.as_str(),
 3288:                 record.target_addr_kind.as_str(),
 3289:                 sanitize_netcheck_value(&record.expected_ip),
 3290:                 record.ttl_secs,
 3291:                 aliases
 3292:             ));
 3293:         }
 3294:         message
 3295:     }

 3297:     fn resolve_dns_ipv4_record(&self, fqdn: &str) -> Option<(Ipv4Addr, u32)> {
 3298:         let envelope = self.dns_zone.as_ref()?;
 3299:         let normalized = fqdn.trim_end_matches('.').to_ascii_lowercase();
 3300:         for record in &envelope.bundle.records {
 3301:             if normalized == record.fqdn
 3302:                 || record
 3303:                     .aliases
 3304:                     .iter()
 3305:                     .any(|alias| normalized == format!("{alias}.{}", envelope.bundle.zone_name))
 3306:             {
 3307:                 let ip = record.expected_ip.parse::<Ipv4Addr>().ok()?;
 3308:                 let ttl = u32::try_from(record.ttl_secs).ok()?;
 3309:                 return Some((ip, ttl));
 3310:             }
 3311:         }
 3312:         None
 3313:     }

 3315:     fn update_verified_traversal_index(&mut self, envelope: &TraversalBundleSetEnvelope) {
 3316:         let now_unix = SystemTime::now()
 3317:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 3318:             .unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO)
 3319:             .as_secs();
 3320: 
 3321:         self.verified_traversal_index = VerifiedTraversalIndex::new();
 3322:         self.verified_traversal_coordination_index = BTreeMap::new();
 3323:         self.traversal_coordination_replay_window = CoordinationReplayWindow::default();
 3324: 
 3325:         for bundle_envelope in &envelope.bundles {
 3326:             let bundle = &bundle_envelope.bundle;
 3327: 
 3328:             let mut candidates = Vec::new();
 3329:             for cand in &bundle.candidates {
 3330:                 let endpoint = SocketEndpoint {
 3331:                     addr: cand.endpoint.ip(),
 3332:                     port: cand.endpoint.port(),
 3333:                 };
 3334:                 let source = match cand.candidate_type {
 3335:                     TraversalCandidateType::Host => ProbeCandidateSource::Host,
 3336:                     TraversalCandidateType::ServerReflexive => {
 3337:                         ProbeCandidateSource::ServerReflexive
 3338:                     }
 3339:                     TraversalCandidateType::Relay => ProbeCandidateSource::Relay,
 3340:                 };
 3341: 
 3342:                 candidates.push(ProbeTraversalCandidate {
 3343:                     endpoint,
 3344:                     source,
 3345:                     priority: cand.priority,
 3346:                     observed_at_unix: bundle.generated_at_unix,
 3347:                 });
 3348:             }
 3349: 
 3350:             let record = VerifiedTraversalRecord {
 3351:                 candidates,
 3352:                 generated_at_unix: bundle.generated_at_unix,
 3353:                 expires_at_unix: bundle.expires_at_unix,
 3354:                 nonce: bundle.nonce,
 3355:                 verified_at_unix: now_unix,
 3356:             };
 3357: 
 3358:             self.verified_traversal_index.insert(
 3359:                 bundle.source_node_id.clone(),
 3360:                 bundle.target_node_id.clone(),
 3361:                 record,
 3362:             );
 3363:         }
 3364: 
 3365:         for coordination in &envelope.coordinations {
 3366:             let key = traversal_coordination_pair_key(
 3367:                 coordination.record.node_a.as_str(),
 3368:                 coordination.record.node_b.as_str(),
 3369:             );
 3370:             self.verified_traversal_coordination_index
 3371:                 .insert(key, coordination.record.clone());
 3372:         }
 3373:     }

 3375:     fn refresh_traversal_hint_state(&mut self, force_reprobe: bool) {
 3376:         let previous_watermark = match load_traversal_watermark(&self.traversal_watermark_path) {
 3377:             Ok(value) => value,
 3378:             Err(err) => {
 3379:                 self.traversal_hints = None;
 3380:                 self.traversal_hint_error = Some(err.to_string());
 3381:                 self.traversal_coordination_replay_window = CoordinationReplayWindow::default();
 3382:                 self.traversal_probe_statuses.clear();
 3383:                 return;
 3384:             }
 3385:         };
 3386:         match load_traversal_bundle_set(
 3387:             &self.traversal_bundle_path,
 3388:             &self.traversal_verifier_key_path,
 3389:             self.traversal_max_age_secs,
 3390:             self.trust_policy,
 3391:             previous_watermark,
 3392:         ) {
 3393:             Ok(envelope) => {
 3394:                 if let Err(err) =
 3395:                     persist_traversal_watermark(&self.traversal_watermark_path, envelope.watermark)
 3396:                 {
 3397:                     self.traversal_hints = None;
 3398:                     self.traversal_hint_error = Some(err.to_string());
 3399:                     self.traversal_probe_statuses.clear();
 3400:                     return;
 3401:                 }
 3402:                 self.update_verified_traversal_index(&envelope);
 3403:                 self.traversal_hints = Some(envelope);
 3404:                 self.traversal_hint_error = None;
 3405:             }
 3406:             Err(TraversalBootstrapError::Missing) => {
 3407:                 self.traversal_hints = None;
 3408:                 self.verified_traversal_index = VerifiedTraversalIndex::new();
 3409:                 self.verified_traversal_coordination_index = BTreeMap::new();
 3410:                 self.traversal_coordination_replay_window = CoordinationReplayWindow::default();
 3411:                 self.traversal_hint_error = None;
 3412:                 self.traversal_probe_statuses.clear();
 3413:             }
 3414:             Err(err) => {
 3415:                 self.record_traversal_bootstrap_error(&err);
 3416:                 self.traversal_hints = None;
 3417:                 self.verified_traversal_index = VerifiedTraversalIndex::new();
 3418:                 self.verified_traversal_coordination_index = BTreeMap::new();
 3419:                 self.traversal_coordination_replay_window = CoordinationReplayWindow::default();
 3420:                 self.traversal_hint_error = Some(err.to_string());
 3421:                 self.traversal_probe_statuses.clear();
 3422:             }
 3423:         }
 3424:         if let Err(err) = self.sync_traversal_runtime_state(force_reprobe) {
 3425:             self.traversal_hint_error = Some(err.clone());
 3426:             if self.traversal_authority_mode().is_enforced() {
 3427:                 self.restrict_recoverable(format!("traversal runtime sync failed: {err}"));
 3428:                 let _ = self
 3429:                     .controller
 3430:                     .force_fail_closed("traversal_runtime_sync_failed");
 3431:             }
 3432:         }
 3433:     }

 3435:     fn refresh_signed_state_with_reason(
 3436:         &mut self,
 3437:         force_reprobe: bool,
 3438:         reason: SignedStateRefreshReason,
 3439:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
 3440:         match self.state_fetcher.fetch_trust() {
 3441:             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => eprintln!("statefetch: trust applied during refresh"),
 3442:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 3443:             Err(e) => return Err(format!("remote trust fetch failed: {e}")),
 3444:         }
 3445:         match self.state_fetcher.fetch_traversal() {
 3446:             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => eprintln!("statefetch: traversal applied during refresh"),
 3447:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 3448:             Err(e) => return Err(format!("remote traversal fetch failed: {e}")),
 3449:         }
 3450:         if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 3451:             match self.state_fetcher.fetch_assignment() {
 3452:                 Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => {
 3453:                     eprintln!("statefetch: assignment applied during refresh")
 3454:                 }
 3455:                 Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 3456:                 Err(e) => return Err(format!("remote assignment fetch failed: {e}")),
 3457:             }
 3458:         }
 3459:         // For dns_zone: load auto_bundle from disk first if enforced, for accurate context.
 3460:         let auto_bundle_for_dns = if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 3461:             // Load assignment bundle for context; if this fails, treat as no context.
 3462:             // Use a local load, not the full load_verified_auto_tunnel (which does full policy
 3463:             // enforcement) — we just need the bundle content for DNS zone context.
 3464:             // If load fails here, pass None (dns zone will use empty bundle context).
 3465:             self.try_load_auto_tunnel_bundle_for_dns_context().ok()
 3466:         } else {
 3467:             None
 3468:         };
 3469:         match self
 3470:             .state_fetcher
 3471:             .fetch_dns_zone(auto_bundle_for_dns.as_ref())
 3472:         {
 3473:             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => eprintln!("statefetch: dns zone applied during refresh"),
 3474:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 3475:             Err(e) => return Err(format!("remote dns zone fetch failed: {e}")),
 3476:         }
 3477: 
 3478:         let _trust = self
 3479:             .load_verified_trust()
 3480:             .map_err(|err| format!("signed trust refresh failed: {err}"))?;
 3481:         let membership_state = self
 3482:             .load_verified_membership()
 3483:             .map_err(|err| format!("signed membership refresh failed: {err}"))?;
 3484:         let membership_directory = membership_directory_from_state(&membership_state);
 3485:         let auto_bundle = if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 3486:             Some(
 3487:                 self.load_verified_auto_tunnel(&membership_directory)
 3488:                     .map_err(|err| format!("signed assignment refresh failed: {err}"))?,
 3489:             )
 3490:         } else {
 3491:             None
 3492:         };
 3493: 
 3494:         self.membership_state = Some(membership_state);
 3495:         self.membership_directory = membership_directory;
 3496:         self.refresh_dns_zone_state(auto_bundle.as_ref());
 3497:         self.refresh_traversal_hint_state(force_reprobe);
 3498: 
 3499:         if self.traversal_authority_mode().is_enforced()
 3500:             && self.traversal_hints.is_none()
 3501:             && !self.controller.managed_peer_ids().is_empty()
 3502:         {
 3503:             return Err(
 3504:                 "signed traversal refresh failed: traversal state missing while peers are managed"
 3505:                     .to_string(),
 3506:             );
 3507:         }
 3508: 
 3509:         self.restriction_mode = RestrictionMode::None;
 3510:         self.bootstrap_error = None;
 3511:         self.reconcile_failures = 0;
 3512:         self.last_reconcile_error = None;
 3513:         eprintln!(
 3514:             "rustynetd: signed state refresh completed (reason={})",
 3515:             reason.as_str()
 3516:         );
 3517:         Ok(())
 3518:     }
 3519: 
 3520:     fn record_traversal_bootstrap_error(&mut self, err: &TraversalBootstrapError) {
 3521:         match err {
 3522:             TraversalBootstrapError::Stale => {
 3523:                 self.traversal_stale_rejections = self.traversal_stale_rejections.saturating_add(1);
 3524:             }
 3525:             TraversalBootstrapError::ReplayDetected => {
 3526:                 self.traversal_replay_rejections =
 3527:                     self.traversal_replay_rejections.saturating_add(1);
 3528:             }
 3529:             TraversalBootstrapError::FutureDated => {
 3530:                 self.traversal_future_dated_rejections =
 3531:                     self.traversal_future_dated_rejections.saturating_add(1);
 3532:             }
 3533:             TraversalBootstrapError::Missing
 3534:             | TraversalBootstrapError::Io(_)
 3535:             | TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(_)
 3536:             | TraversalBootstrapError::KeyInvalid
 3537:             | TraversalBootstrapError::SignatureInvalid => {}
 3538:         }
 3539:     }
 3540: 
 3541:     fn traversal_next_preexpiry_refresh_target(&self, now_unix: u64) -> Option<u64> {
 3542:         let envelope = self.traversal_hints.as_ref()?;
 3543:         let expires_at_unix = envelope
 3544:             .bundles
 3545:             .first()
 3546:             .map(|bundle| bundle.bundle.expires_at_unix)?;
 3547:         if expires_at_unix <= now_unix {
 3548:             return Some(now_unix);
 3549:         }
 3550:         let ttl_window = expires_at_unix.saturating_sub(now_unix);
 3551:         let margin = ttl_window.saturating_div(4).clamp(
 3552:             MIN_TRAVERSAL_REFRESH_MARGIN_SECS,
 3553:             MAX_TRAVERSAL_REFRESH_JITTER_SECS,
 3554:         );
 3555:         Some(expires_at_unix.saturating_sub(margin))
 3556:     }
 3557: 
 3558:     fn traversal_refresh_jitter_offset_secs(&self) -> u64 {
 3559:         let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
 3560:         hasher.update(self.local_node_id.as_bytes());
 3561:         hasher.update(self.wg_interface.as_bytes());
 3562:         let digest = hasher.finalize();
 3563:         u64::from(digest[0]) % MAX_TRAVERSAL_REFRESH_JITTER_SECS
 3564:     }
 3565: 
 3566:     fn traversal_preexpiry_refresh_due(&self, now_unix: u64) -> bool {
 3567:         let Some(target_unix) = self.traversal_next_preexpiry_refresh_target(now_unix) else {
 3568:             return false;
 3569:         };
 3570:         let scheduled_unix =
 3571:             target_unix.saturating_sub(self.traversal_refresh_jitter_offset_secs());
 3572:         if now_unix < scheduled_unix {
 3573:             return false;
 3574:         }
 3575:         if let Some(last_refresh_unix) = self.traversal_last_preexpiry_refresh_unix
 3576:             && now_unix.saturating_sub(last_refresh_unix) < MIN_TRAVERSAL_REFRESH_COOLDOWN_SECS
 3577:         {
 3578:             return false;
 3579:         }
 3580:         true
 3581:     }
 3582: 
 3583:     fn maybe_preexpiry_refresh_traversal(&mut self, now_unix: u64) {
 3584:         if !self.traversal_preexpiry_refresh_due(now_unix) {
 3585:             return;
 3586:         }
 3587:         self.traversal_preexpiry_refresh_events =
 3588:             self.traversal_preexpiry_refresh_events.saturating_add(1);
 3589:         self.traversal_last_preexpiry_refresh_unix = Some(now_unix);
 3590:         if let Err(err) =
 3591:             self.refresh_signed_state_with_reason(true, SignedStateRefreshReason::PreExpiry)
 3592:         {
 3593:             self.restrict_recoverable(err);
 3594:             let _ = self
 3595:                 .controller
 3596:                 .force_fail_closed("preexpiry_signed_state_refresh_failed");
 3597:         }
 3598:     }
 3599: 
 3600:     fn compute_runtime_endpoint_fingerprint(&self) -> String {
 3601:         let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
 3602:         hasher.update(self.local_node_id.as_bytes());
 3603:         hasher.update(self.wg_interface.as_bytes());
 3604:         #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
 3605:         {
 3606:             hasher.update(self.egress_interface.as_bytes());
 3607:             match detect_ipv4_default_gateway_for_interface(self.egress_interface.as_str()) {
 3608:                 Ok(gateway) => hasher.update(gateway.octets()),
 3609:                 Err(err) => hasher.update(format!("gateway-error:{err}").as_bytes()),
 3610:             }
 3611:         }
 3612:         hasher.update(self.wg_listen_port.to_be_bytes());
 3613:         if let Some(envelope) = self.traversal_hints.as_ref() {
 3614:             for bundle in &envelope.bundles {
 3615:                 hasher.update(bundle.bundle.source_node_id.as_bytes());
 3616:                 hasher.update(bundle.bundle.target_node_id.as_bytes());
 3617:                 for candidate in &bundle.bundle.candidates {
 3618:                     hasher.update(candidate.candidate_type.as_str().as_bytes());
 3619:                     hasher.update(candidate.endpoint.ip().to_string().as_bytes());
 3620:                     hasher.update(candidate.endpoint.port().to_be_bytes());
 3621:                     hasher.update(candidate.priority.to_be_bytes());
 3622:                     if let Some(relay_id) = candidate.relay_id.as_deref() {
 3623:                         hasher.update(relay_id.as_bytes());
 3624:                     }
 3625:                 }
 3626:             }
 3627:         } else if let Some(err) = self.traversal_hint_error.as_deref() {
 3628:             hasher.update(err.as_bytes());
 3629:         } else {
 3630:             hasher.update(b"no-traversal-hints");
 3631:         }
 3632:         encode_hex(&hasher.finalize())
 3633:     }
 3634: 
 3635:     fn maybe_trigger_endpoint_change_refresh(&mut self) {
 3636:         let fingerprint = self.compute_runtime_endpoint_fingerprint();
 3637:         match self.traversal_last_endpoint_fingerprint.as_deref() {
 3638:             Some(previous) if previous == fingerprint.as_str() => {}
 3639:             Some(_) => {
 3640:                 let now_unix = SystemTime::now()
 3641:                     .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 3642:                     .unwrap()
 3643:                     .as_secs();
 3644:                 if let Some(last) = self.traversal_last_endpoint_change_unix {
 3645:                     if now_unix < last.saturating_add(MIN_ENDPOINT_CHANGE_STABILITY_SECS) {
 3646:                         return;
 3647:                     }
 3648:                 }
 3649: 
 3650:                 self.traversal_endpoint_change_events =
 3651:                     self.traversal_endpoint_change_events.saturating_add(1);
 3652:                 self.traversal_last_endpoint_fingerprint = Some(fingerprint);
 3653:                 self.traversal_last_endpoint_change_unix = Some(now_unix);
 3654:                 if let Err(err) = self.refresh_signed_state_with_reason(
 3655:                     true,
 3656:                     SignedStateRefreshReason::EndpointChange,
 3657:                 ) {
 3658:                     self.restrict_recoverable(err);
 3659:                     let _ = self
 3660:                         .controller
 3661:                         .force_fail_closed("endpoint_change_signed_state_refresh_failed");
 3662:                 }
 3663:             }
 3664:             None => {
 3665:                 self.traversal_last_endpoint_fingerprint = Some(fingerprint);
 3666:             }
 3667:         }
 3668:     }

 3670:     /// Poll the EndpointMonitor for NIC address changes; trigger a signed-state
 3671:     /// refresh whenever a routable address is added, removed, or changes on any
 3672:     /// non-WireGuard interface.  This supplements the coarser fingerprint-based
 3673:     /// detection in `maybe_trigger_endpoint_change_refresh`.
 3674:     #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
 3675:     fn poll_endpoint_monitor_and_maybe_refresh(&mut self) {
 3676:         let current = collect_linux_interface_addrs();
 3677:         if snapshot_has_usable_traversal_host_candidates(&current) {
 3678:             self.local_host_candidates = current.clone();
 3679:         }
 3680:         if self._endpoint_monitor.poll_with_addrs(current).is_some() {
 3681:             self.maybe_trigger_endpoint_change_refresh();
 3682:         }
 3683:     }

 3686:     fn poll_endpoint_monitor_and_maybe_refresh(&mut self) {
 3687:         // EndpointMonitor NIC polling is Linux-only; the fingerprint-based
 3688:         // change detection in maybe_trigger_endpoint_change_refresh() handles
 3689:         // other platforms.
 3690:     }

 3692:     fn traversal_alarm_state(&self, now_unix: u64) -> (&'static str, String) {
 3693:         if let Some(err) = self.traversal_hint_error.as_deref() {
 3694:             return ("error", sanitize_netcheck_value(err));
 3695:         }
 3696:         let Some(envelope) = self.traversal_hints.as_ref() else {
 3697:             return ("missing", "signed_traversal_state_missing".to_string());
 3698:         };
 3699:         let Some(expires_at) = envelope
 3700:             .bundles
 3701:             .first()
 3702:             .map(|bundle| bundle.bundle.expires_at_unix)
 3703:         else {
 3704:             return ("error", "signed_traversal_bundle_set_empty".to_string());
 3705:         };
 3706:         let remaining_secs = expires_at.saturating_sub(now_unix);
 3707:         if remaining_secs == 0 {
 3708:             ("critical", "signed_traversal_state_expired".to_string())
 3709:         } else if remaining_secs <= MIN_TRAVERSAL_REFRESH_MARGIN_SECS {
 3710:             ("warning", "signed_traversal_state_near_expiry".to_string())
 3711:         } else {
 3712:             ("ok", "none".to_string())
 3713:         }
 3714:     }
 3715: 
 3716:     fn dns_zone_alarm_state(&self, now_unix: u64) -> (&'static str, String) {
 3717:         if let Some(err) = self.dns_zone_error.as_deref() {
 3718:             return ("error", sanitize_netcheck_value(err));
 3719:         }
 3720:         let Some(envelope) = self.dns_zone.as_ref() else {
 3721:             return ("missing", "signed_dns_zone_state_missing".to_string());
 3722:         };
 3723:         let expires_at = envelope.bundle.expires_at_unix;
 3724:         let remaining_secs = expires_at.saturating_sub(now_unix);
 3725:         if remaining_secs == 0 {
 3726:             ("critical", "signed_dns_zone_state_expired".to_string())
 3727:         } else if remaining_secs <= MIN_DNS_ZONE_REFRESH_MARGIN_SECS {
 3728:             ("warning", "signed_dns_zone_state_near_expiry".to_string())
 3729:         } else {
 3730:             ("ok", "none".to_string())
 3731:         }
 3732:     }

 3734:     fn poll_stun_results(&mut self) {
 3735:         let Some(next_refresh_at) = self.next_stun_refresh_at else {
 3736:             return;
 3737:         };
 3738:         let now = Instant::now();
 3739:         if now < next_refresh_at {
 3740:             return;
 3741:         }
 3742:         self.next_stun_refresh_at =
 3743:             Some(now + Duration::from_secs(DEFAULT_TRAVERSAL_STUN_GATHER_INTERVAL_SECS));
 3744:         if self.transport_socket_identity_blocker.is_some()
 3745:             || self.traversal_probe_config.stun_servers.is_empty()
 3746:         {
 3747:             return;
 3748:         }
 3749: 
 3750:         let client = StunClient::new(
 3751:             self.traversal_probe_config
 3752:                 .stun_servers
 3753:                 .iter()
 3754:                 .map(|addr| addr.to_string())
 3755:                 .collect(),
 3756:             Duration::from_millis(self.traversal_probe_config.stun_gather_timeout_ms),
 3757:         );
 3758:         let results = client.gather_mapped_endpoints_with_round_trip(|target, request, timeout| {
 3759:             self.controller
 3760:                 .authoritative_transport_round_trip(target, request, timeout)
 3761:                 .map(|response| StunTransportRoundTrip {
 3762:                     response: response.payload,
 3763:                     remote_addr: response.remote_addr,
 3764:                     local_addr: response.local_addr,
 3765:                 })
 3766:                 .map_err(|err| err.to_string())
 3767:         });
 3768:         self.local_stun_observations = results.clone();
 3769:         self.local_stun_candidates = results
 3770:             .into_iter()
 3771:             .map(|result| result.mapped_endpoint)
 3772:             .collect();
 3773:         if !self.local_stun_candidates.is_empty() {
 3774:             eprintln!(
 3775:                 "rustynetd: authoritative stun candidates updated: {:?}",
 3776:                 self.local_stun_candidates
 3777:             );
 3778:         }
 3779:     }

 3783:     }

 3831:     fn selected_exit_peer_endpoint_summary(&self) -> (String, String) {
 3832:         let Some(selected_exit_node) = self.selected_exit_node.as_deref() else {
 3833:             return ("none".to_string(), "none".to_string());
 3834:         };
 3835:         let node_id = match NodeId::new(selected_exit_node.to_string()) {
 3836:             Ok(node_id) => node_id,
 3837:             Err(err) => {
 3838:                 return (
 3839:                     "none".to_string(),
 3840:                     sanitize_netcheck_value(&err.to_string()),
 3841:                 );
 3842:             }
 3843:         };
 3844:         match self.controller.current_peer_endpoint(&node_id) {
 3845:             Ok(Some(endpoint)) => (
 3846:                 sanitize_netcheck_value(&format!("{}:{}", endpoint.addr, endpoint.port)),
 3847:                 "none".to_string(),
 3848:             ),
 3849:             Ok(None) => ("none".to_string(), "none".to_string()),
 3850:             Err(err) => (
 3851:                 "none".to_string(),
 3852:                 sanitize_netcheck_value(&err.to_string()),
 3853:             ),
 3854:         }
 3855:     }

 3857:     fn managed_peer_endpoints_summary(&self) -> (String, String) {
 3858:         match self.controller.current_peer_endpoints() {
 3859:             Ok(endpoints) => {
 3860:                 if endpoints.is_empty() {
 3861:                     return ("none".to_string(), "none".to_string());
 3862:                 }
 3863:                 let summary = endpoints
 3864:                     .into_iter()
 3865:                     .map(|(node_id, endpoint)| match endpoint {
 3866:                         Some(endpoint) => format!(
 3867:                             "{node_id}/{addr}:{port}",
 3868:                             addr = endpoint.addr,
 3869:                             port = endpoint.port
 3870:                         ),
 3871:                         None => format!("{node_id}/none"),
 3872:                     })
 3873:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 3874:                     .join("+");
 3875:                 (sanitize_netcheck_value(&summary), "none".to_string())
 3876:             }
 3877:             Err(err) => (
 3878:                 "none".to_string(),
 3879:                 sanitize_netcheck_value(&err.to_string()),
 3880:             ),
 3881:         }
 3882:     }

 3898:     fn netcheck_response_line(&self) -> String {
 3899:         let path_state = self.runtime_path_state_summary();
 3900:         let path_mode = path_state.live_mode;
 3901:         let path_reason = sanitize_netcheck_value(path_state.live_reason.as_str());
 3902:         let path_programmed_mode = path_state.programmed_mode;
 3903:         let path_programmed_reason = sanitize_netcheck_value(path_state.programmed_reason.as_str());
 3904:         let path_live_proven = if path_state.live_proven {
 3905:             "true"
 3906:         } else {
 3907:             "false"
 3908:         };
 3909:         let path_latest_live_handshake_unix = path_state
 3910:             .latest_live_handshake_unix
 3911:             .map(|value| value.to_string())
 3912:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string());
 3913:         let relay_session_configured = if path_state.relay_session_configured {
 3914:             "true"
 3915:         } else {
 3916:             "false"
 3917:         };
 3918:         let relay_session_next_expiry_unix = path_state
 3919:             .relay_session_next_expiry_unix
 3920:             .map(|value| value.to_string())
 3921:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string());
 3922:         let traversal_authority = self.traversal_authority_mode().as_str();
 3923:         let (
 3924:             probe_result,
 3925:             probe_reason,
 3926:             probe_attempts,
 3927:             probe_endpoint,
 3928:             probe_handshake_unix,
 3929:             probe_next_reprobe_unix,
 3930:             probe_peer_count,
 3931:             probe_direct_peers,
 3932:             probe_relay_peers,
 3933:         ) = self.traversal_probe_summary();
 3934: 
 3935:         let now = unix_now();
 3936:         let (traversal_status, source, target, generated_at, expires_at, age_secs, remaining_secs) =
 3937:             if let Some(envelope) = self.traversal_hints.as_ref() {
 3938:                 let generated = envelope
 3939:                     .bundles
 3940:                     .first()
 3941:                     .map(|bundle| bundle.bundle.generated_at_unix)
 3942:                     .unwrap_or(0);
 3943:                 let expires = envelope
 3944:                     .bundles
 3945:                     .first()
 3946:                     .map(|bundle| bundle.bundle.expires_at_unix)
 3947:                     .unwrap_or(0);
 3948:                 let age = now.saturating_sub(generated);
 3949:                 let remaining = expires.saturating_sub(now);
 3950:                 let mut sources = BTreeSet::new();
 3951:                 let mut targets = BTreeSet::new();
 3952:                 for bundle in &envelope.bundles {

 4112:     fn all_local_candidates(&self) -> Vec<ProbeTraversalCandidate> {
 4113:         let mut candidates = Vec::new();
 4114:         // Host candidates
 4115:         for (iface, addrs) in &self.local_host_candidates {
 4116:             if !interface_name_is_usable_for_traversal_host_candidate(iface.as_str()) {
 4117:                 continue;
 4118:             }
 4119:             for ip in addrs {
 4120:                 if !ip_is_usable_for_traversal_host_candidate(*ip) {
 4121:                     continue;
 4122:                 }
 4123: 
 4124:                 candidates.push(ProbeTraversalCandidate {
 4125:                     endpoint: SocketEndpoint {
 4126:                         addr: *ip,
 4127:                         port: self.wg_listen_port,
 4128:                     },
 4129:                     source: ProbeCandidateSource::Host,
 4130:                     priority: 300,
 4131:                     observed_at_unix: unix_now(),
 4132:                 });
 4133:             }
 4134:         }
 4135:         // STUN candidates
 4136:         for endpoint in &self.local_stun_candidates {
 4137:             candidates.push(ProbeTraversalCandidate {
 4138:                 endpoint: SocketEndpoint {
 4139:                     addr: endpoint.ip(),
 4140:                     port: endpoint.port(),
 4141:                 },
 4142:                 source: ProbeCandidateSource::ServerReflexive,
 4143:                 priority: 200,
 4144:                 observed_at_unix: unix_now(),
 4145:             });
 4146:         }
 4147:         candidates
 4148:     }
