 4165:     fn sync_traversal_runtime_state(&mut self, force_reprobe: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
 4166:         let now_unix = unix_now();
 4167:         if let Some(mut relay_client) = self.relay_client.take() {
 4168:             let freshness_secs = self.traversal_probe_handshake_freshness_secs;
 4169:             let active_relay_peers = self
 4170:                 .traversal_probe_statuses
 4171:                 .iter()
 4172:                 .filter(|(_node_id, status)| {
 4173:                     status.decision == TraversalProbeDecision::Relay
 4174:                         && status
 4175:                             .latest_handshake_unix
 4176:                             .map(|timestamp| now_unix.saturating_sub(timestamp) <= freshness_secs)
 4177:                             .unwrap_or(false)
 4178:                 })
 4179:                 .map(|(node_id, _status)| node_id.clone())
 4180:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 4181:             for node_id in active_relay_peers {
 4182:                 relay_client.touch_session(&node_id);
 4183:             }
 4184:             if self.transport_socket_identity_blocker.is_none() {
 4185:                 for peer_node_id in relay_client.sessions_needing_keepalive() {
 4186:                     if let Err(err) = relay_client.send_keepalive_with_sender(
 4187:                         &peer_node_id,
 4188:                         |remote_addr, payload| {
 4189:                             self.controller
 4190:                                 .authoritative_transport_send(remote_addr, payload)
 4191:                                 .map(|_| ())
 4192:                                 .map_err(|error| {
 4193:                                     RelayClientError::AuthoritativeTransport(error.to_string())
 4194:                                 })
 4195:                         },
 4196:                     ) {
 4197:                         eprintln!(
 4198:                             "rustynetd: relay keepalive failed for peer {}: {err}",
 4199:                             peer_node_id.as_str()
 4200:                         );
 4201:                     }
 4202:                 }
 4203:             }
 4204:             relay_client
 4205:                 .cleanup_idle_sessions(Duration::from_secs(self.relay_session_idle_timeout_secs));
 4206:             self.relay_client = Some(relay_client);
 4207:         }
 4208:         if !matches!(
 4209:             self.controller.state(),
 4210:             DataplaneState::DataplaneApplied | DataplaneState::ExitActive
 4211:         ) {
 4212:             self.traversal_probe_statuses.clear();
 4213:             return Ok(());
 4214:         }
 4215: 
 4216:         if let Some(err) = self.traversal_hint_error.as_deref()
 4217:             && self.traversal_authority_mode().is_enforced()
 4218:         {
 4219:             self.traversal_probe_statuses.clear();
 4220:             return Err(format!(
 4221:                 "traversal authority rejected invalid traversal state: {err}"
 4222:             ));
 4223:         }
 4224: 
 4225:         let Some(envelope) = self.traversal_hints.clone() else {
 4226:             self.traversal_probe_statuses.clear();
 4227:             if self.traversal_authority_mode().is_enforced()
 4228:                 && !self.controller.managed_peer_ids().is_empty()
 4229:             {
 4230:                 return Err(
 4231:                     "traversal authority requires signed traversal state for all managed peers"
 4232:                         .to_string(),
 4233:                 );
 4234:             }
 4235:             return Ok(());
 4236:         };
 4237: 
 4238:         let traversal_index =
 4239:             self.build_verified_traversal_index(&self.membership_directory, &envelope)?;
 4240:         let managed_peer_ids = self.controller.managed_peer_ids();
 4241:         let managed_peer_set = managed_peer_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
 4242:         let indexed_peer_set = traversal_index.keys().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
 4243:         let extra_peers = indexed_peer_set
 4244:             .difference(&managed_peer_set)
 4245:             .map(|node_id| node_id.as_str().to_string())
 4246:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 4247:         if !extra_peers.is_empty() {
 4248:             self.traversal_probe_statuses.clear();
 4249:             return Err(format!(
 4250:                 "traversal authority snapshot contains unmanaged peers: {}",

 4253:         }
 4254:         self.refresh_local_host_candidates_for_traversal();
 4255:         let local_candidates = self.all_local_candidates();
 4256:         let previous_statuses = self.traversal_probe_statuses.clone();
 4257:         let mut statuses = BTreeMap::new();
 4258:         for remote_node_id in managed_peer_ids {
 4259:             let Some(bundle) = traversal_index.get(&remote_node_id) else {
 4260:                 self.traversal_probe_statuses.clear();

 4406:                 })?;
 4407:             if report.decision == TraversalProbeDecision::Direct {
 4408:                 self.close_relay_session(&remote_node_id);
 4409:             } else if self.traversal_handshake_is_fresh(report.latest_handshake_unix, now_unix)
 4410:                 && let Some(relay_client) = self.relay_client.as_mut()
 4411:             {
 4412:                 relay_client.touch_session(&remote_node_id);
 4413:             }
 4414:             statuses.insert(
 4415:                 remote_node_id.clone(),
 4416:                 TraversalProbeStatus {
 4417:                     remote_node_id: remote_node_id.as_str().to_string(),
 4418:                     decision: report.decision,
 4419:                     reason: report.reason,
 4420:                     attempts: report.attempts,
 4421:                     selected_endpoint: report.selected_endpoint,
 4422:                     latest_handshake_unix: report.latest_handshake_unix,
 4423:                     evaluated_at_unix: now_unix,
 4424:                     next_reprobe_unix: (report.decision == TraversalProbeDecision::Relay).then(
 4425:                         || now_unix.saturating_add(self.traversal_probe_reprobe_interval_secs),
 4426:                     ),
 4427:                 },
 4428:             );
 4429:         }
 4430:         self.traversal_probe_statuses = statuses;
 4431:         Ok(())
 4432:     }
 4433: 
 4434:     fn traversal_probe_due(
 4435:         &self,
 4436:         current: TraversalProbeCurrentState,
 4437:         direct_candidates: &[ProbeTraversalCandidate],
 4438:         existing_status: Option<&TraversalProbeStatus>,
 4439:         now_unix: u64,
 4440:         force_reprobe: bool,
 4441:     ) -> bool {
 4442:         if force_reprobe {
 4443:             return true;
 4444:         }
 4445:         let Some(status) = existing_status else {
 4446:             return true;
 4447:         };
 4448: 
 4449:         match current.path {
 4450:             Some(PathMode::Direct) => {
 4451:                 let current_endpoint_is_direct_candidate = current
 4452:                     .endpoint
 4453:                     .map(|endpoint| {
 4454:                         direct_candidates
 4455:                             .iter()
 4456:                             .any(|candidate| candidate.endpoint == endpoint)
 4457:                     })
 4458:                     .unwrap_or(false);
 4459:                 !current_endpoint_is_direct_candidate
 4460:                     || !self.traversal_handshake_is_fresh(
 4461:                         current
 4462:                             .latest_handshake_unix
 4463:                             .or(status.latest_handshake_unix),
 4464:                         now_unix,
 4465:                     )
 4466:             }
 4467:             Some(PathMode::Relay) => status
 4468:                 .next_reprobe_unix
 4469:                 .map(|next| now_unix >= next)
 4470:                 .unwrap_or(true),
 4471:             None => true,
 4472:         }
 4473:     }
 4474: 
 4475:     fn relay_session_refresh_due(
 4476:         &self,
 4477:         remote_node_id: &NodeId,
 4478:         bundle: &TraversalBundleEnvelope,
 4479:         now_unix: u64,
 4480:     ) -> Result<bool, String> {
 4481:         let Some(relay_client) = self.relay_client.as_ref() else {
 4482:             return Ok(false);
 4483:         };
 4484:         let Some(relay_candidate) = select_runtime_relay_candidate(&bundle.bundle.candidates)?
 4485:         else {
 4486:             return Ok(false);
 4487:         };
 4488:         let Some(session) = relay_client.session_for_peer(remote_node_id) else {
 4489:             return Ok(true);
 4490:         };
 4491:         Ok(session.relay_addr != relay_candidate.endpoint
 4492:             || session.relay_id != relay_candidate.relay_id
 4493:             || session.token_refresh_due(now_unix, self.relay_session_refresh_margin_secs))
 4494:     }
 4495: 
 4496:     fn resolve_relay_client_endpoint(
 4497:         &mut self,
 4498:         remote_node_id: &NodeId,
 4499:         bundle: &TraversalBundleEnvelope,
 4500:         now_unix: u64,
 4501:     ) -> Result<Option<SocketEndpoint>, String> {
 4502:         if self.transport_socket_identity_blocker.is_some() {
 4503:             return Ok(None);
 4504:         }
 4505:         let Some(relay_candidate) = select_runtime_relay_candidate(&bundle.bundle.candidates)?
 4506:         else {
 4507:             return Ok(None);
 4508:         };
 4509:         let Some(relay_client) = self.relay_client.as_ref() else {
 4510:             return Ok(None);
 4511:         };
 4512:         let needs_refresh = match relay_client.session_for_peer(remote_node_id) {
 4513:             Some(session) => {
 4514:                 session.relay_addr != relay_candidate.endpoint
 4515:                     || session.relay_id != relay_candidate.relay_id
 4516:                     || session.token_refresh_due(now_unix, self.relay_session_refresh_margin_secs)
 4517:             }
 4518:             None => true,
 4519:         };
 4520:         if !needs_refresh {
 4521:             return Ok(relay_client.relay_endpoint_for_peer(remote_node_id));
 4522:         }
 4523:         let mut relay_client = self
 4524:             .relay_client
 4525:             .take()
 4526:             .expect("relay client should remain available during establish");
 4527:         let endpoint = relay_client.establish_session_with_round_trip(
 4528:             remote_node_id,
 4529:             relay_candidate.endpoint,
 4530:             relay_candidate.relay_id,
 4531:             self.relay_session_token_ttl_secs,
 4532:             |remote_addr, payload, timeout| {
 4533:                 self.controller
 4534:                     .authoritative_transport_round_trip(remote_addr, payload, timeout)
 4535:                     .map(|response| (response.payload, response.remote_addr))
 4536:                     .map_err(|err| RelayClientError::AuthoritativeTransport(err.to_string()))
 4537:             },
 4538:         );
 4539:         self.relay_client = Some(relay_client);
 4540:         let endpoint = endpoint.map_err(|err| {
 4541:             format!(
 4542:                 "relay session establishment failed for peer {} via {}: {err}",
 4543:                 remote_node_id.as_str(),
 4544:                 relay_candidate.endpoint
 4545:             )
 4546:         })?;
 4547:         Ok(Some(endpoint))
 4548:     }
 4549: 
 4550:     fn close_relay_session(&mut self, remote_node_id: &NodeId) {
 4551:         if let Some(relay_client) = self.relay_client.as_mut() {
 4552:             relay_client.close_session(remote_node_id);
 4553:         }
 4554:     }
 4555: 
 4556:     fn traversal_handshake_is_fresh(&self, value: Option<u64>, now_unix: u64) -> bool {
 4557:         value
 4558:             .map(|timestamp| {
 4559:                 now_unix.saturating_sub(timestamp) <= self.traversal_probe_handshake_freshness_secs
 4560:             })
 4561:             .unwrap_or(false)
 4562:     }
 4563: 
 4564:     fn traversal_authority_mode(&self) -> TraversalAuthorityMode {
 4565:         if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 4566:             TraversalAuthorityMode::EnforcedV1
 4567:         } else {
 4568:             TraversalAuthorityMode::StaticAssignment
 4569:         }
 4570:     }
 4571: 
 4572:     fn apply_traversal_authority_to_peers(
 4573:         &self,
 4574:         mut peers: Vec<PeerConfig>,
 4575:         membership_directory: &MembershipDirectory,
 4576:     ) -> Result<Vec<PeerConfig>, String> {
 4577:         if !self.traversal_authority_mode().is_enforced() {
 4578:             return Ok(peers);
 4579:         }
 4580:         if let Some(err) = self.traversal_hint_error.as_deref() {
 4581:             return Err(format!(
 4582:                 "traversal authority requires valid signed traversal state: {err}"
 4583:             ));
 4584:         }
 4585: 
 4586:         let Some(envelope) = self.traversal_hints.as_ref() else {
 4587:             return Err(
 4588:                 "traversal authority requires signed traversal state for all managed peers"
 4589:                     .to_string(),
 4590:             );
 4591:         };
 4592:         let traversal_index =
 4593:             self.build_verified_traversal_index(membership_directory, envelope)?;
 4594:         let expected_peers = peers
 4595:             .iter()
 4596:             .map(|peer| peer.node_id.clone())
 4597:             .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
 4598:         let indexed_peers = traversal_index.keys().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
 4599:         let missing_peers = expected_peers
 4600:             .difference(&indexed_peers)
 4601:             .map(|node_id| node_id.as_str().to_string())
 4602:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 4603:         if !missing_peers.is_empty() {
 4604:             return Err(format!(
 4605:                 "traversal authority is missing signed traversal state for managed peers: {}",
 4606:                 missing_peers.join(",")
 4607:             ));
 4608:         }
 4609:         let extra_peers = indexed_peers
 4610:             .difference(&expected_peers)
 4611:             .map(|node_id| node_id.as_str().to_string())
 4612:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 4613:         if !extra_peers.is_empty() {
 4614:             return Err(format!(
 4615:                 "traversal authority snapshot contains unmanaged peers: {}",
 4616:                 extra_peers.join(",")
 4617:             ));
 4618:         }
 4619: 
 4620:         for peer in &mut peers {
 4621:             let bundle = traversal_index.get(&peer.node_id).ok_or_else(|| {
 4622:                 format!(
 4623:                     "traversal authority is missing signed traversal state for managed peer {}",
 4624:                     peer.node_id.as_str()
 4625:                 )
 4626:             })?;
 4627:             if let Some(status) = self.traversal_probe_statuses.get(&peer.node_id) {
 4628:                 peer.endpoint = status.selected_endpoint;
 4629:             } else {
 4630:                 peer.endpoint = self.static_traversal_endpoint(bundle, &peer.node_id)?;
 4631:             }
 4632:         }
 4633:         Ok(peers)
 4634:     }
 4635: 
 4636:     fn static_traversal_endpoint(
 4637:         &self,
 4638:         bundle: &TraversalBundleEnvelope,
 4639:         remote_node_id: &NodeId,
 4640:     ) -> Result<SocketEndpoint, String> {
 4641:         let endpoints = select_runtime_traversal_endpoints(&bundle.bundle.candidates);
 4642:         endpoints.1.or(endpoints.0).ok_or_else(|| {
 4643:             format!(
 4644:                 "traversal authority bundle for peer {} contains no usable runtime endpoints",
 4645:                 remote_node_id.as_str()
 4646:             )
 4647:         })
 4648:     }
 4649: 
 4650:     fn validated_traversal_coordination_schedule(
 4651:         &mut self,
 4652:         remote_node_id: &NodeId,
 4653:         now_unix: u64,
 4654:     ) -> Result<Option<CoordinationSchedule>, String> {
 4655:         let key =
 4656:             traversal_coordination_pair_key(self.local_node_id.as_str(), remote_node_id.as_str());
 4657:         let Some(record) = self
 4658:             .verified_traversal_coordination_index
 4659:             .get(&key)
 4660:             .cloned()
 4661:         else {
 4662:             return Ok(None);
 4663:         };
 4664:         let verifier_key_bytes = self
 4665:             .traversal_hints
 4666:             .as_ref()
 4667:             .map(|envelope| envelope.verifier_key_bytes)
 4668:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 4669:                 format!(
 4670:                     "validated traversal coordination for peer {} is unavailable because traversal state is not loaded",
 4671:                     remote_node_id.as_str()
 4672:                 )
 4673:             })?;
 4674:         let local_node_id = NodeId::new(self.local_node_id.clone()).map_err(|err| {
 4675:             format!(
 4676:                 "local traversal coordination identity is invalid for peer {}: {err}",
 4677:                 remote_node_id.as_str()
 4678:             )
 4679:         })?;
 4680:         let engine = TraversalEngine::new(self.traversal_probe_config.clone())
 4681:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid traversal engine config: {err}"))?;
 4682:         engine
 4683:             .validate_signed_coordination_record(
 4684:                 &record,
 4685:                 &local_node_id,
 4686:                 remote_node_id,
 4687:                 &verifier_key_bytes,
 4688:                 &mut self.traversal_coordination_replay_window,
 4689:                 now_unix,
 4690:             )
 4691:             .map(Some)
 4692:             .map_err(|err| {
 4693:                 format!(
 4694:                     "validated traversal coordination for peer {} is unavailable: {err}",
 4695:                     remote_node_id.as_str()
 4696:                 )
 4697:             })
 4698:     }
 4699: 
 4700:     fn build_verified_traversal_index(
 4701:         &self,
 4702:         membership_directory: &MembershipDirectory,
 4703:         envelope: &TraversalBundleSetEnvelope,
 4704:     ) -> Result<BTreeMap<NodeId, TraversalBundleEnvelope>, String> {
 4705:         let mut index = BTreeMap::new();
 4706:         for bundle in &envelope.bundles {
 4707:             let Some(remote_node_id) = self.traversal_remote_node_id(
 4708:                 bundle.bundle.source_node_id.as_str(),
 4709:                 bundle.bundle.target_node_id.as_str(),
 4710:             ) else {
 4711:                 return Err(format!(
 4712:                     "traversal authority bundle {} -> {} does not include local node {}",
 4713:                     bundle.bundle.source_node_id, bundle.bundle.target_node_id, self.local_node_id
 4714:                 ));
 4715:             };
 4716:             if membership_directory.node_status(remote_node_id.as_str()) != MembershipStatus::Active
 4717:             {
 4718:                 return Err(format!(
 4719:                     "traversal authority target {} is not active in membership state",
 4720:                     remote_node_id.as_str()
 4721:                 ));
 4722:             }
 4723:             if index
 4724:                 .insert(remote_node_id.clone(), bundle.clone())
 4725:                 .is_some()
 4726:             {
 4727:                 return Err(format!(
 4728:                     "traversal authority contains duplicate bundle entries for peer {}",
 4729:                     remote_node_id.as_str()
 4730:                 ));
 4731:             }
 4732:         }
 4733:         Ok(index)
 4734:     }
 4735: 
 4736:     fn traversal_probe_summary(
 4737:         &self,
 4738:     ) -> (
 4739:         String,
 4740:         String,
 4741:         String,
 4742:         String,
 4743:         String,
 4744:         String,
 4745:         usize,
 4746:         usize,
 4747:         usize,
 4748:     ) {
 4749:         if self.traversal_probe_statuses.is_empty() {
 4750:             return (
 4751:                 "none".to_string(),
 4752:                 "none".to_string(),
 4753:                 "0".to_string(),
 4754:                 "none".to_string(),
 4755:                 "none".to_string(),
 4756:                 "none".to_string(),
 4757:                 0,
 4758:                 0,
 4759:                 0,
 4760:             );
 4761:         }
 4762: 
 4763:         let direct_peers = self
 4764:             .traversal_probe_statuses
 4765:             .values()
 4766:             .filter(|status| status.decision == TraversalProbeDecision::Direct)
 4767:             .count();
 4768:         let relay_peers = self
 4769:             .traversal_probe_statuses
 4770:             .values()
 4771:             .filter(|status| status.decision == TraversalProbeDecision::Relay)
 4772:             .count();
 4773:         if self.traversal_probe_statuses.len() == 1 {
 4774:             let status = self
 4775:                 .traversal_probe_statuses
 4776:                 .values()
 4777:                 .next()
 4778:                 .expect("single traversal probe status should exist");
 4779:             return (
 4780:                 status.decision.as_str().to_string(),
 4781:                 status.reason.as_str().to_string(),
 4782:                 status.attempts.to_string(),
 4783:                 sanitize_netcheck_value(&format!(
 4784:                     "{}:{}",
 4785:                     status.selected_endpoint.addr, status.selected_endpoint.port
 4786:                 )),
 4787:                 status
 4788:                     .latest_handshake_unix
 4789:                     .map(|value| value.to_string())
 4790:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string()),
 4791:                 status
 4792:                     .next_reprobe_unix
 4793:                     .map(|value| value.to_string())
 4794:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string()),
 4795:                 1,
 4796:                 direct_peers,
 4797:                 relay_peers,
 4798:             );
 4799:         }
 4800: 
 4801:         let combined_result = if direct_peers == self.traversal_probe_statuses.len() {
 4802:             "direct"
 4803:         } else if relay_peers == self.traversal_probe_statuses.len() {
 4804:             "relay"
 4805:         } else {
 4806:             "mixed"
 4807:         };
 4808:         (
 4809:             combined_result.to_string(),
 4810:             "multi_peer_summary".to_string(),
 4811:             self.traversal_probe_statuses
 4812:                 .values()
 4813:                 .map(|status| status.attempts)
 4814:                 .sum::<usize>()
 4815:                 .to_string(),
 4816:             "multiple".to_string(),
 4817:             "multiple".to_string(),
 4818:             "multiple".to_string(),
 4819:             self.traversal_probe_statuses.len(),
 4820:             direct_peers,
 4821:             relay_peers,
 4822:         )
 4823:     }
 4824: 
 4825:     fn runtime_path_state_summary(&self) -> RuntimePathStateSummary {
 4826:         let now_unix = unix_now();
 4827:         match self.controller.state() {
 4828:             DataplaneState::FailClosed => {
 4829:                 return RuntimePathStateSummary {
 4830:                     live_mode: "fail_closed",
 4831:                     live_reason: "fail_closed".to_string(),
 4832:                     programmed_mode: "fail_closed",
 4833:                     programmed_reason: "fail_closed".to_string(),
 4834:                     live_proven: false,
 4835:                     programmed_peer_count: 0,
 4836:                     live_peer_count: 0,
 4837:                     programmed_direct_peers: 0,
 4838:                     programmed_relay_peers: 0,
 4839:                     live_direct_peers: 0,
 4840:                     live_relay_peers: 0,
 4841:                     latest_live_handshake_unix: None,
 4842:                     relay_session_configured: self.relay_client.is_some(),
 4843:                     relay_session_state: self.relay_session_inactive_state(),
 4844:                     relay_session_established_peers: 0,
 4845:                     relay_session_expired_peers: 0,
 4846:                     relay_session_next_expiry_unix: None,
 4847:                 };
 4848:             }
 4849:             DataplaneState::ControlTrusted => {
 4850:                 return RuntimePathStateSummary {
 4851:                     live_mode: "control_trusted",
 4852:                     live_reason: "control_trusted".to_string(),
 4853:                     programmed_mode: "control_trusted",
 4854:                     programmed_reason: "control_trusted".to_string(),
 4855:                     live_proven: false,
 4856:                     programmed_peer_count: 0,
 4857:                     live_peer_count: 0,
 4858:                     programmed_direct_peers: 0,
 4859:                     programmed_relay_peers: 0,
 4860:                     live_direct_peers: 0,
 4861:                     live_relay_peers: 0,
 4862:                     latest_live_handshake_unix: None,
 4863:                     relay_session_configured: self.relay_client.is_some(),
 4864:                     relay_session_state: self.relay_session_inactive_state(),
 4865:                     relay_session_established_peers: 0,
 4866:                     relay_session_expired_peers: 0,
 4867:                     relay_session_next_expiry_unix: None,
 4868:                 };
 4869:             }
 4870:             DataplaneState::Init => {
 4871:                 return RuntimePathStateSummary {
 4872:                     live_mode: "initializing",
 4873:                     live_reason: "init".to_string(),
 4874:                     programmed_mode: "initializing",
 4875:                     programmed_reason: "init".to_string(),
 4876:                     live_proven: false,
 4877:                     programmed_peer_count: 0,
 4878:                     live_peer_count: 0,
 4879:                     programmed_direct_peers: 0,
 4880:                     programmed_relay_peers: 0,
 4881:                     live_direct_peers: 0,
 4882:                     live_relay_peers: 0,
 4883:                     latest_live_handshake_unix: None,
 4884:                     relay_session_configured: self.relay_client.is_some(),
 4885:                     relay_session_state: self.relay_session_inactive_state(),
 4886:                     relay_session_established_peers: 0,
 4887:                     relay_session_expired_peers: 0,
 4888:                     relay_session_next_expiry_unix: None,
 4889:                 };
 4890:             }
 4891:             DataplaneState::DataplaneApplied | DataplaneState::ExitActive => {}
 4892:         }
 4893: 
 4894:         let relay_session_configured = self.relay_client.is_some();
 4895:         let managed_peer_ids = self.controller.managed_peer_ids();
 4896:         let programmed_peer_count = managed_peer_ids.len();
 4897:         let mut programmed_direct_peers = 0usize;
 4898:         let mut programmed_relay_peers = 0usize;
 4899:         let mut live_direct_peers = 0usize;
 4900:         let mut live_relay_peers = 0usize;
 4901:         let mut latest_live_handshake_unix: Option<u64> = None;
 4902:         let mut relay_session_established_peers = 0usize;
 4903:         let mut relay_session_expired_peers = 0usize;
 4904:         let mut relay_session_selected_endpoint_peers = 0usize;
 4905:         let mut relay_session_next_expiry_unix: Option<u64> = None;
 4906:         let mut direct_live_reasons = BTreeSet::new();
 4907: 
 4908:         for node_id in managed_peer_ids {
 4909:             let Some(path) = self.controller.peer_path(&node_id) else {
 4910:                 continue;
 4911:             };
 4912:             let status = self.traversal_probe_statuses.get(&node_id);
 4913:             let handshake_unix = status.and_then(|entry| entry.latest_handshake_unix);
 4914:             let handshake_fresh = self.traversal_handshake_is_fresh(handshake_unix, now_unix);
 4915: 
 4916:             match path {
 4917:                 PathMode::Direct => {
 4918:                     programmed_direct_peers = programmed_direct_peers.saturating_add(1);
 4919:                     if handshake_fresh {
 4920:                         live_direct_peers = live_direct_peers.saturating_add(1);
 4921:                         latest_live_handshake_unix = Some(
 4922:                             latest_live_handshake_unix
 4923:                                 .unwrap_or(0)
 4924:                                 .max(handshake_unix.expect(
 4925:                                 "fresh direct handshake must carry a latest handshake timestamp",
 4926:                             )),
 4927:                         );
 4928:                         if let Some(status) = status {
 4929:                             direct_live_reasons.insert(status.reason.as_str());
 4930:                         }
 4931:                     }
 4932:                 }
 4933:                 PathMode::Relay => {
 4934:                     programmed_relay_peers = programmed_relay_peers.saturating_add(1);
 4935:                     let current_endpoint = self.controller.managed_peer_endpoint(&node_id);
 4936:                     let session = self
 4937:                         .relay_client
 4938:                         .as_ref()
 4939:                         .and_then(|client| client.session_for_peer(&node_id));
 4940:                     if let Some(session) = session {
 4941:                         relay_session_next_expiry_unix =
 4942:                             Some(match relay_session_next_expiry_unix {
 4943:                                 Some(value) => value.min(session.token_expires_at_unix),
 4944:                                 None => session.token_expires_at_unix,
 4945:                             });
 4946:                         if session.is_expired(now_unix) {
 4947:                             relay_session_expired_peers =
 4948:                                 relay_session_expired_peers.saturating_add(1);
 4949:                             continue;
 4950:                         }
 4951: 
 4952:                         relay_session_established_peers =
 4953:                             relay_session_established_peers.saturating_add(1);
 4954:                         let selected_endpoint_matches = current_endpoint
 4955:                             .map(|endpoint| session.matches_selected_endpoint(endpoint))
 4956:                             .unwrap_or(false);
 4957:                         if selected_endpoint_matches {
 4958:                             relay_session_selected_endpoint_peers =
 4959:                                 relay_session_selected_endpoint_peers.saturating_add(1);
 4960:                         }
 4961:                         if selected_endpoint_matches && handshake_fresh {
 4962:                             live_relay_peers = live_relay_peers.saturating_add(1);
 4963:                             latest_live_handshake_unix = Some(
 4964:                                 latest_live_handshake_unix
 4965:                                     .unwrap_or(0)
 4966:                                     .max(handshake_unix.expect(
 4967:                                     "fresh relay handshake must carry a latest handshake timestamp",
 4968:                                 )),
 4969:                             );
 4970:                         }
 4971:                     }
 4972:                 }
 4973:             }
 4974:         }
 4975: 
 4976:         let programmed_mode = if programmed_relay_peers > 0 && programmed_direct_peers > 0 {
 4977:             "mixed_programmed"
 4978:         } else if programmed_relay_peers > 0 {
 4979:             "relay_programmed"
 4980:         } else {
 4981:             "direct_programmed"
 4982:         };
 4983:         let programmed_reason = if programmed_relay_peers > 0 {
 4984:             "relay_endpoint_programmed".to_string()
 4985:         } else if self.controller.has_armed_relay_path() {
 4986:             "relay_armed".to_string()
 4987:         } else if self.traversal_authority_mode().is_enforced() && self.traversal_hints.is_some() {
 4988:             "traversal_authority".to_string()
 4989:         } else {
 4990:             "static_assignment".to_string()
 4991:         };
 4992: 
 4993:         let live_peer_count = live_direct_peers.saturating_add(live_relay_peers);
 4994:         let live_mode = if live_peer_count == 0 {
 4995:             programmed_mode
 4996:         } else if live_peer_count < programmed_peer_count {
 4997:             "mixed_active"
 4998:         } else if live_relay_peers == programmed_peer_count {
 4999:             "relay_active"
 5000:         } else if live_direct_peers == programmed_peer_count {
 5001:             "direct_active"
 5002:         } else {
 5003:             "mixed_active"
 5004:         };
 5005:         let live_reason = match live_mode {
 5006:             "direct_active" => {
 5007:                 if direct_live_reasons.len() == 1 {
 5008:                     direct_live_reasons
 5009:                         .iter()
 5010:                         .next()
 5011:                         .copied()
 5012:                         .unwrap_or("fresh_handshake_observed")
 5013:                         .to_string()
 5014:                 } else {
 5015:                     "fresh_handshake_observed".to_string()
 5016:                 }
 5017:             }
 5018:             "relay_active" => "relay_selected_endpoint_with_fresh_handshake".to_string(),
 5019:             "mixed_active" => {
 5020:                 if live_peer_count < programmed_peer_count {
 5021:                     "partial_live_proof".to_string()
 5022:                 } else {
 5023:                     "mixed_live_paths".to_string()
 5024:                 }
 5025:             }
 5026:             _ => {
 5027:                 if programmed_relay_peers > 0 {
 5028:                     if !relay_session_configured {
 5029:                         "relay_session_disabled".to_string()
 5030:                     } else if self.transport_socket_identity_blocker.is_some() {
 5031:                         "relay_transport_identity_blocked".to_string()
 5032:                     } else if self.controller.authoritative_transport_identity().is_none() {
 5033:                         "relay_transport_unavailable".to_string()
 5034:                     } else if relay_session_expired_peers > 0 {
 5035:                         "relay_session_expired".to_string()
 5036:                     } else if relay_session_established_peers == 0 {
 5037:                         "relay_session_missing".to_string()
 5038:                     } else if relay_session_selected_endpoint_peers < programmed_relay_peers {
 5039:                         "relay_endpoint_unselected".to_string()
 5040:                     } else {
 5041:                         "relay_handshake_unproven".to_string()
 5042:                     }
 5043:                 } else if programmed_direct_peers > 0 {
 5044:                     "direct_handshake_unproven".to_string()
 5045:                 } else {
 5046:                     programmed_reason.clone()
 5047:                 }
 5048:             }
 5049:         };
 5050: 
 5051:         let relay_session_state = if !relay_session_configured {
 5052:             "disabled"
 5053:         } else if self.transport_socket_identity_blocker.is_some() {
 5054:             "blocked_transport_identity"
 5055:         } else if self.controller.authoritative_transport_identity().is_none() {
 5056:             "unavailable_authoritative_transport"
 5057:         } else if programmed_relay_peers == 0 {
 5058:             "unused"
 5059:         } else if relay_session_established_peers == 0 {
 5060:             "missing"
 5061:         } else if relay_session_expired_peers > 0 {
 5062:             "expired"
 5063:         } else if relay_session_established_peers < programmed_relay_peers {
 5064:             "partial"
 5065:         } else if live_relay_peers == programmed_relay_peers {
 5066:             "live"
 5067:         } else if relay_session_selected_endpoint_peers < programmed_relay_peers {
 5068:             "endpoint_unselected"
 5069:         } else {
 5070:             "established_unproven"
 5071:         };
 5072: 
 5073:         RuntimePathStateSummary {
 5074:             live_mode,
 5075:             live_reason,
 5076:             programmed_mode,
 5077:             programmed_reason,
 5078:             live_proven: live_peer_count == programmed_peer_count && programmed_peer_count > 0,
 5079:             programmed_peer_count,
 5080:             live_peer_count,
 5081:             programmed_direct_peers,
 5082:             programmed_relay_peers,
 5083:             live_direct_peers,
 5084:             live_relay_peers,
 5085:             latest_live_handshake_unix,
 5086:             relay_session_configured,
 5087:             relay_session_state,
 5088:             relay_session_established_peers,
 5089:             relay_session_expired_peers,
 5090:             relay_session_next_expiry_unix,
 5091:         }
 5092:     }
 5093: 
 5094:     fn traversal_remote_node_id(
 5095:         &self,
 5096:         source_node_id: &str,
 5097:         target_node_id: &str,
 5098:     ) -> Option<NodeId> {
 5099:         let remote_node = if source_node_id == self.local_node_id {
 5100:             target_node_id
 5101:         } else if target_node_id == self.local_node_id {
 5102:             source_node_id
 5103:         } else {
 5104:             return None;
 5105:         };
 5106:         NodeId::new(remote_node.to_string()).ok()
 5107:     }
 5108: 
 5109:     fn bootstrap(&mut self) {
 5110:         // Attempt remote pull of all signed state before disk loads.
 5111:         // Skipped = no URL configured or network unreachable: continue to disk load.
 5112:         // Err = bundle received but verification failed: fail permanently closed.
 5113:         match self.state_fetcher.fetch_trust() {
 5114:             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => {
 5115:                 eprintln!("rustynetd: bootstrap: remote trust bundle applied");
 5116:             }
 5117:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 5118:             Err(e) => {
 5119:                 self.restrict_permanent(format!("remote trust fetch verification failed: {e}"));
 5120:                 let _ = self
 5121:                     .controller
 5122:                     .force_fail_closed("remote_trust_fetch_verification_failed");
 5123:                 return;
 5124:             }
 5125:         }
 5126:         match self.state_fetcher.fetch_traversal() {
 5127:             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => {
 5128:                 eprintln!("rustynetd: bootstrap: remote traversal bundle applied");
 5129:             }
 5130:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 5131:             Err(e) => {
 5132:                 self.restrict_permanent(format!("remote traversal fetch verification failed: {e}"));
 5133:                 let _ = self
 5134:                     .controller
 5135:                     .force_fail_closed("remote_traversal_fetch_verification_failed");
 5136:                 return;
 5137:             }
 5138:         }
 5139:         if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 5140:             match self.state_fetcher.fetch_assignment() {
 5141:                 Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => {
 5142:                     eprintln!("rustynetd: bootstrap: remote assignment bundle applied");
 5143:                 }
 5144:                 Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 5145:                 Err(e) => {
 5146:                     self.restrict_permanent(format!(
 5147:                         "remote assignment fetch verification failed: {e}"
 5148:                     ));
 5149:                     let _ = self
 5150:                         .controller
 5151:                         .force_fail_closed("remote_assignment_fetch_verification_failed");
 5152:                     return;
 5153:                 }
 5154:             }
 5155:         }
 5156:         match self.state_fetcher.fetch_dns_zone(None) {
 5157:             // Pass None: we haven't loaded auto_bundle yet; auto_tunnel context not yet known.
 5158:             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => {
 5159:                 eprintln!("rustynetd: bootstrap: remote dns zone bundle applied");
 5160:             }
 5161:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 5162:             Err(e) => {
 5163:                 self.restrict_permanent(format!("remote dns zone fetch verification failed: {e}"));
 5164:                 let _ = self
 5165:                     .controller
 5166:                     .force_fail_closed("remote_dns_zone_fetch_verification_failed");
 5167:                 return;
 5168:             }
 5169:         }
 5170: 
 5171:         match self.restore_state() {
 5172:             Ok(()) => {}
 5173:             Err(_err) => {
 5174:                 self.restrict_permanent("state restore failed integrity checks".to_string());
 5175:                 let _ = self
 5176:                     .controller
 5177:                     .force_fail_closed("state_restore_integrity_failed");
 5178:                 return;
 5179:             }
 5180:         }
 5181:         if let Err(err) = self.enforce_blind_exit_invariants() {
 5182:             self.restrict_permanent(format!(
 5183:                 "blind-exit role invariants failed during bootstrap: {err}"
 5184:             ));
 5185:             let _ = self
 5186:                 .controller
 5187:                 .force_fail_closed("blind_exit_invariants_failed");
 5188:             return;
 5189:         }
 5190: 
 5191:         match self.state_fetcher.fetch_trust() {
 5192:             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => eprintln!("statefetch: trust applied before bootstrap"),
 5193:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 5194:             Err(e) => {
 5195:                 self.restrict_permanent(format!("remote trust fetch failed: {e}"));
 5196:                 let _ = self
 5197:                     .controller
 5198:                     .force_fail_closed("remote_trust_fetch_failed");
 5199:                 return;
 5200:             }
 5201:         }
 5202:         match self.state_fetcher.fetch_traversal() {
 5203:             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => {
 5204:                 eprintln!("statefetch: traversal applied before bootstrap")
 5205:             }
 5206:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 5207:             Err(e) => {
 5208:                 self.restrict_permanent(format!("remote traversal fetch failed: {e}"));
 5209:                 let _ = self
 5210:                     .controller
 5211:                     .force_fail_closed("remote_traversal_fetch_failed");
 5212:                 return;
 5213:             }
 5214:         }
 5215:         if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 5216:             match self.state_fetcher.fetch_assignment() {
 5217:                 Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => {
 5218:                     eprintln!("statefetch: assignment applied before bootstrap")
 5219:                 }
 5220:                 Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 5221:                 Err(e) => {
 5222:                     self.restrict_permanent(format!("remote assignment fetch failed: {e}"));
 5223:                     let _ = self
 5224:                         .controller
 5225:                         .force_fail_closed("remote_assignment_fetch_failed");
 5226:                     return;
 5227:                 }
 5228:             }
 5229:         }
 5230:         let dns_context = if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 5231:             if let Some(path) = &self.auto_tunnel_bundle_path {
 5232:                 if let Some(verifier) = &self.auto_tunnel_verifier_key_path {
 5233:                     use crate::phase10::TrustPolicy;
 5234:                     let policy = TrustPolicy {
 5235:                         max_signed_data_age_secs: self.auto_tunnel_max_age_secs,
 5236:                         max_clock_skew_secs: DEFAULT_SIGNED_STATE_MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_SECS,
 5237:                     };
 5238:                     load_auto_tunnel_bundle(
 5239:                         path,
 5240:                         verifier,
 5241:                         self.auto_tunnel_max_age_secs,
 5242:                         policy,
 5243:                         None,
 5244:                     )
 5245:                     .map(|b| b.bundle)
 5246:                     .ok()
 5247:                 } else {
 5248:                     None
 5249:                 }
 5250:             } else {
 5251:                 None
 5252:             }
 5253:         } else {
 5254:             None
 5255:         };
 5256:         match self.state_fetcher.fetch_dns_zone(dns_context.as_ref()) {
 5257:             Ok(FetchDecision::Applied) => {
 5258:                 eprintln!("statefetch: dns zone applied before bootstrap")
 5259:             }
 5260:             Ok(FetchDecision::Skipped) => {}
 5261:             Err(e) => {
 5262:                 self.restrict_permanent(format!("remote dns zone fetch failed: {e}"));
 5263:                 let _ = self
 5264:                     .controller
 5265:                     .force_fail_closed("remote_dns_zone_fetch_failed");
 5266:                 return;
 5267:             }
 5268:         }
 5269: 
 5270:         let trust = match self.load_verified_trust() {
 5271:             Ok(evidence) => evidence,
 5272:             Err(err) => {
 5273:                 self.restrict_recoverable(err.to_string());
 5274:                 let _ = self.controller.force_fail_closed("trust_bootstrap_failed");
 5275:                 return;
 5276:             }
 5277:         };
 5278: 
 5279:         let membership_state = match self.load_verified_membership() {
 5280:             Ok(state) => state,
 5281:             Err(err) => {
 5282:                 self.restrict_recoverable(err.to_string());
 5283:                 let _ = self
 5284:                     .controller
 5285:                     .force_fail_closed("membership_bootstrap_failed");
 5286:                 return;
 5287:             }
 5288:         };
 5289:         let membership_directory = membership_directory_from_state(&membership_state);
 5290: 
 5291:         let auto_bundle = if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 5292:             match self.load_verified_auto_tunnel(&membership_directory) {
 5293:                 Ok(bundle) => Some(bundle),
 5294:                 Err(err) => {
 5295:                     self.restrict_recoverable(err.to_string());
 5296:                     let _ = self
 5297:                         .controller
 5298:                         .force_fail_closed("auto_tunnel_bootstrap_failed");
 5299:                     return;
 5300:                 }
 5301:             }
 5302:         } else {
 5303:             None
 5304:         };
 5305: 
 5306:         let (mesh_cidr, local_cidr, peers, routes, auto_exit, auto_lan_access, auto_watermark) =
 5307:             if let Some(ref envelope) = auto_bundle {
 5308:                 let lan_enabled = envelope
 5309:                     .bundle
 5310:                     .routes
 5311:                     .iter()
 5312:                     .any(|route| route.kind == RouteKind::ExitNodeLan);
 5313:                 (
 5314:                     envelope.bundle.mesh_cidr.clone(),
 5315:                     envelope.bundle.assigned_cidr.clone(),
 5316:                     envelope.bundle.peers.clone(),
 5317:                     envelope.bundle.routes.clone(),
 5318:                     envelope.bundle.selected_exit_node.clone(),
 5319:                     lan_enabled,
 5320:                     Some(envelope.watermark),
 5321:                 )
 5322:             } else {
 5323:                 (
 5324:                     "100.64.0.0/10".to_string(),
 5325:                     "100.64.0.1/32".to_string(),
 5326:                     Vec::new(),
 5327:                     Vec::new(),
 5328:                     None,
 5329:                     false,
 5330:                     None,
 5331:                 )
 5332:             };
 5333:         if let Err(err) = self.validate_blind_exit_assignment(auto_exit.as_deref(), auto_lan_access)
 5334:         {
 5335:             self.restrict_recoverable(err);
 5336:             let _ = self
 5337:                 .controller
 5338:                 .force_fail_closed("blind_exit_assignment_rejected");
 5339:             return;
 5340:         }
 5341: 
 5342:         self.refresh_traversal_hint_state(true);
 5343: 
 5344:         let local_node = match NodeId::new(self.local_node_id.clone()) {
 5345:             Ok(node_id) => node_id,
 5346:             Err(err) => {
 5347:                 self.restrict_permanent(format!("invalid local node id in runtime: {err}"));
 5348:                 let _ = self.controller.force_fail_closed("invalid_local_node_id");
 5349:                 return;
 5350:             }
 5351:         };
 5352: 
 5353:         if let Err(err) = self.ensure_runtime_private_key_material() {
 5354:             self.restrict_recoverable(format!("runtime key preparation failed: {err}"));
 5355:             let _ = self
 5356:                 .controller
 5357:                 .force_fail_closed("runtime_key_prepare_failed");
 5358:             return;
 5359:         }
 5360: 
 5361:         let serve_exit_node = if self.node_role.is_blind_exit() {
 5362:             true
 5363:         } else if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 5364:             self.is_serving_exit_node(auto_exit.as_deref())
 5365:         } else {
 5366:             self.is_serving_exit_node(self.selected_exit_node.as_deref())
 5367:         };
 5368: 
 5369:         let peers = match self.apply_traversal_authority_to_peers(peers, &membership_directory) {
 5370:             Ok(peers) => peers,
 5371:             Err(err) => {
 5372:                 self.restrict_recoverable(format!(
 5373:                     "traversal authority rejected bootstrap apply: {err}"
 5374:                 ));
 5375:                 let _ = self
 5376:                     .controller
 5377:                     .force_fail_closed("bootstrap_traversal_authority_rejected");
 5378:                 return;
 5379:             }
 5380:         };
 5381: 
 5382:         let routes = sanitize_dataplane_routes_for_node_role(self.node_role, routes);
 5383:         let apply_result = self.controller.apply_dataplane_generation(
 5384:             trust,
 5385:             RuntimeContext {
 5386:                 local_node,
 5387:                 interface_name: self.wg_interface.clone(),
 5388:                 mesh_cidr,
 5389:                 local_cidr,
 5390:             },
 5391:             peers,
 5392:             routes,
 5393:             ApplyOptions {
 5394:                 protected_dns: true,
 5395:                 ipv6_parity_supported: false,
 5396:                 serve_exit_node,
 5397:                 exit_mode: if self.node_role.is_blind_exit() {
 5398:                     ExitMode::Off
 5399:                 } else if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 5400:                     if auto_exit.is_some() {
 5401:                         ExitMode::FullTunnel
 5402:                     } else {
 5403:                         ExitMode::Off
 5404:                     }
 5405:                 } else {
 5406:                     self.desired_exit_mode()
 5407:                 },
 5408:             },
 5409:         );
 5410:         let cleanup_result = self.scrub_runtime_private_key_material();
 5411:         match (apply_result, cleanup_result) {
 5412:             (Ok(()), Ok(())) => {}
 5413:             (Err(err), Ok(())) => {
 5414:                 self.restrict_recoverable(format!("dataplane bootstrap apply failed: {err}"));
 5415:                 let _ = self.controller.force_fail_closed("bootstrap_apply_failed");
 5416:                 return;
 5417:             }
 5418:             (Err(err), Err(cleanup_err)) => {
 5419:                 self.restrict_recoverable(format!(
 5420:                     "dataplane bootstrap apply failed: {err}; runtime key cleanup failed: {cleanup_err}"
 5421:                 ));
 5422:                 let _ = self.controller.force_fail_closed("bootstrap_apply_failed");
 5423:                 return;
 5424:             }
 5425:             (Ok(()), Err(cleanup_err)) => {
 5426:                 self.restrict_recoverable(format!(
 5427:                     "runtime key cleanup failed after bootstrap apply: {cleanup_err}"
 5428:                 ));
 5429:                 let _ = self
 5430:                     .controller
 5431:                     .force_fail_closed("runtime_key_cleanup_failed");
 5432:                 return;
 5433:             }
 5434:         }
 5435:         self.membership_state = Some(membership_state);
 5436:         self.membership_directory = membership_directory;
 5437:         self.refresh_dns_zone_state(auto_bundle.as_ref());
 5438: 
 5439:         if self.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 5440:             if self.node_role.is_blind_exit() {
 5441:                 self.selected_exit_node = None;
 5442:                 self.lan_access_enabled = false;
 5443:                 self.controller.set_lan_access(false);
 5444:             } else {
 5445:                 self.selected_exit_node = auto_exit;
 5446:                 self.lan_access_enabled = auto_lan_access;
 5447:                 self.controller.set_lan_access(auto_lan_access);
 5448:             }
 5449:             self.last_applied_assignment = auto_watermark;
 5450:         } else if let Some(exit_node) = &self.selected_exit_node {
 5451:             if let Ok(node_id) = NodeId::new(exit_node.clone()) {
 5452:                 let _ = self
 5453:                     .controller
 5454:                     .set_exit_node(node_id, "user:local", Protocol::Any);
 5455:             }
 5456:         }
 5457: 
 5458:         self.restriction_mode = RestrictionMode::None;
 5459:         self.bootstrap_error = None;
 5460:         if let Err(err) = self.persist_state() {
 5461:             eprintln!("rustynetd: bootstrap: initial state persist failed: {err}");
 5462:             return;
 5463:         }
 5464:         self.poll_endpoint_monitor_and_maybe_refresh();
 5465:         self.refresh_traversal_hint_state(false);
 5466:         self.maybe_preexpiry_refresh_dns_zone(unix_now(), auto_bundle.as_ref());
 5467:         self.maybe_trigger_endpoint_change_refresh();
 5468:         self.maintain_exit_port_forward(
 5469:             self.is_serving_exit_node(self.selected_exit_node.as_deref()),
 5470:         );
 5471:     }
 5472: 
 5473:     fn authorize_remote_command(
 5474:         &mut self,
 5475:         envelope: &RemoteCommandEnvelope,
 5476:         now_unix: u64,
 5477:     ) -> Result<IpcCommand, String> {
 5478:         if envelope.subject != self.remote_ops_expected_subject {
 5479:             return Err(format!("unexpected subject: {}", envelope.subject));
 5480:         }
 5481: 
 5482:         // Enforce strict freshness (nonce as timestamp)
 5483:         // Window: 60 seconds
 5484:         let age = now_unix.saturating_sub(envelope.nonce);
 5485:         if age > 60 {
 5486:             return Err(format!("nonce expired (age {age}s)"));
 5487:         }
 5488:         if envelope.nonce > now_unix + 60 {
 5489:             return Err(format!(
 5490:                 "nonce in future ({nonce} > {now})",
 5491:                 nonce = envelope.nonce,
 5492:                 now = now_unix
 5493:             ));
 5494:         }
 5495: 
 5496:         if let Some(verifier) = &self.remote_ops_verifying_key {
 5497:             let payload = crate::ipc::remote_ops_signature_payload(
 5498:                 &envelope.subject,
 5499:                 envelope.nonce,
 5500:                 &envelope.command,
 5501:             );
 5502:             use ed25519_dalek::Verifier;
 5503:             let signature = ed25519_dalek::Signature::from_bytes(
 5504:                 &envelope
 5505:                     .signature
 5506:                     .clone()
 5507:                     .try_into()
 5508:                     .map_err(|_| "invalid signature length".to_string())?,
 5509:             );
 5510:             verifier
 5511:                 .verify(&payload, &signature)
 5512:                 .map_err(|e| format!("signature verification failed: {e}"))?;
 5513: 
 5514:             let active_window_floor = now_unix.saturating_sub(60);
 5515:             let seen_nonces = self
 5516:                 .remote_ops_seen_nonces
 5517:                 .entry(envelope.subject.clone())
 5518:                 .or_default();
 5519:             seen_nonces.retain(|nonce| *nonce >= active_window_floor);
 5520:             if !seen_nonces.insert(envelope.nonce) {
 5521:                 return Err("remote command replay detected".to_string());
 5522:             }
 5523: 
 5524:             Ok(envelope.command.clone())
 5525:         } else {
 5526:             Err("remote ops not configured".to_string())
 5527:         }
 5528:     }
 5529: 
 5530:     fn handle_command(&mut self, command: IpcCommand) -> IpcResponse {
 5531:         if !self.node_role.allows_command(&command) {
 5532:             return IpcResponse::err(
 5533:                 "command denied: current node role does not permit this operation",
 5534:             );
 5535:         }
 5536:         if self.is_restricted()
 5537:             && command.is_mutating()
 5538:             && !matches!(command, IpcCommand::StateRefresh)
 5539:         {
 5540:             return IpcResponse::err("daemon is in restricted-safe mode");
 5541:         }
 5542:         let auto_tunnel_route_advertise_allowed = matches!(
 5543:             &command,
 5544:             IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise(cidr)
 5545:                 if self.allow_auto_tunnel_exit_advertisement(cidr)
 5546:         );
 5547:         if self.auto_tunnel_enforce
 5548:             && matches!(
 5549:                 &command,
 5550:                 IpcCommand::ExitNodeSelect(_)
 5551:                     | IpcCommand::ExitNodeOff
 5552:                     | IpcCommand::LanAccessOn
 5553:                     | IpcCommand::LanAccessOff
 5554:                     | IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise(_)
 5555:             )
 5556:             && !auto_tunnel_route_advertise_allowed
 5557:         {
 5558:             return IpcResponse::err(
 5559:                 "manual route and exit mutations are disabled while auto-tunnel is enforced (except route advertise 0.0.0.0/0 for exit-serving nodes)",
 5560:             );
 5561:         }

 5796:             }
 5797:             IpcCommand::Netcheck => {

 5799:                 IpcResponse::ok(self.netcheck_response_line())
 5800:             }
 5801:             IpcCommand::StateRefresh => {
 5802:                 match self.refresh_signed_state_with_reason(true, SignedStateRefreshReason::Command)
 5803:                 {
 5804:                     Ok(()) => IpcResponse::ok("signed state refresh completed"),
 5805:                     Err(err) => {
 5806:                         self.restrict_recoverable(err.clone());
 5807:                         let _ = self
 5808:                             .controller
 5809:                             .force_fail_closed("command_signed_state_refresh_failed");
 5810:                         IpcResponse::err(format!("signed state refresh failed: {err}"))
 5811:                     }
 5812:                 }
 5813:             }
 5814:             IpcCommand::ExitNodeSelect(node) => {
 5815:                 let node_id = match NodeId::new(node.clone()) {
 5816:                     Ok(value) => value,
 5817:                     Err(err) => return IpcResponse::err(format!("invalid node: {err}")),
 5818:                 };
 5819:                 if self.membership_directory.node_status(node.as_str()) != MembershipStatus::Active
 5820:                 {
 5821:                     return IpcResponse::err(
 5822:                         "exit-node selection denied: node is not active in membership state",
 5823:                     );
 5824:                 }
 5825:                 match self
 5826:                     .controller
 5827:                     .set_exit_node(node_id, "user:local", Protocol::Any)
 5828:                 {
 5829:                     Ok(()) => {

 5831:                         if let Err(err) = self.persist_state() {
 5832:                             return IpcResponse::err(format!("persist failed: {err}"));
 5833:                         }
 5834:                         IpcResponse::ok(format!("exit-node selected: {node}"))
 5835:                     }
 5836:                     Err(err) => IpcResponse::err(err.to_string()),
 5837:                 }
 5838:             }
 5839:             IpcCommand::ExitNodeOff => match self.controller.clear_exit_node() {
 5840:                 Ok(()) => {
 5841:                     self.selected_exit_node = None;
 5842:                     if let Err(err) = self.persist_state() {
 5843:                         return IpcResponse::err(format!("persist failed: {err}"));
 5844:                     }
 5845:                     IpcResponse::ok("exit-node disabled")
 5846:                 }
 5847:                 Err(err) => IpcResponse::err(err.to_string()),
 5848:             },
 5849:             IpcCommand::LanAccessOn => {
 5850:                 self.controller.set_lan_access(true);
 5851:                 self.lan_access_enabled = true;
 5852:                 if let Some(exit_node) = &self.selected_exit_node {
 5853:                     if self.membership_directory.node_status(exit_node.as_str())
 5854:                         != MembershipStatus::Active

 5858:                         );
 5859:                     }
 5860:                     self.controller
 5861:                         .set_lan_route_acl("user:local", "192.168.1.0/24", true);

 5863:                         self.controller
 5864:                             .advertise_lan_route(node_id, "192.168.1.0/24");
 5865:                     }
 5866:                     let _ = self.controller.ensure_lan_route_allowed(RouteGrantRequest {
 5867:                         user: "user:local".to_string(),
 5868:                         cidr: "192.168.1.0/24".to_string(),
 5869:                         protocol: Protocol::Any,
 5870:                         context: TrafficContext::SharedExit,
 5871:                     });
 5872:                 }
 5873:                 if let Err(err) = self.persist_state() {
 5874:                     return IpcResponse::err(format!("persist failed: {err}"));
 5875:                 }
 5876:                 IpcResponse::ok("lan-access enabled")
 5877:             }
 5878:             IpcCommand::LanAccessOff => {
 5879:                 self.controller.set_lan_access(false);
 5880:                 self.lan_access_enabled = false;
 5881:                 if let Err(err) = self.persist_state() {
 5882:                     return IpcResponse::err(format!("persist failed: {err}"));
 5883:                 }
 5884:                 IpcResponse::ok("lan-access disabled")
 5885:             }
 5886:             IpcCommand::DnsInspect => IpcResponse::ok(self.dns_inspect_message()),
 5887:             IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise(cidr) => {
 5888:                 if self.auto_tunnel_enforce && !self.allow_auto_tunnel_exit_advertisement(&cidr) {
 5889:                     return IpcResponse::err(
 5890:                         "manual route and exit mutations are disabled while auto-tunnel is enforced (except route advertise 0.0.0.0/0 for exit-serving nodes)",
 5891:                     );
 5892:                 }
 5893:                 if !validate_cidr(&cidr) {
 5894:                     return IpcResponse::err("invalid cidr format");
 5895:                 }
 5896:                 if let Some(exit_node) = &self.selected_exit_node {
 5897:                     if let Ok(node_id) = NodeId::new(exit_node.clone()) {
 5898:                         if self.membership_directory.node_status(exit_node.as_str())
 5899:                             != MembershipStatus::Active
 5900:                         {
 5901:                             return IpcResponse::err(
 5902:                                 "route advertise denied: selected exit node is not active in membership state",
 5903:                             );
 5904:                         }
 5905:                         self.controller.advertise_lan_route(node_id, &cidr);
 5906:                         self.controller.set_lan_route_acl("user:local", &cidr, true);
 5907:                     }
 5908:                 }
 5909:                 self.advertised_routes.insert(cidr.clone());
 5910:                 self.local_route_reconcile_pending = true;
 5911:                 if let Err(err) = self.persist_state() {
 5912:                     return IpcResponse::err(format!("persist failed: {err}"));
 5913:                 }
 5914:                 if self.auto_tunnel_enforce && cidr == "0.0.0.0/0" {
 5915:                     // Apply exit-serving dataplane/NAT immediately after advertised default route changes
 5916:                     // (including relay-with-upstream-exit mode) so status and forwarding reflect the
 5917:                     // requested fail-closed policy without waiting for the periodic reconcile interval.
 5918:                     self.reconcile();
 5919:                 }
 5920:                 IpcResponse::ok(format!("route advertised: {cidr}"))
 5921:             }
 5922:             IpcCommand::KeyRotate => match self.rotate_local_key_material() {
 5923:                 Ok(message) => IpcResponse::ok(message),
 5924:                 Err(err) => IpcResponse::err(err),
 5925:             },
 5926:             IpcCommand::KeyRevoke => match self.revoke_local_key_material() {
 5927:                 Ok(message) => IpcResponse::ok(message),
 5928:                 Err(err) => IpcResponse::err(err),
 5929:             },
 5930:             IpcCommand::Unknown(raw) => IpcResponse::err(format!("unknown command: {raw}")),
 5931:         }
 5932:     }
 5933: 
 5934:     fn apply_interface_private_key_runtime(&self, runtime_key_path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 5935:         if let Some(client) = self.privileged_helper_client.as_ref() {
 5936:             let runtime_path = runtime_key_path
 5937:                 .to_str()
 5938:                 .ok_or_else(|| "runtime key path must be valid utf-8".to_string())?;
 5939:             let output = client.run_capture(
 5940:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Wg,
 5941:                 &[
 5942:                     "set",
 5943:                     self.wg_interface.as_str(),
 5944:                     "private-key",
 5945:                     runtime_path,
 5946:                 ],
 5947:             )?;
 5948:             if output.success() {
 5949:                 return Ok(());
 5950:             }
 5951:             return Err(format!(
 5952:                 "wg set private-key failed for {}: status={} stderr={}",
 5953:                 self.wg_interface, output.status, output.stderr
 5954:             ));
 5955:         }
 5956:         apply_interface_private_key(&self.wg_interface, runtime_key_path)
 5957:     }
 5958: 
 5959:     fn set_interface_down_runtime(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
 5960:         if let Some(client) = self.privileged_helper_client.as_ref() {
 5961:             let output = match self.backend_mode {
 5962:                 DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard => client.run_capture(
 5963:                     PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip,
 5964:                     &["link", "set", "down", "dev", self.wg_interface.as_str()],
 5965:                 )?,
 5966:                 DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguardUserspaceShared => {
 5967:                     return Err(
 5968:                         "interface down is not supported for linux-wireguard-userspace-shared backend; use backend shutdown"
 5969:                             .to_string(),
 5970:                     );
 5971:                 }
 5972:                 DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguard => client.run_capture(
 5973:                     PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ifconfig,
 5974:                     &[self.wg_interface.as_str(), "down"],
 5975:                 )?,
 5976:                 DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguardUserspaceShared => {
 5977:                     return Err(DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguardUserspaceShared
 5978:                         .userspace_shared_blocker()
 5979:                         .expect("macos shared backend blocker should exist")
 5980:                         .to_string());
 5981:                 }
 5982:                 DaemonBackendMode::WindowsWireguardNt => {
 5983:                     return Err(
 5984:                         "interface down is not supported for windows-wireguard-nt backend; use backend shutdown or Windows service stop"
 5985:                             .to_string(),
 5986:                     );
 5987:                 }
 5988:                 DaemonBackendMode::WindowsUnsupported => {
 5989:                     return Err(
 5990:                         require_supported_windows_backend(WindowsBackendMode::Unsupported)
 5991:                             .expect_err("windows unsupported backend must fail closed"),
 5992:                     );
 5993:                 }
 5994:                 DaemonBackendMode::InMemory => {
 5995:                     return Err("interface down is not supported for in-memory backend".to_string());
 5996:                 }
 5997:             };
 5998:             if output.success() {
 5999:                 return Ok(());
 6000:             }
 6001:             let command_label = match self.backend_mode {
 6002:                 DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard => "ip link set down",
 6003:                 DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguardUserspaceShared => "linux userspace-shared down",
 6004:                 DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguard => "ifconfig down",
 6005:                 DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguardUserspaceShared => {
 6006:                     "macos-wireguard-userspace-shared blocked"
 6007:                 }
 6008:                 DaemonBackendMode::WindowsWireguardNt => "windows-wireguard-nt blocked",
 6009:                 DaemonBackendMode::WindowsUnsupported => "windows-unsupported blocked",
 6010:                 DaemonBackendMode::InMemory => "interface down",
 6011:             };
 6012:             return Err(format!(
 6013:                 "{command_label} failed for {}: status={} stderr={}",
 6014:                 self.wg_interface, output.status, output.stderr
 6015:             ));
 6016:         }
 6017:         set_interface_down(&self.wg_interface)
 6018:     }
 6019: 
 6020:     fn rotate_local_key_material(&mut self) -> Result<String, String> {
 6021:         if !matches!(
 6022:             self.backend_mode,
 6023:             DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard | DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguard
 6024:         ) {
 6025:             return Err(
 6026:                 "key rotation is only supported for linux-wireguard or macos-wireguard backend"
 6027:                     .to_string(),
 6028:             );
 6029:         }
 6030:         let runtime_path = self
 6031:             .wg_private_key_path
 6032:             .clone()
 6033:             .ok_or_else(|| "wg private key path is not configured".to_string())?;
 6034: 
 6035:         let mut old_runtime = fs::read(&runtime_path).ok();
 6036:         let mut old_encrypted = self
 6037:             .wg_encrypted_private_key_path
 6038:             .as_ref()
 6039:             .and_then(|path| fs::read(path).ok());
 6040:         let old_public = self
 6041:             .wg_public_key_path
 6042:             .as_ref()
 6043:             .and_then(|path| fs::read_to_string(path).ok());
 6044: 
 6045:         let result = (|| -> Result<String, String> {
 6046:             let (mut new_private, new_public) = generate_wireguard_keypair()?;
 6047: 
 6048:             if let Some(encrypted_path) = self.wg_encrypted_private_key_path.as_ref() {
 6049:                 let passphrase_path = self.wg_key_passphrase_path.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
 6050:                     "wg key passphrase path is required when encrypted key storage is configured"
 6051:                         .to_string()
 6052:                 })?;
 6053:                 if let Err(err) = encrypt_private_key(&new_private, encrypted_path, passphrase_path)
 6054:                 {
 6055:                     new_private.fill(0);
 6056:                     return Err(err);
 6057:                 }
 6058:             }
 6059: 
 6060:             if let Err(err) = write_runtime_private_key(&runtime_path, &new_private) {
 6061:                 new_private.fill(0);
 6062:                 return Err(err);
 6063:             }
 6064:             if let Some(public_path) = self.wg_public_key_path.as_ref() {
 6065:                 if let Err(err) = write_public_key(public_path, &new_public) {
 6066:                     new_private.fill(0);
 6067:                     return Err(err);
 6068:                 }
 6069:             }
 6070: 
 6071:             if let Err(err) = self.apply_interface_private_key_runtime(&runtime_path) {
 6072:                 let _ = self.restore_key_backups(
 6073:                     old_runtime.as_deref(),
 6074:                     old_encrypted.as_deref(),
 6075:                     old_public.as_deref(),
 6076:                 );
 6077:                 new_private.fill(0);
 6078:                 return Err(format!("rotate apply failed and rollback attempted: {err}"));
 6079:             }
 6080: 
 6081:             new_private.fill(0);
 6082: 
 6083:             if let Err(err) = self.persist_state() {
 6084:                 return Err(format!("persist failed after key rotation: {err}"));
 6085:             }
 6086:             if let Err(err) = self.scrub_runtime_private_key_file() {
 6087:                 return Err(format!(
 6088:                     "key rotation completed but runtime key cleanup failed: {err}"
 6089:                 ));
 6090:             }
 6091: 
 6092:             let bundle = format!("rotation:{}:{}", self.local_node_id, new_public);
 6093:             Ok(format!(
 6094:                 "key rotated: node_id={} public_key={} rotation_bundle={}",
 6095:                 self.local_node_id, new_public, bundle
 6096:             ))
 6097:         })();
 6098: 
 6099:         zeroize_optional_bytes(&mut old_runtime);
 6100:         zeroize_optional_bytes(&mut old_encrypted);
 6101:         result
 6102:     }
 6103: 
 6104:     fn restore_key_backups(
 6105:         &self,
 6106:         old_runtime: Option<&[u8]>,
 6107:         old_encrypted: Option<&[u8]>,
 6108:         old_public: Option<&str>,
 6109:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
 6110:         if let (Some(path), Some(bytes)) = (self.wg_private_key_path.as_ref(), old_runtime) {
 6111:             write_runtime_private_key(path, bytes)?;
 6112:             let _ = self.apply_interface_private_key_runtime(path);
 6113:         }
 6114:         if let (Some(path), Some(bytes)) =
 6115:             (self.wg_encrypted_private_key_path.as_ref(), old_encrypted)
 6116:         {
 6117:             write_runtime_private_key(path, bytes)?;
 6118:         }
 6119:         if let (Some(path), Some(value)) = (self.wg_public_key_path.as_ref(), old_public) {
 6120:             write_public_key(path, value.trim())?;
 6121:         }
 6122:         Ok(())
 6123:     }

 6125:     fn revoke_local_key_material(&mut self) -> Result<String, String> {
 6126:         if !matches!(
 6127:             self.backend_mode,
 6128:             DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard | DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguard
 6129:         ) {
 6130:             return Err(
 6131:                 "key revoke is only supported for linux-wireguard or macos-wireguard backend"
 6132:                     .to_string(),
 6133:             );
 6134:         }
 6135:         self.restrict_permanent("local key revoked".to_string());
 6136:         let _ = self.controller.force_fail_closed("local_key_revoked");
 6137: 
 6138:         let mut failures = Vec::new();
 6139:         if let Err(err) = self.set_interface_down_runtime() {
 6140:             failures.push(format!("interface down failed: {err}"));
 6141:         }
 6142:         if let Some(path) = self.wg_private_key_path.as_ref() {
 6143:             if let Err(err) = remove_file_if_present(path) {
 6144:                 failures.push(err);
 6145:             }
 6146:         }
 6147:         if let Some(path) = self.wg_encrypted_private_key_path.as_ref() {
 6148:             if let Err(err) = remove_file_if_present(path) {
 6149:                 failures.push(err);
 6150:             }
 6151:         }
 6152:         if let Some(path) = self.wg_public_key_path.as_ref() {
 6153:             if let Err(err) = remove_file_if_present(path) {
 6154:                 failures.push(err);
 6155:             }
 6156:         }
 6157: 
 6158:         self.selected_exit_node = None;
 6159:         self.lan_access_enabled = false;
 6160:         self.release_exit_port_forward();
 6161:         self.clear_exit_port_forward_state();
 6162: 
 6163:         if let Err(err) = self.persist_state() {
 6164:             failures.push(format!("persist failed after revoke: {err}"));
 6165:         }
 6166: 
 6167:         if failures.is_empty() {
 6168:             Ok("local key revoked: interface disabled and key material removed".to_string())
 6169:         } else {
 6170:             Err(format!(
 6171:                 "key revoke completed with errors: {}",
 6172:                 failures.join("; ")
 6173:             ))
 6174:         }
 6175:     }
 6176: 
 6177:     fn scrub_runtime_private_key_file(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
 6178:         if self.wg_encrypted_private_key_path.is_none() {
 6179:             return Ok(());
 6180:         }
 6181:         if let Some(path) = self.wg_private_key_path.as_ref() {
 6182:             remove_file_if_present(path)?;
 6183:         }
 6184:         Ok(())
 6185:     }

 6204:     fn persist_state(&mut self) -> Result<(), String> {
 6205:         let snapshot = SessionStateSnapshot {
 6206:             timestamp_unix: unix_now(),
 6207:             peer_ids: self.advertised_routes.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
 6208:             selected_exit_node: self.selected_exit_node.clone(),
 6209:             lan_access_enabled: self.lan_access_enabled,
 6210:         };
 6211:         persist_session_snapshot(&snapshot, &self.state_path).map_err(|err| {
 6212:             self.restrict_permanent("state persist failure".to_string());
 6213:             let _ = self.controller.force_fail_closed("state_persist_failure");
 6214:             err.to_string()
 6215:         })
