 7725: fn validate_daemon_config(config: &DaemonConfig) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
 7726:     if matches!(config.backend_mode, DaemonBackendMode::InMemory) {
 7727:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7728:             "in-memory backend is disabled in production daemon paths".to_string(),
 7729:         ));
 7730:     }
 7731:     if matches!(
 7732:         config.backend_mode,
 7733:         DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguardUserspaceShared
 7734:     ) {
 7735:         let blocker = config
 7736:             .backend_mode
 7737:             .userspace_shared_blocker()
 7738:             .expect("macos userspace-shared blocker should exist");
 7739:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(blocker.to_string()));
 7740:     }
 7741:     #[cfg(all(not(test), not(target_os = "linux")))]
 7742:     if matches!(
 7743:         config.backend_mode,
 7744:         DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguardUserspaceShared
 7745:     ) {
 7746:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7747:             "linux-wireguard-userspace-shared backend is only supported on linux".to_string(),
 7748:         ));
 7749:     }
 7750: 
 7751:     NodeId::new(config.node_id.clone())
 7752:         .map_err(|err| DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("node id is invalid: {err}")))?;
 7753: 
 7754:     if config.trust_url.is_some()
 7755:         || config.traversal_url.is_some()
 7756:         || config.assignment_url.is_some()
 7757:         || config.dns_zone_url.is_some()
 7758:     {
 7759:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7760:             "remote network state fetch is disabled in hardened daemon paths; use pinned local signed artifacts"
 7761:                 .to_string(),
 7762:         ));
 7763:     }
 7764: 
 7765:     validate_control_socket_path(&config.socket_path)?;
 7766:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.state_path, "state")?;
 7767:     if let Some(path) = config.privileged_helper_socket_path.as_ref() {
 7768:         validate_privileged_helper_control_path(path)?;
 7769:     }
 7770:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.trust_evidence_path, "trust evidence")?;
 7771:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.trust_verifier_key_path, "trust verifier key")?;
 7772:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.trust_watermark_path, "trust watermark")?;
 7773:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.membership_snapshot_path, "membership snapshot")?;
 7774:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.membership_log_path, "membership log")?;
 7775:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.membership_watermark_path, "membership watermark")?;
 7776:     if let Some(path) = config.remote_ops_token_verifier_key_path.as_ref() {
 7777:         validate_runtime_file_path(path, "remote ops token verifier key")?;
 7778:     }
 7779:     if let Some(path) = config.auto_tunnel_bundle_path.as_ref() {
 7780:         validate_runtime_file_path(path, "auto tunnel bundle")?;
 7781:     }
 7782:     if let Some(path) = config.auto_tunnel_verifier_key_path.as_ref() {
 7783:         validate_runtime_file_path(path, "auto tunnel verifier key")?;
 7784:     }
 7785:     if let Some(path) = config.auto_tunnel_watermark_path.as_ref() {
 7786:         validate_runtime_file_path(path, "auto tunnel watermark")?;
 7787:     }
 7788:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.dns_zone_bundle_path, "dns zone bundle")?;
 7789:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.dns_zone_verifier_key_path, "dns zone verifier key")?;
 7790:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.dns_zone_watermark_path, "dns zone watermark")?;
 7791:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.traversal_bundle_path, "traversal bundle")?;
 7792:     validate_runtime_file_path(
 7793:         &config.traversal_verifier_key_path,
 7794:         "traversal verifier key",
 7795:     )?;
 7796:     validate_runtime_file_path(&config.traversal_watermark_path, "traversal watermark")?;
 7797:     if config.traversal_probe_max_candidates.get() > MAX_TRAVERSAL_CANDIDATE_COUNT {
 7798:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 7799:             "traversal probe max candidates must be at most {MAX_TRAVERSAL_CANDIDATE_COUNT}"
 7800:         )));
 7801:     }
 7802:     let max_probe_pairs_allowed = config
 7803:         .traversal_probe_max_candidates
 7804:         .get()
 7805:         .saturating_mul(config.traversal_probe_max_candidates.get());
 7806:     if config.traversal_probe_max_pairs.get() > max_probe_pairs_allowed {
 7807:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 7808:             "traversal probe max pairs must be at most {max_probe_pairs_allowed} for max candidates {}",
 7809:             config.traversal_probe_max_candidates.get()
 7810:         )));
 7811:     }
 7812:     if config.traversal_probe_simultaneous_open_rounds.get()
 7813:         > MAX_TRAVERSAL_PROBE_SIMULTANEOUS_OPEN_ROUNDS
 7814:     {
 7815:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 7816:             "traversal probe rounds must be at most {MAX_TRAVERSAL_PROBE_SIMULTANEOUS_OPEN_ROUNDS}"
 7817:         )));
 7818:     }
 7819:     if config.traversal_probe_round_spacing_ms.get() > MAX_TRAVERSAL_PROBE_ROUND_SPACING_MS {
 7820:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 7821:             "traversal probe round spacing must be at most {MAX_TRAVERSAL_PROBE_ROUND_SPACING_MS} ms"
 7822:         )));
 7823:     }
 7824:     if config.traversal_probe_relay_switch_after_failures.get()
 7825:         > MAX_TRAVERSAL_PROBE_RELAY_SWITCH_AFTER_FAILURES
 7826:     {
 7827:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 7828:             "traversal probe relay switch threshold must be at most {MAX_TRAVERSAL_PROBE_RELAY_SWITCH_AFTER_FAILURES}"
 7829:         )));
 7830:     }
 7831:     if config.traversal_probe_handshake_freshness_secs.get() > config.traversal_max_age_secs.get() {
 7832:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7833:             "traversal probe handshake freshness must not exceed traversal max age".to_string(),
 7834:         ));
 7835:     }
 7836:     if config.traversal_probe_reprobe_interval_secs.get()
 7837:         > MAX_TRAVERSAL_PROBE_REPROBE_INTERVAL_SECS
 7838:     {
 7839:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 7840:             "traversal probe reprobe interval must be at most {MAX_TRAVERSAL_PROBE_REPROBE_INTERVAL_SECS} seconds"
 7841:         )));
 7842:     }
 7843:     canonicalize_dns_zone_name(&config.dns_zone_name)
 7844:         .map_err(|err| DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("dns zone name is invalid: {err}")))?;
 7845:     if !config.dns_resolver_bind_addr.ip().is_loopback() {
 7846:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7847:             "dns resolver bind addr must be loopback".to_string(),
 7848:         ));
 7849:     }
 7850:     if config.wg_interface.is_empty() {
 7851:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7852:             "wireguard interface must not be empty".to_string(),
 7853:         ));
 7854:     }
 7855:     if config.wg_listen_port == 0 {
 7856:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7857:             "wireguard listen port must be in range 1-65535".to_string(),
 7858:         ));
 7859:     }
 7860:     if config.egress_interface.is_empty() {
 7861:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7862:             "egress interface must not be empty".to_string(),
 7863:         ));
 7864:     }
 7865:     if config.auto_port_forward_lease_secs.get() < 60 {
 7866:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7867:             "auto port-forward lease must be at least 60 seconds".to_string(),
 7868:         ));
 7869:     }
 7870:     if config.auto_port_forward_exit
 7871:         && !matches!(config.backend_mode, DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard)
 7872:     {
 7873:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7874:             "auto port-forward exit is supported only with linux-wireguard backend".to_string(),
 7875:         ));
 7876:     }
 7877:     if config.trust_evidence_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7878:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7879:             "trust evidence path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7880:         ));
 7881:     }
 7882:     if config.trust_verifier_key_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7883:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7884:             "trust verifier key path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7885:         ));
 7886:     }
 7887:     if config.trust_watermark_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7888:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7889:             "trust watermark path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7890:         ));
 7891:     }
 7892:     if config.membership_snapshot_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7893:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7894:             "membership snapshot path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7895:         ));
 7896:     }
 7897:     if config.membership_log_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7898:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7899:             "membership log path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7900:         ));
 7901:     }
 7902:     if config.membership_watermark_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7903:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7904:             "membership watermark path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7905:         ));
 7906:     }
 7907:     if config.remote_ops_expected_subject.trim().is_empty() {
 7908:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7909:             "remote ops expected subject must not be empty".to_string(),
 7910:         ));
 7911:     }
 7912:     if config.traversal_bundle_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7913:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7914:             "traversal bundle path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7915:         ));
 7916:     }
 7917:     if config.traversal_verifier_key_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7918:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7919:             "traversal verifier key path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7920:         ));
 7921:     }
 7922:     if config.traversal_watermark_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7923:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7924:             "traversal watermark path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7925:         ));
 7926:     }
 7927:     if let Some(path) = config.relay_session_signing_secret_path.as_ref() {
 7928:         if path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7929:             return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7930:                 "relay session signing secret path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7931:             ));
 7932:         }
 7933:         validate_runtime_file_path(path, "relay session signing secret")?;
 7934:     }
 7935:     if let Some(path) = config.relay_session_signing_secret_passphrase_path.as_ref() {
 7936:         if path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 7937:             return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7938:                 "relay session signing secret passphrase path must not be empty".to_string(),
 7939:             ));
 7940:         }
 7941:         validate_runtime_file_path(path, "relay session signing secret passphrase")?;
 7942:     }
 7943:     if config.relay_session_signing_secret_path.is_some()
 7944:         && config
 7945:             .relay_session_signing_secret_passphrase_path
 7946:             .is_none()
 7947:     {
 7948:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 7949:             "{ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_PASSPHRASE_ENV} is required when {ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_ENV} is set"
 7950:         )));
 7951:     }
 7952:     if config
 7953:         .relay_session_signing_secret_passphrase_path
 7954:         .is_some()
 7955:         && config.relay_session_signing_secret_path.is_none()
 7956:     {
 7957:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 7958:             "{ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_ENV} is required when {ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_PASSPHRASE_ENV} is set"
 7959:         )));
 7960:     }
 7961:     if config.relay_session_refresh_margin_secs.get() >= config.relay_session_token_ttl_secs.get() {
 7962:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7963:             "relay session refresh margin must be less than relay session token ttl".to_string(),
 7964:         ));
 7965:     }
 7966:     if config.auto_tunnel_enforce
 7967:         && (config.auto_tunnel_bundle_path.is_none()
 7968:             || config.auto_tunnel_verifier_key_path.is_none()
 7969:             || config.auto_tunnel_watermark_path.is_none())
 7970:     {
 7971:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7972:             "auto tunnel enforce requires bundle, verifier key, and watermark paths".to_string(),
 7973:         ));
 7974:     }
 7975:     if config
 7976:         .backend_mode
 7977:         .requires_runtime_wireguard_key_material()
 7978:     {
 7979:         if let Some(path) = config.wg_private_key_path.as_ref() {
 7980:             validate_runtime_file_path(path, "wg private key")?;
 7981:         }
 7982:         if let Some(path) = config.wg_encrypted_private_key_path.as_ref() {
 7983:             validate_runtime_file_path(path, "wg encrypted private key")?;
 7984:         }
 7985:         if let Some(path) = config.wg_key_passphrase_path.as_ref() {
 7986:             validate_runtime_file_path(path, "wg key passphrase")?;
 7987:         }
 7988:         if let Some(path) = config.wg_public_key_path.as_ref() {
 7989:             validate_runtime_file_path(path, "wg public key")?;
 7990:         }
 7991:         if config.wg_encrypted_private_key_path.is_some() && config.wg_key_passphrase_path.is_none()
 7992:         {
 7993:             return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 7994:                 "wg key passphrase path is required when encrypted key path is set".to_string(),
 7995:             ));
 7996:         }
 7997:         if config.wg_key_passphrase_path.is_some() && config.wg_encrypted_private_key_path.is_none()
 7998:         {
 7999:             return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 8000:                 "wg encrypted private key path is required when passphrase path is set".to_string(),
 8001:             ));
 8002:         }
 8003:     }
 8004: 
 8005:     if matches!(
 8006:         config.backend_mode,
 8007:         DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard
 8008:             | DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguardUserspaceShared
 8009:             | DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguard
 8010:             | DaemonBackendMode::WindowsWireguardNt
 8011:     ) && config.wg_private_key_path.is_none()
 8012:     {
 8013:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 8014:             "wg private key path is required for linux-wireguard, linux-wireguard-userspace-shared, macos-wireguard, or windows-wireguard-nt backend"
 8015:                 .to_string(),
 8016:         ));
 8017:     }
 8018:     if config.fail_closed_ssh_allow {
 8019:         if config.fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs.is_empty() {
 8020:             return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 8021:                 "fail-closed ssh allow requires at least one management cidr".to_string(),
 8022:             ));
 8023:         }
 8024:     }
 8025:     if matches!(
 8026:         config.backend_mode,
 8027:         DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguard
 8028:             | DaemonBackendMode::LinuxWireguardUserspaceShared
 8029:             | DaemonBackendMode::MacosWireguard
 8030:     ) && config.privileged_helper_socket_path.is_none()
 8031:     {
 8032:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 8033:             "privileged helper socket path is required for linux-wireguard, linux-wireguard-userspace-shared, or macos-wireguard backend"
 8034:                 .to_string(),
 8035:         ));
 8036:     }
 8037: 
 8038:     validate_backend_supported_on_current_host(config.backend_mode)?;
 8039: 
 8040:     Ok(())
 8041: }
 8042: 
 8043: fn resolve_configured_egress_interface(config: &mut DaemonConfig) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
 8044:     config.egress_interface = resolve_egress_interface_value(
 8045:         config.egress_interface.as_str(),
 8046:         detect_default_egress_interface,
 8047:     )
 8048:     .map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)?;
 8049:     Ok(())
 8050: }
 8051: 
 8052: fn resolve_egress_interface_value<F>(configured: &str, detect: F) -> Result<String, String>
 8053: where
 8054:     F: FnOnce() -> Result<String, String>,
 8055: {
 8056:     let value = configured.trim();
 8057:     if value.is_empty() {
 8058:         return Err("egress interface must not be empty".to_string());
 8059:     }
 8060:     if !value.eq_ignore_ascii_case(DEFAULT_EGRESS_INTERFACE) {
 8061:         return Ok(value.to_string());
 8062:     }
 8063:     detect()
 8064: }

 8066: #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
 8067: fn detect_default_egress_interface() -> Result<String, String> {
 8068:     detect_route_interface("ip", &["-o", "route", "show", "to", "default"])
 8069: }

 8071: #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
 8072: fn detect_default_egress_interface() -> Result<String, String> {
 8073:     detect_route_interface("route", &["-n", "get", "default"])
 8074: }

 8076: #[cfg(windows)]
 8077: fn detect_default_egress_interface() -> Result<String, String> {
 8078:     // Use PowerShell Get-NetRoute to find the best default-route interface alias.
 8079:     // The InterfaceAlias (e.g. "Ethernet 0") is the string the daemon uses for
 8080:     // egress operations on Windows.
 8081:     let output = Command::new("powershell.exe")
 8082:         .args([
 8083:             "-NoProfile",
 8084:             "-NonInteractive",
 8085:             "-Command",
 8086:             "(Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' | Sort-Object -Property RouteMetric | Select-Object -First 1).InterfaceAlias",
 8087:         ])
 8088:         .output()
 8089:         .map_err(|err| format!("spawn powershell for egress detection failed: {err}"))?;
 8090:     if !output.status.success() {
 8091:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
 8092:         return Err(format!(
 8093:             "powershell egress detection failed: status={} stderr={stderr}",
 8094:             output.status
 8095:         ));
 8096:     }
 8097:     let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
 8098:         .map_err(|_| "powershell egress detection returned non-utf8 output".to_string())?;
 8099:     let interface = stdout.trim().to_string();
 8100:     if interface.is_empty() {
 8101:         return Err(
 8102:             "powershell egress detection returned empty interface (no default route?)".to_string(),
 8103:         );
 8104:     }
 8105:     Ok(interface)
 8106: }

 8113: fn detect_route_interface(program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<String, String> {
 8114:     let output = Command::new(program)
 8115:         .args(args)
 8116:         .output()
 8117:         .map_err(|err| format!("spawn {program} for egress detection failed: {err}"))?;
 8118:     if !output.status.success() {
 8119:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
 8120:         return Err(format!(
 8121:             "{program} egress detection exited unsuccessfully: status={} stderr={stderr}",
 8122:             output.status
 8123:         ));
 8124:     }
 8125:     let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
 8126:         .map_err(|_| format!("{program} egress detection returned non-utf8 output"))?;
 8127:     parse_first_route_interface(stdout.as_str())
 8128:         .ok_or_else(|| "unable to detect default egress interface from route output".to_string())
 8129: }

 8131: fn parse_first_route_interface(output: &str) -> Option<String> {
 8132:     output
 8133:         .lines()
 8134:         .find_map(parse_route_interface_token)
 8135:         .map(str::to_string)

 8138: fn parse_route_interface_token(line: &str) -> Option<&str> {
 8139:     let tokens = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
 8140:     for (idx, token) in tokens.iter().enumerate() {
 8141:         let normalized = token.trim_end_matches(':');
 8142:         if normalized == "dev" || normalized == "interface" {
 8143:             return tokens.get(idx + 1).copied();
 8144:         }
 8145:     }
 8146:     tokens.get(4).copied()
 8147: }

 8199:                     DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 8200:                         "auto tunnel watermark directory create failed: {err}"
 8201:                     ))
 8202:                 })?;
 8203:             }
 8204:         }
 8205:     }
 8206:     if let Some(parent) = config.traversal_bundle_path.parent() {
 8207:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 8208:             DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("traversal bundle directory create failed: {err}"))
 8209:         })?;
 8210:     }
 8211:     if let Some(parent) = config.traversal_watermark_path.parent() {
 8212:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 8213:             DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(

 8230:     if config.traversal_bundle_path.exists() {

 8261:             validate_private_key_permissions(path)?;

 8263:         if let Some(path) = config.wg_key_passphrase_path.as_ref() {
 8264:             validate_passphrase_permissions(path)?;
 8265:         }
 8266:         if let Some(path) = config.wg_public_key_path.as_ref() {
 8267:             validate_public_key_permissions(path)?;

 8270: 
 8271:     let watermark = load_trust_watermark(&config.trust_watermark_path).map_err(|err| {

 8302:             DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("membership replay preflight failed: {err}"))

 8304:     }
 8305: 
 8306:     let auto_tunnel_preflight = if config.auto_tunnel_enforce {
 8307:         let bundle_path = config.auto_tunnel_bundle_path.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
 8308:             DaemonError::InvalidConfig("auto tunnel enforce requires bundle path".to_string())
 8309:         })?;
 8310:         let verifier_key_path = config
 8311:             .auto_tunnel_verifier_key_path
 8312:             .as_ref()
 8313:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 8314:                 DaemonError::InvalidConfig(
 8315:                     "auto tunnel enforce requires verifier key path".to_string(),
 8316:                 )
 8317:             })?;
 8318:         let watermark_path = config.auto_tunnel_watermark_path.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
 8319:             DaemonError::InvalidConfig("auto tunnel enforce requires watermark path".to_string())

 8335:     } else {

 8337:     };
 8338: 
 8339:     let dns_zone_watermark =

 8341:             DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("dns zone watermark preflight failed: {err}"))
 8342:         })?;
 8343:     if config.dns_zone_bundle_path.exists() {
 8344:         if let Some(auto_tunnel) = auto_tunnel_preflight.as_ref() {
 8345:             if let Err(err) = load_dns_zone_bundle(DnsZoneLoadContext {
 8346:                 path: &config.dns_zone_bundle_path,

 8350:                 previous_watermark: dns_zone_watermark,
 8351:                 expected_zone_name: &config.dns_zone_name,
 8352:                 local_node_id: &config.node_id,
 8353:                 auto_tunnel: &auto_tunnel.bundle,
 8354:             }) {
 8355:                 // Managed DNS must fail closed for managed names, but stale/invalid bundles
 8356:                 // should not prevent daemon startup or dataplane reconciliation.
 8357:                 eprintln!(
 8358:                     "rustynetd startup warning: dns zone preflight skipped invalid managed DNS bundle: {err}"
 8359:                 );
 8360:             }
 8361:         } else {
 8362:             eprintln!(
 8363:                 "rustynetd startup warning: dns zone bundle present without signed assignment context; managed DNS remains fail-closed"
 8364:             );
 8365:         }
 8366:     }
 8367: 
 8368:     let traversal_watermark =
 8369:         load_traversal_watermark(&config.traversal_watermark_path).map_err(|err| {
 8370:             DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("traversal watermark preflight failed: {err}"))
 8371:         })?;
 8372:     if config.traversal_bundle_path.exists() {
 8373:         match load_traversal_bundle_set(
 8374:             &config.traversal_bundle_path,
 8375:             &config.traversal_verifier_key_path,
 8376:             config.traversal_max_age_secs.get(),
 8377:             TrustPolicy::default(),
 8378:             traversal_watermark,
 8379:         ) {
 8380:             Ok(_) => {}
 8381:             // A stale bundle is non-fatal at startup: the orchestrator may distribute a
 8382:             // fresh bundle after the service starts.  The reconcile loop will refuse to use
 8383:             // it until a valid bundle is in place, so the node is safe but not yet
 8384:             // forwarding traffic.  Any other error (bad signature, replay, format) is still
 8385:             // fatal because it indicates data corruption or an active attack.
 8386:             Err(TraversalBootstrapError::Stale) => {
 8387:                 eprintln!(
 8388:                     "rustynetd startup warning: traversal bundle is stale ({}); daemon \
 8389:                      will start and reload when a fresh bundle is distributed",
 8390:                     config.traversal_bundle_path.display()
 8391:                 );
 8392:             }
 8393:             Err(err) => {
 8394:                 return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 8395:                     "traversal preflight failed: {err}"
 8396:                 )));
 8397:             }
 8398:         }
 8399:     }
 8400: 
 8401:     let mut system = daemon_system(config)?;
 8402:     system
 8403:         .check_prerequisites()
 8404:         .map_err(|err| DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("dataplane preflight failed: {err}")))?;
 8405: 
 8406:     Ok(())
 8407: }

 8419: fn validate_passphrase_permissions(path: &Path) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
 8420:     #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
 8421:     {
 8422:         if std::env::var("RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT")
 8423:             .ok()
 8424:             .map(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
 8425:             .unwrap_or(false)
 8426:         {
 8427:             read_passphrase_file(path).map_err(|err| {

 8432:             return Ok(());

 8437:     let disallowed_mode_mask = passphrase_disallowed_mode_mask(path);
 8438:     validate_file_security(
 8439:         path,

 8441:         disallowed_mode_mask,

 8454:         0o337

 8456:         0o077

 8490: fn load_trust_evidence(
 8491:     path: &Path,
 8492:     verifier_key_path: &Path,
 8493:     trust_policy: TrustPolicy,
 8494:     previous_watermark: Option<TrustWatermark>,
 8495: ) -> Result<TrustEvidenceEnvelope, TrustBootstrapError> {
 8496:     if !path.exists() {
 8497:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::Missing);
 8498:     }
 8499: 
 8500:     let verifying_key = load_verifying_key(verifier_key_path)?;
 8501:     enforce_text_artifact_size_limit(path, "trust evidence", MAX_TRUST_EVIDENCE_BYTES)
 8502:         .map_err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
 8503:     let content =
 8504:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| TrustBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 8505:     if content.len() > MAX_TRUST_EVIDENCE_BYTES {
 8506:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 8507:             "trust evidence exceeds maximum size of {MAX_TRUST_EVIDENCE_BYTES} bytes"
 8508:         )));
 8509:     }
 8510:     let mut version: Option<u8> = None;
 8511:     let mut tls13_valid: Option<bool> = None;
 8512:     let mut signed_control_valid: Option<bool> = None;
 8513:     let mut signed_data_age_secs: Option<u64> = None;
 8514:     let mut clock_skew_secs: Option<u64> = None;
 8515:     let mut updated_at_unix: Option<u64> = None;
 8516:     let mut nonce: Option<u64> = None;
 8517:     let mut signature_hex: Option<String> = None;
 8518:     let mut line_count = 0usize;
 8519:     let mut seen_keys = std::collections::HashSet::new();
 8520: 
 8521:     for line in content.lines() {
 8522:         line_count = line_count.saturating_add(1);
 8523:         if line_count > MAX_TRUST_EVIDENCE_LINES {
 8524:             return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 8525:                 "trust evidence exceeds maximum line count of {MAX_TRUST_EVIDENCE_LINES}"
 8526:             )));
 8527:         }
 8528:         let (key, value) = parse_limited_key_value_line(
 8529:             line,
 8530:             line_count,
 8531:             MAX_TRUST_EVIDENCE_LINE_BYTES,
 8532:             MAX_TRUST_EVIDENCE_KEY_BYTES,
 8533:             MAX_TRUST_EVIDENCE_VALUE_BYTES,
 8534:             MAX_TRUST_EVIDENCE_KEY_DEPTH,
 8535:         )
 8536:         .map_err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
 8537:         if !seen_keys.insert(key.to_string()) {
 8538:             return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 8539:                 "duplicate key {key}"
 8540:             )));
 8541:         }
 8542:         if !matches!(
 8543:             key,
 8544:             "version"
 8545:                 | "tls13_valid"
 8546:                 | "signed_control_valid"
 8547:                 | "signed_data_age_secs"
 8548:                 | "clock_skew_secs"
 8549:                 | "updated_at_unix"
 8550:                 | "nonce"
 8551:                 | "signature"
 8552:         ) {
 8553:             return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 8554:                 "unknown key {key}"
 8555:             )));
 8556:         }
 8557: 
 8558:         match key {
 8559:             "version" => {
 8560:                 version = value.parse::<u8>().ok();
 8561:             }
 8562:             "tls13_valid" => {
 8563:                 tls13_valid = parse_bool(value);
 8564:             }
 8565:             "signed_control_valid" => {
 8566:                 signed_control_valid = parse_bool(value);
 8567:             }
 8568:             "signed_data_age_secs" => {
 8569:                 signed_data_age_secs = value.parse::<u64>().ok();
 8570:             }
 8571:             "clock_skew_secs" => {
 8572:                 clock_skew_secs = value.parse::<u64>().ok();
 8573:             }
 8574:             "updated_at_unix" => {
 8575:                 updated_at_unix = value.parse::<u64>().ok();
 8576:             }
 8577:             "nonce" => {
 8578:                 nonce = value.parse::<u64>().ok();
 8579:             }
 8580:             "signature" => {
 8581:                 signature_hex = Some(value.to_string());
 8582:             }
 8583:             _ => {
 8584:                 return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 8585:                     "unknown key {key}"
 8586:                 )));
 8587:             }
 8588:         }
 8589:     }
 8590: 
 8591:     if version != Some(2) {
 8592:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 8593:             "unsupported trust evidence version".to_string(),
 8594:         ));
 8595:     }
 8596: 
 8597:     let record = TrustEvidenceRecord {
 8598:         tls13_valid: tls13_valid
 8599:             .ok_or_else(|| TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing tls13_valid".to_string()))?,
 8600:         signed_control_valid: signed_control_valid.ok_or_else(|| {
 8601:             TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing signed_control_valid".to_string())
 8602:         })?,
 8603:         signed_data_age_secs: signed_data_age_secs.ok_or_else(|| {
 8604:             TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing signed_data_age_secs".to_string())
 8605:         })?,
 8606:         clock_skew_secs: clock_skew_secs.ok_or_else(|| {
 8607:             TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing clock_skew_secs".to_string())
 8608:         })?,
 8609:         updated_at_unix: updated_at_unix.ok_or_else(|| {
 8610:             TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing updated_at_unix".to_string())
 8611:         })?,
 8612:         nonce: nonce
 8613:             .ok_or_else(|| TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing nonce".to_string()))?,
 8614:     };
 8615: 
 8616:     let signature_hex = signature_hex.ok_or_else(|| {
 8617:         TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing trust evidence signature".to_string())
 8618:     })?;
 8619:     let signature_bytes = decode_hex_to_fixed::<64>(&signature_hex).map_err(|_| {
 8620:         TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid signature encoding".to_string())
 8621:     })?;
 8622:     let signature = Signature::from_bytes(&signature_bytes);
 8623:     let payload = trust_evidence_payload(&record);
 8624:     verifying_key
 8625:         .verify(payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
 8626:         .map_err(|_| TrustBootstrapError::SignatureInvalid)?;
 8627: 
 8628:     let now = unix_now();
 8629:     if record.updated_at_unix > now.saturating_add(trust_policy.max_clock_skew_secs) {
 8630:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::FutureDated);
 8631:     }
 8632: 
 8633:     let age = now.saturating_sub(record.updated_at_unix);
 8634:     if age > trust_policy.max_signed_data_age_secs {
 8635:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::Stale);
 8636:     }
 8637: 
 8638:     let payload_digest = sha256_digest(payload.as_bytes());
 8639:     let watermark = TrustWatermark {
 8640:         updated_at_unix: record.updated_at_unix,
 8641:         nonce: record.nonce,
 8642:         payload_digest: Some(payload_digest),
 8643:     };
 8644:     if let Some(existing) = previous_watermark {
 8645:         match compare_trust_watermark_generation(&watermark, &existing) {
 8646:             std::cmp::Ordering::Less => return Err(TrustBootstrapError::ReplayDetected),
 8647:             std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => {
 8648:                 if existing.payload_digest != Some(payload_digest) {
 8649:                     return Err(TrustBootstrapError::ReplayDetected);
 8650:                 }
 8651:             }
 8652:             std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => {}
 8653:         }
 8654:     }
 8655: 
 8656:     Ok(TrustEvidenceEnvelope {
 8657:         evidence: TrustEvidence {
 8658:             tls13_valid: record.tls13_valid,
 8659:             signed_control_valid: record.signed_control_valid,
 8660:             signed_data_age_secs: record.signed_data_age_secs,
 8661:             clock_skew_secs: record.clock_skew_secs,
 8662:         },
 8663:         watermark,
 8664:     })
 8665: }
 8666: 
 8667: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 8668: struct TrustEvidenceRecord {
 8669:     tls13_valid: bool,
 8670:     signed_control_valid: bool,
 8671:     signed_data_age_secs: u64,
 8672:     clock_skew_secs: u64,
 8673:     updated_at_unix: u64,
 8674:     nonce: u64,
 8675: }
 8676: 
 8677: fn trust_evidence_payload(record: &TrustEvidenceRecord) -> String {
 8678:     format!(
 8679:         "version=2\ntls13_valid={}\nsigned_control_valid={}\nsigned_data_age_secs={}\nclock_skew_secs={}\nupdated_at_unix={}\nnonce={}\n",
 8680:         if record.tls13_valid { "true" } else { "false" },
 8681:         if record.signed_control_valid {
 8682:             "true"
 8683:         } else {
 8684:             "false"
 8685:         },
 8686:         record.signed_data_age_secs,
 8687:         record.clock_skew_secs,
 8688:         record.updated_at_unix,
 8689:         record.nonce
 8690:     )
 8691: }
 8692: 
 8693: fn enforce_text_artifact_size_limit(
 8694:     path: &Path,
 8695:     artifact_name: &str,
 8696:     max_bytes: usize,
 8697: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 8698:     let metadata =
 8699:         fs::metadata(path).map_err(|err| format!("{artifact_name} metadata read failed: {err}"))?;
 8700:     if metadata.len() > max_bytes as u64 {
 8701:         return Err(format!(
 8702:             "{artifact_name} exceeds maximum size of {max_bytes} bytes"
 8703:         ));
 8704:     }
 8705:     Ok(())
 8706: }
 8707: 
 8708: fn parse_limited_key_value_line(
 8709:     line: &str,
 8710:     line_number: usize,
 8711:     max_line_bytes: usize,
 8712:     max_key_bytes: usize,
 8713:     max_value_bytes: usize,
 8714:     max_key_depth: usize,
 8715: ) -> Result<(&str, &str), String> {
 8716:     if line.len() > max_line_bytes {
 8717:         return Err(format!(
 8718:             "line {line_number} exceeds maximum size of {max_line_bytes} bytes"
 8719:         ));
 8720:     }
 8721:     let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once('=') else {
 8722:         return Err("line missing key/value separator".to_string());
 8723:     };
 8724:     if key.is_empty() {
 8725:         return Err(format!("line {line_number} has empty key"));
 8726:     }
 8727:     if key.len() > max_key_bytes {
 8728:         return Err(format!(
 8729:             "line {line_number} key exceeds maximum size of {max_key_bytes} bytes"
 8730:         ));
 8731:     }
 8732:     if value.len() > max_value_bytes {
 8733:         return Err(format!(
 8734:             "line {line_number} value exceeds maximum size of {max_value_bytes} bytes"
 8735:         ));
 8736:     }
 8737:     let depth = key.split('.').count();
 8738:     if depth == 0 || depth > max_key_depth {
 8739:         return Err(format!(
 8740:             "line {line_number} key depth exceeds maximum of {max_key_depth}"
 8741:         ));
 8742:     }
 8743:     if !key
 8744:         .chars()
 8745:         .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '.' | '_' | '-'))
 8746:     {
 8747:         return Err(format!("line {line_number} has invalid key characters"));
 8748:     }
 8749:     Ok((key, value))
 8750: }
 8751: 
 8752: fn parse_indexed_key<'a>(key: &'a str, prefix: &str) -> Option<(usize, &'a str)> {
 8753:     let tail = key.strip_prefix(prefix)?;
 8754:     let (index_raw, suffix) = tail.split_once('.')?;
 8755:     let index = index_raw.parse::<usize>().ok()?;
 8756:     Some((index, suffix))
 8757: }
 8758: 
 8759: fn is_allowed_auto_tunnel_key(key: &str) -> bool {
 8760:     if matches!(
 8761:         key,
 8762:         "version"
 8763:             | "node_id"
 8764:             | "mesh_cidr"
 8765:             | "assigned_cidr"
 8766:             | "generated_at_unix"
 8767:             | "expires_at_unix"
 8768:             | "nonce"
 8769:             | "peer_count"
 8770:             | "route_count"
 8771:             | "signature"
 8772:     ) {
 8773:         return true;
 8774:     }
 8775: 
 8776:     if let Some((_index, suffix)) = parse_indexed_key(key, "peer.") {
 8777:         return matches!(
 8778:             suffix,
 8779:             "node_id" | "endpoint" | "public_key_hex" | "allowed_ips"
 8780:         );
 8781:     }
 8782: 
 8783:     if let Some((_index, suffix)) = parse_indexed_key(key, "route.") {
 8784:         return matches!(suffix, "destination_cidr" | "via_node" | "kind");
 8785:     }
 8786: 
 8787:     false
 8788: }
 8789: 
 8790: fn is_allowed_traversal_key(key: &str) -> bool {
 8791:     if matches!(
 8792:         key,
 8793:         "version"
 8794:             | "type"
 8795:             | "path_policy"
 8796:             | "source_node_id"
 8797:             | "target_node_id"
 8798:             | "generated_at_unix"
 8799:             | "expires_at_unix"
 8800:             | "nonce"
 8801:             | "candidate_count"
 8802:             | "session_id"
 8803:             | "probe_start_unix"
 8804:             | "node_a"
 8805:             | "node_b"
 8806:             | "issued_at_unix"
 8807:             | "signature"
 8808:     ) {
 8809:         return true;
 8810:     }
 8811: 
 8812:     if let Some((_index, suffix)) = parse_indexed_key(key, "candidate.") {
 8813:         return matches!(
 8814:             suffix,
 8815:             "type" | "addr" | "port" | "family" | "relay_id" | "priority"
 8816:         );
 8817:     }
 8818: 
 8819:     false
 8820: }

 8822: fn traversal_coordination_pair_key(left: &str, right: &str) -> (String, String) {
 8823:     if left <= right {
 8824:         (left.to_string(), right.to_string())
 8825:     } else {
 8826:         (right.to_string(), left.to_string())
 8827:     }
 8828: }

 8830: fn parse_bool(value: &str) -> Option<bool> {
 8831:     match value {
 8832:         "true" => Some(true),
 8833:         "false" => Some(false),
 8834:         _ => None,
 8835:     }
 8836: }
