 8838: fn compare_trust_watermark_generation(
 8839:     incoming: &TrustWatermark,
 8840:     existing: &TrustWatermark,
 8841: ) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
 8842:     (incoming.updated_at_unix, incoming.nonce).cmp(&(existing.updated_at_unix, existing.nonce))
 8843: }
 8844: 
 8845: fn sha256_digest(bytes: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32] {
 8846:     let digest = Sha256::digest(bytes);
 8847:     let mut out = [0u8; 32];
 8848:     out.copy_from_slice(&digest);
 8849:     out
 8850: }
 8851: 
 8852: fn encode_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
 8853:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
 8854:     for byte in bytes {
 8855:         out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
 8856:     }
 8857:     out
 8858: }
 8859: 
 8860: fn decode_hex_to_fixed<const N: usize>(encoded: &str) -> Result<[u8; N], TrustBootstrapError> {
 8861:     let mut bytes = [0u8; N];
 8862:     let trimmed = encoded.trim();
 8863:     if trimmed.len() != N * 2 {
 8864:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 8865:             "unexpected hex length".to_string(),
 8866:         ));
 8867:     }
 8868:     let raw = trimmed.as_bytes();
 8869:     let mut index = 0usize;
 8870:     while index < N {
 8871:         let hi = decode_hex_nibble(raw[index * 2])?;
 8872:         let lo = decode_hex_nibble(raw[index * 2 + 1])?;
 8873:         bytes[index] = (hi << 4) | lo;
 8874:         index += 1;
 8875:     }
 8876:     Ok(bytes)
 8877: }
 8878: 
 8879: fn decode_hex_nibble(value: u8) -> Result<u8, TrustBootstrapError> {
 8880:     match value {
 8881:         b'0'..=b'9' => Ok(value - b'0'),
 8882:         b'a'..=b'f' => Ok(value - b'a' + 10),
 8883:         b'A'..=b'F' => Ok(value - b'A' + 10),
 8884:         _ => Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 8885:             "invalid hex character".to_string(),
 8886:         )),
 8887:     }
 8888: }
 8889: 
 8890: fn load_verifying_key(path: &Path) -> Result<VerifyingKey, TrustBootstrapError> {
 8891:     enforce_text_artifact_size_limit(path, "trust verifier key", MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES)
 8892:         .map_err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
 8893:     let content =
 8894:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| TrustBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 8895:     if content.len() > MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES {
 8896:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 8897:             "trust verifier key exceeds maximum size of {MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES} bytes"
 8898:         )));
 8899:     }
 8900:     let key_line = content
 8901:         .lines()
 8902:         .map(str::trim)
 8903:         .find(|line| !line.is_empty() && !line.starts_with('#'))
 8904:         .ok_or_else(|| TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing verifier key".to_string()))?;
 8905:     let key_bytes = decode_hex_to_fixed::<32>(key_line)?;
 8906:     VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&key_bytes).map_err(|_| TrustBootstrapError::KeyInvalid)
 8907: }
 8908: 
 8909: fn load_remote_ops_access_token_verifying_key(path: &Path) -> Result<VerifyingKey, DaemonError> {
 8910:     enforce_text_artifact_size_limit(
 8911:         path,
 8912:         "remote ops token verifier key",
 8913:         MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES,
 8914:     )
 8915:     .map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)?;
 8916:     let content = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| {
 8917:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("read remote ops verifier key: {err}"))
 8918:     })?;
 8919:     if content.len() > MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES {
 8920:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
 8921:             "remote ops token verifier key exceeds maximum size of {MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES} bytes"
 8922:         )));
 8923:     }
 8924:     let key_line = content
 8925:         .lines()
 8926:         .map(str::trim)
 8927:         .find(|line| !line.is_empty() && !line.starts_with('#'))
 8928:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 8929:             DaemonError::InvalidConfig("missing remote ops token verifier key".to_string())
 8930:         })?;
 8931:     let key_bytes = decode_hex_to_fixed::<32>(key_line).map_err(|_| {
 8932:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig("invalid remote ops verifier key hex".to_string())
 8933:     })?;
 8934:     VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&key_bytes)
 8935:         .map_err(|_| DaemonError::InvalidConfig("remote ops verifier key is invalid".to_string()))
 8936: }
 8937: 
 8938: fn load_trust_watermark(path: &Path) -> Result<Option<TrustWatermark>, TrustBootstrapError> {
 8939:     if !path.exists() {
 8940:         return Ok(None);
 8941:     }
 8942: 
 8943:     let content =
 8944:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| TrustBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 8945:     let mut version: Option<u8> = None;
 8946:     let mut updated_at_unix: Option<u64> = None;
 8947:     let mut nonce: Option<u64> = None;
 8948:     let mut payload_digest: Option<[u8; 32]> = None;
 8949:     for line in content.lines() {
 8950:         let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once('=') else {
 8951:             return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 8952:                 "watermark line missing key/value separator".to_string(),
 8953:             ));
 8954:         };
 8955:         match key {
 8956:             "version" => {
 8957:                 version = value.parse::<u8>().ok();
 8958:             }
 8959:             "updated_at_unix" => {
 8960:                 updated_at_unix = value.parse::<u64>().ok();
 8961:             }
 8962:             "nonce" => {
 8963:                 nonce = value.parse::<u64>().ok();
 8964:             }
 8965:             "payload_digest_sha256" => {
 8966:                 payload_digest = Some(decode_hex_to_fixed::<32>(value)?);
 8967:             }
 8968:             _ => {
 8969:                 return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 8970:                     "unknown watermark key {key}"
 8971:                 )));
 8972:             }
 8973:         }
 8974:     }
 8975:     let version = version.ok_or_else(|| {
 8976:         TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark version".to_string())
 8977:     })?;
 8978:     if version != 2 {
 8979:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 8980:             "unsupported watermark version; expected version=2".to_string(),
 8981:         ));
 8982:     }
 8983:     Ok(Some(TrustWatermark {
 8984:         updated_at_unix: updated_at_unix.ok_or_else(|| {
 8985:             TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark updated_at_unix".to_string())
 8986:         })?,
 8987:         nonce: nonce.ok_or_else(|| {
 8988:             TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark nonce".to_string())
 8989:         })?,
 8990:         payload_digest: Some(payload_digest.ok_or_else(|| {
 8991:             TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 8992:                 "missing watermark payload_digest_sha256".to_string(),
 8993:             )
 8994:         })?),
 8995:     }))
 8996: }
 8997: 
 8998: fn persist_trust_watermark(
 8999:     path: &Path,
 9000:     watermark: TrustWatermark,
 9001: ) -> Result<(), TrustBootstrapError> {
 9002:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 9003:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| TrustBootstrapError::Io(format!("create_dir_all({}): {}", parent.display(), err)))?;
 9004:         #[cfg(unix)]
 9005:         {
 9006:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
 9007:             fs::set_permissions(parent, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
 9008:                 .map_err(|err| TrustBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9009:         }
 9010:     }
 9011:     let payload = format!(
 9012:         "version=2\nupdated_at_unix={}\nnonce={}\npayload_digest_sha256={}\n",
 9013:         watermark.updated_at_unix,
 9014:         watermark.nonce,
 9015:         encode_hex(&watermark.payload_digest.ok_or_else(|| {
 9016:             TrustBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9017:                 "watermark payload digest must be present".to_string(),
 9018:             )
 9019:         })?)
 9020:     );
 9021:     let temp_path = path.with_extension(format!(
 9022:         "tmp.{}.{}",
 9023:         std::process::id(),
 9024:         SystemTime::now()
 9025:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 9026:             .map(|duration| duration.as_nanos())
 9027:             .unwrap_or(0)
 9028:     ));
 9029:     let mut options = fs::OpenOptions::new();
 9030:     options.write(true).create_new(true);
 9031:     #[cfg(unix)]
 9032:     {
 9033:         use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
 9034:         options.mode(0o600);
 9035:     }
 9036:     let mut temp = options
 9037:         .open(&temp_path)
 9038:         .map_err(|err| TrustBootstrapError::Io(format!("create_temp({}): {}", temp_path.display(), err)))?;
 9039:     if let Err(err) = temp.write_all(payload.as_bytes()) {
 9040:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9041:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::Io(format!("write_temp: {err}")));
 9042:     }
 9043:     if let Err(err) = temp.sync_all() {
 9044:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9045:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::Io(format!("sync_temp: {err}")));
 9046:     }
 9047:     drop(temp);
 9048:     if let Err(err) = fs::rename(&temp_path, path) {
 9049:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9050:         return Err(TrustBootstrapError::Io(format!("rename({} -> {}): {}", temp_path.display(), path.display(), err)));
 9051:     }
 9052:     #[cfg(unix)]
 9053:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 9054:         let parent_dir = fs::File::open(parent)
 9055:             .map_err(|err| TrustBootstrapError::Io(format!("open_parent_dir({}): {}", parent.display(), err)))?;
 9056:         parent_dir
 9057:             .sync_all()
 9058:             .map_err(|err| TrustBootstrapError::Io(format!("sync_parent_dir: {err}")))?;
 9059:     }
 9060:     Ok(())
 9061: }
 9062: 
 9063: fn load_membership_watermark(path: &Path) -> Result<Option<MembershipWatermark>, String> {
 9064:     if !path.exists() {
 9065:         return Ok(None);
 9066:     }
 9067:     let content = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 9068:     let mut version: Option<u8> = None;
 9069:     let mut epoch: Option<u64> = None;
 9070:     let mut state_root: Option<String> = None;
 9071:     for line in content.lines() {
 9072:         let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once('=') else {
 9073:             return Err("membership watermark line missing key/value separator".to_string());
 9074:         };
 9075:         match key {
 9076:             "version" => {
 9077:                 version = value.parse::<u8>().ok();
 9078:             }
 9079:             "epoch" => {
 9080:                 epoch = value.parse::<u64>().ok();
 9081:             }
 9082:             "state_root" => {
 9083:                 state_root = Some(value.to_string());
 9084:             }
 9085:             _ => return Err(format!("unknown membership watermark key {key}")),
 9086:         }
 9087:     }
 9088:     if version != Some(1) {
 9089:         return Err("unsupported membership watermark version".to_string());
 9090:     }
 9091:     Ok(Some(MembershipWatermark {
 9092:         epoch: epoch.ok_or_else(|| "missing membership watermark epoch".to_string())?,
 9093:         state_root: state_root
 9094:             .ok_or_else(|| "missing membership watermark state_root".to_string())?,
 9095:     }))
 9096: }
 9097: 
 9098: fn persist_membership_watermark(
 9099:     path: &Path,
 9100:     watermark: &MembershipWatermark,
 9101: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 9102:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 9103:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 9104:         #[cfg(unix)]
 9105:         {
 9106:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
 9107:             fs::set_permissions(parent, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
 9108:                 .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 9109:         }
 9110:     }
 9111:     let payload = format!(
 9112:         "version=1\nepoch={}\nstate_root={}\n",
 9113:         watermark.epoch, watermark.state_root
 9114:     );
 9115:     let temp_path = path.with_extension(format!(
 9116:         "tmp.{}.{}",
 9117:         std::process::id(),
 9118:         SystemTime::now()
 9119:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 9120:             .map(|duration| duration.as_nanos())
 9121:             .unwrap_or(0)
 9122:     ));
 9123:     let mut options = fs::OpenOptions::new();
 9124:     options.write(true).create_new(true);
 9125:     #[cfg(unix)]
 9126:     {
 9127:         use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
 9128:         options.mode(0o600);
 9129:     }
 9130:     let mut temp = options.open(&temp_path).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 9131:     if let Err(err) = temp.write_all(payload.as_bytes()) {
 9132:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9133:         return Err(err.to_string());
 9134:     }
 9135:     if let Err(err) = temp.sync_all() {
 9136:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9137:         return Err(err.to_string());
 9138:     }
 9139:     if let Err(err) = fs::rename(&temp_path, path) {
 9140:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9141:         return Err(err.to_string());
 9142:     }
 9143:     #[cfg(unix)]
 9144:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 9145:         let parent_dir = fs::File::open(parent).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 9146:         parent_dir.sync_all().map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 9147:     }
 9148:     Ok(())
 9149: }
 9150: 
 9151: fn load_auto_tunnel_bundle(
 9152:     path: &Path,
 9153:     verifier_key_path: &Path,
 9154:     max_age_secs: u64,
 9155:     trust_policy: TrustPolicy,
 9156:     previous_watermark: Option<AutoTunnelWatermark>,
 9157: ) -> Result<AutoTunnelBundleEnvelope, AutoTunnelBootstrapError> {
 9158:     if !path.exists() {
 9159:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Missing);
 9160:     }
 9161: 
 9162:     let verifying_key = load_auto_tunnel_verifying_key(verifier_key_path)?;
 9163:     enforce_text_artifact_size_limit(path, "auto-tunnel bundle", MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_BYTES)
 9164:         .map_err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
 9165:     let content =
 9166:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9167:     if content.len() > MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_BYTES {
 9168:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9169:             "auto-tunnel bundle exceeds maximum size of {MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_BYTES} bytes"
 9170:         )));
 9171:     }
 9172: 
 9173:     let mut payload = String::new();
 9174:     let mut signature_hex: Option<String> = None;
 9175:     let mut fields = std::collections::HashMap::new();
 9176:     let mut line_count = 0usize;
 9177: 
 9178:     for line in content.lines() {
 9179:         line_count = line_count.saturating_add(1);
 9180:         if line_count > MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_LINES {
 9181:             return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9182:                 "auto-tunnel bundle exceeds maximum line count of {MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE_LINES}"
 9183:             )));
 9184:         }
 9185:         let (key, value) = parse_limited_key_value_line(
 9186:             line,
 9187:             line_count,
 9188:             MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_LINE_BYTES,
 9189:             MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_KEY_BYTES,
 9190:             MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_VALUE_BYTES,
 9191:             MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_KEY_DEPTH,
 9192:         )
 9193:         .map_err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
 9194:         if !is_allowed_auto_tunnel_key(key) {
 9195:             return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9196:                 "unknown key {key}"
 9197:             )));
 9198:         }
 9199:         if key == "signature" {
 9200:             if signature_hex.is_some() {
 9201:                 return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9202:                     "duplicate key signature".to_string(),
 9203:                 ));
 9204:             }
 9205:             signature_hex = Some(value.to_string());
 9206:             continue;
 9207:         }
 9208:         payload.push_str(line);
 9209:         payload.push('\n');
 9210:         if fields.insert(key.to_string(), value.to_string()).is_some() {
 9211:             return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9212:                 "duplicate key {key}"
 9213:             )));
 9214:         }
 9215:     }
 9216:     if fields.len() > MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_FIELD_COUNT {
 9217:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9218:             "auto-tunnel bundle exceeds maximum field count of {MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_FIELD_COUNT}"
 9219:         )));
 9220:     }
 9221: 
 9222:     let version = fields
 9223:         .get("version")
 9224:         .ok_or_else(|| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing version".to_string()))?;
 9225:     if version != "1" {
 9226:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9227:             "unsupported bundle version".to_string(),
 9228:         ));
 9229:     }
 9230: 
 9231:     let node_id = fields
 9232:         .get("node_id")
 9233:         .ok_or_else(|| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing node_id".to_string()))?
 9234:         .to_string();
 9235:     NodeId::new(node_id.clone())
 9236:         .map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(err.to_string()))?;
 9237: 
 9238:     let mesh_cidr = fields
 9239:         .get("mesh_cidr")
 9240:         .ok_or_else(|| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing mesh_cidr".to_string()))?
 9241:         .to_string();
 9242:     if !is_valid_ipv4_or_ipv6_cidr(&mesh_cidr) {
 9243:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9244:             "invalid mesh_cidr".to_string(),
 9245:         ));
 9246:     }
 9247: 
 9248:     let assigned_cidr = fields
 9249:         .get("assigned_cidr")
 9250:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 9251:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing assigned_cidr".to_string())
 9252:         })?
 9253:         .to_string();
 9254:     if !is_valid_ipv4_or_ipv6_cidr(&assigned_cidr) {
 9255:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9256:             "invalid assigned_cidr".to_string(),
 9257:         ));
 9258:     }
 9259:     if !is_host_cidr(&assigned_cidr) {
 9260:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9261:             "assigned_cidr must be a host cidr".to_string(),
 9262:         ));
 9263:     }
 9264:     if !cidr_contains(&mesh_cidr, &assigned_cidr) {
 9265:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9266:             "assigned_cidr is outside mesh_cidr".to_string(),
 9267:         ));
 9268:     }
 9269: 
 9270:     let generated_at_unix = fields
 9271:         .get("generated_at_unix")
 9272:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 9273:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing generated_at_unix".to_string())
 9274:         })?
 9275:         .parse::<u64>()
 9276:         .map_err(|_| {
 9277:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid generated_at_unix".to_string())
 9278:         })?;
 9279:     let expires_at_unix = fields
 9280:         .get("expires_at_unix")
 9281:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 9282:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing expires_at_unix".to_string())
 9283:         })?
 9284:         .parse::<u64>()
 9285:         .map_err(|_| {
 9286:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid expires_at_unix".to_string())
 9287:         })?;
 9288:     if generated_at_unix >= expires_at_unix {
 9289:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9290:             "invalid generated/expires ordering".to_string(),
 9291:         ));
 9292:     }
 9293: 
 9294:     let nonce = fields
 9295:         .get("nonce")
 9296:         .ok_or_else(|| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing nonce".to_string()))?
 9297:         .parse::<u64>()
 9298:         .map_err(|_| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid nonce".to_string()))?;
 9299: 
 9300:     let signature_hex = signature_hex.ok_or_else(|| {
 9301:         AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing bundle signature".to_string())
 9302:     })?;
 9303:     let signature_bytes = decode_auto_tunnel_hex_to_fixed::<64>(&signature_hex)?;
 9304:     let signature = Signature::from_bytes(&signature_bytes);
 9305:     verifying_key
 9306:         .verify(payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
 9307:         .map_err(|_| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::SignatureInvalid)?;
 9308: 
 9309:     let now = unix_now();
 9310:     if generated_at_unix > now.saturating_add(trust_policy.max_clock_skew_secs) {
 9311:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::FutureDated);
 9312:     }
 9313:     if now > expires_at_unix || now.saturating_sub(generated_at_unix) > max_age_secs {
 9314:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Stale);
 9315:     }
 9316: 
 9317:     let payload_digest = sha256_digest(payload.as_bytes());
 9318:     let watermark = AutoTunnelWatermark {
 9319:         generated_at_unix,
 9320:         nonce,
 9321:         payload_digest: Some(payload_digest),
 9322:     };
 9323:     if let Some(existing) = previous_watermark {
 9324:         match auto_tunnel_watermark_ordering(&watermark, &existing) {
 9325:             std::cmp::Ordering::Less => {
 9326:                 return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::ReplayDetected);
 9327:             }
 9328:             std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => {
 9329:                 let existing_digest = existing
 9330:                     .payload_digest
 9331:                     .ok_or(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::ReplayDetected)?;
 9332:                 if existing_digest != payload_digest {
 9333:                     return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::ReplayDetected);
 9334:                 }
 9335:             }
 9336:             std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => {}
 9337:         }
 9338:     }
 9339: 
 9340:     let peer_count = fields
 9341:         .get("peer_count")
 9342:         .ok_or_else(|| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing peer_count".to_string()))?
 9343:         .parse::<usize>()
 9344:         .map_err(|_| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid peer_count".to_string()))?;
 9345:     if peer_count > MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_PEER_COUNT {
 9346:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9347:             "peer_count exceeds maximum of {MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_PEER_COUNT}"
 9348:         )));
 9349:     }
 9350: 
 9351:     let mut peers = Vec::with_capacity(peer_count);
 9352:     for index in 0..peer_count {
 9353:         let node_id_key = format!("peer.{index}.node_id");
 9354:         let endpoint_key = format!("peer.{index}.endpoint");
 9355:         let public_key_key = format!("peer.{index}.public_key_hex");
 9356:         let allowed_ips_key = format!("peer.{index}.allowed_ips");
 9357: 
 9358:         let peer_node = fields.get(&node_id_key).ok_or_else(|| {
 9359:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {node_id_key}"))
 9360:         })?;
 9361:         let peer_node_id = NodeId::new(peer_node.clone())
 9362:             .map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(err.to_string()))?;
 9363: 
 9364:         let endpoint_raw = fields.get(&endpoint_key).ok_or_else(|| {
 9365:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {endpoint_key}"))
 9366:         })?;
 9367:         let endpoint = endpoint_raw.parse::<std::net::SocketAddr>().map_err(|_| {
 9368:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("invalid endpoint {endpoint_key}"))
 9369:         })?;
 9370: 
 9371:         let public_key_hex = fields.get(&public_key_key).ok_or_else(|| {
 9372:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {public_key_key}"))
 9373:         })?;
 9374:         let public_key = decode_auto_tunnel_hex_to_fixed::<32>(public_key_hex)?;
 9375: 
 9376:         let allowed_ips_raw = fields.get(&allowed_ips_key).ok_or_else(|| {
 9377:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {allowed_ips_key}"))
 9378:         })?;
 9379:         let allowed_ips = allowed_ips_raw
 9380:             .split(',')
 9381:             .map(str::trim)
 9382:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 9383:             .map(ToString::to_string)
 9384:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 9385:         if allowed_ips.is_empty()
 9386:             || allowed_ips
 9387:                 .iter()
 9388:                 .any(|cidr| !is_valid_ipv4_or_ipv6_cidr(cidr))
 9389:         {
 9390:             return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9391:                 "invalid allowed_ips for peer {index}"
 9392:             )));
 9393:         }
 9394: 
 9395:         peers.push(PeerConfig {
 9396:             node_id: peer_node_id,
 9397:             endpoint: rustynet_backend_api::SocketEndpoint {
 9398:                 addr: endpoint.ip(),
 9399:                 port: endpoint.port(),
 9400:             },
 9401:             public_key,
 9402:             allowed_ips,
 9403:         });
 9404:     }
 9405: 
 9406:     let route_count = fields
 9407:         .get("route_count")
 9408:         .ok_or_else(|| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing route_count".to_string()))?
 9409:         .parse::<usize>()
 9410:         .map_err(|_| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid route_count".to_string()))?;
 9411:     if route_count > MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_ROUTE_COUNT {
 9412:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9413:             "route_count exceeds maximum of {MAX_AUTO_TUNNEL_ROUTE_COUNT}"
 9414:         )));
 9415:     }
 9416:     let expected_field_count = 9usize
 9417:         .checked_add(peer_count.checked_mul(4).ok_or_else(|| {
 9418:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("peer field count overflow".to_string())
 9419:         })?)
 9420:         .and_then(|value| value.checked_add(route_count.checked_mul(3)?))
 9421:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 9422:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("route field count overflow".to_string())
 9423:         })?;
 9424:     if fields.len() != expected_field_count {
 9425:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9426:             "unexpected field count for auto-tunnel bundle: expected {expected_field_count}, got {}",
 9427:             fields.len()
 9428:         )));
 9429:     }
 9430: 
 9431:     let mut routes = Vec::with_capacity(route_count);
 9432:     let mut selected_exit_node: Option<String> = None;
 9433:     for index in 0..route_count {
 9434:         let destination_key = format!("route.{index}.destination_cidr");
 9435:         let via_node_key = format!("route.{index}.via_node");
 9436:         let kind_key = format!("route.{index}.kind");
 9437: 
 9438:         let destination_cidr = fields.get(&destination_key).ok_or_else(|| {
 9439:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {destination_key}"))
 9440:         })?;
 9441:         if !is_valid_ipv4_or_ipv6_cidr(destination_cidr) {
 9442:             return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9443:                 "invalid destination cidr for route {index}"
 9444:             )));
 9445:         }
 9446:         let via_node_raw = fields.get(&via_node_key).ok_or_else(|| {
 9447:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {via_node_key}"))
 9448:         })?;
 9449:         let via_node = NodeId::new(via_node_raw.clone())
 9450:             .map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(err.to_string()))?;
 9451:         let kind = match fields.get(&kind_key).map(String::as_str) {
 9452:             Some("mesh") => RouteKind::Mesh,
 9453:             Some("exit_lan") => RouteKind::ExitNodeLan,
 9454:             Some("exit_default") => RouteKind::ExitNodeDefault,
 9455:             _ => {
 9456:                 return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9457:                     "invalid route kind for route {index}"
 9458:                 )));
 9459:             }
 9460:         };
 9461:         if matches!(kind, RouteKind::ExitNodeDefault | RouteKind::ExitNodeLan) {
 9462:             let via = via_node.as_str().to_string();
 9463:             if let Some(existing) = selected_exit_node.as_deref() {
 9464:                 if existing != via {
 9465:                     return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9466:                         "exit routes reference multiple exit nodes".to_string(),
 9467:                     ));
 9468:                 }
 9469:             }
 9470:             selected_exit_node = Some(via);
 9471:         }
 9472: 
 9473:         routes.push(Route {
 9474:             destination_cidr: destination_cidr.clone(),
 9475:             via_node,
 9476:             kind,
 9477:         });
 9478:     }
 9479: 
 9480:     Ok(AutoTunnelBundleEnvelope {
 9481:         bundle: AutoTunnelBundle {
 9482:             node_id,
 9483:             mesh_cidr,
 9484:             assigned_cidr,
 9485:             peers,
 9486:             routes,
 9487:             selected_exit_node,
 9488:         },
 9489:         watermark,
 9490:     })
 9491: }
 9492: 
 9493: fn load_auto_tunnel_verifying_key(path: &Path) -> Result<VerifyingKey, AutoTunnelBootstrapError> {
 9494:     enforce_text_artifact_size_limit(
 9495:         path,
 9496:         "auto-tunnel verifier key",
 9497:         MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES,
 9498:     )
 9499:     .map_err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
 9500:     let content =
 9501:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9502:     if content.len() > MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES {
 9503:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9504:             "auto-tunnel verifier key exceeds maximum size of {MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES} bytes"
 9505:         )));
 9506:     }
 9507:     let key_line = content
 9508:         .lines()
 9509:         .map(str::trim)
 9510:         .find(|line| !line.is_empty() && !line.starts_with('#'))
 9511:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 9512:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing verifier key".to_string())
 9513:         })?;
 9514:     let key_bytes = decode_auto_tunnel_hex_to_fixed::<32>(key_line)?;
 9515:     VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&key_bytes).map_err(|_| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::KeyInvalid)
 9516: }
 9517: 
 9518: fn decode_auto_tunnel_hex_to_fixed<const N: usize>(
 9519:     encoded: &str,
 9520: ) -> Result<[u8; N], AutoTunnelBootstrapError> {
 9521:     let mut bytes = [0u8; N];
 9522:     let trimmed = encoded.trim();
 9523:     if trimmed.len() != N * 2 {
 9524:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9525:             "unexpected hex length".to_string(),
 9526:         ));
 9527:     }
 9528:     let raw = trimmed.as_bytes();
 9529:     let mut index = 0usize;
 9530:     while index < N {
 9531:         let hi = decode_auto_tunnel_hex_nibble(raw[index * 2])?;
 9532:         let lo = decode_auto_tunnel_hex_nibble(raw[index * 2 + 1])?;
 9533:         bytes[index] = (hi << 4) | lo;
 9534:         index += 1;
 9535:     }
 9536:     Ok(bytes)
 9537: }
 9538: 
 9539: fn decode_auto_tunnel_hex_nibble(value: u8) -> Result<u8, AutoTunnelBootstrapError> {
 9540:     match value {
 9541:         b'0'..=b'9' => Ok(value - b'0'),
 9542:         b'a'..=b'f' => Ok(value - b'a' + 10),
 9543:         b'A'..=b'F' => Ok(value - b'A' + 10),
 9544:         _ => Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9545:             "invalid hex character".to_string(),
 9546:         )),
 9547:     }
 9548: }
 9549: 
 9550: fn auto_tunnel_watermark_ordering(
 9551:     current: &AutoTunnelWatermark,
 9552:     previous: &AutoTunnelWatermark,
 9553: ) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
 9554:     current
 9555:         .generated_at_unix
 9556:         .cmp(&previous.generated_at_unix)
 9557:         .then(current.nonce.cmp(&previous.nonce))
 9558: }
 9559: 
 9560: fn load_auto_tunnel_watermark(
 9561:     path: &Path,
 9562: ) -> Result<Option<AutoTunnelWatermark>, AutoTunnelBootstrapError> {
 9563:     if !path.exists() {
 9564:         return Ok(None);
 9565:     }
 9566: 
 9567:     let content =
 9568:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9569:     let mut version: Option<u8> = None;
 9570:     let mut generated_at_unix: Option<u64> = None;
 9571:     let mut nonce: Option<u64> = None;
 9572:     let mut payload_digest: Option<[u8; 32]> = None;
 9573:     for line in content.lines() {
 9574:         let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once('=') else {
 9575:             return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9576:                 "watermark line missing key/value separator".to_string(),
 9577:             ));
 9578:         };
 9579:         match key {
 9580:             "version" => {
 9581:                 version = value.parse::<u8>().ok();
 9582:             }
 9583:             "generated_at_unix" => {
 9584:                 generated_at_unix = value.parse::<u64>().ok();
 9585:             }
 9586:             "nonce" => {
 9587:                 nonce = value.parse::<u64>().ok();
 9588:             }
 9589:             "payload_digest_sha256" => {
 9590:                 payload_digest = Some(decode_auto_tunnel_hex_to_fixed::<32>(value)?);
 9591:             }
 9592:             _ => {
 9593:                 return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9594:                     "unknown watermark key {key}"
 9595:                 )));
 9596:             }
 9597:         }
 9598:     }
 9599:     let generated_at_unix = generated_at_unix.ok_or_else(|| {
 9600:         AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark generated_at_unix".to_string())
 9601:     })?;
 9602:     let nonce = nonce.ok_or_else(|| {
 9603:         AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark nonce".to_string())
 9604:     })?;
 9605:     let version = version.ok_or_else(|| {
 9606:         AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark version".to_string())
 9607:     })?;
 9608:     if version != 2 {
 9609:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9610:             "unsupported watermark version; expected version=2".to_string(),
 9611:         ));
 9612:     }
 9613:     let payload_digest = Some(payload_digest.ok_or_else(|| {
 9614:         AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9615:             "missing watermark payload_digest_sha256".to_string(),
 9616:         )
 9617:     })?);
 9618:     Ok(Some(AutoTunnelWatermark {
 9619:         generated_at_unix,
 9620:         nonce,
 9621:         payload_digest,
 9622:     }))
 9623: }
 9624: 
 9625: fn persist_auto_tunnel_watermark(
 9626:     path: &Path,
 9627:     watermark: AutoTunnelWatermark,
 9628: ) -> Result<(), AutoTunnelBootstrapError> {
 9629:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 9630:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9631:         #[cfg(unix)]
 9632:         {
 9633:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
 9634:             fs::set_permissions(parent, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
 9635:                 .map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9636:         }
 9637:     }
 9638:     let payload_digest = watermark
 9639:         .payload_digest
 9640:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 9641:             AutoTunnelBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9642:                 "watermark payload digest is required".to_string(),
 9643:             )
 9644:         })
 9645:         .map(|digest| encode_hex(&digest))?;
 9646:     let payload = format!(
 9647:         "version=2\ngenerated_at_unix={}\nnonce={}\npayload_digest_sha256={}\n",
 9648:         watermark.generated_at_unix, watermark.nonce, payload_digest
 9649:     );
 9650:     let temp_path = path.with_extension(format!(
 9651:         "tmp.{}.{}",
 9652:         std::process::id(),
 9653:         SystemTime::now()
 9654:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 9655:             .map(|duration| duration.as_nanos())
 9656:             .unwrap_or(0)
 9657:     ));
 9658:     let mut options = fs::OpenOptions::new();
 9659:     options.write(true).create_new(true);
 9660:     #[cfg(unix)]
 9661:     {
 9662:         use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
 9663:         options.mode(0o600);
 9664:     }
 9665:     let mut temp = options
 9666:         .open(&temp_path)
 9667:         .map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9668:     if let Err(err) = temp.write_all(payload.as_bytes()) {
 9669:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9670:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()));
 9671:     }
 9672:     if let Err(err) = temp.sync_all() {
 9673:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9674:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()));
 9675:     }
 9676:     if let Err(err) = fs::rename(&temp_path, path) {
 9677:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9678:         return Err(AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()));
 9679:     }
 9680:     #[cfg(unix)]
 9681:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 9682:         let parent_dir =
 9683:             fs::File::open(parent).map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9684:         parent_dir
 9685:             .sync_all()
 9686:             .map_err(|err| AutoTunnelBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9687:     }
 9688:     Ok(())
 9689: }
 9690: 
 9691: fn load_dns_zone_bundle(
 9692:     context: DnsZoneLoadContext<'_>,
 9693: ) -> Result<DnsZoneBundleEnvelope, DnsZoneBootstrapError> {
 9694:     let DnsZoneLoadContext {
 9695:         path,
 9696:         verifier_key_path,
 9697:         max_age_secs,
 9698:         trust_policy,
 9699:         previous_watermark,
 9700:         expected_zone_name,
 9701:         local_node_id,
 9702:         auto_tunnel,
 9703:     } = context;
 9704:     if !path.exists() {
 9705:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::Missing);
 9706:     }
 9707: 
 9708:     let verifying_key = load_dns_zone_verifying_key(verifier_key_path)?;
 9709:     enforce_text_artifact_size_limit(path, "dns zone bundle", MAX_DNS_ZONE_BUNDLE_BYTES)
 9710:         .map_err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
 9711:     let content =
 9712:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9713:     let bundle = parse_signed_dns_zone_bundle_wire(&content).map_err(map_dns_zone_parse_error)?;
 9714:     verify_dns_zone_bundle(&bundle, &verifying_key).map_err(map_dns_zone_parse_error)?;
 9715:     if bundle.zone_name != expected_zone_name {
 9716:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9717:             "dns zone bundle zone_name mismatch: expected {expected_zone_name}, got {}",
 9718:             bundle.zone_name
 9719:         )));
 9720:     }
 9721:     NodeId::new(bundle.subject_node_id.clone())
 9722:         .map_err(|err| DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(err.to_string()))?;
 9723:     if bundle.subject_node_id != local_node_id {
 9724:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::WrongNode);
 9725:     }
 9726: 
 9727:     let now = unix_now();
 9728:     if bundle.generated_at_unix > now.saturating_add(trust_policy.max_clock_skew_secs) {
 9729:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::FutureDated);
 9730:     }
 9731:     if now > bundle.expires_at_unix || now.saturating_sub(bundle.generated_at_unix) > max_age_secs {
 9732:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::Stale);
 9733:     }
 9734: 
 9735:     let assignment_ip_map = collect_assignment_mesh_ip_map(auto_tunnel)?;
 9736:     for record in &bundle.records {
 9737:         NodeId::new(record.target_node_id.clone())
 9738:             .map_err(|err| DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(err.to_string()))?;
 9739:         let assigned_ip = assignment_ip_map
 9740:             .get(&record.target_node_id)
 9741:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 9742:                 DnsZoneBootstrapError::AssignmentMismatch(format!(
 9743:                     "target node {} is not present in signed assignment state",
 9744:                     record.target_node_id
 9745:                 ))
 9746:             })?;
 9747:         if assigned_ip != &record.expected_ip {
 9748:             return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::AssignmentMismatch(format!(
 9749:                 "target node {} expected ip {} does not match signed assignment {}",
 9750:                 record.target_node_id, record.expected_ip, assigned_ip
 9751:             )));
 9752:         }
 9753:     }
 9754: 
 9755:     let watermark = DnsZoneWatermark {
 9756:         version: 2,
 9757:         generated_at_unix: bundle.generated_at_unix,
 9758:         nonce: bundle.nonce,
 9759:         payload_digest: dns_zone_payload_digest(&bundle),
 9760:     };
 9761:     if let Some(existing) = previous_watermark {
 9762:         match dns_zone_watermark_ordering(&watermark, &existing) {
 9763:             std::cmp::Ordering::Less => return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::ReplayDetected),
 9764:             std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => {
 9765:                 if existing.payload_digest != watermark.payload_digest {
 9766:                     return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::ReplayDetected);
 9767:                 }
 9768:             }
 9769:             std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => {}
 9770:         }
 9771:     }
 9772: 
 9773:     Ok(DnsZoneBundleEnvelope { bundle, watermark })
 9774: }
 9775: 
 9776: fn load_dns_zone_verifying_key(path: &Path) -> Result<VerifyingKey, DnsZoneBootstrapError> {
 9777:     enforce_text_artifact_size_limit(path, "dns zone verifier key", MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES)
 9778:         .map_err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
 9779:     let content =
 9780:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9781:     if content.len() > MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES {
 9782:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9783:             "dns zone verifier key exceeds maximum size of {MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES} bytes"
 9784:         )));
 9785:     }
 9786:     parse_dns_zone_verifying_key(&content).map_err(map_dns_zone_parse_error)
 9787: }
 9788: 
 9789: fn load_dns_zone_watermark(path: &Path) -> Result<Option<DnsZoneWatermark>, DnsZoneBootstrapError> {
 9790:     if !path.exists() {
 9791:         return Ok(None);
 9792:     }
 9793: 
 9794:     let content =
 9795:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9796:     let mut version: Option<u8> = None;
 9797:     let mut generated_at_unix: Option<u64> = None;
 9798:     let mut nonce: Option<u64> = None;
 9799:     let mut payload_digest: Option<[u8; 32]> = None;
 9800:     for line in content.lines() {
 9801:         let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once('=') else {
 9802:             return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9803:                 "watermark line missing key/value separator".to_string(),
 9804:             ));
 9805:         };
 9806:         match key {
 9807:             "version" => version = value.parse::<u8>().ok(),
 9808:             "generated_at_unix" => generated_at_unix = value.parse::<u64>().ok(),
 9809:             "nonce" => nonce = value.parse::<u64>().ok(),
 9810:             "payload_digest_sha256" => {
 9811:                 payload_digest = Some(decode_hex_to_fixed::<32>(value).map_err(|err| {
 9812:                     DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9813:                         "invalid dns zone watermark payload digest: {err}"
 9814:                     ))
 9815:                 })?);
 9816:             }
 9817:             _ => {
 9818:                 return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9819:                     "unknown watermark key {key}"
 9820:                 )));
 9821:             }
 9822:         }
 9823:     }
 9824:     let generated_at_unix = generated_at_unix.ok_or_else(|| {
 9825:         DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark generated_at_unix".to_string())
 9826:     })?;
 9827:     let nonce = nonce.ok_or_else(|| {
 9828:         DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark nonce".to_string())
 9829:     })?;
 9830:     let version = version.ok_or_else(|| {
 9831:         DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark version".to_string())
 9832:     })?;
 9833:     if version != 2 {
 9834:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9835:             "unsupported watermark version; expected version=2".to_string(),
 9836:         ));
 9837:     }
 9838:     let payload_digest = payload_digest.ok_or_else(|| {
 9839:         DnsZoneBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark payload_digest_sha256".to_string())
 9840:     })?;
 9841:     Ok(Some(DnsZoneWatermark {
 9842:         version,
 9843:         generated_at_unix,
 9844:         nonce,
 9845:         payload_digest,
 9846:     }))
 9847: }

 9849: fn persist_dns_zone_watermark(
 9850:     path: &Path,
 9851:     watermark: DnsZoneWatermark,
 9852: ) -> Result<(), DnsZoneBootstrapError> {
 9853:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 9854:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9855:         #[cfg(unix)]
 9856:         {
 9857:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
 9858:             fs::set_permissions(parent, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
 9859:                 .map_err(|err| DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9860:         }
 9861:     }
 9862:     let payload = format!(
 9863:         "version=2\ngenerated_at_unix={}\nnonce={}\npayload_digest_sha256={}\n",
 9864:         watermark.generated_at_unix,
 9865:         watermark.nonce,
 9866:         encode_hex(&watermark.payload_digest)
 9867:     );
 9868:     let temp_path = path.with_extension(format!(
 9869:         "tmp.{}.{}",
 9870:         std::process::id(),
 9871:         SystemTime::now()
 9872:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 9873:             .map(|duration| duration.as_nanos())
 9874:             .unwrap_or(0)
 9875:     ));
 9876:     let mut options = fs::OpenOptions::new();
 9877:     options.write(true).create_new(true);
 9878:     #[cfg(unix)]
 9879:     {
 9880:         use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
 9881:         options.mode(0o600);
 9882:     }
 9883:     let mut temp = options
 9884:         .open(&temp_path)
 9885:         .map_err(|err| DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9886:     if let Err(err) = temp.write_all(payload.as_bytes()) {
 9887:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9888:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()));
 9889:     }
 9890:     if let Err(err) = temp.sync_all() {
 9891:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9892:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()));
 9893:     }
 9894:     if let Err(err) = fs::rename(&temp_path, path) {
 9895:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 9896:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()));
 9897:     }
 9898:     #[cfg(unix)]
 9899:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 9900:         let parent_dir =
 9901:             fs::File::open(parent).map_err(|err| DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9902:         parent_dir
 9903:             .sync_all()
 9904:             .map_err(|err| DnsZoneBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
 9905:     }
 9906:     Ok(())
 9907: }
