 9909: #[cfg(test)]
 9910: fn load_traversal_bundle(
 9911:     path: &Path,
 9912:     verifier_key_path: &Path,
 9913:     max_age_secs: u64,
 9914:     trust_policy: TrustPolicy,
 9915:     previous_watermark: Option<TraversalWatermark>,
 9916: ) -> Result<TraversalBundleEnvelope, TraversalBootstrapError> {
 9917:     let envelope = load_traversal_bundle_set(
 9918:         path,
 9919:         verifier_key_path,
 9920:         max_age_secs,
 9921:         trust_policy,
 9922:         previous_watermark,
 9923:     )?;
 9924:     if envelope.bundles.len() != 1 {
 9925:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9926:             "expected exactly one traversal bundle entry".to_string(),
 9927:         ));
 9928:     }
 9929:     envelope.bundles.into_iter().next().ok_or_else(|| {
 9930:         TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing traversal bundle".to_string())
 9931:     })
 9932: }
 9933: 
 9934: fn load_traversal_bundle_set(
 9935:     path: &Path,
 9936:     verifier_key_path: &Path,
 9937:     max_age_secs: u64,
 9938:     trust_policy: TrustPolicy,
 9939:     previous_watermark: Option<TraversalWatermark>,
 9940: ) -> Result<TraversalBundleSetEnvelope, TraversalBootstrapError> {
 9941:     if !path.exists() {
 9942:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::Missing);
 9943:     }
 9944: 
 9945:     let verifying_key = load_traversal_verifying_key(verifier_key_path)?;
 9946:     let verifier_key_bytes = verifying_key.to_bytes();
 9947:     let content = read_traversal_bundle_content(path)?;
 9948:     let sections = split_traversal_bundle_sections(&content)?;
 9949:     if sections.len() > MAX_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_ENTRY_COUNT {
 9950:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
 9951:             "traversal bundle entry count exceeds maximum of {MAX_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_ENTRY_COUNT}"
 9952:         )));
 9953:     }
 9954: 
 9955:     let mut bundles = Vec::with_capacity(sections.len());
 9956:     let mut coordinations = Vec::new();
 9957:     for section in &sections {
 9958:         match parse_traversal_bundle_section(section, &verifying_key, max_age_secs, trust_policy)? {
 9959:             TraversalSectionEnvelope::Bundle(bundle) => bundles.push(bundle),
 9960:             TraversalSectionEnvelope::Coordination(coordination) => {
 9961:                 coordinations.push(coordination)
 9962:             }
 9963:         }
 9964:     }
 9965:     let Some(first_bundle) = bundles.first() else {
 9966:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9967:             "traversal bundle set contains no endpoint hint entries".to_string(),
 9968:         ));
 9969:     };
 9970:     for bundle in &bundles[1..] {
 9971:         if bundle.bundle.generated_at_unix != first_bundle.bundle.generated_at_unix
 9972:             || bundle.bundle.expires_at_unix != first_bundle.bundle.expires_at_unix
 9973:             || bundle.bundle.nonce != first_bundle.bundle.nonce
 9974:         {
 9975:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9976:                 "traversal bundle entries must share a single generated_at/expires_at/nonce snapshot"
 9977:                     .to_string(),
 9978:             ));
 9979:         }
 9980:     }
 9981: 
 9982:     let mut seen_coordination_pairs = BTreeSet::new();
 9983:     for coordination in &coordinations {
 9984:         let key = traversal_coordination_pair_key(
 9985:             coordination.record.node_a.as_str(),
 9986:             coordination.record.node_b.as_str(),
 9987:         );
 9988:         if !seen_coordination_pairs.insert(key) {
 9989:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
 9990:                 "traversal bundle contains duplicate coordination entries for a node pair"
 9991:                     .to_string(),
 9992:             ));
 9993:         }
 9994:     }
 9995: 
 9996:     let payload_digest = traversal_snapshot_payload_digest(&bundles, &coordinations)?;
 9997:     let watermark = TraversalWatermark {
 9998:         generated_at_unix: first_bundle.bundle.generated_at_unix,
 9999:         nonce: first_bundle.bundle.nonce,
10000:         payload_digest: Some(payload_digest),
10001:     };
10002:     if let Some(existing) = previous_watermark {
10003:         match traversal_watermark_ordering(&watermark, &existing) {
10004:             std::cmp::Ordering::Less => {
10005:                 return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::ReplayDetected);
10006:             }
10007:             std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => {
10008:                 let existing_digest = existing
10009:                     .payload_digest
10010:                     .ok_or(TraversalBootstrapError::ReplayDetected)?;
10011:                 if existing_digest != payload_digest {
10012:                     return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::ReplayDetected);
10013:                 }
10014:             }
10015:             std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => {}
10016:         }
10017:     }
10018: 
10019:     Ok(TraversalBundleSetEnvelope {
10020:         bundles,
10021:         coordinations,
10022:         verifier_key_bytes,
10023:         watermark,
10024:     })
10025: }
10026: 
10027: fn read_traversal_bundle_content(path: &Path) -> Result<String, TraversalBootstrapError> {
10028:     enforce_text_artifact_size_limit(path, "traversal bundle", MAX_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_BYTES)
10029:         .map_err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
10030:     let content =
10031:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
10032:     if content.len() > MAX_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_BYTES {
10033:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10034:             "traversal bundle exceeds maximum size of {MAX_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_BYTES} bytes"
10035:         )));
10036:     }
10037:     Ok(content)
10038: }
10039: 
10040: fn split_traversal_bundle_sections(content: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, TraversalBootstrapError> {
10041:     let mut sections = Vec::new();
10042:     let mut current = Vec::new();
10043:     let mut saw_signature = false;
10044:     let mut total_lines = 0usize;
10045: 
10046:     for line in content.lines() {
10047:         total_lines = total_lines.saturating_add(1);
10048:         if total_lines > MAX_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_LINES {
10049:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10050:                 "traversal bundle exceeds maximum line count of {MAX_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_LINES}"
10051:             )));
10052:         }
10053:         if line.trim().is_empty() {
10054:             if current.is_empty() {
10055:                 continue;
10056:             }
10057:             if !saw_signature {
10058:                 return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10059:                     "blank line before traversal bundle signature".to_string(),
10060:                 ));
10061:             }
10062:             sections.push(current.join("\n"));
10063:             current.clear();
10064:             saw_signature = false;
10065:             continue;
10066:         }
10067:         if saw_signature {
10068:             sections.push(current.join("\n"));
10069:             current.clear();
10070:             saw_signature = false;
10071:         }
10072:         current.push(line.to_string());
10073:         if line.starts_with("signature=") {
10074:             saw_signature = true;
10075:         }
10076:     }
10077:     if !current.is_empty() {
10078:         sections.push(current.join("\n"));
10079:     }
10080:     if sections.is_empty() {
10081:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10082:             "traversal bundle is empty".to_string(),
10083:         ));
10084:     }
10085:     Ok(sections)
10086: }
10087: 
10088: fn parse_traversal_bundle_section(
10089:     content: &str,
10090:     verifying_key: &VerifyingKey,
10091:     max_age_secs: u64,
10092:     trust_policy: TrustPolicy,
10093: ) -> Result<TraversalSectionEnvelope, TraversalBootstrapError> {
10094:     let mut payload = String::new();
10095:     let mut signature_hex: Option<String> = None;
10096:     let mut fields = std::collections::HashMap::new();
10097:     let mut line_count = 0usize;
10098: 
10099:     for line in content.lines() {
10100:         line_count = line_count.saturating_add(1);
10101:         if line_count > MAX_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_LINES {
10102:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10103:                 "traversal bundle exceeds maximum line count of {MAX_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_LINES}"
10104:             )));
10105:         }
10106:         let (key, value) = parse_limited_key_value_line(
10107:             line,
10108:             line_count,
10109:             MAX_TRAVERSAL_LINE_BYTES,
10110:             MAX_TRAVERSAL_KEY_BYTES,
10111:             MAX_TRAVERSAL_VALUE_BYTES,
10112:             MAX_TRAVERSAL_KEY_DEPTH,
10113:         )
10114:         .map_err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
10115:         if !is_allowed_traversal_key(key) {
10116:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10117:                 "unknown key {key}"
10118:             )));
10119:         }
10120:         if key == "signature" {
10121:             if signature_hex.is_some() {
10122:                 return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10123:                     "duplicate key signature".to_string(),
10124:                 ));
10125:             }
10126:             signature_hex = Some(value.to_string());
10127:             continue;
10128:         }
10129:         payload.push_str(line);
10130:         payload.push('\n');
10131:         if fields.insert(key.to_string(), value.to_string()).is_some() {
10132:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10133:                 "duplicate key {key}"
10134:             )));
10135:         }
10136:     }
10137:     if fields.len() > MAX_TRAVERSAL_FIELD_COUNT {
10138:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10139:             "traversal bundle exceeds maximum field count of {MAX_TRAVERSAL_FIELD_COUNT}"
10140:         )));
10141:     }
10142: 
10143:     let version = fields
10144:         .get("version")
10145:         .ok_or_else(|| TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing version".to_string()))?;
10146:     if version != "1" {
10147:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10148:             "unsupported traversal version".to_string(),
10149:         ));
10150:     }
10151:     if fields.get("type").map(String::as_str) == Some("traversal_coordination") {
10152:         return parse_traversal_coordination_section(
10153:             &payload,
10154:             &fields,
10155:             signature_hex,
10156:             verifying_key,
10157:         );
10158:     }
10159:     if fields.get("path_policy").map(String::as_str) != Some("direct_preferred_relay_allowed") {
10160:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10161:             "unsupported traversal path_policy".to_string(),
10162:         ));
10163:     }
10164: 
10165:     let source_node_id = fields
10166:         .get("source_node_id")
10167:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10168:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing source_node_id".to_string())
10169:         })?
10170:         .to_string();
10171:     NodeId::new(source_node_id.clone())
10172:         .map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(err.to_string()))?;
10173:     let target_node_id = fields
10174:         .get("target_node_id")
10175:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10176:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing target_node_id".to_string())
10177:         })?
10178:         .to_string();
10179:     NodeId::new(target_node_id.clone())
10180:         .map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(err.to_string()))?;
10181: 
10182:     let generated_at_unix = fields
10183:         .get("generated_at_unix")
10184:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10185:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing generated_at_unix".to_string())
10186:         })?
10187:         .parse::<u64>()
10188:         .map_err(|_| {
10189:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid generated_at_unix".to_string())
10190:         })?;
10191:     let expires_at_unix = fields
10192:         .get("expires_at_unix")
10193:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10194:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing expires_at_unix".to_string())
10195:         })?
10196:         .parse::<u64>()
10197:         .map_err(|_| {
10198:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid expires_at_unix".to_string())
10199:         })?;
10200:     if generated_at_unix >= expires_at_unix {
10201:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10202:             "invalid generated/expires ordering".to_string(),
10203:         ));
10204:     }
10205:     let nonce = fields
10206:         .get("nonce")
10207:         .ok_or_else(|| TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing nonce".to_string()))?
10208:         .parse::<u64>()
10209:         .map_err(|_| TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid nonce".to_string()))?;
10210: 
10211:     let signature_hex = signature_hex.ok_or_else(|| {
10212:         TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing traversal signature".to_string())
10213:     })?;
10214:     let signature_bytes = decode_traversal_hex_to_fixed::<64>(&signature_hex)?;
10215:     let signature = Signature::from_bytes(&signature_bytes);
10216:     verifying_key
10217:         .verify(payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
10218:         .map_err(|_| TraversalBootstrapError::SignatureInvalid)?;
10219: 
10220:     let now = unix_now();
10221:     if generated_at_unix > now.saturating_add(trust_policy.max_clock_skew_secs) {
10222:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::FutureDated);
10223:     }
10224:     if now > expires_at_unix || now.saturating_sub(generated_at_unix) > max_age_secs {
10225:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::Stale);
10226:     }
10227: 
10228:     let candidate_count = fields
10229:         .get("candidate_count")
10230:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10231:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing candidate_count".to_string())
10232:         })?
10233:         .parse::<usize>()
10234:         .map_err(|_| {
10235:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid candidate_count".to_string())
10236:         })?;
10237:     if candidate_count == 0 || candidate_count > MAX_TRAVERSAL_CANDIDATE_COUNT {
10238:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10239:             "candidate_count must be between 1 and {MAX_TRAVERSAL_CANDIDATE_COUNT}"
10240:         )));
10241:     }
10242:     let expected_field_count = 8usize
10243:         .checked_add(candidate_count.checked_mul(6).ok_or_else(|| {
10244:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("candidate field count overflow".to_string())
10245:         })?)
10246:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10247:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("candidate field count overflow".to_string())
10248:         })?;
10249:     if fields.len() != expected_field_count {
10250:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10251:             "unexpected field count for traversal bundle: expected {expected_field_count}, got {}",
10252:             fields.len()
10253:         )));
10254:     }
10255: 
10256:     let mut candidates = Vec::with_capacity(candidate_count);
10257:     let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
10258:     for index in 0..candidate_count {
10259:         let candidate_type_key = format!("candidate.{index}.type");
10260:         let addr_key = format!("candidate.{index}.addr");
10261:         let port_key = format!("candidate.{index}.port");
10262:         let family_key = format!("candidate.{index}.family");
10263:         let relay_id_key = format!("candidate.{index}.relay_id");
10264:         let priority_key = format!("candidate.{index}.priority");
10265: 
10266:         let candidate_type = match fields.get(&candidate_type_key).map(String::as_str) {
10267:             Some("host") => TraversalCandidateType::Host,
10268:             Some("srflx") => TraversalCandidateType::ServerReflexive,
10269:             Some("relay") => TraversalCandidateType::Relay,
10270:             _ => {
10271:                 return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10272:                     "invalid candidate type for index {index}"
10273:                 )));
10274:             }
10275:         };
10276: 
10277:         let ip = fields
10278:             .get(&addr_key)
10279:             .ok_or_else(|| TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {addr_key}")))?
10280:             .parse::<std::net::IpAddr>()
10281:             .map_err(|_| {
10282:                 TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10283:                     "invalid candidate addr for index {index}"
10284:                 ))
10285:             })?;
10286:         validate_traversal_candidate_ip(candidate_type, ip, index)?;
10287:         let family = fields.get(&family_key).ok_or_else(|| {
10288:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {family_key}"))
10289:         })?;
10290:         if (ip.is_ipv4() && family != "ipv4") || (ip.is_ipv6() && family != "ipv6") {
10291:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10292:                 "candidate family mismatch for index {index}"
10293:             )));
10294:         }
10295:         let port = fields
10296:             .get(&port_key)
10297:             .ok_or_else(|| TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {port_key}")))?
10298:             .parse::<u16>()
10299:             .map_err(|_| {
10300:                 TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10301:                     "invalid candidate port for index {index}"
10302:                 ))
10303:             })?;
10304:         if port == 0 {
10305:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10306:                 "candidate port must be non-zero for index {index}"
10307:             )));
10308:         }
10309: 
10310:         let relay_id_raw = fields.get(&relay_id_key).ok_or_else(|| {
10311:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {relay_id_key}"))
10312:         })?;
10313:         let relay_id = if relay_id_raw.trim().is_empty() {
10314:             None
10315:         } else {
10316:             Some(relay_id_raw.trim().to_string())
10317:         };
10318:         if matches!(candidate_type, TraversalCandidateType::Relay) && relay_id.is_none() {
10319:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10320:                 "relay candidate missing relay_id for index {index}"
10321:             )));
10322:         }
10323:         if !matches!(candidate_type, TraversalCandidateType::Relay) && relay_id.is_some() {
10324:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10325:                 "relay_id is only allowed for relay candidates (index {index})"
10326:             )));
10327:         }
10328: 
10329:         let priority = fields
10330:             .get(&priority_key)
10331:             .ok_or_else(|| {
10332:                 TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!("missing {priority_key}"))
10333:             })?
10334:             .parse::<u32>()
10335:             .map_err(|_| {
10336:                 TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10337:                     "invalid candidate priority for index {index}"
10338:                 ))
10339:             })?;
10340:         let dedupe = format!(
10341:             "{}|{}|{}|{}",
10342:             candidate_type.as_str(),
10343:             ip,
10344:             port,
10345:             relay_id.as_deref().unwrap_or("")
10346:         );
10347:         if !seen.insert(dedupe) {
10348:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10349:                 "duplicate traversal candidate tuple".to_string(),
10350:             ));
10351:         }
10352: 
10353:         candidates.push(TraversalCandidate {
10354:             candidate_type,
10355:             endpoint: std::net::SocketAddr::new(ip, port),
10356:             relay_id,
10357:             priority,
10358:         });
10359:     }
10360: 
10361:     let payload_digest = sha256_digest(payload.as_bytes());
10362:     let watermark = TraversalWatermark {
10363:         generated_at_unix,
10364:         nonce,
10365:         payload_digest: Some(payload_digest),
10366:     };
10367:     Ok(TraversalSectionEnvelope::Bundle(TraversalBundleEnvelope {
10368:         bundle: TraversalBundle {
10369:             source_node_id,
10370:             target_node_id,
10371:             generated_at_unix,
10372:             expires_at_unix,
10373:             nonce,
10374:             candidates,
10375:         },
10376:         watermark,
10377:     }))
10378: }
10379: 
10380: fn parse_traversal_coordination_section(
10381:     payload: &str,
10382:     fields: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
10383:     signature_hex: Option<String>,
10384:     verifying_key: &VerifyingKey,
10385: ) -> Result<TraversalSectionEnvelope, TraversalBootstrapError> {
10386:     let expected_field_count = 9usize;
10387:     if fields.len() != expected_field_count {
10388:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10389:             "unexpected field count for traversal coordination: expected {expected_field_count}, got {}",
10390:             fields.len()
10391:         )));
10392:     }
10393: 
10394:     let session_id = decode_traversal_hex_to_fixed::<16>(
10395:         fields
10396:             .get("session_id")
10397:             .ok_or_else(|| {
10398:                 TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10399:                     "missing coordination session_id".to_string(),
10400:                 )
10401:             })?
10402:             .as_str(),
10403:     )
10404:     .map_err(|_| {
10405:         TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid coordination session_id".to_string())
10406:     })?;
10407:     if session_id.iter().all(|value| *value == 0) {
10408:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10409:             "coordination session_id must not be all zeros".to_string(),
10410:         ));
10411:     }
10412:     let probe_start_unix = fields
10413:         .get("probe_start_unix")
10414:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10415:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10416:                 "missing coordination probe_start_unix".to_string(),
10417:             )
10418:         })?
10419:         .parse::<u64>()
10420:         .map_err(|_| {
10421:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10422:                 "invalid coordination probe_start_unix".to_string(),
10423:             )
10424:         })?;
10425:     let node_a = fields
10426:         .get("node_a")
10427:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10428:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing coordination node_a".to_string())
10429:         })?
10430:         .trim()
10431:         .to_string();
10432:     let node_b = fields
10433:         .get("node_b")
10434:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10435:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing coordination node_b".to_string())
10436:         })?
10437:         .trim()
10438:         .to_string();
10439:     NodeId::new(node_a.clone())
10440:         .map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(err.to_string()))?;
10441:     NodeId::new(node_b.clone())
10442:         .map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(err.to_string()))?;
10443:     let issued_at_unix = fields
10444:         .get("issued_at_unix")
10445:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10446:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10447:                 "missing coordination issued_at_unix".to_string(),
10448:             )
10449:         })?
10450:         .parse::<u64>()
10451:         .map_err(|_| {
10452:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10453:                 "invalid coordination issued_at_unix".to_string(),
10454:             )
10455:         })?;
10456:     let expires_at_unix = fields
10457:         .get("expires_at_unix")
10458:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10459:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10460:                 "missing coordination expires_at_unix".to_string(),
10461:             )
10462:         })?
10463:         .parse::<u64>()
10464:         .map_err(|_| {
10465:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10466:                 "invalid coordination expires_at_unix".to_string(),
10467:             )
10468:         })?;
10469:     let nonce = decode_traversal_hex_to_fixed::<16>(
10470:         fields
10471:             .get("nonce")
10472:             .ok_or_else(|| {
10473:                 TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing coordination nonce".to_string())
10474:             })?
10475:             .as_str(),
10476:     )
10477:     .map_err(|_| {
10478:         TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("invalid coordination nonce".to_string())
10479:     })?;
10480:     if nonce.iter().all(|value| *value == 0) {
10481:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10482:             "coordination nonce must not be all zeros".to_string(),
10483:         ));
10484:     }
10485: 
10486:     let signature_hex = signature_hex.ok_or_else(|| {
10487:         TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing traversal signature".to_string())
10488:     })?;
10489:     let signature_bytes = decode_traversal_hex_to_fixed::<64>(&signature_hex)?;
10490:     let signature = Signature::from_bytes(&signature_bytes);
10491:     verifying_key
10492:         .verify(payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
10493:         .map_err(|_| TraversalBootstrapError::SignatureInvalid)?;
10494: 
10495:     Ok(TraversalSectionEnvelope::Coordination(
10496:         TraversalCoordinationEnvelope {
10497:             record: SignedTraversalCoordinationRecord {
10498:                 payload: payload.to_string(),
10499:                 signature_hex,
10500:                 session_id,
10501:                 probe_start_unix,
10502:                 node_a,
10503:                 node_b,
10504:                 issued_at_unix,
10505:                 expires_at_unix,
10506:                 nonce,
10507:             },
10508:             payload_digest: sha256_digest(payload.as_bytes()),
10509:         },
10510:     ))
10511: }
10512: 
10513: fn traversal_snapshot_payload_digest(
10514:     bundles: &[TraversalBundleEnvelope],
10515:     coordinations: &[TraversalCoordinationEnvelope],
10516: ) -> Result<[u8; 32], TraversalBootstrapError> {
10517:     if coordinations.is_empty() && bundles.len() == 1 {
10518:         return bundles[0]
10519:             .watermark
10520:             .payload_digest
10521:             .ok_or(TraversalBootstrapError::ReplayDetected);
10522:     }
10523: 
10524:     let mut ordered_digests = bundles
10525:         .iter()
10526:         .map(|bundle| {
10527:             let digest = bundle
10528:                 .watermark
10529:                 .payload_digest
10530:                 .ok_or(TraversalBootstrapError::ReplayDetected)?;
10531:             Ok((
10532:                 bundle.bundle.source_node_id.clone(),
10533:                 bundle.bundle.target_node_id.clone(),
10534:                 digest,
10535:             ))
10536:         })
10537:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, TraversalBootstrapError>>()?;
10538:     ordered_digests.sort_by(|left, right| left.0.cmp(&right.0).then(left.1.cmp(&right.1)));
10539: 
10540:     let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
10541:     for (_source_node_id, _target_node_id, digest) in ordered_digests {
10542:         hasher.update(digest);
10543:     }
10544:     if !coordinations.is_empty() {
10545:         let mut ordered_coordination_digests = coordinations
10546:             .iter()
10547:             .map(|coordination| {
10548:                 Ok((
10549:                     traversal_coordination_pair_key(
10550:                         coordination.record.node_a.as_str(),
10551:                         coordination.record.node_b.as_str(),
10552:                     ),
10553:                     coordination.record.probe_start_unix,
10554:                     coordination.payload_digest,
10555:                 ))
10556:             })
10557:             .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, TraversalBootstrapError>>()?;
10558:         ordered_coordination_digests.sort_by(|left, right| {
10559:             left.0
10560:                 .cmp(&right.0)
10561:                 .then(left.1.cmp(&right.1))
10562:                 .then(left.2.cmp(&right.2))
10563:         });
10564:         for ((node_a, node_b), probe_start_unix, digest) in ordered_coordination_digests {
10565:             hasher.update(b"coordination");
10566:             hasher.update(node_a.as_bytes());
10567:             hasher.update(node_b.as_bytes());
10568:             hasher.update(probe_start_unix.to_be_bytes());
10569:             hasher.update(digest);
10570:         }
10571:     }
10572:     Ok(hasher.finalize().into())
10573: }
10574: 
10575: fn validate_traversal_candidate_ip(
10576:     candidate_type: TraversalCandidateType,
10577:     ip: std::net::IpAddr,
10578:     index: usize,
10579: ) -> Result<(), TraversalBootstrapError> {
10580:     if ip.is_unspecified() || ip.is_loopback() || ip.is_multicast() {
10581:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10582:             "candidate index {index} uses disallowed special address"
10583:         )));
10584:     }
10585:     match ip {
10586:         std::net::IpAddr::V4(v4) => {
10587:             if v4.is_link_local() || v4.is_broadcast() {
10588:                 return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10589:                     "candidate index {index} uses disallowed special address"
10590:                 )));
10591:             }
10592:             if matches!(candidate_type, TraversalCandidateType::Relay)
10593:                 && (v4.is_private() || is_shared_carrier_grade_nat_ipv4(v4))
10594:             {
10595:                 return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10596:                     "relay candidate index {index} must not use private transport address"
10597:                 )));
10598:             }
10599:             if matches!(candidate_type, TraversalCandidateType::ServerReflexive)
10600:                 && !is_global_unicast_ipv4(v4)
10601:             {
10602:                 return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10603:                     "srflx candidate index {index} must use global unicast address"
10604:                 )));
10605:             }
10606:         }
10607:         std::net::IpAddr::V6(v6) => {
10608:             if v6.is_unicast_link_local() || v6.is_unique_local() {
10609:                 return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10610:                     "candidate index {index} uses disallowed special address"
10611:                 )));
10612:             }
10613:             if matches!(candidate_type, TraversalCandidateType::ServerReflexive)
10614:                 && !is_global_unicast_ipv6(v6)
10615:             {
10616:                 return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10617:                     "srflx candidate index {index} must use global unicast address"
10618:                 )));
10619:             }
10620:         }
10621:     }
10622:     Ok(())
10623: }
10624: 
10625: fn select_runtime_traversal_endpoints(
10626:     candidates: &[TraversalCandidate],
10627: ) -> (Option<SocketEndpoint>, Option<SocketEndpoint>) {
10628:     let direct = candidates
10629:         .iter()
10630:         .filter(|candidate| !matches!(candidate.candidate_type, TraversalCandidateType::Relay))
10631:         .max_by_key(|candidate| candidate.priority)
10632:         .map(|candidate| SocketEndpoint {
10633:             addr: candidate.endpoint.ip(),
10634:             port: candidate.endpoint.port(),
10635:         });
10636:     let relay = candidates
10637:         .iter()
10638:         .filter(|candidate| matches!(candidate.candidate_type, TraversalCandidateType::Relay))
10639:         .max_by_key(|candidate| candidate.priority)
10640:         .map(|candidate| SocketEndpoint {
10641:             addr: candidate.endpoint.ip(),
10642:             port: candidate.endpoint.port(),
10643:         });
10644:     (direct, relay)
10645: }
10646: 
10647: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
10648: struct RuntimeRelayCandidate {
10649:     endpoint: SocketAddr,
10650:     relay_id: [u8; 16],
10651: }
10652: 
10653: fn relay_transport_id_from_label(label: &str) -> Result<[u8; 16], String> {
10654:     let trimmed = label.trim();
10655:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
10656:         return Err("relay candidate relay_id must not be empty".to_string());
10657:     }
10658:     if !trimmed.is_ascii() {
10659:         return Err("relay candidate relay_id must be ASCII".to_string());
10660:     }
10661:     if trimmed.len() > 16 {
10662:         return Err("relay candidate relay_id must be at most 16 ASCII bytes".to_string());
10663:     }
10664:     let mut relay_id = [0u8; 16];
10665:     relay_id[..trimmed.len()].copy_from_slice(trimmed.as_bytes());
10666:     Ok(relay_id)
10667: }
10668: 
10669: fn select_runtime_relay_candidate(
10670:     candidates: &[TraversalCandidate],
10671: ) -> Result<Option<RuntimeRelayCandidate>, String> {
10672:     let Some(candidate) = candidates
10673:         .iter()
10674:         .filter(|candidate| matches!(candidate.candidate_type, TraversalCandidateType::Relay))
10675:         .max_by_key(|candidate| candidate.priority)
10676:     else {
10677:         return Ok(None);
10678:     };
10679:     let relay_id_label = candidate
10680:         .relay_id
10681:         .as_deref()
10682:         .ok_or_else(|| "relay candidate missing relay_id".to_string())?;
10683:     if let std::net::IpAddr::V4(v4) = candidate.endpoint.ip()
10684:         && (v4.is_private() || is_shared_carrier_grade_nat_ipv4(v4))
10685:     {
10686:         return Err("relay candidate must not use private transport address".to_string());
10687:     }
10688:     Ok(Some(RuntimeRelayCandidate {
10689:         endpoint: candidate.endpoint,
10690:         relay_id: relay_transport_id_from_label(relay_id_label)?,
10691:     }))
10692: }
10693: 
10694: fn traversal_direct_probe_candidates(
10695:     candidates: &[TraversalCandidate],
10696:     observed_at_unix: u64,
10697: ) -> Vec<ProbeTraversalCandidate> {
10698:     candidates
10699:         .iter()
10700:         .filter_map(|candidate| {
10701:             let source = match candidate.candidate_type {
10702:                 TraversalCandidateType::Host => ProbeCandidateSource::Host,
10703:                 TraversalCandidateType::ServerReflexive => ProbeCandidateSource::ServerReflexive,
10704:                 TraversalCandidateType::Relay => return None,
10705:             };
10706:             Some(ProbeTraversalCandidate {
10707:                 endpoint: SocketEndpoint {
10708:                     addr: candidate.endpoint.ip(),
10709:                     port: candidate.endpoint.port(),
10710:                 },
10711:                 source,
10712:                 priority: candidate.priority,
10713:                 observed_at_unix,
10714:             })
10715:         })
10716:         .collect()
10717: }
10718: 
10719: fn host_ip_from_host_cidr_daemon(value: &str) -> Option<String> {
10720:     let (ip, prefix) = value.split_once('/')?;
10721:     if prefix != "32" && prefix != "128" {
10722:         return None;
10723:     }
10724:     Some(ip.to_string())
10725: }
10726: 
10727: fn collect_assignment_mesh_ip_map(
10728:     auto_tunnel: &AutoTunnelBundle,
10729: ) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>, DnsZoneBootstrapError> {
10730:     if !cidr_contains(&auto_tunnel.mesh_cidr, &auto_tunnel.assigned_cidr)
10731:         || !is_host_cidr(&auto_tunnel.assigned_cidr)
10732:     {
10733:         return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::AssignmentMismatch(
10734:             "local assigned_cidr must be a host cidr inside mesh_cidr".to_string(),
10735:         ));
10736:     }
10737:     let mut ip_map = BTreeMap::new();
10738:     let mut seen_ips = BTreeSet::new();
10739:     let local_ip = host_ip_from_host_cidr_daemon(&auto_tunnel.assigned_cidr).ok_or_else(|| {
10740:         DnsZoneBootstrapError::AssignmentMismatch(
10741:             "local assigned_cidr must be a host cidr".to_string(),
10742:         )
10743:     })?;
10744:     seen_ips.insert(local_ip.clone());
10745:     ip_map.insert(auto_tunnel.node_id.clone(), local_ip);
10746: 
10747:     for peer in &auto_tunnel.peers {
10748:         let mut mesh_host_ips = peer
10749:             .allowed_ips
10750:             .iter()
10751:             .filter(|cidr| cidr_contains(&auto_tunnel.mesh_cidr, cidr) && is_host_cidr(cidr))
10752:             .filter_map(|cidr| host_ip_from_host_cidr_daemon(cidr))
10753:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
10754:         mesh_host_ips.sort();
10755:         mesh_host_ips.dedup();
10756:         if mesh_host_ips.len() != 1 {
10757:             return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::AssignmentMismatch(format!(
10758:                 "peer {} must expose exactly one mesh host cidr in allowed_ips",
10759:                 peer.node_id
10760:             )));
10761:         }
10762:         let mesh_ip = mesh_host_ips
10763:             .pop()
10764:             .expect("exactly one deduped mesh host ip should remain");
10765:         if !seen_ips.insert(mesh_ip.clone()) {
10766:             return Err(DnsZoneBootstrapError::AssignmentMismatch(format!(
10767:                 "duplicate mesh ip {mesh_ip} in signed assignment state",
10768:             )));
10769:         }
10770:         ip_map.insert(peer.node_id.to_string(), mesh_ip);
10771:     }
10772: 
10773:     Ok(ip_map)
10774: }
10775: 
10776: fn is_global_unicast_ipv4(value: std::net::Ipv4Addr) -> bool {
10777:     if value.is_private()
10778:         || value.is_loopback()
10779:         || value.is_link_local()
10780:         || value.is_multicast()
10781:         || value.is_broadcast()
10782:         || value.is_unspecified()
10783:         || value.is_documentation()
10784:     {
10785:         return false;
10786:     }
10787:     let octets = value.octets();
10788:     // Shared Address Space (100.64.0.0/10) and benchmarking space (198.18.0.0/15).
10789:     if octets[0] == 100 && (octets[1] & 0b1100_0000) == 0b0100_0000 {
10790:         return false;
10791:     }
10792:     if octets[0] == 198 && (octets[1] == 18 || octets[1] == 19) {
10793:         return false;
10794:     }
10795:     true
10796: }
10797: 
10798: fn is_shared_carrier_grade_nat_ipv4(value: std::net::Ipv4Addr) -> bool {
10799:     let octets = value.octets();
10800:     octets[0] == 100 && (octets[1] & 0b1100_0000) == 0b0100_0000
10801: }
10802: 
10803: fn is_global_unicast_ipv6(value: std::net::Ipv6Addr) -> bool {
10804:     if value.is_unspecified()
10805:         || value.is_loopback()
10806:         || value.is_multicast()
10807:         || value.is_unicast_link_local()
10808:         || value.is_unique_local()
10809:     {
10810:         return false;
10811:     }
10812:     // Documentation range 2001:db8::/32.
10813:     let segments = value.segments();
10814:     if segments[0] == 0x2001 && segments[1] == 0x0db8 {
10815:         return false;
10816:     }
10817:     true
10818: }

10820: fn load_traversal_verifying_key(path: &Path) -> Result<VerifyingKey, TraversalBootstrapError> {
10821:     enforce_text_artifact_size_limit(
10822:         path,
10823:         "traversal verifier key",
10824:         MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES,
10825:     )
10826:     .map_err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat)?;
10827:     let content =
10828:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
10829:     if content.len() > MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES {
10830:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10831:             "traversal verifier key exceeds maximum size of {MAX_BUNDLE_VERIFIER_KEY_BYTES} bytes"
10832:         )));
10833:     }
10834:     let key_line = content
10835:         .lines()
10836:         .map(str::trim)
10837:         .find(|line| !line.is_empty() && !line.starts_with('#'))
10838:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10839:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing verifier key".to_string())
10840:         })?;
10841:     let key_bytes = decode_traversal_hex_to_fixed::<32>(key_line)?;
10842:     VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&key_bytes).map_err(|_| TraversalBootstrapError::KeyInvalid)
10843: }
10844: 
10845: fn decode_traversal_hex_to_fixed<const N: usize>(
10846:     encoded: &str,
10847: ) -> Result<[u8; N], TraversalBootstrapError> {
10848:     let mut bytes = [0u8; N];
10849:     let trimmed = encoded.trim();
10850:     if trimmed.len() != N * 2 {
10851:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10852:             "unexpected hex length".to_string(),
10853:         ));
10854:     }
10855:     let raw = trimmed.as_bytes();
10856:     let mut index = 0usize;
10857:     while index < N {
10858:         let hi = decode_traversal_hex_nibble(raw[index * 2])?;
10859:         let lo = decode_traversal_hex_nibble(raw[index * 2 + 1])?;
10860:         bytes[index] = (hi << 4) | lo;
10861:         index += 1;
10862:     }
10863:     Ok(bytes)
10864: }
10865: 
10866: fn decode_traversal_hex_nibble(value: u8) -> Result<u8, TraversalBootstrapError> {
10867:     match value {
10868:         b'0'..=b'9' => Ok(value - b'0'),
10869:         b'a'..=b'f' => Ok(value - b'a' + 10),
10870:         b'A'..=b'F' => Ok(value - b'A' + 10),
10871:         _ => Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10872:             "invalid hex character".to_string(),
10873:         )),
10874:     }
10875: }
10876: 
10877: fn traversal_watermark_ordering(
10878:     current: &TraversalWatermark,
10879:     previous: &TraversalWatermark,
10880: ) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
10881:     current
10882:         .generated_at_unix
10883:         .cmp(&previous.generated_at_unix)
10884:         .then(current.nonce.cmp(&previous.nonce))
10885: }
10886: 
10887: fn load_traversal_watermark(
10888:     path: &Path,
10889: ) -> Result<Option<TraversalWatermark>, TraversalBootstrapError> {
10890:     if !path.exists() {
10891:         return Ok(None);
10892:     }
10893:     let content =
10894:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
10895:     let mut version: Option<u8> = None;
10896:     let mut generated_at_unix: Option<u64> = None;
10897:     let mut nonce: Option<u64> = None;
10898:     let mut payload_digest: Option<[u8; 32]> = None;
10899:     for line in content.lines() {
10900:         let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once('=') else {
10901:             return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10902:                 "watermark line missing key/value separator".to_string(),
10903:             ));
10904:         };
10905:         match key {
10906:             "version" => version = value.parse::<u8>().ok(),
10907:             "generated_at_unix" => generated_at_unix = value.parse::<u64>().ok(),
10908:             "nonce" => nonce = value.parse::<u64>().ok(),
10909:             "payload_digest_sha256" => {
10910:                 payload_digest = Some(decode_traversal_hex_to_fixed::<32>(value)?);
10911:             }
10912:             _ => {
10913:                 return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(format!(
10914:                     "unknown watermark key {key}"
10915:                 )));
10916:             }
10917:         }
10918:     }
10919:     let generated_at_unix = generated_at_unix.ok_or_else(|| {
10920:         TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark generated_at_unix".to_string())
10921:     })?;
10922:     let nonce = nonce.ok_or_else(|| {
10923:         TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark nonce".to_string())
10924:     })?;
10925:     let version = version.ok_or_else(|| {
10926:         TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat("missing watermark version".to_string())
10927:     })?;
10928:     if version != 2 {
10929:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10930:             "unsupported watermark version; expected version=2".to_string(),
10931:         ));
10932:     }
10933:     let payload_digest = Some(payload_digest.ok_or_else(|| {
10934:         TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10935:             "missing watermark payload_digest_sha256".to_string(),
10936:         )
10937:     })?);
10938:     Ok(Some(TraversalWatermark {
10939:         generated_at_unix,
10940:         nonce,
10941:         payload_digest,
10942:     }))
10943: }
10944: 
10945: fn persist_traversal_watermark(
10946:     path: &Path,
10947:     watermark: TraversalWatermark,
10948: ) -> Result<(), TraversalBootstrapError> {
10949:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
10950:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
10951:         #[cfg(unix)]
10952:         {
10953:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
10954:             fs::set_permissions(parent, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
10955:                 .map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
10956:         }
10957:     }
10958:     let payload_digest = watermark
10959:         .payload_digest
10960:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10961:             TraversalBootstrapError::InvalidFormat(
10962:                 "watermark payload digest is required".to_string(),
10963:             )
10964:         })
10965:         .map(|digest| encode_hex(&digest))?;
10966:     let payload = format!(
10967:         "version=2\ngenerated_at_unix={}\nnonce={}\npayload_digest_sha256={}\n",
10968:         watermark.generated_at_unix, watermark.nonce, payload_digest
10969:     );
10970:     let temp_path = path.with_extension(format!(
10971:         "tmp.{}.{}",
10972:         std::process::id(),
10973:         SystemTime::now()
10974:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
10975:             .map(|duration| duration.as_nanos())
10976:             .unwrap_or(0)
10977:     ));
10978:     let mut options = fs::OpenOptions::new();
10979:     options.write(true).create_new(true);
10980:     #[cfg(unix)]
10981:     {
10982:         use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
10983:         options.mode(0o600);
10984:     }
10985:     let mut temp = options
10986:         .open(&temp_path)
10987:         .map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
10988:     if let Err(err) = temp.write_all(payload.as_bytes()) {
10989:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
10990:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()));
10991:     }
10992:     if let Err(err) = temp.sync_all() {
10993:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
10994:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()));
10995:     }
10996:     if let Err(err) = fs::rename(&temp_path, path) {
10997:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
10998:         return Err(TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()));
10999:     }
11000:     #[cfg(unix)]
11001:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
11002:         let parent_dir =
11003:             fs::File::open(parent).map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
11004:         parent_dir
11005:             .sync_all()
11006:             .map_err(|err| TraversalBootstrapError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
11007:     }
11008:     Ok(())
11009: }
11010: 
11011: fn is_valid_ipv4_or_ipv6_cidr(value: &str) -> bool {
11012:     parse_cidr(value).is_some()
11013: }
11014: 
11015: fn is_host_cidr(value: &str) -> bool {
11016:     match parse_cidr(value) {
11017:         Some((std::net::IpAddr::V4(_), prefix)) => prefix == 32,
11018:         Some((std::net::IpAddr::V6(_), prefix)) => prefix == 128,
11019:         None => false,
11020:     }
11021: }
11022: 
11023: fn cidr_contains(container: &str, candidate: &str) -> bool {
11024:     let Some((container_ip, container_prefix)) = parse_cidr(container) else {
11025:         return false;
11026:     };
11027:     let Some((candidate_ip, candidate_prefix)) = parse_cidr(candidate) else {
11028:         return false;
11029:     };
11030:     if candidate_prefix < container_prefix {
11031:         return false;
11032:     }
11033:     match (container_ip, candidate_ip) {
11034:         (std::net::IpAddr::V4(container_v4), std::net::IpAddr::V4(candidate_v4)) => {
11035:             let mask = if container_prefix == 0 {
11036:                 0
11037:             } else {
11038:                 u32::MAX << (32 - container_prefix)
11039:             };
11040:             (u32::from(container_v4) & mask) == (u32::from(candidate_v4) & mask)
11041:         }
11042:         (std::net::IpAddr::V6(container_v6), std::net::IpAddr::V6(candidate_v6)) => {
11043:             let container_raw = u128::from_be_bytes(container_v6.octets());
11044:             let candidate_raw = u128::from_be_bytes(candidate_v6.octets());
11045:             let mask = if container_prefix == 0 {
11046:                 0
11047:             } else {
11048:                 u128::MAX << (128 - container_prefix)
11049:             };
11050:             (container_raw & mask) == (candidate_raw & mask)
11051:         }
11052:         _ => false,
11053:     }
11054: }
11055: 
11056: fn parse_cidr(value: &str) -> Option<(std::net::IpAddr, u8)> {
11057:     let (ip_part, prefix_part) = value.split_once('/')?;
11058:     let ip = ip_part.parse::<std::net::IpAddr>().ok()?;
11059:     let prefix = prefix_part.parse::<u8>().ok()?;
11060:     let valid = match ip {
11061:         std::net::IpAddr::V4(_) => prefix <= 32,
11062:         std::net::IpAddr::V6(_) => prefix <= 128,
11063:     };
11064:     if valid { Some((ip, prefix)) } else { None }
11065: }

11157: #[cfg(not(windows))]
11158: fn validate_file_security(
11159:     path: &Path,
11160:     label: &str,
11161:     disallowed_mode_mask: u32,
11162:     allow_root_owner: bool,
11163: ) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
11164:     validate_parent_directory_security(path, label, allow_root_owner)?;
11165: 
11166:     let link_metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|err| {
11167:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("{label} metadata read failed: {err}"))
11168:     })?;
11169:     if link_metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
11170:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11171:             "{label} must not be a symlink"
11172:         )));
11173:     }
11174:     if !link_metadata.file_type().is_file() {
11175:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11176:             "{label} must be a regular file"
11177:         )));
11178:     }
11179: 
11180:     let metadata = fs::metadata(path).map_err(|err| {
11181:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("{label} metadata read failed: {err}"))
11182:     })?;
11183:     let mode = metadata.permissions().mode();
11184:     if mode & disallowed_mode_mask != 0 {
11185:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11186:             "{label} has insecure permissions: mode {:o}",
11187:             mode & 0o777
11188:         )));
11189:     }
11190: 
11191:     let owner_uid = metadata.uid();
11192:     let expected_uid = Uid::effective().as_raw();
11193:     if owner_uid != expected_uid && !(allow_root_owner && owner_uid == 0) {
11194:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11195:             "{label} owner uid mismatch: expected {expected_uid}, got {owner_uid}"
11196:         )));
11197:     }
11198:     fs::File::open(path).map_err(|err| {
11199:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11200:             "{label} is not readable by runtime user (uid {expected_uid}): {err}"
11201:         ))
11202:     })?;
11203:     Ok(())
11204: }
11205: 
11206: #[cfg(windows)]
11207: fn validate_file_security(
11208:     path: &Path,
11209:     label: &str,
11210:     _disallowed_mode_mask: u32,
11211:     _allow_root_owner: bool,
11212: ) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
11213:     validate_windows_runtime_file_path(path, label).map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)?;
11214:     let link_metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|err| {
11215:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!("{label} metadata read failed: {err}"))
11216:     })?;
11217:     if link_metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
11218:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11219:             "{label} must not be a symlink"
11220:         )));
11221:     }
11222:     if !link_metadata.file_type().is_file() {
11223:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11224:             "{label} must be a regular file"
11225:         )));
11226:     }
11227:     fs::File::open(path).map_err(|err| {
11228:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11229:             "{label} is not readable by the current service identity: {err}"
11230:         ))
11231:     })?;
11232:     // Use local-secret ACL (not runtime ACL) so files created during SSH bootstrap
11233:     // (owned by the admin SSH user, not SYSTEM/BA) are accepted. NTFS DACL on the
11234:     // containing directory enforces access control; the file-owner SID is not a
11235:     // meaningful security invariant — the directory-level owner check in
11236:     // validate_windows_runtime_startup_acls() is the authoritative gate.
11237:     validate_windows_local_secret_acl(path, label).map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)
11238: }
11239: 
11240: #[cfg(not(windows))]
11241: fn validate_parent_directory_security(
11242:     path: &Path,
11243:     label: &str,
11244:     allow_root_owner: bool,
11245: ) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
11246:     let parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
11247:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11248:             "{label} path must include a parent directory: {}",
11249:             path.display()
11250:         ))
11251:     })?;
11252:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(parent).map_err(|err| {
11253:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11254:             "{label} parent directory metadata read failed for {}: {err}",
11255:             parent.display()
11256:         ))
11257:     })?;
11258:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() || !metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
11259:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11260:             "{label} parent directory must be a non-symlink directory: {}",
11261:             parent.display()
11262:         )));
11263:     }
11264: 
11265:     let mode = metadata.permissions().mode() & 0o777;
11266:     let owner_uid = metadata.uid();
11267:     let owner_gid = metadata.gid();
11268:     let expected_gid = Gid::effective().as_raw();
11269:     let root_managed_shared_runtime =
11270:         is_root_managed_shared_runtime_parent(parent, mode, owner_uid, owner_gid, expected_gid);
11271: 
11272:     if mode & 0o022 != 0 && !root_managed_shared_runtime {
11273:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11274:             "{label} parent directory has insecure permissions: mode {mode:o}"
11275:         )));
11276:     }
11277: 
11278:     let expected_uid = Uid::effective().as_raw();
11279:     if owner_uid != expected_uid
11280:         && !(allow_root_owner && owner_uid == 0)
11281:         && !root_managed_shared_runtime
11282:     {
11283:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11284:             "{label} parent directory owner uid mismatch: expected {expected_uid}, got {owner_uid}"
11285:         )));
11286:     }
11287:     Ok(())
11288: }
11289: 
11290: #[cfg(windows)]
11291: fn validate_parent_directory_security(
11292:     path: &Path,
11293:     label: &str,
11294:     _allow_root_owner: bool,
11295: ) -> Result<(), DaemonError> {
11296:     let parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
11297:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11298:             "{label} path must include a parent directory: {}",
11299:             path.display()
11300:         ))
11301:     })?;
11302:     validate_windows_runtime_file_path(parent, label).map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)?;
11303:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(parent).map_err(|err| {
11304:         DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11305:             "{label} parent directory metadata read failed for {}: {err}",
11306:             parent.display()
11307:         ))
11308:     })?;
11309:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() || !metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
11310:         return Err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig(format!(
11311:             "{label} parent directory must be a non-symlink directory: {}",
11312:             parent.display()
11313:         )));
11314:     }
11315:     validate_windows_runtime_acl(parent, label).map_err(DaemonError::InvalidConfig)
11316: }

11318: #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
11319: fn is_root_managed_shared_runtime_parent(
11320:     parent: &Path,
11321:     mode: u32,
11322:     owner_uid: u32,
11323:     owner_gid: u32,
11324:     expected_gid: u32,
11325: ) -> bool {
11326:     parent == Path::new("/run/rustynet")
11327:         && owner_uid == 0
11328:         && mode == 0o770
11329:         && (owner_gid == expected_gid || owner_gid == 0)
11330: }
11331:

11335:     _mode: u32,
11336:     _owner_uid: u32,
11337:     _owner_gid: u32,
11338:     _expected_gid: u32,
11339: ) -> bool {
11340:     false
11341: }

11372: fn peer_uid(stream: &UnixStream) -> Option<u32> {
11373:     #[cfg(any(target_os = "linux", target_os = "android"))]
11374:     {
11375:         return getsockopt(stream, PeerCredentials)
11376:             .ok()
11377:             .map(|cred| cred.uid());
11378:     }
11379: 
11380:     #[cfg(any(
11381:         target_os = "macos",
11382:         target_os = "ios",
11383:         target_os = "tvos",
11384:         target_os = "watchos",
11385:         target_os = "visionos"
11386:     ))]
11387:     {
11388:         return getsockopt(stream, LocalPeerCred)
11389:             .ok()
11390:             .map(|cred| cred.uid());
11391:     }
11392: 
11393:     #[allow(unreachable_code)]
11394:     None
11395: }

11410: fn unix_now() -> u64 {
11411:     SystemTime::now()
11412:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
11413:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
11414:         .unwrap_or(0)
11415: }

11417: fn sanitize_netcheck_value(value: &str) -> String {
11418:     value
11419:         .chars()
11420:         .map(|ch| match ch {
11421:             'a'..='z' | 'A'..='Z' | '0'..='9' | '_' | '-' | ':' | '.' | '/' | '+' => ch,
11422:             _ => '_',
11423:         })
11424:         .collect()
11425: }

11427: fn membership_directory_from_state(state: &MembershipState) -> MembershipDirectory {
11428:     let mut directory = MembershipDirectory::default();
11429:     for node in &state.nodes {
11430:         let status = match node.status {
11431:             MembershipNodeStatus::Active => MembershipStatus::Active,
11432:             MembershipNodeStatus::Revoked | MembershipNodeStatus::Quarantined => {
11433:                 MembershipStatus::Revoked
11434:             }
11435:         };
11436:         directory.set_node_status(node.node_id.clone(), status);
11437:     }
11438:     directory
11439: }

11554:     fn write_signed_kv_artifact(path: &Path, verifier_path: &Path, seed: [u8; 32], payload: &str) {
11555:         let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&seed);
11556:         std::fs::write(
11557:             verifier_path,
11558:             format!("{}\n", hex_encode(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes())),
11559:         )
11560:         .expect("verifier key should be written");
11561:         let signature = signing_key.sign(payload.as_bytes());
11562:         std::fs::write(
11563:             path,
11564:             format!(
11565:                 "{}signature={}\n",
11566:                 payload,
11567:                 hex_encode(&signature.to_bytes())
11568:             ),
11569:         )
11570:         .expect("signed artifact should be written");
11571:     }

11604:         verifier_path: &Path,
11605:         seed: [u8; 32],

11610: 
11611:     fn write_signed_kv_sections_with_verifier_seed(
11612:         path: &Path,
11613:         verifier_path: &Path,
11614:         signer_seed: [u8; 32],
11615:         verifier_seed: [u8; 32],
11616:         payloads: &[String],
11617:     ) {
11618:         let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&signer_seed);
11619:         let verifier_signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&verifier_seed);
11620:         std::fs::write(
11621:             verifier_path,
11622:             format!(
11623:                 "{}\n",
11624:                 hex_encode(verifier_signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes())
11625:             ),
11626:         )
11627:         .expect("verifier key should be written");
11628: 
11629:         let mut body = String::new();
11630:         for (index, payload) in payloads.iter().enumerate() {
11631:             if index > 0 {
11632:                 body.push('\n');
11633:             }
11634:             let signature = signing_key.sign(payload.as_bytes());
11635:             body.push_str(payload);
11636:             body.push_str(&format!(
11637:                 "signature={}\n",
11638:                 hex_encode(&signature.to_bytes())
11639:             ));
11640:         }
11641:         std::fs::write(path, body).expect("signed sections should be written");
11642:     }

11676:     #[allow(dead_code)]
11677:     fn percent_encode_test(value: &str) -> String {
11678:         let mut encoded = String::new();
11679:         for byte in value.bytes() {
11680:             if byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
11681:                 || matches!(
11682:                     byte,
11683:                     b':' | b'.' | b'-' | b'_' | b'/' | b' ' | b',' | b'=' | b'+' | b'@'
11684:                 )
11685:             {
11686:                 encoded.push(byte as char);
11687:             } else {
11688:                 encoded.push_str(&format!("%{byte:02X}"));
11689:             }
11690:         }
11691:         encoded
11692:     }

11694:     fn render_remote_command_wire(
11695:         subject: &str,
11696:         nonce: u64,
11697:         command: IpcCommand,
11698:         signing_seed: [u8; 32],
11699:     ) -> String {
11700:         let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&signing_seed);
11701:         let _envelope = RemoteCommandEnvelope {
11702:             subject: subject.to_string(),
11703:             nonce,
11704:             command: command.clone(),
11705:             signature: Vec::new(),
11706:         };
11707:         let payload = remote_ops_signature_payload(subject, nonce, &command);
11708:         let signature = signing_key.sign(&payload);
11709:         format!(
11710:             "{REMOTE_OPS_WIRE_PREFIX}subject={} nonce={} command={} signature={}",
11711:             subject,
11712:             nonce,
11713:             command.as_wire(),
11714:             hex_encode(&signature.to_bytes())
11715:         )
11716:     }

11758:         let envelope = read_command_envelope(&reader).expect("remote envelope should parse");
11759:         match envelope {
11760:             CommandEnvelope::Remote(remote) => {
11761:                 assert_eq!(remote.subject, DEFAULT_REMOTE_OPS_EXPECTED_SUBJECT);
11762:                 assert_eq!(remote.command, IpcCommand::Status);
11763:                 assert_eq!(remote.nonce, nonce);
11764:             }
11765:             CommandEnvelope::Local(_) => panic!("expected remote envelope"),
11766:         }
11767:     }

12013:     #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
12014:     enum RoleAuthMatrixMode {
12015:         Manual,
12016:         AutoTunnel,
12017:         Restricted,
12018:         AutoTunnelRestricted,
12019:     }
12020: 
12021:     impl RoleAuthMatrixMode {
12022:         fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
12023:             match self {
12024:                 RoleAuthMatrixMode::Manual => "manual",
12025:                 RoleAuthMatrixMode::AutoTunnel => "auto_tunnel",
12026:                 RoleAuthMatrixMode::Restricted => "restricted",
12027:                 RoleAuthMatrixMode::AutoTunnelRestricted => "auto_tunnel_restricted",
12028:             }
12029:         }
12030: 
12031:         fn auto_tunnel_enforced(self) -> bool {
12032:             matches!(
12033:                 self,
12034:                 RoleAuthMatrixMode::AutoTunnel | RoleAuthMatrixMode::AutoTunnelRestricted
12035:             )
12036:         }
12037: 
12038:         fn restricted_safe(self) -> bool {
12039:             matches!(
12040:                 self,
12041:                 RoleAuthMatrixMode::Restricted | RoleAuthMatrixMode::AutoTunnelRestricted
12042:             )
12043:         }
12044:     }
12045: 
12046:     #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
12047:     enum RoleAuthMatrixHop {
12048:         OneHop,
12049:         TwoHop,
12050:     }
12051: 
12052:     impl RoleAuthMatrixHop {
12053:         fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
12054:             match self {
12055:                 RoleAuthMatrixHop::OneHop => "one_hop",
12056:                 RoleAuthMatrixHop::TwoHop => "two_hop",
12057:             }
12058:         }
12059:     }

12061:     #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
12062:     enum RoleAuthDecision {
12063:         Allowed,
12064:         DeniedByRole,
12065:         DeniedByRestrictedSafeMode,
12066:         DeniedByAutoTunnelEnforcement,
12067:     }
12068: 
12069:     fn role_auth_matrix_commands() -> Vec<IpcCommand> {
12070:         vec![
12071:             IpcCommand::Status,
12072:             IpcCommand::Netcheck,
12073:             IpcCommand::StateRefresh,
12074:             IpcCommand::DnsInspect,
12075:             IpcCommand::ExitNodeSelect("node-exit".to_string()),
12076:             IpcCommand::ExitNodeOff,
12077:             IpcCommand::LanAccessOn,
12078:             IpcCommand::LanAccessOff,
12079:             IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise("0.0.0.0/0".to_string()),
12080:             IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise("192.168.1.0/24".to_string()),
12081:             IpcCommand::KeyRotate,
12082:             IpcCommand::KeyRevoke,
12083:             IpcCommand::Unknown("unknown".to_string()),
12084:         ]
12085:     }
12086: 
12087:     fn classify_role_auth_decision(response: &IpcResponse) -> RoleAuthDecision {
12088:         if response
12089:             .message
12090:             .contains("current node role does not permit this operation")
12091:         {
12092:             return RoleAuthDecision::DeniedByRole;
12093:         }
12094:         if response.message.contains("restricted-safe mode") {
12095:             return RoleAuthDecision::DeniedByRestrictedSafeMode;
12096:         }
12097:         if response
12098:             .message
12099:             .contains("disabled while auto-tunnel is enforced")
12100:         {
12101:             return RoleAuthDecision::DeniedByAutoTunnelEnforcement;
12102:         }
12103:         RoleAuthDecision::Allowed
12104:     }
12105: 
12106:     fn expected_role_auth_decision(
12107:         role: NodeRole,
12108:         mode: RoleAuthMatrixMode,
12109:         command: &IpcCommand,
12110:     ) -> RoleAuthDecision {
12111:         if !role.allows_command(command) {
12112:             return RoleAuthDecision::DeniedByRole;
12113:         }
12114:         if mode.restricted_safe()
12115:             && command.is_mutating()
12116:             && !matches!(command, IpcCommand::StateRefresh)
12117:         {
12118:             return RoleAuthDecision::DeniedByRestrictedSafeMode;
12119:         }
12120:         if mode.auto_tunnel_enforced()
12121:             && matches!(
12122:                 command,
12123:                 IpcCommand::ExitNodeSelect(_)
12124:                     | IpcCommand::ExitNodeOff
12125:                     | IpcCommand::LanAccessOn
12126:                     | IpcCommand::LanAccessOff
12127:                     | IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise(_)
12128:             )
12129:         {
12130:             let auto_tunnel_exception = matches!(
12131:                 command,
12132:                 IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise(cidr)
12133:                     if role == NodeRole::Admin && cidr == "0.0.0.0/0"
12134:             );
12135:             if !auto_tunnel_exception {
12136:                 return RoleAuthDecision::DeniedByAutoTunnelEnforcement;
12137:             }
12138:         }
12139:         RoleAuthDecision::Allowed
12140:     }
12141: 
12142:     fn build_role_auth_matrix_runtime(
12143:         role: NodeRole,
12144:         mode: RoleAuthMatrixMode,
12145:         hop: RoleAuthMatrixHop,
12146:     ) -> (DaemonRuntime, std::path::PathBuf) {
12147:         let test_dir = secure_test_dir(&format!(
12148:             "rustynetd-role-auth-{}-{}-{}",
12149:             role.as_str(),
12150:             mode.as_str(),
12151:             hop.as_str()
12152:         ));
12153:         let state_path = test_dir.join("daemon.state");
12154:         let trust_path = test_dir.join("trust.evidence");
12155:         let trust_verifier_path = test_dir.join("trust.verifier.pub");
12156:         let trust_watermark_path = test_dir.join("trust.watermark");
12157:         let membership_snapshot_path = test_dir.join("membership.snapshot");
12158:         let membership_log_path = test_dir.join("membership.log");
12159:         let membership_watermark_path = test_dir.join("membership.watermark");
12160: 
12161:         write_trust_file(&trust_path, &trust_verifier_path, 1);
12162:         write_membership_files(
12163:             &membership_snapshot_path,
12164:             &membership_log_path,
12165:             "daemon-local",
12166:         );
12167: 
12168:         let config = DaemonConfig {
12169:             state_path,
12170:             trust_evidence_path: trust_path,
12171:             trust_verifier_key_path: trust_verifier_path,
12172:             trust_watermark_path,
12173:             membership_snapshot_path,
12174:             membership_log_path,
12175:             membership_watermark_path,
12176:             auto_tunnel_enforce: false,
12177:             backend_mode: DaemonBackendMode::InMemory,
12178:             node_role: role,
12179:             ..DaemonConfig::default()
12180:         };
12181: 
12182:         let mut runtime = DaemonRuntime::new(&config).expect("runtime should be created");
12183:         runtime.bootstrap();
12184: 
12185:         runtime.auto_tunnel_enforce = mode.auto_tunnel_enforced();
12186:         runtime.advertised_routes.clear();
12187:         runtime.local_route_reconcile_pending = false;
12188: 
12189:         if !role.is_blind_exit() {
12190:             runtime.selected_exit_node = Some("node-exit".to_string());
12191:         } else {
12192:             // Start from an intentionally over-privileged state and force invariant cleanup.
12193:             runtime.selected_exit_node = Some("node-exit".to_string());
12194:             runtime.lan_access_enabled = true;
12195:             runtime.controller.set_lan_access(true);
12196:             runtime
12197:                 .enforce_blind_exit_invariants()
12198:                 .expect("blind_exit invariants should enforce least-knowledge state");
12199:         }
12200: 
12201:         if matches!(hop, RoleAuthMatrixHop::TwoHop) {
12202:             runtime.advertised_routes.insert("0.0.0.0/0".to_string());
12203:         }
12204: 
12205:         if mode.restricted_safe() {
12206:             runtime.restrict_recoverable("matrix-forced-restricted".to_string());
12207:         }
12208: 
12209:         (runtime, test_dir)
12210:     }

12212:     fn assert_role_auth_status_invariants(
12213:         runtime: &mut DaemonRuntime,
12214:         role: NodeRole,
12215:         mode: RoleAuthMatrixMode,
12216:         hop: RoleAuthMatrixHop,
12217:     ) {
12218:         let status = runtime.handle_command(IpcCommand::Status);
12219:         assert!(
12220:             status.ok,
12221:             "status must succeed in matrix scenario role={} mode={} hop={}: {}",
12222:             role.as_str(),
12223:             mode.as_str(),
12224:             hop.as_str(),
12225:             status.message
12226:         );
12227:         assert!(
12228:             status
12229:                 .message
12230:                 .contains(format!("node_role={}", role.as_str()).as_str()),
12231:             "status role marker mismatch for role={} mode={} hop={}: {}",
12232:             role.as_str(),
12233:             mode.as_str(),
12234:             hop.as_str(),
12235:             status.message
12236:         );
12237:         assert!(
12238:             status.message.contains(
12239:                 format!(
12240:                     "auto_tunnel_enforce={}",
12241:                     if mode.auto_tunnel_enforced() {
12242:                         "true"
12243:                     } else {
12244:                         "false"
12245:                     }
12246:                 )
12247:                 .as_str()
12248:             ),
12249:             "status auto_tunnel marker mismatch for role={} mode={} hop={}: {}",
12250:             role.as_str(),
12251:             mode.as_str(),
12252:             hop.as_str(),
12253:             status.message
12254:         );
12255:         assert!(
12256:             status.message.contains(
12257:                 format!(
12258:                     "restricted_safe_mode={}",
12259:                     if mode.restricted_safe() {
12260:                         "true"
12261:                     } else {
12262:                         "false"
12263:                     }
12264:                 )
12265:                 .as_str()
12266:             ),
12267:             "status restricted marker mismatch for role={} mode={} hop={}: {}",
12268:             role.as_str(),
12269:             mode.as_str(),
12270:             hop.as_str(),
12271:             status.message
12272:         );
12273: 
12274:         if role.is_blind_exit() {
12275:             assert!(
12276:                 status.message.contains("exit_node=none"),
12277:                 "blind_exit must never report selected exit: {}",
12278:                 status.message
12279:             );
12280:             assert!(
12281:                 status.message.contains("serving_exit_node=true"),
12282:                 "blind_exit must always serve as exit: {}",
12283:                 status.message
12284:             );
12285:             assert!(
12286:                 status.message.contains("lan_access=off"),
12287:                 "blind_exit must never enable LAN access: {}",
12288:                 status.message
12289:             );
12290:             return;
12291:         }
12292: 
12293:         assert!(
12294:             status.message.contains("exit_node=node-exit"),
12295:             "non-blind role must preserve selected exit for matrix scenario role={} mode={} hop={}: {}",
12296:             role.as_str(),
12297:             mode.as_str(),
12298:             hop.as_str(),
12299:             status.message
12300:         );
12301: 
12302:         let serving_expected = role.is_admin() && matches!(hop, RoleAuthMatrixHop::TwoHop);
12303:         assert!(
12304:             status.message.contains(
12305:                 format!(
12306:                     "serving_exit_node={}",
12307:                     if serving_expected { "true" } else { "false" }
12308:                 )
12309:                 .as_str()
12310:             ),
12311:             "serving_exit_node mismatch for role={} mode={} hop={}: {}",
12312:             role.as_str(),
12313:             mode.as_str(),
12314:             hop.as_str(),
12315:             status.message
12316:         );
12317:     }

12319:     #[test]
12320:     fn role_auth_matrix_runtime_is_exhaustive_and_fail_closed() {
12321:         let roles = [NodeRole::Admin, NodeRole::Client, NodeRole::BlindExit];
12322:         let modes = [
12323:             RoleAuthMatrixMode::Manual,

12328:         let hops = [RoleAuthMatrixHop::OneHop, RoleAuthMatrixHop::TwoHop];
12329:         let commands = role_auth_matrix_commands();

12335:                         build_role_auth_matrix_runtime(role, mode, hop);
12336:                     assert_role_auth_status_invariants(&mut status_runtime, role, mode, hop);
12337:                     let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(status_test_dir);
12338: 
12339:                     for command in &commands {
12340:                         let (mut runtime, test_dir) =
12341:                             build_role_auth_matrix_runtime(role, mode, hop);
12342:                         let response = runtime.handle_command(command.clone());
12343:                         let observed = classify_role_auth_decision(&response);
12344:                         let expected = expected_role_auth_decision(role, mode, command);
12345:                         assert_eq!(
12346:                             observed,
12347:                             expected,
12348:                             "role/auth matrix mismatch role={} mode={} hop={} command={} expected={:?} observed={:?} ok={} message={}",
12349:                             role.as_str(),
12350:                             mode.as_str(),
12351:                             hop.as_str(),
12352:                             command.as_wire(),
12353:                             expected,
12354:                             observed,
12355:                             response.ok,
12356:                             response.message
12357:                         );
12358: 
12359:                         if expected == RoleAuthDecision::Allowed
12360:                             && !matches!(
12361:                                 command,
12362:                                 IpcCommand::Unknown(_)
12363:                                     | IpcCommand::KeyRotate
12364:                                     | IpcCommand::KeyRevoke
12365:                                     | IpcCommand::StateRefresh
12366:                             )
12367:                         {
12368:                             assert!(
12369:                                 response.ok,
12370:                                 "allowed command should complete successfully role={} mode={} hop={} command={} message={}",
12371:                                 role.as_str(),
12372:                                 mode.as_str(),
12373:                                 hop.as_str(),
12374:                                 command.as_wire(),
12375:                                 response.message
12376:                             );
12377:                         }
12378: 
12379:                         let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(test_dir);
12380:                     }
12381:                 }
12382:             }
12383:         }
12384:     }

12506:         let record = TrustEvidenceRecord {
12507:             tls13_valid: true,
12508:             signed_control_valid: true,
12509:             signed_data_age_secs: 0,
12510:             clock_skew_secs: 0,
