12517:     fn write_trust_file_with_record(
12518:         path: &Path,
12519:         verifier_path: &Path,
12520:         record: TrustEvidenceRecord,
12521:     ) {
12522:         let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[7u8; 32]);
12523:         std::fs::write(
12524:             verifier_path,
12525:             format!("{}\n", hex_encode(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes())),
12526:         )
12527:         .expect("verifier key should be written");
12528:         #[cfg(unix)]
12529:         {
12530:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
12531:             std::fs::set_permissions(verifier_path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o644))
12532:                 .expect("verifier key permissions should be secure");
12533:         }
12534:         let body = trust_evidence_payload(&record);
12535:         let signature = signing_key.sign(body.as_bytes());
12536:         std::fs::write(
12537:             path,
12538:             format!("{body}signature={}\n", hex_encode(&signature.to_bytes())),
12539:         )
12540:         .expect("trust file should be written");
12541:         #[cfg(unix)]
12542:         {
12543:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
12544:             std::fs::set_permissions(path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))
12545:                 .expect("trust evidence permissions should be secure");
12546:         }
12547:     }

12549:     fn write_auto_tunnel_file(
12550:         path: &Path,
12551:         verifier_path: &Path,
12552:         node_id: &str,
12553:         nonce: u64,
12554:         tamper_after_sign: bool,
12555:     ) {
12556:         let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[19u8; 32]);
12557:         std::fs::write(
12558:             verifier_path,
12559:             format!("{}\n", hex_encode(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes())),
12560:         )
12561:         .expect("auto tunnel verifier key should be written");
12562:         #[cfg(unix)]
12563:         {
12564:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
12565:             std::fs::set_permissions(verifier_path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o644))
12566:                 .expect("auto tunnel verifier key permissions should be secure");
12567:         }
12568: 
12569:         let generated = unix_now();
12570:         let expires = generated.saturating_add(300);
12571:         let peer_public = hex_encode(&[9u8; 32]);
12572:         let payload = format!(
12573:             "version=1\nnode_id={node_id}\nmesh_cidr=100.64.0.0/10\nassigned_cidr=100.64.0.1/32\ngenerated_at_unix={generated}\nexpires_at_unix={expires}\nnonce={nonce}\npeer_count=1\npeer.0.node_id=node-exit\npeer.0.endpoint=203.0.113.20:51820\npeer.0.public_key_hex={peer_public}\npeer.0.allowed_ips=100.64.0.2/32\nroute_count=1\nroute.0.destination_cidr=0.0.0.0/0\nroute.0.via_node=node-exit\nroute.0.kind=exit_default\n"
12574:         );
12575:         let signature = signing_key.sign(payload.as_bytes());
12576:         let mut body = format!(
12577:             "{}signature={}\n",
12578:             payload,
12579:             hex_encode(&signature.to_bytes())
12580:         );
12581:         if tamper_after_sign {
12582:             body = body.replace("route_count=1", "route_count=2");
12583:         }
12584:         std::fs::write(path, body).expect("auto tunnel file should be written");
12585:         #[cfg(unix)]
12586:         {
12587:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
12588:             std::fs::set_permissions(path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o640))
12589:                 .expect("auto tunnel bundle permissions should be secure");
12590:         }
12591:     }

12714:     fn write_dns_zone_file_with_timing(
12715:         path: &Path,
12716:         verifier_path: &Path,
12717:         subject_node_id: &str,
12718:         record: (&str, &str, &[&str]),
12719:         nonce: u64,
12720:         timing: DnsZoneFixtureTiming,
12721:     ) {
12722:         let (target_node_id, expected_ip, aliases) = record;
12723:         let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[31u8; 32]);
12724:         std::fs::write(
12725:             verifier_path,
12726:             format!("{}\n", hex_encode(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes())),
12727:         )
12728:         .expect("dns zone verifier key should be written");
12729:         #[cfg(unix)]
12730:         {
12731:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
12732:             std::fs::set_permissions(verifier_path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o644))
12733:                 .expect("dns zone verifier key permissions should be secure");
12734:         }
12735: 
12736:         let bundle = rustynet_dns_zone::build_signed_dns_zone_bundle(
12737:             &signing_key,
12738:             "rustynet",
12739:             subject_node_id,
12740:             timing.generated_at_unix,
12741:             timing.ttl_secs,
12742:             nonce,
12743:             &[rustynet_dns_zone::DnsZoneRecordInput {
12744:                 label: "app".to_string(),
12745:                 target_node_id: target_node_id.to_string(),
12746:                 rr_type: rustynet_dns_zone::DnsRecordType::A,
12747:                 target_addr_kind: rustynet_dns_zone::DnsTargetAddrKind::MeshIpv4,
12748:                 expected_ip: expected_ip.to_string(),
12749:                 ttl_secs: timing.ttl_secs,
12750:                 aliases: aliases.iter().map(|alias| alias.to_string()).collect(),
12751:             }],
12752:         )
12753:         .expect("dns zone bundle should be built");
12754:         let mut body = rustynet_dns_zone::render_signed_dns_zone_bundle_wire(&bundle);
12755:         if timing.tamper_after_sign {
12756:             body = body.replace("record.0.ttl_secs=60", "record.0.ttl_secs=61");
12757:         }
12758:         std::fs::write(path, body).expect("dns zone file should be written");
12759:         #[cfg(unix)]
12760:         {
12761:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
12762:             std::fs::set_permissions(path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o640))
12763:                 .expect("dns zone bundle permissions should be secure");
12764:         }
12765:     }

12785:     fn build_dns_query(name: &str, qtype: u16) -> Vec<u8> {
12786:         let mut out = Vec::new();
12787:         out.extend_from_slice(&0x1234_u16.to_be_bytes());
12788:         out.extend_from_slice(&0x0100_u16.to_be_bytes());
12789:         out.extend_from_slice(&1u16.to_be_bytes());
12790:         out.extend_from_slice(&0u16.to_be_bytes());
12791:         out.extend_from_slice(&0u16.to_be_bytes());
12792:         out.extend_from_slice(&0u16.to_be_bytes());
12793:         for label in name.split('.').filter(|label| !label.is_empty()) {
12794:             out.push(label.len() as u8);
12795:             out.extend_from_slice(label.as_bytes());
12796:         }
12797:         out.push(0);
12798:         out.extend_from_slice(&qtype.to_be_bytes());
12799:         out.extend_from_slice(&1u16.to_be_bytes());
12800:         out
12801:     }

12842:     fn write_traversal_file_with_timing(
12843:         path: &Path,
12844:         verifier_path: &Path,
12845:         source_node: &str,
12846:         target_node: &str,
12847:         nonce: u64,
12848:         timing: TraversalFixtureTiming,
12849:     ) {
12850:         let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[23u8; 32]);
12851:         std::fs::write(
12852:             verifier_path,
12853:             format!("{}\n", hex_encode(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes())),
12854:         )
12855:         .expect("traversal verifier key should be written");
12856: 
12857:         let generated = timing.generated_at_unix;
12858:         let expires = generated.saturating_add(timing.ttl_secs);
12859:         let payload = format!(
12860:             "version=1\npath_policy=direct_preferred_relay_allowed\nsource_node_id={source_node}\ntarget_node_id={target_node}\ngenerated_at_unix={generated}\nexpires_at_unix={expires}\nnonce={nonce}\ncandidate_count=2\ncandidate.0.type=host\ncandidate.0.addr=10.0.0.2\ncandidate.0.port=51820\ncandidate.0.family=ipv4\ncandidate.0.relay_id=\ncandidate.0.priority=10\ncandidate.1.type=relay\ncandidate.1.addr=203.0.113.77\ncandidate.1.port=443\ncandidate.1.family=ipv4\ncandidate.1.relay_id=relay-eu-1\ncandidate.1.priority=20\n"
12861:         );
12862:         let signature = signing_key.sign(payload.as_bytes());
12863:         let mut body = format!(
12864:             "{}signature={}\n",
12865:             payload,
12866:             hex_encode(&signature.to_bytes())
12867:         );
12868:         if timing.tamper_after_sign {
12869:             body = body.replace("candidate_count=2", "candidate_count=3");
12870:         }
12871:         std::fs::write(path, body).expect("traversal file should be written");
12872:     }

13328:     fn traversal_host_candidate_retry_waits_for_usable_snapshot() {
13329:         let mut snapshots = vec![
13330:             transient_loopback_only_candidate_snapshot(),
13331:             usable_probe_candidate_snapshot(),
13332:         ]
13333:         .into_iter();
13334:         let mut waited = Vec::new();
13335: 
13336:         let collected = collect_traversal_host_candidate_snapshot_with_retry(
13337:             || {
13338:                 snapshots
13339:                     .next()
13340:                     .unwrap_or_else(usable_probe_candidate_snapshot)
13341:             },
13342:             |duration| waited.push(duration),
13343:             3,
13344:         );
13345: 
13346:         assert!(snapshot_has_usable_traversal_host_candidates(&collected));
13347:         assert_eq!(waited.len(), 1);
13348:         assert_eq!(
13349:             waited[0],
13350:             Duration::from_millis(TRAVERSAL_LOCAL_HOST_CANDIDATE_RETRY_DELAY_MS)
13351:         );
13352:         assert_eq!(collected, usable_probe_candidate_snapshot());
13353:     }

13356:     fn traversal_host_candidate_retry_returns_last_unusable_snapshot_when_exhausted() {
13357:         let mut snapshots = vec![
13358:             transient_loopback_only_candidate_snapshot(),
13359:             transient_loopback_only_candidate_snapshot(),
13360:         ]
13361:         .into_iter();
13362:         let mut waited = Vec::new();
13363: 
13364:         let collected = collect_traversal_host_candidate_snapshot_with_retry(
13365:             || {
13366:                 snapshots
13367:                     .next()
13368:                     .unwrap_or_else(transient_loopback_only_candidate_snapshot)
13369:             },
13370:             |duration| waited.push(duration),
13371:             2,
13372:         );
13373: 
13374:         assert!(!snapshot_has_usable_traversal_host_candidates(&collected));
13375:         assert_eq!(waited.len(), 1);
13376:         assert_eq!(collected, transient_loopback_only_candidate_snapshot());
13377:     }

13379:     fn write_traversal_file_set(
13380:         path: &Path,
13381:         verifier_path: &Path,
13382:         source_node: &str,
13383:         peers: &[(&str, &str, u16)],
13384:         nonce: u64,
13385:     ) {
13386:         let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[23u8; 32]);
13387:         std::fs::write(
13388:             verifier_path,
13389:             format!("{}\n", hex_encode(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes())),
13390:         )
13391:         .expect("traversal verifier key should be written");
13392: 
13393:         let generated = unix_now();
13394:         let expires = generated.saturating_add(60);
13395:         let mut body = String::new();
13396:         for (index, (target_node, direct_addr, direct_port)) in peers.iter().enumerate() {
13397:             let relay_octet = 77u8.saturating_add(index as u8);
13398:             let payload = format!(
13399:                 "version=1\npath_policy=direct_preferred_relay_allowed\nsource_node_id={source_node}\ntarget_node_id={target_node}\ngenerated_at_unix={generated}\nexpires_at_unix={expires}\nnonce={nonce}\ncandidate_count=2\ncandidate.0.type=host\ncandidate.0.addr={direct_addr}\ncandidate.0.port={direct_port}\ncandidate.0.family=ipv4\ncandidate.0.relay_id=\ncandidate.0.priority=10\ncandidate.1.type=relay\ncandidate.1.addr=203.0.113.{relay_octet}\ncandidate.1.port=443\ncandidate.1.family=ipv4\ncandidate.1.relay_id=relay-eu-{}\ncandidate.1.priority=20\n",
13400:                 index + 1
13401:             );
13402:             let signature = signing_key.sign(payload.as_bytes());
13403:             body.push_str(&payload);
13404:             body.push_str(&format!(
13405:                 "signature={}\n",
13406:                 hex_encode(&signature.to_bytes())
13407:             ));
13408:             if index + 1 != peers.len() {
13409:                 body.push('\n');
13410:             }
13411:         }
13412:         std::fs::write(path, body).expect("traversal file set should be written");
13413:     }

13428:         exit_status: MembershipNodeStatus,

13431:         write_membership_files_with_nodes(

13440:     fn write_membership_files_with_additional_nodes(
13441:         snapshot_path: &Path,
13442:         log_path: &Path,
13443:         local_node_id: &str,
13444:         nodes: &[(&str, MembershipNodeStatus)],
13445:     ) {
13446:         let owner_signing = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[7; 32]);
13447:         write_membership_files_with_nodes(
13448:             snapshot_path,
13449:             log_path,
13450:             local_node_id,
13451:             nodes,
13452:             &owner_signing,

13456:     fn write_membership_files_with_nodes(
13457:         snapshot_path: &Path,
13458:         log_path: &Path,
13459:         local_node_id: &str,
13460:         nodes: &[(&str, MembershipNodeStatus)],
13461:         owner_signing: &SigningKey,
13462:     ) {
13463:         let mut state_nodes = vec![MembershipNode {
13464:             node_id: local_node_id.to_string(),
13465:             node_pubkey_hex: hex_encode(&[9; 32]),
13466:             owner: "owner@example.local".to_string(),
13467:             status: MembershipNodeStatus::Active,
13468:             roles: vec!["tag:servers".to_string()],
13469:             joined_at_unix: 100,
13470:             updated_at_unix: 100,
13471:         }];
13472:         for (index, (node_id, status)) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {
13473:             let pubkey_byte = 11u8.saturating_add(index as u8);
13474:             state_nodes.push(MembershipNode {
13475:                 node_id: (*node_id).to_string(),
13476:                 node_pubkey_hex: hex_encode(&[pubkey_byte; 32]),
13477:                 owner: "owner@example.local".to_string(),
13478:                 status: *status,
13479:                 roles: vec!["tag:exit".to_string()],
13480:                 joined_at_unix: 100,
13481:                 updated_at_unix: 100,
13482:             });
13483:         }
13484:         let state = MembershipState {
13485:             schema_version: MEMBERSHIP_SCHEMA_VERSION,
13486:             network_id: "net-test".to_string(),
13487:             epoch: 1,
13488:             nodes: state_nodes,
13489:             approver_set: vec![MembershipApprover {
13490:                 approver_id: "owner-1".to_string(),
13491:                 approver_pubkey_hex: hex_encode(owner_signing.verifying_key().as_bytes()),
13492:                 role: MembershipApproverRole::Owner,
13493:                 status: MembershipApproverStatus::Active,
13494:                 created_at_unix: 100,
13495:             }],
13496:             quorum_threshold: 1,
13497:             metadata_hash: None,
13498:         };
13499:         persist_membership_snapshot(snapshot_path, &state)
13500:             .expect("membership snapshot should be written");
13501:         if let Some(parent) = log_path.parent() {
13502:             std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).expect("membership log parent should exist");
13503:         }
13504:         let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
13505:         options.write(true).create(true).truncate(true);
13506:         #[cfg(unix)]
13507:         {
13508:             use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
13509:             options.mode(0o600);
13510:         }
13511:         let mut file = options
13512:             .open(log_path)
13513:             .expect("membership log should be opened");
13514:         file.write_all(b"version=1\n")
13515:             .expect("membership log should be written");
13516:     }

13518:     fn secure_test_dir(prefix: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
13519:         let unique = std::time::SystemTime::now()
13520:             .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
13521:             .expect("clock should be valid")
13522:             .as_nanos();
13523:         let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("{prefix}-{unique}"));
13524:         std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).expect("secure test directory should be creatable");
13525:         #[cfg(unix)]
13526:         {
13527:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
13528:             std::fs::set_permissions(&dir, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
13529:                 .expect("secure test directory permissions should be set");
13530:         }
13531:         dir
13532:     }

13874:             let encrypted_key_path = test_dir.join("wireguard.key.enc");
13875:             std::fs::write(&runtime_key_path, b"private-key\n")
13876:                 .expect("runtime key should be writable");
13877: 
13878:             scrub_runtime_wireguard_key_material(
13879:                 backend_mode,
13880:                 Some(runtime_key_path.as_path()),
13881:                 None,
13882:             )
13883:             .expect("plaintext key mode should not scrub runtime key");
13884:             assert!(runtime_key_path.exists());
13885: 
13886:             scrub_runtime_wireguard_key_material(
13887:                 backend_mode,
13888:                 Some(runtime_key_path.as_path()),
13889:                 Some(encrypted_key_path.as_path()),
13890:             )
13891:             .expect("encrypted key mode should scrub runtime key");
13892:             assert!(!runtime_key_path.exists());
13893: 
13894:             let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(test_dir);
13895:         }
13896:     }

17644:     #[test]
17645:     fn load_traversal_bundle_set_rejects_mixed_snapshot_batches() {
17646:         let test_dir = secure_test_dir("rustynetd-traversal-mixed-snapshot");
17647:         let traversal_path = test_dir.join("traversal.bundle");
17648:         let traversal_verifier_path = test_dir.join("traversal.verifier.pub");
17649:         let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[23u8; 32]);
17650:         std::fs::write(
17651:             &traversal_verifier_path,
17652:             format!("{}\n", hex_encode(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes())),
17653:         )
17654:         .expect("traversal verifier key should be written");
17655: 
17656:         let generated = unix_now();
17657:         let expires = generated.saturating_add(60);
17658:         let payload_a = format!(
17659:             "version=1\npath_policy=direct_preferred_relay_allowed\nsource_node_id=daemon-local\ntarget_node_id=node-exit\ngenerated_at_unix={generated}\nexpires_at_unix={expires}\nnonce=11\ncandidate_count=1\ncandidate.0.type=host\ncandidate.0.addr=10.0.0.2\ncandidate.0.port=51820\ncandidate.0.family=ipv4\ncandidate.0.relay_id=\ncandidate.0.priority=10\n"
17660:         );
17661:         let payload_b = format!(
17662:             "version=1\npath_policy=direct_preferred_relay_allowed\nsource_node_id=daemon-local\ntarget_node_id=node-relay\ngenerated_at_unix={generated}\nexpires_at_unix={expires}\nnonce=12\ncandidate_count=1\ncandidate.0.type=host\ncandidate.0.addr=10.0.0.3\ncandidate.0.port=51820\ncandidate.0.family=ipv4\ncandidate.0.relay_id=\ncandidate.0.priority=10\n"
17663:         );
17664:         let body = format!(
17665:             "{payload_a}signature={}\n\n{payload_b}signature={}\n",
17666:             hex_encode(&signing_key.sign(payload_a.as_bytes()).to_bytes()),
17667:             hex_encode(&signing_key.sign(payload_b.as_bytes()).to_bytes())
17668:         );
17669:         std::fs::write(&traversal_path, body).expect("mixed traversal snapshot should be written");
17670: 
17671:         let err = load_traversal_bundle_set(
17672:             &traversal_path,
17673:             &traversal_verifier_path,
17674:             DEFAULT_TRAVERSAL_MAX_AGE_SECS,
17675:             TrustPolicy::default(),
17676:             None,
17677:         )
17678:         .expect_err("mixed snapshot batches must fail closed");
17679:         assert!(
17680:             err.to_string()
17681:                 .contains("must share a single generated_at/expires_at/nonce snapshot"),
17682:             "unexpected error: {err}"
17683:         );
17684: 
17685:         let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(test_dir);
17686:     }

 110: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]

 118: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
 119: pub struct MagicDnsZone {
 120:     domain: String,
 121:     records: HashMap<String, MagicDnsRecord>,
 122:     node_index: HashMap<NodeId, String>,
 123: }
 124: 
 125: impl MagicDnsZone {
 126:     pub fn new(domain: &str) -> Self {
 127:         Self {
 128:             domain: domain.to_lowercase(),
 129:             records: HashMap::new(),
 130:             node_index: HashMap::new(),
 131:         }
 132:     }
 133: 
 134:     pub fn upsert(
 135:         &mut self,
 136:         requested_hostname: &str,
 137:         node_id: NodeId,
 138:         ip: &str,
 139:         aliases: Vec<String>,
 140:     ) -> String {
 141:         if let Some(previous_name) = self.node_index.get(&node_id).cloned() {
 142:             self.records.remove(&previous_name);
 143:         }
 144: 
 145:         let base = normalize_dns_label(requested_hostname);
 146:         let mut candidate = base.clone();
 147:         let mut counter = 2u64;
 148:         while self
 149:             .records
 150:             .get(&candidate)
 151:             .map(|record| record.node_id != node_id)
 152:             .unwrap_or(false)
 153:         {
 154:             candidate = format!("{base}-{counter}");
 155:             counter = counter.saturating_add(1);
 156:         }
 157: 
 158:         let aliases = aliases
 159:             .into_iter()
 160:             .map(|alias| normalize_dns_label(&alias))
 161:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 162:         self.records.insert(
 163:             candidate.clone(),
 164:             MagicDnsRecord {
 165:                 hostname: format!("{}.{}", candidate, self.domain),
 166:                 node_id: node_id.clone(),
 167:                 ip: ip.to_string(),
 168:                 aliases,
 169:             },
 170:         );
 171:         self.node_index.insert(node_id, candidate.clone());
 172:         candidate
 173:     }
 174: 
 175:     pub fn inspect(&self) -> Vec<MagicDnsRecord> {
 176:         let mut entries = self.records.values().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>();
 177:         entries.sort_by(|left, right| left.hostname.cmp(&right.hostname));
 178:         entries
 179:     }
 180: }

 183: pub enum DataplaneError {
 184:     Backend(BackendError),
 185:     NotStarted,
 186:     PolicyDenied,
 187:     HandshakeRateLimited,
 188:     PeerNotFound,
 189:     ExitNodeNotCapable,
 190:     ExitNodeUnauthorized,
 191:     LanAccessDenied,
 192:     TunnelFailClosed,
 193:     DnsFailClosed,
 194:     InvalidInput,
 195: }
 196: 
 197: impl std::fmt::Display for DataplaneError {
 198:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
 199:         match self {
 200:             DataplaneError::Backend(err) => write!(f, "backend error: {err}"),
 201:             DataplaneError::NotStarted => f.write_str("dataplane not started"),
 202:             DataplaneError::PolicyDenied => f.write_str("policy denied"),
 203:             DataplaneError::HandshakeRateLimited => f.write_str("handshake rate limited"),
 204:             DataplaneError::PeerNotFound => f.write_str("peer not found"),
 205:             DataplaneError::ExitNodeNotCapable => f.write_str("exit node is not capable"),
 206:             DataplaneError::ExitNodeUnauthorized => {
 207:                 f.write_str("exit node is not authorized for user")
 208:             }
 209:             DataplaneError::LanAccessDenied => f.write_str("lan access denied"),
 210:             DataplaneError::TunnelFailClosed => f.write_str("tunnel fail-closed is active"),
 211:             DataplaneError::DnsFailClosed => f.write_str("dns fail-closed is active"),
 212:             DataplaneError::InvalidInput => f.write_str("invalid input"),
 213:         }
 214:     }
 215: }

 225: #[derive(Debug, Default)]
 226: pub struct HandshakeFloodGuard {
 227:     config: HandshakeGuardConfig,
 228:     source_attempts: HashMap<String, Vec<u64>>,
 229: }
 230: 
 231: impl HandshakeFloodGuard {
 232:     pub fn new(config: HandshakeGuardConfig) -> Self {
 233:         Self {
 234:             config,
 235:             source_attempts: HashMap::new(),
 236:         }
 237:     }
 238: 
 239:     pub fn allow_handshake(&mut self, source: &str, now_unix: u64) -> bool {
 240:         let attempts = self.source_attempts.entry(source.to_string()).or_default();
 241:         let cutoff = now_unix.saturating_sub(self.config.window_secs);
 242:         attempts.retain(|value| *value >= cutoff);
 243:         if attempts.len() as u32 >= self.config.max_attempts_per_window {
 244:             return false;
 245:         }
 246:         attempts.push(now_unix);
 247:         true
 248:     }
 249: }

 251: #[derive(Debug, Default)]
 252: pub struct RekeyManager {
 253:     config: RekeyConfig,
 254: }
 255: 
 256: impl RekeyManager {
 257:     pub fn new(config: RekeyConfig) -> Self {
 258:         Self { config }
 259:     }
 260: 
 261:     fn rotate_if_due(&self, session: &mut PeerSessionState, now_unix: u64) -> bool {
 262:         if now_unix.saturating_sub(session.last_rekey_unix) < self.config.interval_secs {
 263:             return false;
 264:         }
 265:         session.last_rekey_unix = now_unix;
 266:         session.rekey_generation = session.rekey_generation.saturating_add(1);
 267:         true
 268:     }
 269: }

 307:         policy: PolicySet,
 308:         handshake_guard_config: HandshakeGuardConfig,
 309:         rekey_config: RekeyConfig,

 312:             backend,

 315:             policy,

 325:             protected_mode: ProtectedMode::Disabled,

 331: 
 332:     pub fn start(&mut self) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 333:         self.backend.start(RuntimeContext {
 334:             local_node: self.local_node.clone(),
 335:             interface_name: "rustynet0".to_string(),
 336:             mesh_cidr: self.mesh_cidr.clone(),
 337:             local_cidr: self.mesh_cidr.clone(),
 338:         })?;
 339:         self.started = true;
 340:         Ok(())
 341:     }
 342: 
 343:     pub fn connect_peer(
 344:         &mut self,
 345:         peer: PeerConfig,
 346:         access_intent: &PeerAccessIntent,
 347:         handshake_source_ip: &str,
 348:         now_unix: u64,
 349:     ) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 350:         self.ensure_started()?;
 351:         if !self
 352:             .handshake_guard
 353:             .allow_handshake(handshake_source_ip, now_unix)
 354:         {
 355:             return Err(DataplaneError::HandshakeRateLimited);
 356:         }
 357: 
 358:         let request = AccessRequest {
 359:             src: access_intent.source.clone(),
 360:             dst: access_intent.destination.clone(),
 361:             protocol: access_intent.protocol,
 362:         };
 363:         if self.policy.evaluate(&request) != Decision::Allow {
 364:             return Err(DataplaneError::PolicyDenied);
 365:         }
 366: 
 367:         let node_id = peer.node_id.clone();
 368:         self.backend.configure_peer(peer)?;
 369:         self.sessions.insert(
 370:             node_id,
 371:             PeerSessionState {
 372:                 path: DataPath::Direct,
 373:                 connected_at_unix: now_unix,
 374:                 last_rekey_unix: now_unix,
 375:                 rekey_generation: 0,
 376:             },
 377:         );
 378:         Ok(())
 379:     }
 380: 
 381:     pub fn remove_peer(&mut self, node_id: &NodeId) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 382:         self.ensure_started()?;
 383:         if !self.sessions.contains_key(node_id) {
 384:             return Err(DataplaneError::PeerNotFound);
 385:         }
 386: 
 387:         self.backend.remove_peer(node_id)?;
 388:         self.sessions.remove(node_id);
 389:         Ok(())
 390:     }
 391: 
 392:     pub fn apply_routes(&mut self, routes: Vec<Route>) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 393:         self.ensure_started()?;
 394:         self.backend.apply_routes(routes)?;
 395:         Ok(())
 396:     }
 397: 
 398:     pub fn set_exit_mode(&mut self, mode: ExitMode) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 399:         self.ensure_started()?;
 400:         self.backend.set_exit_mode(mode)?;
 401:         Ok(())
 402:     }
 403: 
 404:     pub fn set_exit_capable(&mut self, node_id: NodeId, enabled: bool) {

 408:     pub fn select_exit_node(
 409:         &mut self,
 410:         user: &str,
 411:         node_id: NodeId,
 412:         policy: &ExitNodePolicy,
 413:     ) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 414:         self.ensure_started()?;
 415:         if !self
 416:             .exit_capable_nodes
 417:             .get(&node_id)
 418:             .copied()
 419:             .unwrap_or(false)
 420:         {
 421:             return Err(DataplaneError::ExitNodeNotCapable);
 422:         }
 423:         if !policy.allows(user, &node_id) {
 424:             return Err(DataplaneError::ExitNodeUnauthorized);
 425:         }
 426:

 428:         self.set_exit_mode(ExitMode::FullTunnel)
 429:     }

 452:     pub fn set_lan_route_permission(&mut self, user: &str, cidr: &str, allowed: bool) {
 453:         self.lan_route_acl
 454:             .insert((user.to_string(), cidr.to_string()), allowed);
 455:     }
 456: 
 457:     pub fn ensure_lan_route_allowed(&self, user: &str, cidr: &str) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 458:         if !self.lan_access_enabled {
 459:             return Err(DataplaneError::LanAccessDenied);
 460:         }
 461: 
 462:         let Some(selected_exit) = &self.selected_exit_node else {
 463:             return Err(DataplaneError::LanAccessDenied);
 464:         };
 465: 
 466:         let route_is_advertised = self
 467:             .advertised_lan_routes
 468:             .get(selected_exit)
 469:             .map(|routes| routes.iter().any(|route| route == cidr))
 470:             .unwrap_or(false);
 471:         if !route_is_advertised {
 472:             return Err(DataplaneError::LanAccessDenied);
 473:         }
 474: 
 475:         let allowed = self
 476:             .lan_route_acl
 477:             .get(&(user.to_string(), cidr.to_string()))
 478:             .copied()
 479:             .unwrap_or(false);
 480:         if !allowed {
 481:             return Err(DataplaneError::LanAccessDenied);
 482:         }
 483: 
 484:         Ok(())
 485:     }

 499:     pub fn ensure_egress_allowed(&self) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 500:         if matches!(
 501:             self.protected_mode,
 502:             ProtectedMode::TunnelOnly | ProtectedMode::TunnelAndDns
 503:         ) && !self.tunnel_up
 504:         {
 505:             return Err(DataplaneError::TunnelFailClosed);
 506:         }
 507:         Ok(())
 508:     }

 510:     pub fn ensure_dns_allowed(&self) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 511:         if self.protected_mode == ProtectedMode::TunnelAndDns {
 512:             if !self.tunnel_up {
 513:                 return Err(DataplaneError::TunnelFailClosed);
 514:             }
 515:             if !self.dns_up {
 516:                 return Err(DataplaneError::DnsFailClosed);
 517:             }
 518:         }
 519:         Ok(())
 520:     }
 521: 
 522:     pub fn upsert_magic_dns_record(
 523:         &mut self,
 524:         requested_hostname: &str,
 525:         node_id: NodeId,
 526:         ip: &str,
 527:         aliases: Vec<String>,
 528:     ) -> String {
 529:         self.magic_dns
 530:             .upsert(requested_hostname, node_id, ip, aliases)
 531:     }
 532: 
 533:     pub fn inspect_magic_dns(&self) -> Vec<MagicDnsRecord> {
 534:         self.magic_dns.inspect()
 535:     }
 536: 
 537:     pub fn mark_direct_path_failed(&mut self, node_id: &NodeId) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 538:         self.ensure_started()?;
 539:         let Some(session) = self.sessions.get_mut(node_id) else {
 540:             return Err(DataplaneError::PeerNotFound);
 541:         };
 542:         session.path = DataPath::Relay;
 543:         Ok(())
 544:     }
 545: 
 546:     pub fn mark_direct_path_recovered(&mut self, node_id: &NodeId) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 547:         self.ensure_started()?;
 548:         let Some(session) = self.sessions.get_mut(node_id) else {
 549:             return Err(DataplaneError::PeerNotFound);
 550:         };
 551:         session.path = DataPath::Direct;
 552:         Ok(())
 553:     }
 554: 
 555:     pub fn rotate_due_keys(&mut self, now_unix: u64) -> Result<usize, DataplaneError> {
 556:         self.ensure_started()?;
 557:         let mut count = 0usize;
 558:         for session in self.sessions.values_mut() {
 559:             if self.rekey_manager.rotate_if_due(session, now_unix) {
 560:                 count += 1;
 561:             }
 562:         }
 563:         Ok(count)
 564:     }
 565: 
 566:     pub fn session_snapshot(&self, node_id: &NodeId) -> Option<PeerSessionSnapshot> {
 567:         self.sessions.get(node_id).map(|state| PeerSessionSnapshot {
 568:             node_id: node_id.clone(),
 569:             path: state.path,
 570:             connected_at_unix: state.connected_at_unix,
 571:             last_rekey_unix: state.last_rekey_unix,
 572:             rekey_generation: state.rekey_generation,
 573:         })
 574:     }
 575: 
 576:     pub fn has_relay_path(&self) -> bool {
 577:         self.sessions
 578:             .values()
 579:             .any(|session| session.path == DataPath::Relay)
 580:     }
 581: 
 582:     pub fn backend_stats(&self) -> Result<TunnelStats, DataplaneError> {
 583:         self.ensure_started()?;
 584:         self.backend.stats().map_err(DataplaneError::Backend)
 585:     }
 586: 
 587:     pub fn shutdown(&mut self) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 588:         self.ensure_started()?;
 589:         self.backend.shutdown()?;
 590:         self.sessions.clear();
 591:         self.selected_exit_node = None;
 592:         self.lan_access_enabled = false;
 593:         self.started = false;
 594:         Ok(())
 595:     }
 596: 
 597:     fn ensure_started(&self) -> Result<(), DataplaneError> {
 598:         if self.started {
 599:             return Ok(());
 600:         }
 601:         Err(DataplaneError::NotStarted)
 602:     }
 603: }
 604: 
 605: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 606: pub struct Phase3MeshMetric {
 607:     pub name: &'static str,
 608:     pub value: f64,
 609:     pub unit: &'static str,
 610: }
 611: 
 612: pub fn write_phase3_mesh_report(
 613:     path: impl AsRef<Path>,
 614:     connected_nodes: usize,
 615:     total_peer_sessions: usize,
 616:     relay_session_count: usize,
 617: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 618:     let path = path.as_ref();
 619:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 620:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| format!("create_dir_all failed: {err}"))?;
 621:     }
 622: 
 623:     let metrics = [
 624:         Phase3MeshMetric {
 625:             name: "connected_nodes",
 626:             value: connected_nodes as f64,
 627:             unit: "count",
 628:         },
 629:         Phase3MeshMetric {
 630:             name: "peer_sessions",
 631:             value: total_peer_sessions as f64,
 632:             unit: "count",
 633:         },
 634:         Phase3MeshMetric {
 635:             name: "relay_sessions",
 636:             value: relay_session_count as f64,
 637:             unit: "count",
 638:         },
 639:     ];
 640: 
 641:     let mut encoded = String::from("{\n  \"phase\":\"phase3\",\n  \"metrics\":[\n");
 642:     for (index, metric) in metrics.iter().enumerate() {
 643:         let comma = if index + 1 == metrics.len() { "" } else { "," };
 644:         encoded.push_str(&format!(
 645: /* ELIDED: original line had 10 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
 646:             metric.name, metric.value, metric.unit, comma
 647:         ));
 648:     }
 649:     encoded.push_str("  ]\n}\n");
 650: 
 651:     fs::write(path, encoded).map_err(|err| format!("write phase3 report failed: {err}"))?;
 652:     Ok(())
 653: }
 654: 
 655: fn normalize_dns_label(value: &str) -> String {
 656:     let mut out = String::new();
 657:     for ch in value.trim().chars() {
 658:         if ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || ch == '-' {
 659:             out.push(ch.to_ascii_lowercase());
 660:         } else if ch == ' ' || ch == '_' {
 661:             out.push('-');
 662:         }
 663:     }
 664:     if out.is_empty() {
 665:         "node".to_string()
 666:     } else {
 667:         out
 668:     }
 669: }

1119:         policy.allow_user_for_node("alice@example.local", exit_node.clone());
1120: 
1121:         dataplane.start().expect("dataplane should start");
1122:         dataplane.set_exit_capable(exit_node.clone(), true);
1123:         dataplane
1124:             .select_exit_node("alice@example.local", exit_node, &policy)
1125:             .expect("selection should succeed");
1126: 
1127:         dataplane
1128:             .clear_exit_node()
1129:             .expect("clearing exit node should succeed");
1130:         assert_eq!(dataplane.selected_exit_node(), None);
1131:     }
1132: }

===== /crates/rustynetd/src/fetcher.rs =====

   1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   2: 
   3: //! Control-plane state fetcher with signature verification and watermark anti-replay.
   4: //!
   5: //! This module implements StateFetcher for pull-based signed bundle retrieval
   6: //! with strict verification order and fail-closed semantics.
   7: 
   8: use std::fs;
   9: use std::io::{Read, Write};
  10: use std::net::{TcpStream, ToSocketAddrs};
  11: use std::path::Path;
  12: use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
  13: 
  14: use ed25519_dalek::{Signature, Verifier, VerifyingKey};
  15: 
  16: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
  17: pub enum FetchError {
  18:     Network(String),
  19:     SignatureInvalid(String),
  20:     Stale(String),
  21:     WatermarkRejected(String),
  22:     InvalidResponse(String),
  23: }
  24: 
  25: impl std::fmt::Display for FetchError {
  26:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
  27:         match self {
  28:             FetchError::Network(e) => write!(f, "network error: {e}"),
  29:             FetchError::SignatureInvalid(e) => write!(f, "signature invalid: {e}"),
  30:             FetchError::Stale(e) => write!(f, "bundle stale: {e}"),
  31:             FetchError::WatermarkRejected(e) => write!(f, "watermark rejected: {e}"),
  32:             FetchError::InvalidResponse(e) => write!(f, "invalid response: {e}"),
  33:         }
  34:     }
  35: }
  36: 
  37: impl std::error::Error for FetchError {}
  38: 
  39: pub struct StateFetcher {
  40:     control_endpoint: String,
  41:     watermark_store: WatermarkStore,
  42:     verifying_key: VerifyingKey,
  43: }
  44: 
  45: impl StateFetcher {
  46:     pub fn new(
  47:         control_endpoint: String,
  48:         watermark_path: impl AsRef<Path>,
  49:         verifying_key: VerifyingKey,
  50:     ) -> Result<Self, String> {
  51:         let watermark_store = WatermarkStore::new(watermark_path)?;
  52:         Ok(Self {
  53:             control_endpoint,
  54:             watermark_store,
  55:             verifying_key,
  56:         })
  57:     }
  58: 
  59:     pub fn fetch_assignment(&mut self) -> Result<SignedBundle, FetchError> {
  60:         self.fetch_bundle("assignment")
  61:     }
  62: 
  63:     pub fn fetch_traversal(&mut self) -> Result<SignedBundle, FetchError> {
  64:         self.fetch_bundle("traversal")
  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     pub fn fetch_trust(&mut self) -> Result<SignedBundle, FetchError> {
  68:         self.fetch_bundle("trust")
  69:     }
  70: 
  71:     pub fn fetch_dns_zone(&mut self) -> Result<SignedBundle, FetchError> {
  72:         self.fetch_bundle("dns_zone")
  73:     }
  74: 
  75:     fn fetch_bundle(&mut self, bundle_type: &str) -> Result<SignedBundle, FetchError> {
  76:         // Step 1: Perform HTTP GET with mTLS client auth
  77:         // For now, simulate fetch (in production would use reqwest with mTLS)
  78:         let response_bytes =
  79:             self.http_get_raw(&format!("{}/{}", self.control_endpoint, bundle_type))?;
  80: 
  81:         self.process_response_bytes(bundle_type, &response_bytes)
  82:     }
  83: 
  84:     fn process_response_bytes(
  85:         &mut self,
  86:         bundle_type: &str,
  87:         response_bytes: &[u8],
  88:     ) -> Result<SignedBundle, FetchError> {
  89:         // Step 2: Parse response into signed bundle
  90:         let bundle = SignedBundle::parse(response_bytes).map_err(FetchError::InvalidResponse)?;
  91: 
  92:         // Step 3: Verify signature (fail → SignatureInvalid, watermark NOT advanced)
  93:         self.verify_signature(&bundle)
  94:             .map_err(FetchError::SignatureInvalid)?;
  95: 
  96:         // Step 4: Check freshness (fail → Stale, watermark NOT advanced)
  97:         self.check_freshness(&bundle).map_err(FetchError::Stale)?;
  98: 
  99:         // Step 5: Advance watermark (fail → WatermarkRejected)
 100:         self.watermark_store
 101:             .advance(bundle_type, bundle.watermark)
 102:             .map_err(FetchError::WatermarkRejected)?;
 103: 
 104:         Ok(bundle)
 105:     }
 106: 
 107:     fn http_get_raw(&self, url: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, FetchError> {
 108:         // Minimal HTTP/1.1 GET implementation using std::net::TcpStream
 109:         let url = url.trim();
 110:         if !url.starts_with("http://") {
 111:             return Err(FetchError::Network(
 112:                 "only http:// URLs are supported in this minimal fetcher".to_string(),
 113:             ));
 114:         }
 115:         let without_proto = &url[7..];
 116:         let parts: Vec<&str> = without_proto.splitn(2, '/').collect();
 117:         let host_port = parts
 118:             .first()
 119:             .ok_or_else(|| FetchError::Network("invalid url".to_string()))?;
 120:         let path = format!("/{}", parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&""));
 121:         let mut host = host_port.to_string();
 122:         let mut port = 80u16;
 123:         if host_port.contains(':') {
 124:             let mut hp = host_port.splitn(2, ':');
 125:             host = hp.next().unwrap_or("").to_string();
 126:             if let Some(p) = hp.next() {
 127:                 port = p
 128:                     .parse::<u16>()
 129:                     .map_err(|_| FetchError::Network("invalid port in url".to_string()))?;
 130:             }
 131:         }
 132:         let addr = format!("{host}:{port}");
 133: 
 134:         let socket_addrs = addr
 135:             .to_socket_addrs()
 136:             .map_err(|e| FetchError::Network(format!("resolve failed: {e}")))?;
 137:         let mut stream = match socket_addrs.into_iter().next() {
 138:             Some(sa) => TcpStream::connect_timeout(&sa, Duration::from_secs(3))
 139:                 .map_err(|_| FetchError::Network("network unreachable".to_string()))?,
 140:             None => {
 141:                 return Err(FetchError::Network(
 142:                     "resolve returned no addresses".to_string(),
 143:                 ));
 144:             }
 145:         };
 146: 
 147:         stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).ok();
 148:         stream.set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).ok();
 149: 
 150:         let request = format!("GET {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {host}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n");
 151:         stream
 152:             .write_all(request.as_bytes())
 153:             .map_err(|e| FetchError::Network(format!("write failed: {e}")))?;
 154: 
 155:         let mut buf = Vec::new();
 156:         stream
 157:             .read_to_end(&mut buf)
 158:             .map_err(|e| FetchError::Network(format!("read failed: {e}")))?;
 159: 
 160:         if let Some(idx) = buf.windows(4).position(|w| w == b"\r\n\r\n") {
 161:             Ok(buf.split_off(idx + 4))
 162:         } else {
 163:             Err(FetchError::InvalidResponse(
 164:                 "malformed http response".to_string(),
 165:             ))
 166:         }
 167:     }
 168: 
 169:     fn verify_signature(&self, bundle: &SignedBundle) -> Result<(), String> {
 170:         let signature = Signature::from_bytes(&bundle.signature);
 171:         self.verifying_key
 172:             .verify(bundle.payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
 173:             .map_err(|e| format!("signature verification failed: {e}"))
 174:     }
 175: 
 176:     fn check_freshness(&self, bundle: &SignedBundle) -> Result<(), String> {
 177:         // System clock before UNIX_EPOCH is fail-closed evidence of a
 178:         // misconfigured / attacker-rolled-back host clock. Refuse to
 179:         // accept any signed bundle in that state rather than panic
 180:         // and crash the daemon (which would tear down enforced
 181:         // routes). Net effect: stale-bundle rejection by another
 182:         // name — same fail-closed posture, no crash.
 183:         let now_unix = SystemTime::now()
 184:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 185:             .map_err(|err| {
 186:                 format!(
 187:                     "host clock is before UNIX_EPOCH ({err}); refusing signed bundle freshness check until clock is corrected"
 188:                 )
 189:             })?
 190:             .as_secs();
 191: 
 192:         if bundle.expires_at_unix < now_unix {
 193:             return Err(format!(
 194:                 "bundle expired at {} (now: {})",
 195:                 bundle.expires_at_unix, now_unix
 196:             ));
 197:         }
 198: 
 199:         Ok(())
 200:     }
 201: }
 202: 
 203: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 204: pub struct SignedBundle {
 205:     pub payload: String,
 206:     pub signature: [u8; 64],
 207:     pub issued_at_unix: u64,
 208:     pub expires_at_unix: u64,
 209:     pub watermark: u64,
 210: }
 211: 
 212: impl SignedBundle {
 213:     pub fn parse(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, String> {
 214:         let text =
 215:             std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| "bundle is not valid utf8".to_string())?;
 216: 
 217:         let sig_marker = "signature=";
 218:         let mut signature_bytes = [0u8; 64];
 219:         let mut found_sig = false;
 220: 
 221:         let mut issued_at_unix = 0;
 222:         let mut expires_at_unix = 0;
 223:         let mut watermark = 0;
 224: 
 225:         // Reject malformed integer fields explicitly. The previous
 226:         // `unwrap_or(0)` silently mapped bad input to 0, which:
 227:         //   - was fail-closed for `expires_at_unix` (0 < now_unix
 228:         //     means "expired", caller rejects);
 229:         //   - was fail-closed for `nonce` IF the watermark store
 230:         //     already had a non-zero current watermark (replay
 231:         //     check rejects 0);
 232:         //   - but on a freshly-initialised host with no prior
 233:         //     watermark, a `nonce=garbage` bundle parses as
 234:         //     watermark=0 and the watermark store accepts it (its
 235:         //     check is `new <= current` and current=0 here means
 236:         //     "no prior bundle accepted" — but a malformed nonce
 237:         //     is NOT the same as a nonce of 0). Tightening this
 238:         //     means a malformed bundle is rejected at parse time,
 239:         //     never reaching the verifier or watermark store.
 240:         for line in text.lines() {
 241:             if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(sig_marker) {
 242:                 let hex_str = rest.trim();
 243:                 let decoded = hex_decode(hex_str)?;
 244:                 if decoded.len() != 64 {
 245:                     return Err("invalid signature length".to_string());
 246:                 }
 247:                 signature_bytes.copy_from_slice(&decoded);
 248:                 found_sig = true;
 249:             } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("generated_at_unix=") {
 250:                 issued_at_unix = rest
 251:                     .trim()
 252:                     .parse()
 253:                     .map_err(|err| format!("invalid generated_at_unix: {err}"))?;
 254:             } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("expires_at_unix=") {
 255:                 expires_at_unix = rest
 256:                     .trim()
 257:                     .parse()
 258:                     .map_err(|err| format!("invalid expires_at_unix: {err}"))?;
 259:             } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("nonce=") {
 260:                 watermark = rest
 261:                     .trim()
 262:                     .parse()
 263:                     .map_err(|err| format!("invalid nonce: {err}"))?;
 264:             }
 265:         }
 266: 
 267:         if !found_sig {
 268:             return Err("missing signature".to_string());
 269:         }
 270: 
 271:         let sig_idx = text.rfind(sig_marker).ok_or("signature marker missing")?;
 272:         let payload = text[..sig_idx].to_string();
 273: 
 274:         Ok(Self {
 275:             payload,
 276:             signature: signature_bytes,
 277:             issued_at_unix,
 278:             expires_at_unix,
 279:             watermark,
 280:         })
 281:     }
 282: }
 283: 
 284: pub struct WatermarkStore {
 285:     path: std::path::PathBuf,
 286:     watermarks: std::collections::HashMap<String, u64>,
 287: }
 288: 
 289: impl WatermarkStore {
 290:     pub fn new(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Result<Self, String> {
 291:         let path = path.as_ref().to_path_buf();
 292:         let watermarks = if path.exists() {
 293:             Self::load_from_disk(&path)?
 294:         } else {
 295:             std::collections::HashMap::new()
 296:         };
 297: 
 298:         Ok(Self { path, watermarks })
 299:     }
 300: 
 301:     pub fn advance(&mut self, bundle_type: &str, new_watermark: u64) -> Result<(), String> {
 302:         let current = self.watermarks.get(bundle_type).copied().unwrap_or(0);
 303: 
 304:         if new_watermark <= current {
 305:             return Err(format!(
 306:                 "watermark replay: new={new_watermark} <= current={current}"
 307:             ));
 308:         }
 309: 
 310:         self.watermarks
 311:             .insert(bundle_type.to_string(), new_watermark);
 312:         self.persist_to_disk()?;
 313: 
 314:         Ok(())
 315:     }
 316: 
 317:     pub fn get(&self, bundle_type: &str) -> Option<u64> {
 318:         self.watermarks.get(bundle_type).copied()
 319:     }
 320: 
 321:     fn load_from_disk(path: &Path) -> Result<std::collections::HashMap<String, u64>, String> {
 322:         let content =
 323:             fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| format!("failed to read watermark store: {e}"))?;
 324: 
 325:         let mut watermarks = std::collections::HashMap::new();
 326:         for line in content.lines() {
 327:             if line.trim().is_empty() {
 328:                 continue;
 329:             }
 330:             let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split('=').collect();
 331:             if parts.len() != 2 {
 332:                 return Err(format!("malformed watermark line: {line}"));
 333:             }
 334:             let key = parts[0].to_string();
 335:             let value = parts[1]
 336:                 .parse::<u64>()
 337:                 .map_err(|e| format!("invalid watermark value: {e}"))?;
 338:             watermarks.insert(key, value);
 339:         }
 340: 
 341:         Ok(watermarks)
 342:     }
 343: 
 344:     fn persist_to_disk(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
 345:         let mut content = String::new();
 346:         for (key, value) in &self.watermarks {
 347:             content.push_str(&format!("{key}={value}\n"));
 348:         }
 349: 
 350:         fs::write(&self.path, content)
 351:             .map_err(|e| format!("failed to write watermark store: {e}"))?;
 352: 
 353:         // Ensure 0600 permissions
 354:         #[cfg(unix)]
 355:         {
 356:             use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
 357:             let metadata = fs::metadata(&self.path)
 358:                 .map_err(|e| format!("failed to read watermark metadata: {e}"))?;
 359:             let mut permissions = metadata.permissions();
 360:             permissions.set_mode(0o600);
 361:             fs::set_permissions(&self.path, permissions)
 362:                 .map_err(|e| format!("failed to set watermark permissions: {e}"))?;
 363:         }
 364: 
 365:         Ok(())
 366:     }
 367: }
 368: 
 369: pub struct RefreshScheduler {
 370:     pre_expiry_margin_secs: u64,
 371:     jitter_max_secs: u64,
 372: }
 373: 
 374: impl Default for RefreshScheduler {
 375:     fn default() -> Self {
 376:         Self {
 377:             pre_expiry_margin_secs: 120,
 378:             jitter_max_secs: 30,
 379:         }
 380:     }
 381: }
 382: 
 383: impl RefreshScheduler {
 384:     pub fn new(pre_expiry_margin_secs: u64, jitter_max_secs: u64) -> Self {
 385:         Self {
 386:             pre_expiry_margin_secs,
 387:             jitter_max_secs,
 388:         }
 389:     }
 390: 
 391:     pub fn next_refresh_at(&self, bundle_expires_at: SystemTime) -> Instant {
 392:         let now = SystemTime::now();
 393:         let target = bundle_expires_at - Duration::from_secs(self.pre_expiry_margin_secs);
 394: 
 395:         let jitter_secs = rand::random::<u64>() % self.jitter_max_secs;
 396:         let target_with_jitter = target + Duration::from_secs(jitter_secs);
 397: 
 398:         if target_with_jitter <= now {
 399:             // Already past, schedule soon
 400:             Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5)
 401:         } else {
 402:             let duration_until_target = target_with_jitter
 403:                 .duration_since(now)
 404:                 .unwrap_or(Duration::from_secs(5));
 405:             Instant::now() + duration_until_target
 406:         }
 407:     }
 408: }
 409: 
 410: fn hex_decode(s: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
 411:     if !s.len().is_multiple_of(2) {
 412:         return Err("hex string has odd length".to_string());
 413:     }
 414:     (0..s.len())
 415:         .step_by(2)
 416:         .map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&s[i..i + 2], 16).map_err(|_| "invalid hex char".to_string()))
 417:         .collect()
 418: }

 526:     fn signed_bundle_bytes(
 527:         signing_key: &SigningKey,
 528:         generated_at_unix: u64,
 529:         expires_at_unix: u64,
 530:         nonce: u64,
 531:     ) -> Vec<u8> {

 533:             "version=1\ngenerated_at_unix={generated_at_unix}\nexpires_at_unix={expires_at_unix}\nnonce={nonce}\n"
 534:         );

 536:         format!(

 560:     fn test_signed_bundle_parse_rejects_malformed_expires_at_unix() {
 561:         let body = b"version=1\ngenerated_at_unix=1\nexpires_at_unix=not-a-number\nnonce=1\nsignature=00\n";
 562:         let err = super::SignedBundle::parse(body).expect_err("malformed integer must reject");
 563:         assert!(
 564:             err.contains("invalid expires_at_unix"),
 565:             "rejection must cite the field: {err}"
 566:         );
 567:     }
 568: 
 569:     #[test]
 570:     fn test_signed_bundle_parse_rejects_malformed_nonce() {
 571:         // Most security-relevant of the three: a bundle with
 572:         // `nonce=garbage` previously parsed as watermark=0, which on
 573:         // a fresh watermark store (no prior bundle) would pass the
 574:         // replay check (`new <= current` with current=0). Tightening
 575:         // the parse rejects garbage at the bundle layer so the
 576:         // watermark store never sees it.
 577:         let body =
 578:             b"version=1\ngenerated_at_unix=1\nexpires_at_unix=10\nnonce=garbage\nsignature=00\n";
 579:         let err = super::SignedBundle::parse(body).expect_err("malformed nonce must reject");
 580:         assert!(
 581:             err.contains("invalid nonce"),
 582:             "rejection must cite the field: {err}"
 583:         );
 584:     }
 585: 
 586:     #[test]
 587:     fn test_signed_bundle_parse_rejects_overflow_nonce() {
 588:         // u64 max is 18446744073709551615; appending a digit
 589:         // overflows the parse.
 590:         let body = b"version=1\ngenerated_at_unix=1\nexpires_at_unix=10\nnonce=184467440737095516159\nsignature=00\n";
 591:         let err = super::SignedBundle::parse(body).expect_err("overflow nonce must reject");
 592:         assert!(err.contains("invalid nonce"), "unexpected error: {err}");
 593:     }
 594: 
 595:     #[test]
 596:     fn test_signed_bundle_parse_rejects_negative_generated_at_unix() {
 597:         // unsigned integer parser rejects '-1'.
 598:         let body = b"version=1\ngenerated_at_unix=-1\nexpires_at_unix=10\nnonce=1\nsignature=00\n";
 599:         let err =
 600:             super::SignedBundle::parse(body).expect_err("negative generated_at_unix must reject");
 601:         assert!(
 602:             err.contains("invalid generated_at_unix"),
 603:             "unexpected error: {err}"
 604:         );
 605:     }
 606: 
 607:     #[test]
 608:     fn test_signed_bundle_parse_rejects_empty_input() {
 609:         let err = super::SignedBundle::parse(b"").expect_err("empty input must reject");
 610:         // Empty body has no signature= line — falls into the
 611:         // `missing signature` rejection arm, which is the same
 612:         // failure-shape an attacker would get with any signature-
 613:         // less payload.
 614:         assert!(err.contains("missing signature"), "unexpected error: {err}");
 615:     }

 624:     #[test]
 625:     fn test_signed_bundle_parse_rejects_signature_with_odd_hex_length() {
 626:         // hex_decode rejects odd-length hex strings. Even though the
 627:         // length check on the decoded bytes (== 64) would also
 628:         // reject this, catching the parse error earlier means we
 629:         // never allocate the (possibly huge) buffer for the decode.
 630:         let body = b"version=1\ngenerated_at_unix=1\nexpires_at_unix=10\nnonce=1\nsignature=abc\n";
 631:         let err = super::SignedBundle::parse(body).expect_err("odd-length hex must reject");
 632:         assert!(err.contains("odd length"), "unexpected error: {err}");
 633:     }
 634:

 639:         let err = super::SignedBundle::parse(body).expect_err("short signature must reject");

   5: #[derive(Debug)]
   6: pub enum RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError {
   7:     Io(std::io::Error),
   8:     MissingSignature,
   9:     InvalidSignatureHex(String),
  10:     MissingSubject,
  11:     MissingNonce,
  12:     MissingCommand,
  13:     InvalidFormat,
  14:     InvalidNonce(String),
  15: }
  16: 
  17: impl std::fmt::Display for RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError {
  18:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
  19:         match self {
  20:             Self::Io(e) => write!(f, "io error: {e}"),
  21:             Self::MissingSignature => write!(f, "missing signature"),
  22:             Self::InvalidSignatureHex(e) => write!(f, "invalid signature hex: {e}"),
  23:             Self::MissingSubject => write!(f, "missing subject"),
  24:             Self::MissingNonce => write!(f, "missing nonce"),
  25:             Self::MissingCommand => write!(f, "missing command"),
  26:             Self::InvalidFormat => write!(f, "invalid format"),
  27:             Self::InvalidNonce(e) => write!(f, "invalid nonce: {e}"),
  28:         }
  29:     }
  30: }
  31: 
  32: impl std::error::Error for RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError {}
  33: 
  34: impl From<std::io::Error> for RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError {
  35:     fn from(err: std::io::Error) -> Self {
  36:         Self::Io(err)
  37:     }
  38: }

  40: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
  41: pub enum IpcCommand {
  42:     Status,
  43:     Netcheck,
  44:     StateRefresh,
  45:     ExitNodeSelect(String),
  46:     ExitNodeOff,
  47:     LanAccessOn,
  48:     LanAccessOff,
  49:     DnsInspect,
  50:     RouteAdvertise(String),
  51:     KeyRotate,
  52:     KeyRevoke,
  53:     Unknown(String),
  54: }
  55: 
  56: impl IpcCommand {
  57:     pub fn is_mutating(&self) -> bool {
  58:         matches!(
  59:             self,
  60:             IpcCommand::ExitNodeSelect(_)
  61:                 | IpcCommand::ExitNodeOff
  62:                 | IpcCommand::LanAccessOn
  63:                 | IpcCommand::LanAccessOff
  64:                 | IpcCommand::StateRefresh
  65:                 | IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise(_)
  66:                 | IpcCommand::KeyRotate
  67:                 | IpcCommand::KeyRevoke
  68:         )
  69:     }
  70: 
  71:     pub fn as_wire(&self) -> String {
  72:         match self {
  73:             IpcCommand::Status => "status".to_string(),
  74:             IpcCommand::Netcheck => "netcheck".to_string(),
  75:             IpcCommand::StateRefresh => "state refresh".to_string(),
  76:             IpcCommand::ExitNodeSelect(node) => format!("exit-node select {node}"),
  77:             IpcCommand::ExitNodeOff => "exit-node off".to_string(),
  78:             IpcCommand::LanAccessOn => "lan-access on".to_string(),
  79:             IpcCommand::LanAccessOff => "lan-access off".to_string(),
  80:             IpcCommand::DnsInspect => "dns inspect".to_string(),
  81:             IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise(cidr) => format!("route advertise {cidr}"),
  82:             IpcCommand::KeyRotate => "key rotate".to_string(),
  83:             IpcCommand::KeyRevoke => "key revoke".to_string(),
  84:             IpcCommand::Unknown(raw) => raw.clone(),
  85:         }
  86:     }
  87: }
  88: 
  89: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
  90: pub struct IpcResponse {
  91:     pub ok: bool,
  92:     pub message: String,
  93: }
  94: 
  95: impl IpcResponse {
  96:     pub fn ok(message: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
  97:         Self {
  98:             ok: true,
  99:             message: message.into(),
 100:         }
 101:     }
 102: 
 103:     pub fn err(message: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
 104:         Self {
 105:             ok: false,
 106:             message: message.into(),
 107:         }
 108:     }
 109: 
 110:     pub fn to_wire(&self) -> String {
 111:         let status = if self.ok { "ok" } else { "err" };
 112:         format!("{status}|{}", self.message.replace('\n', " "))
 113:     }
 114: 
 115:     pub fn from_wire(value: &str) -> Self {
 116:         let trimmed = value.trim();
 117:         let mut parts = trimmed.splitn(2, '|');
 118:         let status = parts.next().unwrap_or("err");
 119:         let message = parts.next().unwrap_or("invalid response").to_string();
 120:         Self {
 121:             ok: status == "ok",
 122:             message,
 123:         }
 124:     }
 125: }
 126: 
 127: pub fn parse_command(raw: &str) -> IpcCommand {
 128:     let tokens = raw
 129:         .split_whitespace()
 130:         .map(ToString::to_string)
 131:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 132:     match tokens.as_slice() {
 133:         [cmd] if cmd == "status" => IpcCommand::Status,
 134:         [cmd] if cmd == "netcheck" => IpcCommand::Netcheck,
 135:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "state" && subcmd == "refresh" => IpcCommand::StateRefresh,
 136:         [cmd, subcmd, node] if cmd == "exit-node" && subcmd == "select" => {
 137:             IpcCommand::ExitNodeSelect(node.clone())
 138:         }
 139:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "exit-node" && subcmd == "off" => IpcCommand::ExitNodeOff,
 140:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "lan-access" && subcmd == "on" => IpcCommand::LanAccessOn,
 141:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "lan-access" && subcmd == "off" => IpcCommand::LanAccessOff,
 142:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "dns" && subcmd == "inspect" => IpcCommand::DnsInspect,
 143:         [cmd, subcmd, cidr] if cmd == "route" && subcmd == "advertise" => {
 144:             IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise(cidr.clone())
 145:         }
 146:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "key" && subcmd == "rotate" => IpcCommand::KeyRotate,
 147:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "key" && subcmd == "revoke" => IpcCommand::KeyRevoke,
 148:         _ => IpcCommand::Unknown(raw.trim().to_string()),
 149:     }
 150: }
 151: 
 152: pub fn validate_cidr(value: &str) -> bool {
 153:     if value.len() < 3 || value.len() > 43 {
 154:         return false;
 155:     }
 156:     if !value.contains('/') {
 157:         return false;
 158:     }
 159:     value
 160:         .chars()
 161:         .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_hexdigit() || ch == '.' || ch == ':' || ch == '/')
 162: }
 163: 
 164: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 165: pub struct RemoteCommandEnvelope {
 166:     pub subject: String,
 167:     pub nonce: u64,
 168:     pub command: IpcCommand,
 169:     pub signature: Vec<u8>,
 170: }
 171: 
 172: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 173: pub enum CommandEnvelope {
 174:     Local(IpcCommand),
 175:     Remote(RemoteCommandEnvelope),
 176: }
 177: 
 178: pub const REMOTE_OPS_WIRE_PREFIX: &str = "remote-op-v1 ";
 179: pub const DEFAULT_REMOTE_OPS_EXPECTED_SUBJECT: &str = "user:admin";
 180: pub const MAX_COMMAND_BYTES: u64 = 4096;
 181: 
 182: pub fn remote_ops_signature_payload(subject: &str, nonce: u64, command: &IpcCommand) -> Vec<u8> {
 183:     format!(
 184:         "subject={}\nnonce={}\ncommand={}\n",
 185:         subject,
 186:         nonce,
 187:         command.as_wire()
 188:     )
 189:     .into_bytes()
 190: }
 191: 
 192: pub fn read_command_envelope<R: std::io::Read>(
 193:     stream: R,
 194: ) -> Result<CommandEnvelope, RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError> {
 195:     let mut reader = std::io::BufReader::new(stream.take(MAX_COMMAND_BYTES));
 196:     let mut line = String::new();
 197:     reader.read_line(&mut line)?;
 198:     let line = line.trim();
 199:     if line.is_empty() {
 200:         return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, "empty command").into());
 201:     }
 202:     if line.contains('\0') {
 203:         return Err(std::io::Error::new(
 204:             std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
 205:             "command contains null byte",
 206:         )
 207:         .into());
 208:     }
 209: 
 210:     if let Some(payload) = line.strip_prefix(REMOTE_OPS_WIRE_PREFIX) {
 211:         // expected format: subject=<sub|b64> nonce=<u64> command=<wire> signature=<hex>
 212: 
 213:         let parts: Vec<&str> = payload.split(" signature=").collect();
 214:         if parts.len() != 2 {
 215:             return Err(RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError::MissingSignature);
 216:         }
 217:         let content = parts[0];
 218:         let signature_hex = parts[1];
 219: 
 220:         let signature = (0..signature_hex.len())
 221:             .step_by(2)
 222:             .map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&signature_hex[i..i + 2], 16))
 223:             .collect::<Result<Vec<u8>, _>>()
 224:             .map_err(|e| RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError::InvalidSignatureHex(e.to_string()))?;
 225: 
 226:         // content: subject=... nonce=... command=...
 227:         let mut parts = content.splitn(3, ' ');
 228:         let subject_part = parts
 229:             .next()
 230:             .ok_or(RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError::MissingSubject)?;
 231:         let nonce_part = parts
 232:             .next()
 233:             .ok_or(RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError::MissingNonce)?;
 234:         let command_part = parts
 235:             .next()
 236:             .ok_or(RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError::MissingCommand)?;
 237: 
 238:         if !subject_part.starts_with("subject=")
 239:             || !nonce_part.starts_with("nonce=")
 240:             || !command_part.starts_with("command=")
 241:         {
 242:             return Err(RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError::InvalidFormat);
 243:         }
 244: 
 245:         let subject = subject_part["subject=".len()..].to_string();
 246:         let nonce = nonce_part["nonce=".len()..]
 247:             .parse::<u64>()
 248:             .map_err(|e| RemoteOpsEnvelopeParseError::InvalidNonce(e.to_string()))?;
 249:         let command_wire = &command_part["command=".len()..];
 250: 
 251:         let command = parse_command(command_wire);
 252: 
 253:         Ok(CommandEnvelope::Remote(RemoteCommandEnvelope {
 254:             subject,
 255:             nonce,
 256:             command,
 257:             signature,
 258:         }))
 259:     } else {
 260:         Ok(CommandEnvelope::Local(parse_command(line)))
 261:     }
 262: }
