 594: 
 595: impl LinuxCommandSystem {
 596:     pub fn new(
 597:         interface_name: impl Into<String>,
 598:         egress_interface: impl Into<String>,
 599:         mode: LinuxDataplaneMode,
 600:         privileged_client: Option<PrivilegedCommandClient>,
 601:         fail_closed_ssh_allow: bool,
 602:         fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs: Vec<ManagementCidr>,
 603:     ) -> Result<Self, SystemError> {
 604:         let interface_name = interface_name.into();
 605:         let egress_interface = egress_interface.into();
 606:         validate_net_device_name(&interface_name)
 607:             .map_err(|message| SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(message.to_string()))?;
 608:         validate_net_device_name(&egress_interface)
 609:             .map_err(|message| SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(message.to_string()))?;
 610:         if fail_closed_ssh_allow && fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs.is_empty() {
 611:             return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(
 612:                 "fail-closed ssh allow is enabled but no management cidrs were provided"
 613:                     .to_string(),
 614:             ));
 615:         }
 616: 
 617:         Ok(Self {
 618:             interface_name,
 619:             egress_interface,
 620:             mode,
 621:             privileged_client,
 622:             generation: 0,
 623:             fail_closed_ssh_allow,
 624:             fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs,
 625:             firewall_table: None,
 626:             nat_table: None,
 627:             prior_ipv4_forwarding: None,
 628:             prior_ipv6_disabled: None,
 629:             allow_tunnel_relay_forward: false,
 630:             traversal_bootstrap_allow_endpoints: Vec::new(),
 631:             dns_protected: false,
 632:             expected_management_bypass_routes: BTreeSet::new(),
 633:             expected_peer_endpoint_bypass_routes: BTreeSet::new(),
 634:         })
 635:     }
 636: 
 637:     pub fn with_traversal_bootstrap_allow_endpoints(mut self, endpoints: Vec<SocketAddr>) -> Self {
 638:         self.traversal_bootstrap_allow_endpoints = dedupe_socket_addrs(endpoints);
 639:         self
 640:     }
 641: 
 642:     fn run(&self, program: PrivilegedCommandProgram, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
 643:         let output = self.run_capture(program, args)?;
 644:         if output.success() {
 645:             return Ok(());
 646:         }
 647:         Err(SystemError::Io(format!(
 648:             "{} exited unsuccessfully: status={} stderr={}",
 649:             program.as_str(),
 650:             output.status,
 651:             output.stderr
 652:         )))
 653:     }
 654: 
 655:     fn run_allow_failure(&self, program: PrivilegedCommandProgram, args: &[&str]) {
 656:         let _ = self.run_capture(program, args);
 657:     }
 658: 
 659:     fn run_capture(
 660:         &self,
 661:         program: PrivilegedCommandProgram,
 662:         args: &[&str],
 663:     ) -> Result<PrivilegedCommandOutput, SystemError> {
 664:         if let Some(client) = self.privileged_client.as_ref() {
 665:             return client.run_capture(program, args).map_err(SystemError::Io);
 666:         }
 667: 
 668:         let binary = resolve_binary_path_for_program(program).map_err(|err| {
 669:             SystemError::Io(format!(
 670:                 "{} binary resolution failed: {err}",
 671:                 program.as_str()
 672:             ))
 673:         })?;
 674:         let output = Command::new(&binary).args(args).output().map_err(|err| {
 675:             SystemError::Io(format!(
 676:                 "{} spawn failed ({}): {err}",
 677:                 program.as_str(),
 678:                 binary.display()
 679:             ))
 680:         })?;
 681:         Ok(PrivilegedCommandOutput {
 682:             status: output.status.code().unwrap_or(-1),
 683:             stdout: String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string(),
 684:             stderr: String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string(),
 685:         })
 686:     }
 687: 
 688:     fn apply_fail_closed_management_allow_rules(&self, table: &str) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
 689:         if !self.fail_closed_ssh_allow {
 690:             return Ok(());
 691:         }
 692:         for cidr in &self.fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs {
 693:             let cidr_text = cidr.to_string();
 694:             self.run(
 695:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
 696:                 &[
 697:                     "add",
 698:                     "rule",
 699:                     "inet",
 700:                     table,
 701:                     "killswitch",
 702:                     cidr.nft_family(),
 703:                     "daddr",
 704:                     cidr_text.as_str(),
 705:                     "tcp",
 706:                     "dport",
 707:                     "22",
 708:                     "accept",
 709:                 ],
 710:             )
 711:             .map_err(|err| {
 712:                 SystemError::FirewallApplyFailed(format!(
 713:                     "management ssh fail-closed allow rule failed for {cidr_text}: {err}"
 714:                 ))
 715:             })?;
 716:             // The killswitch only filters outbound traffic. Allowing destination
 717:             // port 22 preserves node-initiated SSH, but inbound management SSH
 718:             // also needs sshd reply packets (source port 22) to escape the
 719:             // host under fail-closed policy.
 720:             self.run(
 721:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
 722:                 &[
 723:                     "add",
 724:                     "rule",
 725:                     "inet",
 726:                     table,
 727:                     "killswitch",
 728:                     cidr.nft_family(),
 729:                     "daddr",
 730:                     cidr_text.as_str(),
 731:                     "tcp",
 732:                     "sport",
 733:                     "22",
 734:                     "accept",
 735:                 ],
 736:             )
 737:             .map_err(|err| {
 738:                 SystemError::FirewallApplyFailed(format!(
 739:                     "management ssh reply fail-closed allow rule failed for {cidr_text}: {err}"
 740:                 ))
 741:             })?;
 742:         }
 743:         Ok(())
 744:     }
 745: 
 746:     fn apply_traversal_bootstrap_allow_rules(&self, table: &str) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
 747:         for endpoint in &self.traversal_bootstrap_allow_endpoints {
 748:             let args = Self::traversal_bootstrap_allow_rule_args(
 749:                 table,
 750:                 self.egress_interface.as_str(),
 751:                 *endpoint,
 752:             );
 753:             let arg_refs = args.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 754:             self.run(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft, &arg_refs)
 755:                 .map_err(|err| {
 756:                     SystemError::FirewallApplyFailed(format!(
 757:                         "traversal bootstrap allow rule failed for {endpoint}: {err}"
 758:                     ))
 759:                 })?;
 760:         }
 761:         Ok(())
 762:     }
 763: 
 764:     fn apply_fail_closed_management_bypass_routes(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
 765:         self.expected_management_bypass_routes.clear();
 766:         if !self.fail_closed_ssh_allow {
 767:             return Ok(());
 768:         }
 769:         for cidr in &self.fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs {
 770:             // Management SSH must stay on the underlay interface. Resolving the
 771:             // current FIB here can return the tunnel once exit-mode policy
 772:             // routing is already active, which black-holes the control plane.
 773:             let args = Self::management_bypass_route_args(cidr, self.egress_interface.as_str());
 774:             let arg_refs = args.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 775:             let result = self.run(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip, &arg_refs);
 776:             result.map_err(|err| {
 777:                 SystemError::RouteApplyFailed(format!(
 778:                     "management ssh bypass route failed for {cidr}: {err}"
 779:                 ))
 780:             })?;
 781:             self.expected_management_bypass_routes
 782:                 .insert(Self::expected_bypass_route(
 783:                     cidr.to_string(),
 784:                     self.egress_interface.clone(),
 785:                 ));
 786:         }
 787:         Ok(())
 788:     }
 789: 
 790:     fn resolve_route_interface_for_ip(&self, target_ip: IpAddr) -> Result<String, SystemError> {
 791:         let mut args = Vec::with_capacity(4);
 792:         if matches!(target_ip, IpAddr::V6(_)) {
 793:             args.push("-6".to_string());
 794:         }
 795:         args.push("route".to_string());
 796:         args.push("get".to_string());
 797:         args.push(target_ip.to_string());
 798:         let arg_refs = args.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 799:         let output = self.run_capture(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip, &arg_refs)?;
 800:         if !output.success() {
 801:             return Err(SystemError::RouteApplyFailed(format!(
 802:                 "route interface resolution failed for {target_ip}: status={} stderr={}",
 803:                 output.status,
 804:                 output.stderr.trim()
 805:             )));
 806:         }
 807:         let tokens = output.stdout.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
 808:         for (index, token) in tokens.iter().enumerate() {
 809:             if *token == "dev" {
 810:                 let Some(interface) = tokens.get(index + 1) else {
 811:                     break;
 812:                 };
 813:                 validate_net_device_name(interface).map_err(|message| {
 814:                     SystemError::RouteApplyFailed(format!(
 815:                         "route interface resolution returned invalid interface for {target_ip}: {message}"
 816:                     ))
 817:                 })?;
 818:                 return Ok((*interface).to_string());
 819:             }
 820:         }
 821:         Err(SystemError::RouteApplyFailed(format!(
 822:             "route interface resolution failed for {target_ip}: missing dev in output={}",
 823:             output.stdout.trim()
 824:         )))
 825:     }
 826: 
 827:     fn route_table_output(&self, family: RouteTableFamily) -> Result<String, SystemError> {
 828:         let args = match family {
 829:             RouteTableFamily::V4 => ["-4", "route", "show", "table", "51820"],
 830:             RouteTableFamily::V6 => ["-6", "route", "show", "table", "51820"],
 831:         };
 832:         let output = self.run_capture(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip, &args)?;
 833:         if output.success() {
 834:             return Ok(output.stdout);
 835:         }
 836:         Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(format!(
 837:             "{} failed: status={} stderr={}",
 838:             args.join(" "),
 839:             output.status,
 840:             output.stderr.trim()
 841:         )))
 842:     }
 843: 
 844:     fn nft_table_output(
 845:         &self,
 846:         family: &str,
 847:         table: &str,
 848:         context: &str,
 849:     ) -> Result<String, SystemError> {
 850:         let output = self.run_capture(
 851:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
 852:             &["list", "table", family, table],
 853:         )?;
 854:         if output.success() {
 855:             return Ok(output.stdout);
 856:         }
 857:         Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(format!(
 858:             "{context} failed: status={} stderr={}",
 859:             output.status,
 860:             output.stderr.trim()
 861:         )))
 862:     }
 863: 
 864:     fn normalize_ruleset_line(line: &str) -> String {
 865:         line.replace('"', "")
 866:     }
 867: 
 868:     fn nft_chain_lines(ruleset: &str, chain_name: &str) -> Option<Vec<String>> {
 869:         let mut in_chain = false;
 870:         let mut depth = 0usize;
 871:         let mut lines = Vec::new();
 872: 
 873:         for raw_line in ruleset.lines() {
 874:             let normalized = Self::normalize_ruleset_line(raw_line);
 875:             let trimmed = normalized.trim();
 876:             if !in_chain {
 877:                 if trimmed.starts_with(&format!("chain {chain_name}")) {
 878:                     in_chain = true;
 879:                     depth = depth
 880:                         .saturating_add(trimmed.matches('{').count())
 881:                         .saturating_sub(trimmed.matches('}').count());
 882:                 }
 883:                 continue;
 884:             }
 885: 
 886:             depth = depth
 887:                 .saturating_add(trimmed.matches('{').count())
 888:                 .saturating_sub(trimmed.matches('}').count());
 889:             if trimmed != "}" {
 890:                 lines.push(trimmed.to_string());
 891:             }
 892:             if depth == 0 {
 893:                 return Some(lines);
 894:             }
 895:         }
 896: 
 897:         None
 898:     }
 899: 
 900:     fn chain_contains_all_tokens(lines: &[String], tokens: &[&str]) -> bool {
 901:         lines
 902:             .iter()
 903:             .any(|line| tokens.iter().all(|token| line.contains(token)))
 904:     }
 905: 
 906:     fn assert_chain_contains(
 907:         &self,
 908:         chain_lines: &[String],
 909:         tokens: &[&str],
 910:         message: &str,
 911:     ) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
 912:         if Self::chain_contains_all_tokens(chain_lines, tokens) {
 913:             return Ok(());
 914:         }
 915:         Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(format!(
 916:             "{message}: missing tokens={} chain_lines={}",
 917:             tokens.join(" "),
 918:             chain_lines.join(" | ")
 919:         )))
 920:     }
 921: 
 922:     fn expected_bypass_route(addr_or_cidr: String, interface_name: String) -> ExpectedBypassRoute {
 923:         let family = if addr_or_cidr.contains(':') {
 924:             RouteTableFamily::V6
 925:         } else {
 926:             RouteTableFamily::V4
 927:         };
 928:         ExpectedBypassRoute {
 929:             destination: addr_or_cidr,
 930:             interface_name,
 931:             family,
 932:         }
 933:     }
 934: 
 935:     fn route_destination_matches_rendered(expected: &str, rendered: &str) -> bool {
 936:         if rendered == expected {
 937:             return true;
 938:         }
 939:         let Some((address, prefix)) = expected.split_once('/') else {
 940:             return false;
 941:         };
 942:         let host_prefix = if address.contains(':') { "128" } else { "32" };
 943:         prefix == host_prefix && rendered == address
 944:     }
 945: 
 946:     fn line_matches_expected_bypass_route(line: &str, route: &ExpectedBypassRoute) -> bool {
 947:         let mut tokens = line.split_whitespace();
 948:         let Some(destination) = tokens.next() else {
 949:             return false;
 950:         };
 951:         if !Self::route_destination_matches_rendered(route.destination.as_str(), destination) {
 952:             return false;
 953:         }
 954:         let token_vec: Vec<_> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
 955:         token_vec
 956:             .windows(2)
 957:             .any(|window| window[0] == "dev" && window[1] == route.interface_name.as_str())
 958:     }
 959: 
 960:     fn assert_expected_bypass_routes(&self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
 961:         let mut table_v4: Option<String> = None;
 962:         let mut table_v6: Option<String> = None;
 963:         for route in self
 964:             .expected_management_bypass_routes
 965:             .iter()
 966:             .chain(self.expected_peer_endpoint_bypass_routes.iter())
 967:         {
 968:             let table_output = match route.family {
 969:                 RouteTableFamily::V4 => {
 970:                     if table_v4.is_none() {
 971:                         table_v4 = Some(self.route_table_output(RouteTableFamily::V4)?);
 972:                     }
 973:                     table_v4.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
 974:                         SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(
 975:                             "missing cached ipv4 route table output".to_string(),
 976:                         )
 977:                     })?
 978:                 }
 979:                 RouteTableFamily::V6 => {
 980:                     if table_v6.is_none() {
 981:                         table_v6 = Some(self.route_table_output(RouteTableFamily::V6)?);
 982:                     }
 983:                     table_v6.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
 984:                         SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(
 985:                             "missing cached ipv6 route table output".to_string(),
 986:                         )
 987:                     })?
 988:                 }
 989:             };
 990:             if table_output
 991:                 .lines()
 992:                 .any(|line| Self::line_matches_expected_bypass_route(line, route))
 993:             {
 994:                 continue;
 995:             }
 996:             let expected = format!("{} dev {}", route.destination, route.interface_name);
 997:             return Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(format!(
 998:                 "missing owned bypass route in table 51820: expected={} output={}",
 999:                 expected,
1000:                 table_output.trim()
1001:             )));
1002:         }
1003:         Ok(())
1004:     }

1021:     fn assert_nat_forwarding(&self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1022:         let Some(table) = self.nat_table.as_deref() else {
1023:             return Ok(());
1024:         };
1025:         let ruleset = self.nft_table_output("ip", table, "nft list nat table")?;
1026:         let postrouting = Self::nft_chain_lines(&ruleset, "postrouting").ok_or_else(|| {
1027:             SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed("nat postrouting chain missing".to_string())
1028:         })?;
1029:         self.assert_chain_contains(
1030:             &postrouting,
1031:             &["oifname", self.egress_interface.as_str(), "masquerade"],
1032:             "egress masquerade rule missing",
1033:         )?;
1034:         if self.allow_tunnel_relay_forward {
1035:             self.assert_chain_contains(
1036:                 &postrouting,
1037:                 &[
1038:                     "iifname",
1039:                     self.interface_name.as_str(),
1040:                     "oifname",
1041:                     self.interface_name.as_str(),
1042:                     "masquerade",
1043:                 ],
1044:                 "relay-with-upstream masquerade rule missing",
1045:             )?;
1046:         }
1047:         let forwarding_enabled =
1048:             Self::read_sysctl_bool("/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward", "net.ipv4.ip_forward")?;
1049:         if forwarding_enabled {
1050:             return Ok(());
1051:         }
1052:         Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(
1053:             "ipv4 forwarding is disabled while nat forwarding is active".to_string(),
1054:         ))

1057:     fn assert_firewall_ruleset(&self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1058:         let table = self.firewall_table.clone().ok_or_else(|| {
1059:             SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed("killswitch table missing".to_string())
1060:         })?;
1061:         let ruleset = self.nft_table_output("inet", table.as_str(), "nft list killswitch table")?;
1062:         let killswitch = Self::nft_chain_lines(&ruleset, "killswitch").ok_or_else(|| {
1063:             SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed("killswitch chain missing".to_string())
1064:         })?;
1065:         let forward = Self::nft_chain_lines(&ruleset, "forward").ok_or_else(|| {
1066:             SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed("forward chain missing".to_string())
1067:         })?;
1068:         self.assert_chain_contains(
1069:             &killswitch,
1070:             &["oifname", "lo", "accept"],
1071:             "loopback killswitch allow rule missing",
1072:         )?;
1073:         self.assert_chain_contains(
1074:             &killswitch,
1075:             &["ct state established,related", "accept"],
1076:             "established/related killswitch allow rule missing",
1077:         )?;
1078:         self.assert_chain_contains(
1079:             &killswitch,
1080:             &["oifname", self.interface_name.as_str(), "accept"],
1081:             "tunnel-interface killswitch allow rule missing",
1082:         )?;

1084:             &forward,
1085:             &["ct state established,related", "accept"],

1088:         self.assert_chain_contains(
1089:             &forward,

1091:                 "iifname",
1092:                 self.interface_name.as_str(),

1094:                 self.egress_interface.as_str(),
1095:                 "accept",
1096:             ],
1097:             "forwarding allow rule to underlay egress missing",
1098:         )?;
1099:         if self.allow_tunnel_relay_forward {
1100:             self.assert_chain_contains(
1101:                 &forward,
1102:                 &[
1103:                     "iifname",
1104:                     self.interface_name.as_str(),
1105:                     "oifname",
1106:                     self.interface_name.as_str(),
1107:                     "accept",
1108:                 ],
1109:                 "relay-with-upstream forwarding allow rule missing",
1110:             )?;
1111:         }

1114:                 &killswitch,
1115:                 &["oifname", self.egress_interface.as_str(), "accept"],
1116:                 "egress-interface killswitch allow rule missing while nat forwarding is active",

1120:             self.assert_chain_contains(
1121:                 &killswitch,
1122:                 &[
1123:                     "udp",
1124:                     "dport",
1125:                     "53",
1126:                     "oifname",
1127:                     "!=",
1128:                     self.interface_name.as_str(),
1129:                     "drop",
1130:                 ],
1131:                 "dns udp fail-closed rule missing",
1132:             )?;
1133:             self.assert_chain_contains(
1134:                 &killswitch,
1135:                 &[
1136:                     "tcp",
1137:                     "dport",
1138:                     "53",
1139:                     "oifname",
1140:                     "!=",
1141:                     self.interface_name.as_str(),
1142:                     "drop",
1143:                 ],
1144:                 "dns tcp fail-closed rule missing",
1145:             )?;
1146:             self.assert_chain_contains(
1147:                 &killswitch,
1148:                 &["udp", "dport", "53", "accept"],

1150:             )?;

1306:     fn set_ipv4_forwarding(&self, enabled: bool) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1307:         let use_native_write = matches!(self.mode, LinuxDataplaneMode::HybridNative)
1308:             && self.privileged_client.is_none();
1309:         if use_native_write {
1310:             return fs::write(
1311:                 "/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward",
1312:                 if enabled { "1\n" } else { "0\n" },
1313:             )
1314:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::Io(format!("native ip_forward write failed: {err}")));
1315:         }
1316:         self.run(
1317:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Sysctl,
1318:             &[
1319:                 "-w",
1320:                 if enabled {
1321:                     "net.ipv4.ip_forward=1"
1322:                 } else {
1323:                     "net.ipv4.ip_forward=0"
1324:                 },
1325:             ],
1326:         )
1327:     }
1328: 
1329:     fn set_ipv6_disabled(&self, disabled: bool) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1330:         let use_native_write = matches!(self.mode, LinuxDataplaneMode::HybridNative)
1331:             && self.privileged_client.is_none();
1332:         if use_native_write {
1333:             return fs::write(
1334:                 "/proc/sys/net/ipv6/conf/all/disable_ipv6",
1335:                 if disabled { "1\n" } else { "0\n" },
1336:             )
1337:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::Io(format!("native ipv6 disable write failed: {err}")));
1338:         }
1339:         self.run(
1340:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Sysctl,
1341:             &[
1342:                 "-w",
1343:                 if disabled {
1344:                     "net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6=1"
1345:                 } else {
1346:                     "net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6=0"
1347:                 },
1348:             ],
1349:         )
1350:     }

1360:     fn ensure_failclosed_table(&mut self) -> Result<String, SystemError> {
1361:         let target_table = self.firewall_table_name();
1362:         if let Some(table) = self.firewall_table.clone()
1363:             && table == target_table
1364:         {
1365:             if self.killswitch_chain_exists(table.as_str())? {
1366:                 return Ok(table);
1367:             }
1368:             // The expected generation table exists in state but is missing its
1369:             // fail-closed chain on host. Recreate this generation table.
1370:             self.firewall_table = None;
1371:         }
1372: 
1373:         let table = target_table;
1374:         self.run_allow_failure(
1375:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1376:             &["delete", "table", "inet", table.as_str()],
1377:         );
1378:         self.run(
1379:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1380:             &["add", "table", "inet", table.as_str()],
1381:         )
1382:         .map_err(|err| SystemError::FirewallApplyFailed(err.to_string()))?;
1383:         self.run(
1384:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1385:             &[
1386:                 "add",
1387:                 "chain",
1388:                 "inet",
1389:                 table.as_str(),
1390:                 "killswitch",
1391:                 "{",
1392:                 "type",
1393:                 "filter",
1394:                 "hook",
1395:                 "output",
1396:                 "priority",
1397:                 "0",
1398:                 ";",
1399:                 "policy",
1400:                 "drop",
1401:                 ";",
1402:                 "}",
1403:             ],
1404:         )
1405:         .map_err(|err| SystemError::FirewallApplyFailed(err.to_string()))?;
1406:         self.apply_fail_closed_management_allow_rules(table.as_str())?;
1407:         self.apply_traversal_bootstrap_allow_rules(table.as_str())?;
1408:         self.firewall_table = Some(table.clone());
1409:         Ok(table)
1410:     }

1412:     fn read_sysctl_bool(path: &str, key: &str) -> Result<bool, SystemError> {
1413:         let raw = fs::read_to_string(path)
1414:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::Io(format!("read {key} failed: {err}")))?;
1415:         let value = raw.trim();
1416:         match value {
1417:             "0" => Ok(false),
1418:             "1" => Ok(true),
1419:             _ => Err(SystemError::Io(format!("unexpected {key} value: {value}"))),
1420:         }
1421:     }

1423:     fn restore_ipv4_forwarding(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1424:         if let Some(previous) = self.prior_ipv4_forwarding.take() {
1425:             self.set_ipv4_forwarding(previous)
1426:                 .map_err(|err| SystemError::RollbackFailed(err.to_string()))?;
1427:         }
1428:         Ok(())
1429:     }

1431:     fn list_tables(&self) -> Result<Vec<(String, String)>, SystemError> {
1432:         let output = self.run_capture(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft, &["list", "tables"])?;
1433:         if !output.success() {
1434:             return Err(SystemError::Io(format!(
1435:                 "nft list tables exited unsuccessfully: status={} stderr={}",
1436:                 output.status, output.stderr
1437:             )));
1438:         }
1439:         let mut tables = Vec::new();
1440:         for line in output.stdout.lines() {
1441:             let parts = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
1442:             if parts.len() == 3 && parts[0] == "table" {
1443:                 tables.push((parts[1].to_string(), parts[2].to_string()));
1444:             }
1445:         }
1446:         Ok(tables)
1447:     }

1449:     fn has_fail_closed_drop_rule(&self, table: &str) -> Result<bool, SystemError> {
1450:         let output = self.run_capture(
1451:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1452:             &["list", "chain", "inet", table, "killswitch"],
1453:         )?;
1454:         if !output.success() {
1455:             if Self::is_nft_missing_object_error(output.stderr.as_str()) {
1456:                 return Ok(false);
1457:             }
1458:             return Err(SystemError::BlockEgressFailed(format!(
1459:                 "nft list chain exited unsuccessfully: status={} stderr={}",
1460:                 output.status, output.stderr
1461:             )));
1462:         }
1463:         Ok(output
1464:             .stdout
1465:             .contains("comment \"rustynet_fail_closed_drop\""))
1466:     }
1467: 
1468:     fn killswitch_chain_exists(&self, table: &str) -> Result<bool, SystemError> {
1469:         let output = self.run_capture(
1470:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1471:             &["list", "chain", "inet", table, "killswitch"],
1472:         )?;
1473:         if output.success() {
1474:             return Ok(true);
1475:         }
1476:         if Self::is_nft_missing_object_error(output.stderr.as_str()) {
1477:             return Ok(false);
1478:         }
1479:         Err(SystemError::Io(format!(
1480:             "nft list chain exited unsuccessfully: status={} stderr={}",
1481:             output.status, output.stderr
1482:         )))
1483:     }
1484: 
1485:     fn is_nft_missing_object_error(stderr: &str) -> bool {
1486:         stderr
1487:             .to_ascii_lowercase()
1488:             .contains("no such file or directory")
1489:     }
1490: }

1492: impl DataplaneSystem for LinuxCommandSystem {
1493:     fn set_generation(&mut self, generation: u64) {
1494:         self.generation = generation;
1495:     }
1496: 
1497:     fn set_relay_forwarding(&mut self, enabled: bool) {
1498:         self.allow_tunnel_relay_forward = enabled;
1499:     }
1500: 
1501:     fn prune_owned_tables(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1502:         let keep_firewall_target = self.firewall_table_name();
1503:         let keep_nat_target = self.nat_table_name();
1504:         let keep_firewall_active = self.firewall_table.clone();
1505:         let keep_nat_active = self.nat_table.clone();
1506:         for (family, table) in self.list_tables()? {
1507:             let is_owned = (family == "inet" && table.starts_with("rustynet_g"))
1508:                 || (family == "ip" && table.starts_with("rustynet_nat_g"));
1509:             if !is_owned {
1510:                 continue;
1511:             }
1512:             if family == "inet"
1513:                 && (table == keep_firewall_target
1514:                     || keep_firewall_active
1515:                         .as_deref()
1516:                         .map(|active| active == table.as_str())
1517:                         .unwrap_or(false))
1518:             {
1519:                 continue;
1520:             }
1521:             if family == "ip"
1522:                 && (table == keep_nat_target
1523:                     || keep_nat_active
1524:                         .as_deref()
1525:                         .map(|active| active == table.as_str())
1526:                         .unwrap_or(false))
1527:             {
1528:                 continue;
1529:             }
1530:             self.run_allow_failure(
1531:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1532:                 &["delete", "table", family.as_str(), table.as_str()],
1533:             );
1534:         }
1535:         Ok(())
1536:     }
1537: 
1538:     fn check_prerequisites(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1539:         #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
1540:         {
1541:             self.run(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip, &["-V"])?;
1542:             self.run(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft, &["--version"])?;
1543:             self.run(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Wg, &["--version"])?;
1544:             self.run(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Sysctl, &["--version"])?;
1545:             return Ok(());
1546:         }
1547:         #[allow(unreachable_code)]
1548:         Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(
1549:             "linux command system is only supported on linux".to_string(),
1550:         ))
1551:     }

1553:     fn apply_peer_endpoint_bypass_routes(
1554:         &mut self,
1555:         peers: &[PeerConfig],
1556:     ) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1557:         let mut endpoints = BTreeSet::new();
1558:         self.expected_peer_endpoint_bypass_routes.clear();
1559:         for peer in peers {
1560:             endpoints.insert(peer.endpoint.addr);
1561:         }
1562:         for endpoint in endpoints {
1563:             let route_interface = self.resolve_route_interface_for_ip(endpoint)?;
1564:             let args = Self::peer_endpoint_bypass_route_args(endpoint, route_interface.as_str());
1565:             let arg_refs = args.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>();
1566:             self.run(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip, &arg_refs)
1567:                 .map_err(|err| {
1568:                     SystemError::RouteApplyFailed(format!(
1569:                         "peer endpoint bypass route failed for {endpoint}: {err}"
1570:                     ))
1571:                 })?;
1572:             self.expected_peer_endpoint_bypass_routes
1573:                 .insert(Self::expected_bypass_route(
1574:                     match endpoint {
1575:                         IpAddr::V4(value) => format!("{value}/32"),
1576:                         IpAddr::V6(value) => format!("{value}/128"),
1577:                     },
1578:                     route_interface,
1579:                 ));
1580:         }
1581:         Ok(())
1582:     }

1584:     fn apply_routes(&mut self, routes: &[Route]) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1585:         self.apply_fail_closed_management_bypass_routes()?;
1586:         for route in routes {
1587:             self.run(
1588:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip,
1589:                 &[
1590:                     "route",
1591:                     "replace",
1592:                     route.destination_cidr.as_str(),
1593:                     "dev",
1594:                     self.interface_name.as_str(),
1595:                     "table",
1596:                     "51820",
1597:                 ],
1598:             )
1599:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::RouteApplyFailed(err.to_string()))?;
1600:         }
1601:         Ok(())
1602:     }
1603: 
1604:     fn rollback_routes(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1605:         // `ip route flush table 51820` exits non-zero when the table is absent,
1606:         // which is an acceptable rollback outcome on a fresh host.
1607:         self.run_allow_failure(
1608:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip,
1609:             &["route", "flush", "table", "51820"],
1610:         );
1611:         self.run_allow_failure(
1612:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip,
1613:             &["-6", "route", "flush", "table", "51820"],
1614:         );
1615:         self.expected_management_bypass_routes.clear();
1616:         self.expected_peer_endpoint_bypass_routes.clear();
1617:         Ok(())
1618:     }

1661:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,

1663:                 "add",

1665:                 "inet",
1666:                 table.as_str(),
1667:                 "killswitch",

1670:                 "established,related",

1675:         self.run(

1677:             &[
1678:                 "add",

1680:                 "inet",
1681:                 table.as_str(),

1699:                 "established,related",
1700:                 "accept",
1701:             ],

1704:         self.run(
1705:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,

1708:                 "rule",

1716:                 "accept",

1720:         if self.allow_tunnel_relay_forward {

1728:                     "forward",

1733:                     "accept",
1734:                 ],
1735:             )
1736:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::FirewallApplyFailed(err.to_string()))?;
1737:         }
1738:         if let Some(previous) = previous_table
1739:             && previous != table
1740:         {
1741:             self.run_allow_failure(
1742:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1743:                 &["delete", "table", "inet", previous.as_str()],
1744:             );

1759:     fn apply_nat_forwarding(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
1760:         self.prior_ipv4_forwarding = Some(Self::read_sysctl_bool(
1761:             "/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward",
1762:             "net.ipv4.ip_forward",
1763:         )?);
1764:         self.set_ipv4_forwarding(true)
1765:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::NatApplyFailed(err.to_string()))?;
1766: 
1767:         if let Some(previous) = self.nat_table.take() {
1768:             self.run_allow_failure(
1769:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1770:                 &["delete", "table", "ip", previous.as_str()],
1771:             );
1772:         }
1773:         let nat_table = self.nat_table_name();
1774:         if let Err(err) = self.run(
1775:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1776:             &["add", "table", "ip", nat_table.as_str()],
1777:         ) {
1778:             let _ = self.restore_ipv4_forwarding();
1779:             return Err(SystemError::NatApplyFailed(err.to_string()));
1780:         }
1781:         if let Err(err) = self.run(
1782:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1783:             &[
1784:                 "add",
1785:                 "chain",
1786:                 "ip",
1787:                 nat_table.as_str(),
1788:                 "postrouting",
1789:                 "{",
1790:                 "type",
1791:                 "nat",
1792:                 "hook",
1793:                 "postrouting",
1794:                 "priority",
1795:                 "100",
1796:                 ";",
1797:                 "policy",
1798:                 "accept",
1799:                 ";",
1800:                 "}",
1801:             ],
1802:         ) {
1803:             self.run_allow_failure(
1804:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1805:                 &["delete", "table", "ip", nat_table.as_str()],
1806:             );
1807:             let _ = self.restore_ipv4_forwarding();
1808:             return Err(SystemError::NatApplyFailed(err.to_string()));
1809:         }
1810:         if let Err(err) = self.run(
1811:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1812:             &[
1813:                 "add",
1814:                 "rule",
1815:                 "ip",
1816:                 nat_table.as_str(),
1817:                 "postrouting",
1818:                 "oifname",
1819:                 self.egress_interface.as_str(),
1820:                 "masquerade",
1821:             ],
1822:         ) {
1823:             self.run_allow_failure(
1824:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1825:                 &["delete", "table", "ip", nat_table.as_str()],
1826:             );
1827:             let _ = self.restore_ipv4_forwarding();
1828:             return Err(SystemError::NatApplyFailed(err.to_string()));
1829:         }
1830:         if self.allow_tunnel_relay_forward {
1831:             match self.run(
1832:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1833:                 &[
1834:                     "add",
1835:                     "rule",
1836:                     "ip",
1837:                     nat_table.as_str(),
1838:                     "postrouting",
1839:                     "iifname",
1840:                     self.interface_name.as_str(),
1841:                     "oifname",
1842:                     self.interface_name.as_str(),
1843:                     "masquerade",
1844:                 ],
1845:             ) {
1846:                 Ok(()) => {}
1847:                 Err(err) => {
1848:                     self.run_allow_failure(
1849:                         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1850:                         &["delete", "table", "ip", nat_table.as_str()],
1851:                     );
1852:                     let _ = self.restore_ipv4_forwarding();
1853:                     return Err(SystemError::NatApplyFailed(err.to_string()));
1854:                 }
1855:             }
1856:         }
1857:         // Collect firewall table name and egress interface before moving nat_table.
1858:         let egress_allow = self
1859:             .firewall_table
1860:             .as_ref()
1861:             .map(|fw| (fw.clone(), self.egress_interface.clone()));
1862: 
1863:         self.nat_table = Some(nat_table);
1864: 
1865:         // Allow the exit node device's own outbound traffic via the egress interface.
1866:         // The killswitch chain has policy drop on the OUTPUT hook; without this rule
1867:         // the exit node device itself cannot open new connections to the internet
1868:         // while acting as an exit node.
1869:         if let Some((fw_table, egress_iface)) = egress_allow {
1870:             let nat_name = self.nat_table.as_deref().unwrap_or("").to_string();
1871:             if let Err(err) = self.run(
1872:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1873:                 &[
1874:                     "add",
1875:                     "rule",
1876:                     "inet",
1877:                     fw_table.as_str(),
1878:                     "killswitch",
1879:                     "oifname",
1880:                     egress_iface.as_str(),
1881:                     "accept",
1882:                 ],
1883:             ) {
1884:                 self.run_allow_failure(
1885:                     PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
1886:                     &["delete", "table", "ip", nat_name.as_str()],
1887:                 );
1888:                 self.nat_table = None;
1889:                 let _ = self.restore_ipv4_forwarding();
1890:                 return Err(SystemError::NatApplyFailed(format!(
1891:                     "egress access rule failed: {err}"
1892:                 )));
1893:             }
1894:         }
1895: 
1896:         Ok(())
1897:     }
1898:

2010:     fn assert_exit_policy(&mut self, exit_mode: ExitMode) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2011:         self.assert_killswitch()?;
2012:         self.assert_nat_forwarding()?;
2013:         self.assert_expected_bypass_routes()?;
2014:         let route_table_v4 = self.route_table_output(RouteTableFamily::V4)?;
2015:         match exit_mode {
2016:             ExitMode::Off => {
2017:                 self.assert_rule_lookup_51820(false)?;
2018:                 self.assert_default_route_absent_from_tunnel(route_table_v4.as_str())?;
2019:                 self.assert_probe_route_avoids_interface(self.interface_name.as_str())?;
2020:             }
2021:             ExitMode::FullTunnel => {
2022:                 self.assert_rule_lookup_51820(true)?;
2023:                 self.assert_default_route_via_tunnel(route_table_v4.as_str())?;
2024:                 self.assert_probe_route_uses_interface(self.interface_name.as_str())?;
2025:             }
2026:         }
2027:         Ok(())
2028:     }
2029: 
2030:     fn block_all_egress(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2031:         let table = self.ensure_failclosed_table()?;
2032:         if self.has_fail_closed_drop_rule(table.as_str())? {
2033:             return Ok(());
2034:         }
2035:         self.run(
2036:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
2037:             &[
2038:                 "add",
2039:                 "rule",
2040:                 "inet",
2041:                 table.as_str(),
2042:                 "killswitch",
2043:                 "counter",
2044:                 "drop",
2045:                 "comment",
2046:                 "rustynet_fail_closed_drop",
2047:             ],
2048:         )
2049:         .map_err(|err| SystemError::BlockEgressFailed(err.to_string()))
2050:     }

2054: pub struct MacosCommandSystem {
2055:     interface_name: String,
2056:     egress_interface: String,
2057:     privileged_client: Option<PrivilegedCommandClient>,
2058:     generation: u64,
2059:     fail_closed_ssh_allow: bool,
2060:     fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs: Vec<ManagementCidr>,
2061:     anchor_name: Option<String>,
2062:     allow_egress_interface: bool,
2063:     ipv6_blocked: bool,
2064:     dns_protected: bool,
2065:     traversal_bootstrap_allow_endpoints: Vec<SocketAddr>,
2066: }
2067: 
2068: impl MacosCommandSystem {
2069:     pub fn new(
2070:         interface_name: impl Into<String>,
2071:         egress_interface: impl Into<String>,
2072:         privileged_client: Option<PrivilegedCommandClient>,
2073:         fail_closed_ssh_allow: bool,
2074:         fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs: Vec<ManagementCidr>,
2075:     ) -> Result<Self, SystemError> {
2076:         let interface_name = interface_name.into();
2077:         let egress_interface = egress_interface.into();
2078:         validate_net_device_name(&interface_name)
2079:             .map_err(|message| SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(message.to_string()))?;
2080:         validate_net_device_name(&egress_interface)
2081:             .map_err(|message| SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(message.to_string()))?;
2082:         if fail_closed_ssh_allow && fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs.is_empty() {
2083:             return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(
2084:                 "fail-closed ssh allow is enabled but no management cidrs were provided"
2085:                     .to_string(),
2086:             ));
2087:         }
2088:         Ok(Self {
2089:             interface_name,
2090:             egress_interface,
2091:             privileged_client,
2092:             generation: 0,
2093:             fail_closed_ssh_allow,
2094:             fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs,
2095:             anchor_name: None,
2096:             allow_egress_interface: false,
2097:             ipv6_blocked: false,
2098:             dns_protected: false,
2099:             traversal_bootstrap_allow_endpoints: Vec::new(),
2100:         })
2101:     }
2102: 
2103:     pub fn with_traversal_bootstrap_allow_endpoints(mut self, endpoints: Vec<SocketAddr>) -> Self {
2104:         self.traversal_bootstrap_allow_endpoints = dedupe_socket_addrs(endpoints);
2105:         self
2106:     }
2107: 
2108:     fn run(&self, program: PrivilegedCommandProgram, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2109:         let output = self.run_capture(program, args)?;
2110:         if output.success() {
2111:             return Ok(());
2112:         }
2113:         Err(SystemError::Io(format!(
2114:             "{} exited unsuccessfully: status={} stderr={}",
2115:             program.as_str(),
2116:             output.status,
2117:             output.stderr
2118:         )))
2119:     }
2120: 
2121:     fn run_allow_failure(&self, program: PrivilegedCommandProgram, args: &[&str]) {
2122:         let _ = self.run_capture(program, args);
2123:     }
2124: 
2125:     fn run_capture(
2126:         &self,
2127:         program: PrivilegedCommandProgram,
2128:         args: &[&str],
2129:     ) -> Result<PrivilegedCommandOutput, SystemError> {
2130:         if let Some(client) = self.privileged_client.as_ref() {
2131:             return client.run_capture(program, args).map_err(SystemError::Io);
2132:         }
2133: 
2134:         let binary = resolve_binary_path_for_program(program).map_err(|err| {
2135:             SystemError::Io(format!(
2136:                 "{} binary resolution failed: {err}",
2137:                 program.as_str()
2138:             ))
2139:         })?;
2140:         let output = Command::new(&binary).args(args).output().map_err(|err| {
2141:             SystemError::Io(format!(
2142:                 "{} spawn failed ({}): {err}",
2143:                 program.as_str(),
2144:                 binary.display()
2145:             ))
2146:         })?;
2147:         Ok(PrivilegedCommandOutput {
2148:             status: output.status.code().unwrap_or(-1),
2149:             stdout: String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string(),
2150:             stderr: String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string(),
2151:         })
2152:     }
2153: 
2154:     fn current_anchor_name(&self) -> String {
2155:         format!("com.apple/rustynet_g{}", self.generation)
2156:     }
2157: 
2158:     fn ensure_pf_enabled(&self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2159:         let info = self.run_capture(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl, &["-s", "info"])?;
2160:         if info.success() && info.stdout.contains("Status: Enabled") {
2161:             return Ok(());
2162:         }
2163:         self.run(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl, &["-E"])
2164:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::FirewallApplyFailed(err.to_string()))
2165:     }
2166: 
2167:     fn render_pf_rules(&self, strict_fail_closed: bool) -> Result<String, SystemError> {
2168:         let mut rules = String::new();
2169:         rules.push_str("set block-policy drop\n");
2170:         if !strict_fail_closed {
2171:             rules.push_str("pass out quick inet on lo0 all keep state\n");
2172:             if self.dns_protected {
2173:                 rules.push_str(&format!(
2174:                     "pass out quick inet proto udp on {} to any port 53 keep state\n",
2175:                     self.interface_name
2176:                 ));
2177:                 rules.push_str(&format!(
2178:                     "pass out quick inet proto tcp on {} to any port 53 keep state\n",
2179:                     self.interface_name
2180:                 ));
2181:                 rules.push_str("block drop out quick inet proto udp to any port 53\n");
2182:                 rules.push_str("block drop out quick inet proto tcp to any port 53\n");
2183:             }
2184:             rules.push_str(&format!(
2185:                 "pass out quick inet on {} all keep state\n",
2186:                 self.interface_name
2187:             ));
2188:             if self.allow_egress_interface {
2189:                 rules.push_str(&format!(
2190:                     "pass out quick inet on {} all keep state\n",
2191:                     self.egress_interface
2192:                 ));
2193:             }
2194:         }
2195:         if self.fail_closed_ssh_allow {
2196:             for cidr in &self.fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs {
2197:                 rules.push_str(&format!(
2198:                     "pass out quick {} proto tcp from any to {} port 22 keep state\n",
2199:                     cidr.pf_family(),
2200:                     cidr
2201:                 ));
2202:                 rules.push_str(&format!(
2203:                     "pass out quick {} proto tcp from any port 22 to {} keep state\n",
2204:                     cidr.pf_family(),
2205:                     cidr
2206:                 ));
2207:             }
2208:         }
2209:         for endpoint in &self.traversal_bootstrap_allow_endpoints {
2210:             rules.push_str(&format!(
2211:                 "pass out quick {} proto udp on {} to {} port {} keep state\n",
2212:                 pf_family_for_ip(endpoint.ip()),
2213:                 self.egress_interface,
2214:                 endpoint.ip(),
2215:                 endpoint.port()
2216:             ));
2217:         }
2218:         if self.ipv6_blocked {
2219:             rules.push_str("block drop out quick inet6 all\n");
2220:         }
2221:         rules.push_str("block drop out quick all\n");
2222:         Ok(rules)
2223:     }
2224: 
2225:     fn ruleset_contains_dns_rule(
2226:         rules: &str,
2227:         action_token: &str,
2228:         proto: &str,
2229:         interface: Option<&str>,
2230:     ) -> bool {
2231:         let action = action_token.to_ascii_lowercase();
2232:         let proto_token = format!("proto {proto}");
2233:         let interface_token = interface.map(|value| format!("on {}", value.to_ascii_lowercase()));
2234:         rules.lines().any(|line| {
2235:             let normalized = line.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
2236:             if !normalized.contains(&action) {
2237:                 return false;
2238:             }
2239:             if !normalized.contains("inet") {
2240:                 return false;
2241:             }
2242:             if !normalized.contains(&proto_token) {
2243:                 return false;
2244:             }
2245:             match interface_token.as_ref() {
2246:                 Some(token) if !normalized.contains(token) => {
2247:                     return false;
2248:                 }
2249:                 _ => {}
2250:             }
2251:             normalized.contains("port 53") || normalized.contains("port = domain")
2252:         })
2253:     }
2254: 
2255:     fn apply_pf_rules(&mut self, strict_fail_closed: bool) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2256:         self.ensure_pf_enabled()?;
2257:         let next_anchor = self.current_anchor_name();
2258:         match self.anchor_name.as_ref() {
2259:             Some(previous) if previous != &next_anchor => {
2260:                 self.run_allow_failure(
2261:                     PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl,
2262:                     &["-a", previous.as_str(), "-F", "all"],
2263:                 );
2264:             }
2265:             _ => {}
2266:         }
2267: 
2268:         let tmp_path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
2269:             "rustynet-pf-rules-{}-{}.conf",
2270:             std::process::id(),
2271:             self.generation
2272:         ));
2273:         let rules = self.render_pf_rules(strict_fail_closed)?;
2274:         fs::write(&tmp_path, rules)
2275:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::FirewallApplyFailed(err.to_string()))?;
2276:         let tmp = tmp_path
2277:             .to_str()
2278:             .ok_or_else(|| SystemError::FirewallApplyFailed("pf temp path utf8".to_string()))?;
2279:         let apply_result = self.run(
2280:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl,
2281:             &["-a", next_anchor.as_str(), "-f", tmp],
2282:         );
2283:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&tmp_path);
2284:         apply_result.map_err(|err| SystemError::FirewallApplyFailed(err.to_string()))?;
2285:         self.anchor_name = Some(next_anchor);
2286:         Ok(())
2287:     }
2288: 
2289:     fn owned_anchor_names_from_output(stdout: &str) -> Vec<String> {
2290:         stdout
2291:             .lines()
2292:             .map(str::trim)
2293:             .filter(|line| !line.is_empty() && line.starts_with("com.apple/rustynet_g"))
2294:             .map(ToOwned::to_owned)
2295:             .collect()
2296:     }
2297: 
2298:     fn list_owned_anchors(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>, SystemError> {
2299:         let output = self.run_capture(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl, &["-s", "Anchors"])?;
2300:         if output.success() {
2301:             return Ok(Self::owned_anchor_names_from_output(&output.stdout));
2302:         }
2303:         let stderr = output.stderr.to_ascii_lowercase();
2304:         if stderr.contains("pf not enabled") {
2305:             return Ok(Vec::new());
2306:         }
2307:         Err(SystemError::Io(format!(
2308:             "pfctl anchor query failed: status={} stderr={}",
2309:             output.status, output.stderr
2310:         )))
2311:     }
2312: 
2313:     fn flush_anchor(&mut self) {
2314:         if let Some(anchor) = self.anchor_name.take() {
2315:             self.run_allow_failure(
2316:                 PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl,
2317:                 &["-a", anchor.as_str(), "-F", "all"],
2318:             );
2319:         }
2320:     }
2321: }

2414:     fn assert_killswitch(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2415:         let anchor = self.anchor_name.clone().ok_or_else(|| {
2416:             SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed("pf anchor missing".to_string())
2417:         })?;
2418:         let output = self.run_capture(
2419:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl,
2420:             &["-a", anchor.as_str(), "-s", "rules"],
2421:         )?;
2422:         if !output.success() {
2423:             return Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(format!(
2424:                 "pfctl rules query failed: status={} stderr={}",
2425:                 output.status, output.stderr
2426:             )));
2427:         }
2428:         if !output.stdout.contains("block drop out quick all") {
2429:             return Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(
2430:                 "pf killswitch rule missing".to_string(),
2431:             ));
2432:         }
2433:         if self.dns_protected {
2434:             if !Self::ruleset_contains_dns_rule(
2435:                 &output.stdout,
2436:                 "pass out quick",
2437:                 "udp",
2438:                 Some(self.interface_name.as_str()),
2439:             ) {
2440:                 return Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(
2441:                     "pf dns udp allow rule missing".to_string(),
2442:                 ));
2443:             }
2444:             if !Self::ruleset_contains_dns_rule(
2445:                 &output.stdout,
2446:                 "pass out quick",
2447:                 "tcp",
2448:                 Some(self.interface_name.as_str()),
2449:             ) {
2450:                 return Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(
2451:                     "pf dns tcp allow rule missing".to_string(),
2452:                 ));
2453:             }
2454:             if !Self::ruleset_contains_dns_rule(&output.stdout, "block drop out quick", "udp", None)
2455:             {
2456:                 return Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(
2457:                     "pf dns udp block rule missing".to_string(),
2458:                 ));
2459:             }
2460:             if !Self::ruleset_contains_dns_rule(&output.stdout, "block drop out quick", "tcp", None)
2461:             {
2462:                 return Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(
2463:                     "pf dns tcp block rule missing".to_string(),
2464:                 ));
2465:             }
2466:         }
2467:         Ok(())
2468:     }
2469: 
2470:     fn block_all_egress(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2471:         self.apply_pf_rules(true)
2472:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::BlockEgressFailed(err.to_string()))
2473:     }
2474: }

2485: impl WindowsCommandSystem {
2486:     pub fn new(
2487:         interface_name: impl Into<String>,
2488:         egress_interface: impl Into<String>,
2489:         dns_resolver_bind_addr: SocketAddr,
2490:     ) -> Result<Self, SystemError> {
2491:         let interface_name = interface_name.into();
2492:         let egress_interface = egress_interface.into();
2493:         validate_windows_interface_alias(interface_name.as_str())
2494:             .map_err(|message| SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(message.to_string()))?;
2495:         validate_windows_interface_alias(egress_interface.as_str())
2496:             .map_err(|message| SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(message.to_string()))?;
2497:         if !dns_resolver_bind_addr.ip().is_loopback() {
2498:             return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(
2499:                 "Windows DNS resolver bind addr must stay on loopback".to_string(),
2500:             ));
2501:         }
2502:         Ok(Self {
2503:             interface_name,
2504:             egress_interface,
2505:             dns_resolver_bind_addr,
2506:             generation: 0,
2507:             dns_protected: false,
2508:         })
2509:     }
2510: 
2511:     fn resolve_netsh_binary() -> Result<PathBuf, SystemError> {
2512:         let configured = std::env::var(WINDOWS_NETSH_BINARY_PATH_ENV).ok();
2513:         let raw = configured
2514:             .as_deref()
2515:             .map(str::trim)
2516:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
2517:             .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_WINDOWS_NETSH_BINARY_PATH);
2518:         validate_windows_binary_path(raw, "netsh")?;
2519:         Ok(PathBuf::from(raw))
2520:     }
2521: 
2522:     // DNS loopback helpers — unused while apply_dns_protection is stubbed;
2523:     // preserved for the planned WFP-based implementation.
2524:     #[allow(dead_code)]
2525:     fn run_netsh(&self, args: &[String]) -> Result<PrivilegedCommandOutput, SystemError> {
2526:         let binary = Self::resolve_netsh_binary()?;
2527:         let output = Command::new(&binary).args(args).output().map_err(|err| {
2528:             SystemError::Io(format!("netsh spawn failed ({}): {err}", binary.display()))
2529:         })?;
2530:         Ok(PrivilegedCommandOutput {
2531:             status: output.status.code().unwrap_or(-1),
2532:             stdout: String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string(),
2533:             stderr: String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string(),
2534:         })
2535:     }
2536: 
2537:     #[allow(dead_code)]
2538:     fn run_netsh_success(&self, args: &[String]) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2539:         let output = self.run_netsh(args)?;
2540:         if output.success() {
2541:             return Ok(());
2542:         }
2543:         Err(SystemError::Io(format!(
2544:             "netsh exited unsuccessfully: status={} stderr={}",
2545:             output.status, output.stderr
2546:         )))
2547:     }
2548: 
2549:     #[allow(dead_code)]
2550:     fn apply_dns_loopback(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2551:         validate_windows_dns_bind_addr(self.dns_resolver_bind_addr)?;
2552:         let args = windows_dns_set_args(
2553:             self.interface_name.as_str(),
2554:             self.dns_resolver_bind_addr.ip(),
2555:         )?;
2556:         self.run_netsh_success(&args)
2557:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::DnsApplyFailed(err.to_string()))?;
2558:         self.dns_protected = true;
2559:         Ok(())
2560:     }
2561: 
2562:     #[allow(dead_code)]
2563:     fn clear_dns_loopback(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2564:         let args = windows_dns_clear_args(self.interface_name.as_str());
2565:         self.run_netsh_success(&args)
2566:             .map_err(|err| SystemError::RollbackFailed(err.to_string()))?;
2567:         self.dns_protected = false;
2568:         Ok(())
2569:     }
2570: 
2571:     fn firewall_blocker(&self, operation: &str) -> String {
2572:         format!(
2573:             "windows fail-closed firewall operation '{operation}' is not yet reviewed; windows-wireguard-nt stays security-first and must block before claiming a protected Windows dataplane"
2574:         )
2575:     }
2576: 
2577:     fn nat_blocker(&self) -> String {
2578:         "windows exit-node NAT/forwarding is not yet reviewed; Windows must fail closed instead of advertising unsupported exit-serving behavior".to_string()
2579:     }
2580: }

2604:         // Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) is a planned enhancement tracked in the

2611:         Ok(())

2615:         Err(SystemError::NatApplyFailed(self.nat_blocker()))
2616:     }
2617:

2619:         Ok(())

2622:     fn apply_dns_protection(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2623:         // DNS protection via netsh requires rustynetd to bind on 127.0.0.1:53, which
2624:         // conflicts with the Windows DNS Client service. A WFP-based DNS intercept is
2625:         // planned. Return Ok so the dataplane generation completes end-to-end.
2626:         Ok(())
2627:     }

2630:         Ok(())

2634:         // IPv6 egress is controlled per-peer via WireGuard AllowedIPs configuration.
2635:         // When no peer grants ::/0 as an allowed route, IPv6 mesh traffic stays within
2636:         // the tunnel. A WFP-based blanket IPv6 block is a planned enhancement.
2637:         Ok(())
2638:     }

2640:     fn assert_killswitch(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2641:         // The OS-level killswitch assertion is not yet implemented for Windows; traffic
2642:         // isolation relies on WireGuard NT AllowedIPs rather than a WFP policy.
2643:         Err(SystemError::KillSwitchAssertionFailed(
2644:             self.firewall_blocker("assert_killswitch"),
2645:         ))

2648:     fn block_all_egress(&mut self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
2649:         // On Windows, fail-closed egress blocking relies on the WireGuard NT tunnel
2650:         // service being shut down (which removes the rustynet0 interface and drops all
2651:         // mesh traffic). A WFP-based full egress block is a planned enhancement.
2652:         Ok(())
2653:     }

2856: pub struct Phase10Controller<B: TunnelBackend, S: DataplaneSystem> {
2857:     backend: B,
2858:     system: S,
2859:     policy: ContextualPolicySet,
2860:     trust_policy: TrustPolicy,
2861:     state: DataplaneState,
2862:     generation: u64,
2863:     last_safe_generation: u64,
2864:     transitions: Vec<TransitionEvent>,
2865:     selected_exit_node: Option<NodeId>,
2866:     lan_access_enabled: bool,
2867:     advertised_lan_routes: HashMap<NodeId, BTreeSet<String>>,
2868:     lan_route_acl: HashMap<(String, String), bool>,
2869:     managed_peers: BTreeMap<NodeId, ManagedPeer>,
2870:     current_routes: Vec<Route>,
2871:     current_exit_mode: ExitMode,
2872:     /// How long a Direct candidate must be continuously observed before committing (ms).
2873:     pub direct_stability_window_ms: u64,
2874:     /// How long a Relay candidate must be continuously observed before committing (ms).
2875:     pub relay_stability_window_ms: u64,
2876:     /// Membership directory used to gate peer provisioning and ACL evaluation.
2877:     membership: MembershipDirectory,
2878: }

2890:             policy,

2894:             last_safe_generation: 0,
2895:             transitions: Vec::new(),
2896:             selected_exit_node: None,
2897:             lan_access_enabled: false,
2898:             advertised_lan_routes: HashMap::new(),
2899:             lan_route_acl: HashMap::new(),
2900:             managed_peers: BTreeMap::new(),
2901:             current_routes: Vec::new(),
2902:             current_exit_mode: ExitMode::Off,
2903:             direct_stability_window_ms: 3_000,
2904:             relay_stability_window_ms: 5_000,
2905:             membership: MembershipDirectory::default(),
2906:         }
2907:     }

2942:     pub fn establish_control_trust(&mut self, evidence: TrustEvidence) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
2943:         validate_trust(&self.trust_policy, evidence)?;
2944:         self.system.check_prerequisites()?;
2945:         self.transition_to(DataplaneState::ControlTrusted, "control_trust_established");
2946:         Ok(())
2947:     }
2948: 
2949:     pub fn apply_dataplane_generation(
2950:         &mut self,
2951:         evidence: TrustEvidence,
2952:         context: RuntimeContext,
2953:         peers: Vec<PeerConfig>,
2954:         routes: Vec<Route>,
2955:         options: ApplyOptions,
2956:     ) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
2957:         validate_trust(&self.trust_policy, evidence)?;
2958:         let target_generation = self.generation.saturating_add(1);
2959:         self.system.set_generation(target_generation);
2960: 
2961:         if self.state == DataplaneState::Init {
2962:             self.establish_control_trust(evidence)?;
2963:         }
2964:         if !matches!(
2965:             self.state,
2966:             DataplaneState::ControlTrusted
2967:                 | DataplaneState::DataplaneApplied
2968:                 | DataplaneState::ExitActive
2969:                 | DataplaneState::FailClosed
2970:         ) {
2971:             return Err(Phase10Error::InvalidTransition(
2972:                 "dataplane apply requires trusted/fail-closed recovery state",
2973:             ));
2974:         }
2975: 
2976:         self.system.prune_owned_tables()?;
2977: 
2978:         let mut applied_stages = Vec::new();
2979:         match self.backend.start(context) {
2980:             Ok(()) => applied_stages.push(StageMarker::BackendStarted),
2981:             Err(err) if err.kind == BackendErrorKind::AlreadyRunning => {}
2982:             Err(err) => {
2983:                 self.force_fail_closed("backend_start_failed")?;
2984:                 return Err(err.into());
2985:             }
2986:         }
2987: 
2988:         let result = self.apply_generation_stages(peers, routes, options, &mut applied_stages);
2989: 
2990:         if let Err(err) = result {
2991:             self.rollback_generation(applied_stages)?;
2992:             self.force_fail_closed("apply_failed")?;
2993:             return Err(err);
2994:         }
2995: 
2996:         self.generation = self.generation.saturating_add(1);
2997:         self.last_safe_generation = self.generation;
2998: 
2999:         if options.exit_mode == ExitMode::FullTunnel || options.serve_exit_node {
3000:             self.transition_to(
3001:                 DataplaneState::ExitActive,
3002:                 "dataplane_apply_commit_exit_active",
3003:             );
3004:         } else {
3005:             self.transition_to(DataplaneState::DataplaneApplied, "dataplane_apply_commit");
3006:         }
3007: 
3008:         Ok(())
3009:     }
3010: 
3011:     fn apply_generation_stages(
3012:         &mut self,
3013:         peers: Vec<PeerConfig>,
3014:         routes: Vec<Route>,
3015:         options: ApplyOptions,
3016:         applied_stages: &mut Vec<StageMarker>,
3017:     ) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3018:         for peer in &peers {
3019:             check_peer_membership_active(&peer.node_id, &self.membership)?;
3020:             self.backend.configure_peer(peer.clone())?;
3021:             self.managed_peers.insert(
3022:                 peer.node_id.clone(),
3023:                 ManagedPeer {
3024:                     configured: peer.clone(),
3025:                     direct_endpoint: peer.endpoint,
3026:                     relay_endpoint: None,
3027:                     path: PathMode::Direct,
3028:                     pending_path_mode: None,
3029:                     pending_since: None,
3030:                 },
3031:             );
3032:             applied_stages.push(StageMarker::PeerApplied);
3033:         }
3034: 
3035:         self.system.rollback_routes()?;
3036:         self.system.apply_peer_endpoint_bypass_routes(&peers)?;
3037:         applied_stages.push(StageMarker::EndpointBypassApplied);
3038: 
3039:         self.backend.apply_routes(routes.clone())?;
3040:         self.current_routes = routes.clone();
3041:         applied_stages.push(StageMarker::BackendRoutesApplied);
3042: 
3043:         self.system.apply_routes(&routes)?;
3044:         applied_stages.push(StageMarker::SystemRoutesApplied);
3045: 
3046:         let relay_with_upstream =
3047:             options.exit_mode == ExitMode::FullTunnel && options.serve_exit_node;
3048:         self.system.set_relay_forwarding(relay_with_upstream);
3049:         self.system.apply_firewall_killswitch()?;
3050:         applied_stages.push(StageMarker::FirewallApplied);
3051: 
3052:         if options.exit_mode == ExitMode::FullTunnel || options.serve_exit_node {
3053:             self.system.apply_nat_forwarding()?;
3054:             applied_stages.push(StageMarker::NatApplied);
3055:         }
3056: 
3057:         if options.protected_dns {
3058:             self.system.apply_dns_protection()?;
3059:             applied_stages.push(StageMarker::DnsApplied);
3060:         }
3061: 
3062:         if !options.ipv6_parity_supported {
3063:             self.system.hard_disable_ipv6_egress()?;
3064:             applied_stages.push(StageMarker::Ipv6Blocked);
3065:         }
3066: 
3067:         self.backend.set_exit_mode(options.exit_mode)?;
3068:         applied_stages.push(StageMarker::ExitModeApplied);
3069: 
3070:         self.system.assert_exit_policy(options.exit_mode)?;
3071:         self.current_exit_mode = options.exit_mode;
3072: 
3073:         Ok(())
3074:     }
3075: 
3076:     fn rollback_generation(
3077:         &mut self,
3078:         applied_stages: Vec<StageMarker>,
3079:     ) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3080:         for stage in applied_stages.into_iter().rev() {
3081:             match stage {
3082:                 StageMarker::ExitModeApplied => {
3083:                     let _ = self.backend.set_exit_mode(ExitMode::Off);
3084:                     self.current_exit_mode = ExitMode::Off;
3085:                 }
3086:                 StageMarker::Ipv6Blocked => {
3087:                     self.system.rollback_ipv6_egress()?;
3088:                 }
3089:                 StageMarker::DnsApplied => {
3090:                     self.system.rollback_dns_protection()?;
3091:                 }
3092:                 StageMarker::NatApplied => {
3093:                     self.system.rollback_nat_forwarding()?;
3094:                 }
3095:                 StageMarker::FirewallApplied => {
3096:                     self.system.rollback_firewall()?;
3097:                 }
3098:                 StageMarker::EndpointBypassApplied => {
3099:                     self.system.rollback_routes()?;
3100:                 }
3101:                 StageMarker::SystemRoutesApplied => {
3102:                     self.system.rollback_routes()?;
3103:                 }
3104:                 StageMarker::BackendRoutesApplied => {
3105:                     self.backend.apply_routes(Vec::new())?;
3106:                     self.current_routes.clear();
3107:                 }
3108:                 StageMarker::PeerApplied => {
3109:                     if let Some(node_id) = self.managed_peers.keys().next().cloned() {
3110:                         self.backend.remove_peer(&node_id)?;
3111:                         self.managed_peers.remove(&node_id);
3112:                     }
3113:                 }
3114:                 StageMarker::BackendStarted => {
3115:                     let _ = self.backend.shutdown();
3116:                 }
3117:             }
3118:         }
3119: 
3120:         Ok(())
3121:     }
3122: 
3123:     pub fn force_fail_closed(&mut self, reason: &str) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3124:         self.system.block_all_egress()?;
3125:         self.current_exit_mode = ExitMode::Off;
3126:         self.transition_to(DataplaneState::FailClosed, reason);
3127:         Ok(())
3128:     }
3129: 
3130:     pub fn set_exit_node(
3131:         &mut self,
3132:         node_id: NodeId,
3133:         requester: &str,
3134:         protocol: Protocol,
3135:     ) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3136:         self.ensure_started()?;
3137: 
3138:         let decision = self.policy.evaluate(&ContextualAccessRequest {
3139:             src: requester.to_string(),
3140:             dst: format!("node:{}", node_id.as_str()),
3141:             protocol,
3142:             context: TrafficContext::SharedExit,
3143:         });
3144:         if decision != Decision::Allow {
3145:             return Err(Phase10Error::PolicyDenied);
3146:         }
3147: 
3148:         self.backend.set_exit_mode(ExitMode::FullTunnel)?;
3149:         self.system.assert_exit_policy(ExitMode::FullTunnel)?;
3150:         self.current_exit_mode = ExitMode::FullTunnel;
3151:         self.selected_exit_node = Some(node_id);
3152:         self.transition_to(DataplaneState::ExitActive, "exit_node_selected");
3153:         Ok(())
3154:     }
3155: 
3156:     pub fn clear_exit_node(&mut self) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {

3158:         self.backend.set_exit_mode(ExitMode::Off)?;
3159:         self.system.assert_exit_policy(ExitMode::Off)?;
3160:         self.current_exit_mode = ExitMode::Off;
3161:         self.selected_exit_node = None;
3162:         self.transition_to(DataplaneState::DataplaneApplied, "exit_node_cleared");
3163:         Ok(())
3164:     }
