3181: 
3182:     pub fn ensure_lan_route_allowed(&self, request: RouteGrantRequest) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3183:         if !self.lan_access_enabled {
3184:             return Err(Phase10Error::LanAccessDenied);
3185:         }
3186: 
3187:         let Some(exit_node) = &self.selected_exit_node else {
3188:             return Err(Phase10Error::ExitNotSelected);
3189:         };
3190: 
3191:         let advertised = self
3192:             .advertised_lan_routes
3193:             .get(exit_node)
3194:             .map(|routes| routes.contains(&request.cidr))
3195:             .unwrap_or(false);
3196:         if !advertised {
3197:             return Err(Phase10Error::LanAccessDenied);
3198:         }
3199: 
3200:         let acl_allowed = self
3201:             .lan_route_acl
3202:             .get(&(request.user.clone(), request.cidr.clone()))
3203:             .copied()
3204:             .unwrap_or(false);
3205:         if !acl_allowed {
3206:             return Err(Phase10Error::LanAccessDenied);
3207:         }
3208: 
3209:         let decision = self.policy.evaluate(&ContextualAccessRequest {
3210:             src: request.user,
3211:             dst: request.cidr,
3212:             protocol: request.protocol,
3213:             context: request.context,
3214:         });
3215:         if decision != Decision::Allow {
3216:             return Err(Phase10Error::PolicyDenied);
3217:         }
3218: 
3219:         Ok(())
3220:     }
3221: 
3222:     pub fn mark_direct_failed(&mut self, node_id: &NodeId) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3223:         self.ensure_started()?;
3224:         // Verify relay endpoint is available before entering hysteresis window.
3225:         self.managed_peers
3226:             .get(node_id)
3227:             .ok_or(Phase10Error::PeerNotManaged)?
3228:             .relay_endpoint
3229:             .ok_or(Phase10Error::RelayPathUnavailable)?;
3230:         self.consider_path_change_for_peer(node_id, PathMode::Relay)
3231:     }
3232: 
3233:     pub fn mark_direct_recovered(&mut self, node_id: &NodeId) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3234:         self.ensure_started()?;
3235:         self.consider_path_change_for_peer(node_id, PathMode::Direct)
3236:     }
3237: 
3238:     /// Evaluate a candidate path mode for a peer under hysteresis policy.
3239:     ///
3240:     /// The candidate must be observed continuously for the applicable stability
3241:     /// window before `commit_path_change_for_peer` is invoked.  If the
3242:     /// candidate matches the currently committed path, any pending candidate is
3243:     /// cleared (flap reset).  Returns `Ok(())` in all cases — callers should
3244:     /// not interpret "no immediate switch" as an error.
3245:     pub fn consider_path_change_for_peer(
3246:         &mut self,
3247:         node_id: &NodeId,
3248:         candidate: PathMode,
3249:     ) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3250:         let peer = self
3251:             .managed_peers
3252:             .get_mut(node_id)
3253:             .ok_or(Phase10Error::PeerNotManaged)?;
3254: 
3255:         if peer.path == candidate {
3256:             // Already on the desired path; reset any pending candidate.
3257:             peer.pending_path_mode = None;
3258:             peer.pending_since = None;
3259:             return Ok(());
3260:         }
3261: 
3262:         if peer.pending_path_mode != Some(candidate) {
3263:             // New candidate observed — start stability window.
3264:             peer.pending_path_mode = Some(candidate);
3265:             peer.pending_since = Some(Instant::now());
3266:             return Ok(());
3267:         }
3268: 
3269:         // Same candidate as before — check whether the stability window elapsed.
3270:         let elapsed = peer
3271:             .pending_since
3272:             .map(|t| t.elapsed())
3273:             .unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO);
3274:         let required = match candidate {
3275:             PathMode::Direct => Duration::from_millis(self.direct_stability_window_ms),
3276:             PathMode::Relay => Duration::from_millis(self.relay_stability_window_ms),
3277:         };
3278:         if elapsed >= required {
3279:             // Stability window elapsed — commit the path change.
3280:             let _ = peer; // release mutable borrow before calling commit
3281:             self.commit_path_change_for_peer(node_id, candidate)?;
3282:         }
3283:         Ok(())
3284:     }
3285: 
3286:     /// Commit a path change for a peer. This is the **single hardened apply
3287:     /// path** for peer endpoint updates. It updates the backend, refreshes
3288:     /// routes, asserts the measured exit policy, clears hysteresis state, and
3289:     /// logs the transition.
3290:     fn commit_path_change_for_peer(
3291:         &mut self,
3292:         node_id: &NodeId,
3293:         path: PathMode,
3294:     ) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3295:         let endpoint = {
3296:             let peer = self
3297:                 .managed_peers
3298:                 .get(node_id)
3299:                 .ok_or(Phase10Error::PeerNotManaged)?;
3300:             match path {
3301:                 PathMode::Direct => peer.direct_endpoint,
3302:                 PathMode::Relay => peer
3303:                     .relay_endpoint
3304:                     .ok_or(Phase10Error::RelayPathUnavailable)?,
3305:             }
3306:         };
3307:         self.reconfigure_managed_peer(node_id, endpoint, path)?;
3308:         // Clear hysteresis state after successful commit.
3309:         if let Some(peer) = self.managed_peers.get_mut(node_id) {
3310:             peer.pending_path_mode = None;
3311:             peer.pending_since = None;
3312:         }
3313:         log::info!(
3314:             "peer {}: committed path change to {:?}",
3315:             node_id.as_str(),
3316:             path
3317:         );
3318:         Ok(())
3319:     }
3320: 
3321:     fn commit_verified_traversal_path_for_peer(
3322:         &mut self,
3323:         node_id: &NodeId,
3324:         path: PathMode,
3325:     ) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3326:         self.ensure_started()?;
3327:         if self.peer_path(node_id) == Some(path) {
3328:             if let Some(peer) = self.managed_peers.get_mut(node_id) {
3329:                 peer.pending_path_mode = None;
3330:                 peer.pending_since = None;
3331:             }
3332:             return Ok(());
3333:         }
3334:         self.commit_path_change_for_peer(node_id, path)
3335:     }
3336: 
3337:     /// Apply a peer revocation immediately: remove from backend and dataplane.
3338:     /// Does not wait for the next generation cycle.
3339:     pub fn apply_revocation(&mut self, node_id: &NodeId) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3340:         self.backend.remove_peer(node_id)?;
3341:         self.managed_peers.remove(node_id);
3342:         self.refresh_peer_endpoint_routes_and_attest()?;
3343:         log::info!(
3344:             "peer {} revoked and removed from dataplane",
3345:             node_id.as_str()
3346:         );
3347:         Ok(())
3348:     }

3357:         self.relay_stability_window_ms = relay_stability_window_ms;

3371:     pub fn configure_traversal_paths(
3372:         &mut self,
3373:         node_id: &NodeId,
3374:         direct_endpoint: Option<SocketEndpoint>,
3375:         relay_endpoint: Option<SocketEndpoint>,
3376:     ) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3377:         self.ensure_started()?;
3378: 
3379:         let managed = self
3380:             .managed_peers
3381:             .get_mut(node_id)
3382:             .ok_or(Phase10Error::PeerNotManaged)?;
3383:         let current_path = managed.path;
3384:         let current_endpoint = managed.configured.endpoint;
3385:         if let Some(endpoint) = direct_endpoint {
3386:             managed.direct_endpoint = endpoint;
3387:         }
3388:         managed.relay_endpoint = relay_endpoint;
3389: 
3390:         let reconfigure_endpoint = match current_path {
3391:             PathMode::Direct => Some(managed.direct_endpoint),
3392:             PathMode::Relay => managed.relay_endpoint,
3393:         };
3394:         if let Some(endpoint) = reconfigure_endpoint {
3395:             let needs_update = current_endpoint != endpoint;
3396:             if needs_update {
3397:                 let _ = managed;
3398:                 self.reconfigure_managed_peer(node_id, endpoint, current_path)?;
3399:             }
3400:         }
3401:         Ok(())
3402:     }

3442:         if !self.managed_peers.contains_key(node_id) {

3448:     pub fn evaluate_traversal_probes(
3449:         &mut self,
3450:         node_id: &NodeId,
3451:         evaluation: TraversalProbeEvaluation<'_>,
3452:     ) -> Result<TraversalProbeReport, Phase10Error> {
3453:         self.ensure_started()?;
3454:         if evaluation.handshake_freshness_secs == 0 {
3455:             return Err(Phase10Error::TraversalProbeFailed(
3456:                 "handshake freshness window must be greater than zero".to_string(),
3457:             ));
3458:         }
3459:         if !self.managed_peers.contains_key(node_id) {
3460:             return Err(Phase10Error::PeerNotManaged);
3461:         }
3462: 
3463:         if let Some(relay_endpoint) = evaluation.relay_endpoint {
3464:             self.configure_traversal_paths(node_id, None, Some(relay_endpoint))?;
3465:         }
3466: 
3467:         let current_endpoint = self
3468:             .backend
3469:             .current_peer_endpoint(node_id)?
3470:             .ok_or(Phase10Error::PeerNotManaged)?;
3471:         let current_handshake = self.backend.peer_latest_handshake_unix(node_id)?;
3472:         if evaluation
3473:             .direct_candidates
3474:             .iter()
3475:             .any(|candidate| candidate.endpoint == current_endpoint)
3476:             && handshake_is_fresh(
3477:                 current_handshake,
3478:                 evaluation.now_unix,
3479:                 evaluation.handshake_freshness_secs,
3480:             )
3481:         {
3482:             return Ok(TraversalProbeReport {
3483:                 decision: TraversalProbeDecision::Direct,
3484:                 reason: TraversalProbeReason::ExistingFreshHandshake,
3485:                 attempts: 0,
3486:                 selected_endpoint: current_endpoint,
3487:                 latest_handshake_unix: current_handshake,
3488:             });
3489:         }
3490: 
3491:         if evaluation.direct_candidates.is_empty() {
3492:             let relay_endpoint = evaluation.relay_endpoint.ok_or_else(|| {
3493:                 Phase10Error::TraversalProbeFailed(
3494:                     "traversal failed closed: no direct candidates and no relay endpoint"
3495:                         .to_string(),
3496:                 )
3497:             })?;
3498:             self.commit_verified_traversal_path_for_peer(node_id, PathMode::Relay)?;
3499:             self.configure_traversal_paths(node_id, None, Some(relay_endpoint))?;
3500:             self.reconfigure_managed_peer(node_id, relay_endpoint, PathMode::Relay)?;
3501:             return Ok(TraversalProbeReport {
3502:                 decision: TraversalProbeDecision::Relay,
3503:                 reason: TraversalProbeReason::NoDirectCandidatesRelayArmed,
3504:                 attempts: 0,
3505:                 selected_endpoint: relay_endpoint,
3506:                 latest_handshake_unix: current_handshake,
3507:             });
3508:         }
3509: 
3510:         let schedule = match evaluation.coordination_schedule {
3511:             Some(schedule) => schedule,
3512:             None => {
3513:                 if let Some(relay_endpoint) = evaluation.relay_endpoint {
3514:                     self.commit_verified_traversal_path_for_peer(node_id, PathMode::Relay)?;
3515:                     self.configure_traversal_paths(node_id, None, Some(relay_endpoint))?;
3516:                     self.reconfigure_managed_peer(node_id, relay_endpoint, PathMode::Relay)?;
3517:                     return Ok(TraversalProbeReport {
3518:                         decision: TraversalProbeDecision::Relay,
3519:                         reason: TraversalProbeReason::CoordinationRequiredRelayArmed,
3520:                         attempts: 0,
3521:                         selected_endpoint: relay_endpoint,
3522:                         latest_handshake_unix: current_handshake,
3523:                     });
3524:                 }
3525:                 let detail = evaluation.coordination_error.unwrap_or_else(|| {
3526:                     "validated signed traversal coordination required for direct probe".to_string()
3527:                 });
3528:                 return Err(Phase10Error::TraversalProbeFailed(format!(
3529:                     "traversal failed closed: {detail}"
3530:                 )));
3531:             }
3532:         };
3533: 
3534:         let engine = TraversalEngine::new(evaluation.engine_config).map_err(|err| {
3535:             Phase10Error::TraversalProbeFailed(format!("invalid traversal engine config: {err}"))
3536:         })?;
3537: 
3538:         let result = {
3539:             let mut runtime = Phase10PeerRuntime {
3540:                 controller: self,
3541:                 node_id: node_id.clone(),
3542:             };
3543:             let mut waiter = Phase10PeerWaiter;
3544: 
3545:             engine
3546:                 .execute_simultaneous_open(
3547:                     &mut runtime,
3548:                     &mut waiter,
3549:                     schedule,
3550:                     evaluation.local_candidates,
3551:                     evaluation.direct_candidates,
3552:                     evaluation.relay_endpoint,
3553:                     evaluation.now_unix,
3554:                     evaluation.handshake_freshness_secs,
3555:                 )
3556:                 .map_err(|err| Phase10Error::TraversalProbeFailed(err.to_string()))?
3557:         };
3558: 
3559:         match result.decision {
3560:             TraversalDecision::Direct {
3561:                 endpoint,
3562:                 reason: _,
3563:             } => {
3564:                 self.commit_verified_traversal_path_for_peer(node_id, PathMode::Direct)?;
3565:                 self.configure_traversal_paths(node_id, Some(endpoint), evaluation.relay_endpoint)?;
3566:                 self.reconfigure_managed_peer(node_id, endpoint, PathMode::Direct)?;
3567: 
3568:                 Ok(TraversalProbeReport {
3569:                     decision: TraversalProbeDecision::Direct,
3570:                     reason: TraversalProbeReason::FreshHandshakeObserved,
3571:                     attempts: result.attempts,
3572:                     selected_endpoint: endpoint,
3573:                     latest_handshake_unix: result.latest_handshake_unix,
3574:                 })
3575:             }
3576:             TraversalDecision::Relay {
3577:                 endpoint, reason, ..
3578:             } => {
3579:                 self.commit_verified_traversal_path_for_peer(node_id, PathMode::Relay)?;
3580:                 self.configure_traversal_paths(node_id, None, Some(endpoint))?;
3581:                 self.reconfigure_managed_peer(node_id, endpoint, PathMode::Relay)?;
3582: 
3583:                 let reason = match reason {
3584:                     TraversalDecisionReason::NoDirectCandidatesRelayArmed => {
3585:                         TraversalProbeReason::NoDirectCandidatesRelayArmed
3586:                     }
3587:                     _ => TraversalProbeReason::DirectProbeExhaustedRelayArmed,
3588:                 };
3589: 
3590:                 Ok(TraversalProbeReport {
3591:                     decision: TraversalProbeDecision::Relay,
3592:                     reason,
3593:                     attempts: result.attempts,
3594:                     selected_endpoint: endpoint,
3595:                     latest_handshake_unix: result.latest_handshake_unix,
3596:                 })
3597:             }
3598:             TraversalDecision::FailClosed { reason, .. } => {
3599:                 let endpoint = evaluation
3600:                     .direct_candidates
3601:                     .iter()
3602:                     .max_by_key(|candidate| candidate.priority)
3603:                     .map(|candidate| candidate.endpoint)
3604:                     .ok_or_else(|| {
3605:                         Phase10Error::TraversalProbeFailed(format!(
3606:                             "traversal failed closed: {reason:?}"
3607:                         ))
3608:                     })?;
3609:                 self.commit_verified_traversal_path_for_peer(node_id, PathMode::Direct)?;
3610:                 self.configure_traversal_paths(node_id, Some(endpoint), None)?;
3611:                 self.reconfigure_managed_peer(node_id, endpoint, PathMode::Direct)?;
3612: 
3613:                 Ok(TraversalProbeReport {
3614:                     decision: TraversalProbeDecision::Direct,
3615:                     reason: TraversalProbeReason::DirectProbeExhaustedUnprovenDirect,
3616:                     attempts: result.attempts,
3617:                     selected_endpoint: endpoint,
3618:                     latest_handshake_unix: result.latest_handshake_unix,
3619:                 })
3620:             }
3621:         }
3622:     }

3677:     pub fn shutdown(&mut self) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3678:         let _ = self.backend.set_exit_mode(ExitMode::Off);
3679:         self.backend.shutdown()?;
3680:         self.selected_exit_node = None;
3681:         self.lan_access_enabled = false;
3682:         self.managed_peers.clear();
3683:         self.current_routes.clear();
3684:         self.current_exit_mode = ExitMode::Off;
3685:         self.transition_to(DataplaneState::Init, "shutdown");
3686:         Ok(())
3687:     }
3688: 
3689:     fn reconfigure_managed_peer(
3690:         &mut self,
3691:         node_id: &NodeId,
3692:         endpoint: SocketEndpoint,
3693:         path: PathMode,
3694:     ) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3695:         let mut peer = self
3696:             .managed_peers
3697:             .get(node_id)
3698:             .cloned()
3699:             .ok_or(Phase10Error::PeerNotManaged)?;
3700:         peer.configured.endpoint = endpoint;
3701:         peer.path = path;
3702:         let current_endpoint = self.backend.current_peer_endpoint(node_id)?;
3703:         if current_endpoint == Some(endpoint) {
3704:             self.managed_peers.insert(node_id.clone(), peer);
3705:             return Ok(());
3706:         }
3707:         self.backend.update_peer_endpoint(node_id, endpoint)?;
3708:         self.refresh_peer_endpoint_routes_and_attest()?;
3709:         self.managed_peers.insert(node_id.clone(), peer);
3710:         Ok(())
3711:     }
3712: 
3713:     fn refresh_peer_endpoint_routes_and_attest(&mut self) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3714:         self.system.rollback_routes()?;
3715:         let peers = self
3716:             .managed_peers
3717:             .values()
3718:             .map(|peer| peer.configured.clone())
3719:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
3720:         self.system.apply_peer_endpoint_bypass_routes(&peers)?;
3721:         self.system.apply_routes(&self.current_routes)?;
3722:         self.system.assert_exit_policy(self.current_exit_mode)?;
3723:         Ok(())
3724:     }

3726:     fn transition_to(&mut self, target: DataplaneState, reason: &str) {
3727:         let event = TransitionEvent {
3728:             from_state: self.state,
3729:             to_state: target,
3730:             reason: reason.to_string(),
3731:             generation: self.generation,
3732:         };
3733:         self.transitions.push(event);
3734:         self.state = target;
3735:     }

3737:     fn ensure_started(&self) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3738:         if matches!(
3739:             self.state,
3740:             DataplaneState::DataplaneApplied | DataplaneState::ExitActive
3741:         ) {
3742:             return Ok(());
3743:         }
3744:         Err(Phase10Error::NotStarted)
3745:     }
3746: }
3747: 
3748: fn handshake_is_fresh(value: Option<u64>, now_unix: u64, freshness_secs: u64) -> bool {
3749:     value
3750:         .map(|timestamp| now_unix.saturating_sub(timestamp) <= freshness_secs)
3751:         .unwrap_or(false)
3752: }
3753: 
3754: /// Gate peer provisioning on membership status (M4).
3755: ///
3756: /// A node that is not positively confirmed `Active` in the membership
3757: /// directory is denied provisioning (default-deny).
3758: ///
3759: /// When the directory is unpopulated (no entries have been registered) the
3760: /// check is skipped so that deployments that have not yet adopted quorum
3761: /// membership governance are not broken.
3762: fn check_peer_membership_active(
3763:     node_id: &NodeId,
3764:     membership: &MembershipDirectory,
3765: ) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3766:     if !membership.is_populated() {
3767:         // Membership governance not yet active — skip the gate.
3768:         return Ok(());
3769:     }
3770:     match membership.node_status(node_id.as_str()) {
3771:         MembershipStatus::Active => Ok(()),
3772:         MembershipStatus::Revoked => Err(Phase10Error::MembershipRevoked(
3773:             node_id.as_str().to_string(),
3774:         )),
3775:         MembershipStatus::Unknown => Err(Phase10Error::MembershipNotFound(
3776:             node_id.as_str().to_string(),
3777:         )),
3778:     }
3779: }
3780: 
3781: fn validate_trust(policy: &TrustPolicy, evidence: TrustEvidence) -> Result<(), Phase10Error> {
3782:     if !evidence.tls13_valid {
3783:         return Err(Phase10Error::TrustRejected("tls13_not_valid"));
3784:     }
3785:     if !evidence.signed_control_valid {
3786:         return Err(Phase10Error::TrustRejected("signed_control_invalid"));
3787:     }
3788:     if evidence.signed_data_age_secs > policy.max_signed_data_age_secs {
3789:         return Err(Phase10Error::TrustRejected("signed_data_stale"));
3790:     }
3791:     if evidence.clock_skew_secs > policy.max_clock_skew_secs {
3792:         return Err(Phase10Error::TrustRejected("clock_skew_exceeded"));
3793:     }
3794:     Ok(())
3795: }

3797: fn resolve_binary_path(
3798:     env_var: &str,
3799:     default: &str,
3800:     program: PrivilegedCommandProgram,
3801: ) -> Result<PathBuf, SystemError> {
3802:     let configured = std::env::var(env_var).ok();
3803:     let raw = configured
3804:         .as_deref()
3805:         .map(str::trim)
3806:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
3807:         .unwrap_or(default);
3808:     validate_binary_path(raw, program)?;
3809:     Ok(PathBuf::from(raw))
3810: }
3811: 
3812: fn resolve_binary_path_for_program(
3813:     program: PrivilegedCommandProgram,
3814: ) -> Result<PathBuf, SystemError> {
3815:     match program {
3816:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip => resolve_binary_path(
3817:             IP_BINARY_PATH_ENV,
3818:             DEFAULT_IP_BINARY_PATH,
3819:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip,
3820:         ),
3821:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft => resolve_binary_path(
3822:             NFT_BINARY_PATH_ENV,
3823:             DEFAULT_NFT_BINARY_PATH,
3824:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft,
3825:         ),
3826:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Wg => resolve_binary_path(
3827:             WG_BINARY_PATH_ENV,
3828:             DEFAULT_WG_BINARY_PATH,
3829:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Wg,
3830:         ),
3831:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Sysctl => resolve_binary_path(
3832:             SYSCTL_BINARY_PATH_ENV,
3833:             DEFAULT_SYSCTL_BINARY_PATH,
3834:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Sysctl,
3835:         ),
3836:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ifconfig => resolve_binary_path(
3837:             IFCONFIG_BINARY_PATH_ENV,
3838:             DEFAULT_IFCONFIG_BINARY_PATH,
3839:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ifconfig,
3840:         ),
3841:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Route => resolve_binary_path(
3842:             ROUTE_BINARY_PATH_ENV,
3843:             DEFAULT_ROUTE_BINARY_PATH,
3844:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Route,
3845:         ),
3846:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl => resolve_binary_path(
3847:             PFCTL_BINARY_PATH_ENV,
3848:             DEFAULT_PFCTL_BINARY_PATH,
3849:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl,
3850:         ),
3851:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::WireguardGo => resolve_binary_path(
3852:             WIREGUARD_GO_BINARY_PATH_ENV,
3853:             DEFAULT_WIREGUARD_GO_BINARY_PATH,
3854:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::WireguardGo,
3855:         ),
3856:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Kill => resolve_binary_path(
3857:             KILL_BINARY_PATH_ENV,
3858:             DEFAULT_KILL_BINARY_PATH,
3859:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Kill,
3860:         ),
3861:     }
3862: }
3863: 
3864: fn validate_binary_path(raw: &str, program: PrivilegedCommandProgram) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
3865:     let path = Path::new(raw);
3866:     if !path.is_absolute() {
3867:         return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(format!(
3868:             "{} binary path must be absolute: {raw}",
3869:             program.as_str()
3870:         )));
3871:     }
3872:     let canonical = fs::canonicalize(path).map_err(|err| {
3873:         SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(format!(
3874:             "{} binary canonicalization failed for {}: {err}",
3875:             program.as_str(),
3876:             path.display()
3877:         ))
3878:     })?;
3879:     let metadata = fs::metadata(&canonical).map_err(|err| {
3880:         SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(format!(
3881:             "{} binary metadata read failed for {}: {err}",
3882:             program.as_str(),
3883:             canonical.display()
3884:         ))
3885:     })?;
3886:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
3887:         return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(format!(
3888:             "{} binary path must be a regular file: {}",
3889:             program.as_str(),
3890:             canonical.display()
3891:         )));
3892:     }
3893:     #[cfg(unix)]
3894:     {
3895:         let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
3896:         if mode & 0o111 == 0 {
3897:             return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(format!(
3898:                 "{} binary is not executable: {} ({:03o})",
3899:                 program.as_str(),
3900:                 canonical.display(),
3901:                 mode
3902:             )));
3903:         }
3904:         if mode & 0o022 != 0 {
3905:             return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(format!(
3906:                 "{} binary must not be group/other writable: {} ({:03o})",
3907:                 program.as_str(),
3908:                 canonical.display(),
3909:                 mode
3910:             )));
3911:         }
3912:         let owner_uid = metadata.uid();
3913:         if owner_uid != 0 {
3914:             return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(format!(
3915:                 "{} binary must be root-owned: {} (uid={owner_uid})",
3916:                 program.as_str(),
3917:                 canonical.display()
3918:             )));
3919:         }
3920:     }
3921:     Ok(())
3922: }
3923: 
3924: fn validate_net_device_name(value: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
3925:     if value.is_empty() || value.len() > 15 {
3926:         return Err("device name length must be between 1 and 15 characters");
3927:     }
3928:     if !value
3929:         .chars()
3930:         .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || ch == '-' || ch == '_')
3931:     {
3932:         return Err("device name contains invalid characters");
3933:     }
3934:     Ok(())
3935: }
3936: 
3937: fn validate_windows_interface_alias(value: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
3938:     if value.is_empty() || value.len() > 32 {
3939:         return Err("Windows interface alias length must be between 1 and 32 characters");
3940:     }
3941:     if !value
3942:         .chars()
3943:         .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '-' | '_' | '.' | '+' | '='))
3944:     {
3945:         return Err("Windows interface alias contains invalid characters");
3946:     }
3947:     Ok(())
3948: }

3954:             "{label} binary path must be absolute: {raw}"
3955:         )));
3956:     }

3960: #[allow(dead_code)]
3961: fn validate_windows_dns_bind_addr(addr: SocketAddr) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
3962:     if !addr.ip().is_loopback() {
3963:         return Err(SystemError::DnsApplyFailed(
3964:             "Windows DNS protection requires a loopback resolver bind address".to_string(),
3965:         ));
3966:     }
3967:     if addr.port() != 53 {
3968:         return Err(SystemError::DnsApplyFailed(
3969:             "Windows DNS protection requires rustynetd to bind the reviewed local resolver on 127.0.0.1:53 because Windows interface DNS settings cannot encode a non-default port".to_string(),
3970:         ));
3971:     }
3972:     Ok(())
3973: }

4009: pub fn write_state_transition_audit(
4010:     path: impl AsRef<Path>,
4011:     transitions: &[TransitionEvent],
4012: ) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
4013:     let path = path.as_ref();
4014:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
4015:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| SystemError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
4016:     }
4017: 
4018:     let mut output = String::new();
4019:     for transition in transitions {
4020:         output.push_str(&format!(
4021:             "generation={} from={:?} to={:?} reason={}\n",
4022:             transition.generation, transition.from_state, transition.to_state, transition.reason
4023:         ));
4024:     }
4025: 
4026:     fs::write(path, output).map_err(|err| SystemError::Io(err.to_string()))
4027: }

4030: pub struct PerfMetric {
4031:     pub name: &'static str,
4032:     pub value: f64,
4033:     pub threshold: &'static str,
4034:     pub status: &'static str,
4035: }
4036: 
4037: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
4038: pub struct Phase10PerfMeasurement {
4039:     pub soak_test_hours: u64,
4040:     pub idle_cpu_percent: f64,
4041:     pub idle_rss_mb: f64,
4042:     pub reconnect_seconds: f64,
4043:     pub route_apply_p95_seconds: f64,
4044:     pub throughput_overhead_percent: f64,
4045: }
4046: 
4047: impl Phase10PerfMeasurement {
4048:     fn validate(self) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
4049:         if self.soak_test_hours == 0 {
4050:             return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(
4051:                 "soak_test_hours must be greater than zero".to_string(),
4052:             ));
4053:         }
4054:         for (name, value) in [
4055:             ("idle_cpu_percent", self.idle_cpu_percent),
4056:             ("idle_rss_mb", self.idle_rss_mb),
4057:             ("reconnect_seconds", self.reconnect_seconds),
4058:             ("route_apply_p95_seconds", self.route_apply_p95_seconds),
4059:             (
4060:                 "throughput_overhead_percent",
4061:                 self.throughput_overhead_percent,
4062:             ),
4063:         ] {
4064:             if !value.is_finite() || value < 0.0 {
4065:                 return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(format!(
4066:                     "{name} must be a finite non-negative number"
4067:                 )));
4068:             }
4069:         }
4070:         Ok(())
4071:     }
4072: }
4073: 
4074: fn metric_status(value: f64, threshold_max: f64) -> &'static str {
4075:     if value <= threshold_max {
4076:         "pass"
4077:     } else {
4078:         "fail"
4079:     }
4080: }
4081: 
4082: pub fn write_phase10_perf_report(
4083:     path: impl AsRef<Path>,
4084:     measurements: Phase10PerfMeasurement,
4085:     environment: &str,
4086: ) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
4087:     measurements.validate()?;
4088:     if environment.trim().is_empty() {
4089:         return Err(SystemError::PrerequisiteCheckFailed(
4090:             "environment must not be empty".to_string(),
4091:         ));
4092:     }
4093: 
4094:     let metrics = [
4095:         PerfMetric {
4096:             name: "idle_cpu_percent",
4097:             value: measurements.idle_cpu_percent,
4098:             threshold: "<=2",
4099:             status: metric_status(measurements.idle_cpu_percent, 2.0),
4100:         },
4101:         PerfMetric {
4102:             name: "idle_rss_mb",
4103:             value: measurements.idle_rss_mb,
4104:             threshold: "<=120",
4105:             status: metric_status(measurements.idle_rss_mb, 120.0),
4106:         },
4107:         PerfMetric {
4108:             name: "reconnect_seconds",
4109:             value: measurements.reconnect_seconds,
4110:             threshold: "<=5",
4111:             status: metric_status(measurements.reconnect_seconds, 5.0),
4112:         },
4113:         PerfMetric {
4114:             name: "route_apply_p95_seconds",
4115:             value: measurements.route_apply_p95_seconds,
4116:             threshold: "<=2",
4117:             status: metric_status(measurements.route_apply_p95_seconds, 2.0),
4118:         },
4119:         PerfMetric {
4120:             name: "throughput_overhead_percent",
4121:             value: measurements.throughput_overhead_percent,
4122:             threshold: "<=15",
4123:             status: metric_status(measurements.throughput_overhead_percent, 15.0),
4124:         },
4125:     ];
4126:     let soak_status = if measurements.soak_test_hours >= 24
4127:         && metrics.iter().all(|metric| metric.status == "pass")
4128:     {
4129:         "pass"
4130:     } else {
4131:         "fail"
4132:     };
4133:     let captured_at_unix = std::time::SystemTime::now()
4134:         .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
4135:         .map_err(|err| SystemError::Io(err.to_string()))?
4136:         .as_secs();
4137: 
4138:     let path = path.as_ref();
4139:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
4140:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| SystemError::Io(err.to_string()))?;
4141:     }
4142: 
4143:     let mut out = format!(
4144: /* ELIDED: original line had 22 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
4145:         environment, captured_at_unix, measurements.soak_test_hours, soak_status
4146:     );
4147:     for (index, metric) in metrics.iter().enumerate() {
4148:         let comma = if index + 1 == metrics.len() { "" } else { "," };
4149:         out.push_str(&format!(
4150: /* ELIDED: original line had 14 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
4151:             metric.name, metric.value, metric.threshold, metric.status, comma
4152:         ));
4153:     }
4154:     out.push_str("  ]\n}\n");
4155: 
4156:     fs::write(path, out).map_err(|err| SystemError::Io(err.to_string()))
4157: }

4327:         ) -> Result<(), BackendError> {
4328:             if !self.started {
4329:                 return Err(BackendError::not_running("backend not started"));
4330:             }
4331:             let Some(peer) = self.peers.get_mut(node_id) else {
4332:                 return Err(BackendError::invalid_input("peer is not configured"));

4352:             if !self.started {

4398:         fn initiate_peer_handshake(
4399:             &mut self,
4400:             node_id: &NodeId,
4401:             _force_resend: bool,
4402:         ) -> Result<(), BackendError> {
4403:             if !self.started {
4404:                 return Err(BackendError::not_running("backend not started"));
4405:             }
4406:             let Some(peer) = self.peers.get(node_id) else {
4407:                 return Err(BackendError::invalid_input("peer is not configured"));
4408:             };
4409:             let endpoint_key = format!("{}:{}", peer.endpoint.addr, peer.endpoint.port);
4410:             *self
4411:                 .probe_trigger_count_by_node
4412:                 .entry(node_id.clone())
4413:                 .or_insert(0) += 1;
4414:             if let Some(latest_handshake_unix) = self
4415:                 .handshake_on_probe_by_endpoint
4416:                 .get(&endpoint_key)
4417:                 .copied()
4418:             {
4419:                 self.latest_handshakes_by_endpoint
4420:                     .insert(endpoint_key, latest_handshake_unix);
4421:             }
4422:             Ok(())
4423:         }
4424: 
4425:         fn shutdown(&mut self) -> Result<(), BackendError> {
4426:             self.started = false;
4427:             self.peers.clear();
4428:             self.handshake_on_probe_by_endpoint.clear();
4429:             self.probe_trigger_count_by_node.clear();
4430:             self.routes.clear();
4431:             self.exit_mode = ExitMode::Off;
4432:             Ok(())
4433:         }
4434:     }

4557:     #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
4558:     fn parse_helper_request_command(line: &str) -> Option<String> {
4559:         let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(line).ok()?;
4560:         let program = payload.get("program")?.as_str()?;
4561:         let args = payload.get("args")?.as_array()?;
4562:         let parts = args
4563:             .iter()
4564:             .map(|value| value.as_str())
4565:             .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()?;
4566:         Some(format!("{program} {}", parts.join(" ")))
4567:     }

4570:     fn phase10_test_socket_path(prefix: &str) -> PathBuf {
4571:         let unique = SystemTime::now()
4572:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
4573:             .expect("clock should be valid")
4574:             .as_nanos();
4575:         // Keep socket paths short enough for UNIX domain limits, especially on macOS.
4576:         PathBuf::from("/tmp").join(format!(
4577:             "rn10-{prefix}-{}-{unique:x}.sock",
4578:             std::process::id()
4579:         ))

4582:     #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
4583:     fn spawn_privileged_capture_helper(
4584:         socket_path: &Path,
4585:     ) -> (
4586:         Arc<Mutex<Vec<String>>>,
4587:         Arc<AtomicBool>,
4588:         std::thread::JoinHandle<()>,
4589:     ) {
4590:         if socket_path.exists() {
4591:             let _ = std::fs::remove_file(socket_path);
4592:         }
4593:         let listener = UnixListener::bind(socket_path).unwrap_or_else(|err| {
4594:             panic!(
4595:                 "test helper socket should bind at {}: {err}",
4596:                 socket_path.display()
4597:             )
4598:         });
4599:         listener
4600:             .set_nonblocking(true)
4601:             .expect("test helper socket should be non-blocking");
4602: 
4603:         let commands = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::<String>::new()));
4604:         let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
4605:         let commands_clone = Arc::clone(&commands);
4606:         let stop_clone = Arc::clone(&stop);
4607: 
4608:         let handle = thread::spawn(move || {
4609:             while !stop_clone.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
4610:                 match listener.accept() {
4611:                     Ok((mut stream, _addr)) => {
4612:                         if stream.set_nonblocking(false).is_err() {
4613:                             continue;
4614:                         }
4615:                         let reader_stream = match stream.try_clone() {
4616:                             Ok(value) => value,
4617:                             Err(_) => continue,
4618:                         };
4619:                         let mut reader = BufReader::new(reader_stream);
4620:                         let mut line = String::new();
4621:                         match reader.read_line(&mut line) {
4622:                             Ok(read) if read > 0 => {
4623:                                 if let Some(command) = parse_helper_request_command(line.trim_end())
4624:                                 {
4625:                                     commands_clone
4626:                                         .lock()
4627:                                         .expect("test helper command log should lock")
4628:                                         .push(command);
4629:                                 } else {
4630:                                     let _ = stream.write_all(
4631:                                         b"{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"invalid helper request\"}\n",
4632:                                     );
4633:                                     let _ = stream.flush();
4634:                                     continue;
4635:                                 }
4636:                             }
4637:                             _ => {
4638:                                 let _ = stream.write_all(
4639:                                     b"{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"helper request read failed\"}\n",
4640:                                 );
4641:                                 let _ = stream.flush();
4642:                                 continue;
4643:                             }
4644:                         }
4645:                         if stream
4646:                             .write_all(
4647: /* ELIDED: original line had 12 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
4648:                             )
4649:                             .is_err()
4650:                         {
4651:                             continue;
4652:                         }
4653:                         let _ = stream.flush();
4654:                     }
4655:                     Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
4656:                         thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
4657:                     }
4658:                     Err(_) => break,
4659:                 }
4660:             }
4661:         });
4662: 
4663:         (commands, stop, handle)
4664:     }

5135:     fn firewall_generation_handoff_deletes_previous_table_only_after_new_rules_apply() {
5136:         let socket_path = phase10_test_socket_path("f");
5137: 
5138:         let (commands, stop, helper_thread) = spawn_privileged_capture_helper(&socket_path);
5139:         let client = PrivilegedCommandClient::new(socket_path.clone(), Duration::from_secs(2))
5140:             .expect("privileged client should initialize");
5141:         let mut system = LinuxCommandSystem::new(
5142:             "rustynet0",
5143:             "enp0s9",
5144:             LinuxDataplaneMode::HybridNative,
5145:             Some(client),
5146:             false,
5147:             Vec::new(),
5148:         )
5149:         .expect("linux command system should initialize");
5150: 
5151:         DataplaneSystem::set_generation(&mut system, 1);
5152:         DataplaneSystem::apply_firewall_killswitch(&mut system)
5153:             .expect("first generation firewall apply should succeed");
5154:         let first_generation_count = commands.lock().expect("command log should lock").len();
5155: 
5156:         DataplaneSystem::set_generation(&mut system, 2);
5157:         DataplaneSystem::apply_firewall_killswitch(&mut system)
5158:             .expect("second generation firewall apply should succeed");
5159:         let command_log = commands.lock().expect("command log should lock").clone();
5160: 
5161:         stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
5162:         helper_thread
5163:             .join()
5164:             .expect("helper thread should join cleanly");
5165:         let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&socket_path);
5166: 
5167:         let handoff_commands = &command_log[first_generation_count..];
5168:         let delete_old_index = handoff_commands
5169:             .iter()
5170:             .position(|cmd| cmd.contains("nft delete table inet rustynet_g1"))
5171:             .expect("old generation table must be pruned in second apply");
5172:         let add_new_table_index = handoff_commands
5173:             .iter()
5174:             .position(|cmd| cmd.contains("nft add table inet rustynet_g2"))
5175:             .expect("new generation table must be created");
5176:         let add_new_forward_chain_index = handoff_commands
5177:             .iter()
5178:             .position(|cmd| cmd.contains("nft add chain inet rustynet_g2 forward"))
5179:             .expect("new generation forward chain must be installed");
5180:         let add_new_forward_rule_index = handoff_commands
5181:             .iter()
5182:             .position(|cmd| {
5183:                 cmd.contains(
5184:                     "nft add rule inet rustynet_g2 forward iifname rustynet0 oifname enp0s9 accept",
5185:                 )
5186:             })
5187:             .expect("new generation egress allow rule must be installed");
5188: 
5189:         assert!(
5190:             delete_old_index > add_new_table_index
5191:                 && delete_old_index > add_new_forward_chain_index
5192:                 && delete_old_index > add_new_forward_rule_index,
5193:             "old generation table was pruned before new fail-closed rules were fully applied"
5194:         );
5195:         assert_eq!(
5196:             delete_old_index,
5197:             handoff_commands.len().saturating_sub(1),
5198:             "old generation table prune must happen as the final handoff command"
5199:         );
5200:     }

5600:                 trust_ok(),

5602:                 vec![sample_peer("node-b")],
5603:                 vec![Route {
5604:                     destination_cidr: "100.100.20.0/24".to_string(),
5605:                     via_node: NodeId::new("node-b").expect("node should parse"),
5606:                     kind: RouteKind::Mesh,
5607:                 }],
5608:                 ApplyOptions::default(),
5609:             )
5610:             .expect("apply should succeed");
5611:         let current_endpoint = controller

5617:

5619:             .evaluate_traversal_probes(
5620:                 &peer_id,
5621:                 TraversalProbeEvaluation {
5622:                     local_candidates: &[ProbeTraversalCandidate {
5623:                         endpoint: current_endpoint,
5624:                         source: crate::traversal::CandidateSource::Host,
5625:                         priority: 900,
5626:                         observed_at_unix: 190,
5627:                     }],
5628:                     direct_candidates: &[ProbeTraversalCandidate {
5629:                         endpoint: current_endpoint,
5630:                         source: crate::traversal::CandidateSource::Host,
5631:                         priority: 900,
5632:                         observed_at_unix: 190,
5633:                     }],
5634:                     relay_endpoint: Some(SocketEndpoint {
5635:                         addr: "198.51.100.40".parse::<IpAddr>().expect("ip should parse"),
5636:                         port: 443,
5637:                     }),
5638:                     now_unix: 200,
5639:                     engine_config: TraversalEngineConfig::default(),
5640:                     handshake_freshness_secs: 30,
5641:                     coordination_schedule: None,
5642:                     coordination_error: None,
5643:                 },
5644:             )
5645:             .expect("existing handshake should keep direct path");
5646: 
5647:         assert_eq!(report.decision, TraversalProbeDecision::Direct);
5648:         assert_eq!(report.reason, TraversalProbeReason::ExistingFreshHandshake);
5649:         assert_eq!(report.attempts, 0);

6037:                 from_state: DataplaneState::Init,

6044:         write_phase10_perf_report(
6045:             &perf_path,
6046:             Phase10PerfMeasurement {
6047:                 soak_test_hours: 24,

6227:         );
6228:         assert!(
6229:             command_log
6230:                 .iter()
6231:                 .any(|cmd| cmd.contains("ip -6 route flush table 51820")),
6232:             "route rollback must flush IPv6 table 51820 state"
6233:         );
6234:     }

6236:     #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
6237:     fn sample_linux_firewall_ruleset(
6238:         interface_name: &str,
6239:         egress_interface: &str,
6240:         include_egress_allow: bool,
6241:         dns_protected: bool,
6242:         allow_tunnel_relay_forward: bool,
6243:     ) -> String {
6244:         let mut rules = format!(
6245:             "table inet rustynet_g1 {{\n  chain killswitch {{\n    type filter hook output priority 0; policy drop;\n    oifname \"lo\" accept\n    ct state established,related accept\n    oifname \"{interface_name}\" accept\n"
6246:         );
6247:         if include_egress_allow {
6248:             rules.push_str(format!("    oifname \"{egress_interface}\" accept\n").as_str());
6249:         }
6250:         if dns_protected {
6251:             rules.push_str(
6252:                 format!(
6253:                     "    udp dport 53 oifname != \"{interface_name}\" drop\n    tcp dport 53 oifname != \"{interface_name}\" drop\n    udp dport 53 accept\n    tcp dport 53 accept\n"
6254:                 )
6255:                 .as_str(),
6256:             );
6257:         }
6258:         rules.push_str(
6259:             "  }\n  chain forward {\n    type filter hook forward priority 0; policy drop;\n    ct state established,related accept\n",
6260:         );
6261:         rules.push_str(
6262:             format!("    iifname \"{interface_name}\" oifname \"{egress_interface}\" accept\n")
6263:                 .as_str(),
6264:         );
6265:         if allow_tunnel_relay_forward {
6266:             rules.push_str(
6267:                 format!("    iifname \"{interface_name}\" oifname \"{interface_name}\" accept\n")
6268:                     .as_str(),
6269:             );
6270:         }
6271:         rules.push_str("  }\n}\n");
6272:         rules
6273:     }

6280:             &socket_path,

6284:                     PrivilegedCommandOutput {
6285:                         status: 0,
6286:                         stdout: sample_linux_firewall_ruleset(
6287:                             "rustynet0",
6288:                             "enp0s9",
6289:                             false,
6290:                             false,
6291:                             false,
6292:                         ),
6293:                         stderr: String::new(),
6294:                     },
6295:                 ),
6296:                 (
6297:                     "ip rule show".to_string(),
6298:                     PrivilegedCommandOutput {
6299:                         status: 0,
6300:                         stdout: "0: from all lookup local\n32765: from all lookup 51820\n32766: from all lookup main\n".to_string(),
6301:                         stderr: String::new(),
6302:                     },
6303:                 ),
6304:                 (
6305:                     "ip -4 route show table 51820".to_string(),
6306:                     PrivilegedCommandOutput {
6307:                         status: 0,
6308:                         stdout: "default dev rustynet0 scope link\n203.0.113.10/32 dev enp0s9 scope link\n".to_string(),
6309:                         stderr: String::new(),
6310:                     },
6311:                 ),
6312:                 (
6313:                     "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1".to_string(),
6314:                     PrivilegedCommandOutput {
6315:                         status: 0,
6316:                         stdout: "1.1.1.1 dev rustynet0 src 100.64.0.1 uid 0\n    cache\n"
6317:                             .to_string(),
6318:                         stderr: String::new(),
6319:                     },
6320:                 ),
6321:             ],
6322:         );
6323:         let client = PrivilegedCommandClient::new(socket_path.clone(), Duration::from_secs(2))
6324:             .expect("privileged client should initialize");
6325:         let mut system = LinuxCommandSystem::new(
6326:             "rustynet0",
6327:             "enp0s9",
6328:             LinuxDataplaneMode::HybridNative,
6329:             Some(client),
6330:             false,
6331:             Vec::new(),
6332:         )
6333:         .expect("linux command system should initialize");
6334:         system.firewall_table = Some("rustynet_g1".to_string());
6335:         system
6336:             .expected_peer_endpoint_bypass_routes
6337:             .insert(ExpectedBypassRoute {
6338:                 destination: "203.0.113.10/32".to_string(),
6339:                 interface_name: "enp0s9".to_string(),
6340:                 family: RouteTableFamily::V4,
6341:             });
6342: 
6343:         DataplaneSystem::assert_exit_policy(&mut system, ExitMode::FullTunnel)
6344:             .expect("full-tunnel proof should succeed");
6345:         let command_log = commands.lock().expect("command log should lock").clone();
6346: 
6347:         stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
6348:         helper_thread
6349:             .join()
6350:             .expect("helper thread should join cleanly");
6351:         let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&socket_path);
6352: 
6353:         assert!(
6354:             command_log.iter().any(|cmd| cmd.contains("ip rule show")),
6355:             "measured full-tunnel proof must inspect policy routing rules"
6356:         );
6357:         assert!(
6358:             command_log
6359:                 .iter()
6360:                 .any(|cmd| cmd.contains("ip -4 route show table 51820")),
6361:             "measured full-tunnel proof must inspect table 51820 contents"
6362:         );
6363:         assert!(
6364:             command_log
6365:                 .iter()
6366:                 .any(|cmd| cmd.contains("ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1")),
6367:             "measured full-tunnel proof must probe effective route truth"
6368:         );
6369:     }

6983:     fn make_controller_with_peer(
6984:         direct_stability_ms: u64,
6985:         relay_stability_ms: u64,
6986:     ) -> (
6987:         Phase10Controller<RecordingBackend, DryRunSystem>,
6988:         NodeId,
6989:         SocketEndpoint,
6990:         SocketEndpoint,
6991:     ) {
6992:         let policy = allow_shared_exit_policy();
6993:         let mut controller = Phase10Controller::new(
6994:             RecordingBackend::default(),
6995:             DryRunSystem::default(),
6996:             policy,
6997:             TrustPolicy::default(),
6998:         );
6999:         controller.set_stability_windows(direct_stability_ms, relay_stability_ms);
7000:         let peer_id = NodeId::new("node-b").expect("node id should parse");
7001:         let direct_ep = SocketEndpoint {
7002:             addr: "198.51.100.55".parse::<IpAddr>().expect("ip"),
7003:             port: 51820,
7004:         };
7005:         let relay_ep = SocketEndpoint {
7006:             addr: "198.51.100.40".parse::<IpAddr>().expect("ip"),
7007:             port: 443,
7008:         };
7009:         controller
7010:             .apply_dataplane_generation(
7011:                 trust_ok(),
7012:                 test_runtime_context(),
7013:                 vec![sample_peer("node-b")],
7014:                 vec![],
7015:                 ApplyOptions::default(),
7016:             )
7017:             .expect("apply should succeed");
7018:         controller
7019:             .configure_traversal_paths(&peer_id, Some(direct_ep), Some(relay_ep))
7020:             .expect("traversal endpoints should configure");
7021:         (controller, peer_id, direct_ep, relay_ep)
7022:     }

7024:     #[test]
7025:     fn test_no_switch_within_stability_window() {
7026:         // Relay stability window is 5000ms; calls made before 5000ms elapsed
7027:         // must NOT commit a path change.
7028:         let (mut ctrl, peer_id, _direct_ep, _relay_ep) = make_controller_with_peer(3_000, 5_000);
7029:         assert_eq!(ctrl.peer_path(&peer_id), Some(PathMode::Direct));
7030: 
7031:         // First call: sets pending
7032:         ctrl.consider_path_change_for_peer(&peer_id, PathMode::Relay)
7033:             .expect("consider should not error");
7034:         // Path not yet changed
7035:         assert_eq!(ctrl.peer_path(&peer_id), Some(PathMode::Direct));
7036: 
7037:         // Second call (elapsed = 0ms, well within 5000ms window): no commit
7038:         ctrl.consider_path_change_for_peer(&peer_id, PathMode::Relay)
7039:             .expect("consider should not error");
7040:         assert_eq!(ctrl.peer_path(&peer_id), Some(PathMode::Direct));
7041: 
7042:         // Backdate by only 4999ms (still within window): no commit
7043:         ctrl.backdate_pending_since_for_test(&peer_id, Duration::from_millis(4999));
7044:         ctrl.consider_path_change_for_peer(&peer_id, PathMode::Relay)
7045:             .expect("consider should not error");
7046:         assert_eq!(
7047:             ctrl.peer_path(&peer_id),
7048:             Some(PathMode::Direct),
7049:             "path must not switch before stability window expires"
7050:         );
7051:     }

7056: 
7057:         // First call sets pending

7059:             .expect("consider should not error");

7061: 
7062:         // Backdate by 5001ms (beyond relay window): commit should fire

7065:             .expect("consider should not error");

7082:     #[test]
7083:     fn test_flap_resets_stability_window() {
7084:         let (mut ctrl, peer_id, _direct_ep, _relay_ep) = make_controller_with_peer(3_000, 5_000);
7085: 
7086:         // Start Relay candidate window
7087:         ctrl.consider_path_change_for_peer(&peer_id, PathMode::Relay)
7088:             .expect("consider should not error");
7089:         // Backdate to just under the expiry (4800ms)
7090:         ctrl.backdate_pending_since_for_test(&peer_id, Duration::from_millis(4800));
7091: 
7092:         // Flap back to Direct — clears Relay candidate because it matches
7093:         // current path.  Then re-introduce Relay.
7094:         ctrl.consider_path_change_for_peer(&peer_id, PathMode::Direct)
7095:             .expect("consider should not error");
7096:         // Now introduce Relay again — window must restart from zero
7097:         ctrl.consider_path_change_for_peer(&peer_id, PathMode::Relay)
7098:             .expect("consider should not error");
7099:         // Check that calling again immediately (elapsed ≈ 0) does not commit
7100:         ctrl.consider_path_change_for_peer(&peer_id, PathMode::Relay)
7101:             .expect("consider should not error");
7102:         assert_eq!(
7103:             ctrl.peer_path(&peer_id),
7104:             Some(PathMode::Direct),
7105:             "path must not switch: flap reset the stability window"
7106:         );
7107:     }

7131:         // only called through commit_path_change_for_peer, never directly from
7132:         // consider_path_change_for_peer before the window expires.
7133:         let (mut ctrl, peer_id, direct_ep, _relay_ep) = make_controller_with_peer(3_000, 5_000);

7136:             .backend

7160:     #[test]
7161:     fn test_path_change_count_bounded_during_flap() {
7162:         // Simulate 60s of alternating Direct/Relay at 500ms intervals.
7163:         // With direct_window=3000ms and relay_window=5000ms, at most a few
7164:         // committed changes should occur (each requires its full window).
7165:         let (mut ctrl, peer_id, _direct_ep, _relay_ep) = make_controller_with_peer(3_000, 5_000);
7166: 
7167:         let mut committed_changes = 0usize;
7168:         let total_steps = 120usize; // 60s / 500ms
7169:         let mut last_path = ctrl.peer_path(&peer_id);
7170:         let mut _elapsed_ms: u64 = 0;
7171: 
7172:         for step in 0..total_steps {
7173:             let candidate = if step % 2 == 0 {
7174:                 PathMode::Relay
7175:             } else {
7176:                 PathMode::Direct
7177:             };
7178:             _elapsed_ms += 500;
7179:             ctrl.consider_path_change_for_peer(&peer_id, candidate)
7180:                 .expect("consider should not error");
7181:             // Simulate time passing by backdating pending_since by 500ms each
7182:             // step (only when a pending exists; this is a rough simulation)
7183:             ctrl.backdate_pending_since_for_test(&peer_id, Duration::from_millis(500));
7184:             ctrl.consider_path_change_for_peer(&peer_id, candidate)
7185:                 .expect("consider should not error");
7186: 
7187:             let new_path = ctrl.peer_path(&peer_id);
7188:             if new_path != last_path {
7189:                 committed_changes += 1;
7190:                 last_path = new_path;
7191:             }
7192:         }
7193: 
7194:         // With 500ms alternating flaps and a 5000ms relay window and 3000ms
7195:         // direct window, genuine commits are very rare. Allow a generous bound
7196:         // of ≤ 4 committed changes in 60s.
7197:         assert!(
7198:             committed_changes <= 4,
7199:             "too many path changes ({committed_changes}) during sustained flap in 60s window"
7200:         );
7201:     }

7338:     // ── A4-b: Path Transition ACL Preservation ───
7339:     //
7340:     // These tests verify that measured exit-policy proof is re-asserted on
7341:     // every direct↔relay path transition. The invariant:
7342:     // `assert_exit_policy:*` must appear in `DryRunSystem::operations` after
7343:     // each committed path change — the ACL rule set must never be in a
7344:     // more-permissive state after a transition than it was before.
7345: 
7346:     /// Helper: build a Phase10Controller in DataplaneApplied state with one
7347:     /// managed peer (node-b) that has both direct and relay endpoints
7348:     /// configured.  Stability windows are set to 0 so the second consecutive
7349:     /// call to `consider_path_change_for_peer` always commits immediately.
7350:     fn make_a4b_controller_with_both_endpoints_and_options(
7351:         options: ApplyOptions,
7352:     ) -> (
7353:         Phase10Controller<RecordingBackend, DryRunSystem>,
7354:         NodeId,
7355:         SocketEndpoint,
7356:         SocketEndpoint,
7357:     ) {
7358:         let policy = allow_shared_exit_policy();
7359:         let mut controller = Phase10Controller::new(
7360:             RecordingBackend::default(),
7361:             DryRunSystem::default(),
7362:             policy,
7363:             TrustPolicy::default(),
7364:         );
7365:         // Zero-length stability windows allow the second call to commit.
7366:         controller.set_stability_windows(0, 0);
7367: 
7368:         let peer_id = NodeId::new("node-b").expect("node id");
7369:         let direct_endpoint = SocketEndpoint {

7407:     #[test]
7408:     fn test_a4b_direct_to_relay_transition_asserts_measured_exit_policy() {
7409:         let (mut controller, peer_id, _direct_ep, _relay_ep) =
7410:             make_a4b_controller_with_both_endpoints();
7411:         assert_eq!(controller.peer_path(&peer_id), Some(PathMode::Direct));
7412: 
7413:         // Snapshot operations before transition.
7414:         let ops_before = controller.system.operations.len();
7415: 
7416:         // Two consecutive calls commit the path change (stability window = 0 ms).
7417:         controller
7418:             .mark_direct_failed(&peer_id)
7419:             .expect("first signal starts pending");
7420:         controller
7421:             .mark_direct_failed(&peer_id)
7422:             .expect("second signal commits relay path");
7423: 
7424:         assert_eq!(
7425:             controller.peer_path(&peer_id),
7426:             Some(PathMode::Relay),
7427:             "path must be Relay after committed failover"
7428:         );
7429: 
7430:         // ACL invariant: measured off-mode proof must appear after the transition.
7431:         let new_ops = &controller.system.operations[ops_before..];
7432:         assert!(
7433:             new_ops.contains(&"assert_exit_policy:off".to_string()),
7434:             "assert_exit_policy:off must be called during direct→relay transition; ops={new_ops:?}"
7435:         );
7436: 
7437:         // DataplaneState must remain applied (never FailClosed) during transition.
7438:         assert_ne!(
7439:             controller.state(),
7440:             DataplaneState::FailClosed,
7441:             "ACL transition must not push state to FailClosed"
7442:         );
7443:     }

7448:             make_a4b_controller_with_both_endpoints();

7470:             "path must be Direct after committed recovery"
7471:         );

7477:             "assert_exit_policy:off must be called during relay→direct transition; ops={new_ops:?}"

7484:     fn test_a4b_acl_operations_are_present_throughout_full_path_cycle() {
7485:         let (mut controller, peer_id, _direct_ep, _relay_ep) =
7486:             make_a4b_controller_with_both_endpoints();
7487: 
7488:         // The initial apply must include apply_firewall_killswitch.
7489:         assert!(
7490:             controller
7491:                 .system
7492:                 .operations
7493:                 .contains(&"apply_firewall_killswitch".to_string()),
7494:             "apply_firewall_killswitch must be called during initial generation apply"
7495:         );
7496: 
7497:         // Direct → Relay.
7498:         controller.mark_direct_failed(&peer_id).expect("pending");
7499:         controller
7500:             .mark_direct_failed(&peer_id)
7501:             .expect("commit relay");
7502:         assert!(
7503:             controller
7504:                 .system
7505:                 .operations
7506:                 .contains(&"assert_exit_policy:off".to_string()),
7507:             "assert_exit_policy:off must appear after first path transition"
7508:         );
7509: 
7510:         // Relay → Direct.
7511:         let proof_count_after_first = controller
7512:             .system
7513:             .operations
7514:             .iter()
7515:             .filter(|op| *op == "assert_exit_policy:off")
7516:             .count();
7517:         controller.mark_direct_recovered(&peer_id).expect("pending");
7518:         controller
7519:             .mark_direct_recovered(&peer_id)
7520:             .expect("commit direct");
7521:         let proof_count_after_second = controller
7522:             .system
7523:             .operations
7524:             .iter()
7525:             .filter(|op| *op == "assert_exit_policy:off")
7526:             .count();
7527: 
7528:         assert!(
7529:             proof_count_after_second > proof_count_after_first,
7530:             "assert_exit_policy:off call count must increase on relay→direct transition"
7531:         );
7532:         assert_ne!(controller.state(), DataplaneState::FailClosed);
7533:     }

7559:     #[test]
7560:     fn test_a4b_force_fail_closed_overrides_pending_path_transition() {
7561:         // Even when a path transition is in pending (hysteresis) state,
7562:         // force_fail_closed must immediately move the system to FailClosed.
7563:         // This ensures ACL rules can never be left in a partially-transitioned
7564:         // state — the daemon's emergency shutdown path always wins.
7565:         let (mut controller, peer_id, _direct_ep, _relay_ep) =
7566:             make_a4b_controller_with_both_endpoints();
7567:         assert_eq!(controller.peer_path(&peer_id), Some(PathMode::Direct));
7568:         assert_ne!(controller.state(), DataplaneState::FailClosed);
7569: 
7570:         // Start a relay transition (but don't commit — one call only).
7571:         controller
7572:             .mark_direct_failed(&peer_id)
7573:             .expect("first signal starts pending");
7574: 
7575:         // Peer must still be Direct (stability window not yet elapsed).
7576:         assert_eq!(
7577:             controller.peer_path(&peer_id),
7578:             Some(PathMode::Direct),
7579:             "peer must remain Direct while transition is pending"
7580:         );
7581: 
7582:         // force_fail_closed must override the pending transition immediately.
7583:         controller
7584:             .force_fail_closed("test_a4b_override")
7585:             .expect("force_fail_closed must succeed");
7586: 
7587:         assert_eq!(
7588:             controller.state(),
7589:             DataplaneState::FailClosed,
7590:             "state must be FailClosed after force_fail_closed regardless of pending transition"
7591:         );
7592:     }

   5: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
   6: pub enum ClientPlatform {
   7:     Linux,
   8:     MacOs,
   9:     Windows,
  10: }
  11: 
  12: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
  13: pub struct PlatformIntegrationStatus {
  14:     pub platform: ClientPlatform,
  15:     pub route_hook_ready: bool,
  16:     pub dns_hook_ready: bool,
  17:     pub firewall_hook_ready: bool,
  18:     pub leak_matrix_passed: bool,
  19: }
  20: 
  21: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
  22: pub enum PlatformParityError {
  23:     MissingRouteHook,
  24:     MissingDnsHook,
  25:     MissingFirewallHook,
  26:     LeakMatrixFailed,
  27: }
  28: 
  29: impl fmt::Display for PlatformParityError {
  30:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
  31:         match self {
  32:             PlatformParityError::MissingRouteHook => f.write_str("missing route hook"),
  33:             PlatformParityError::MissingDnsHook => f.write_str("missing dns hook"),
  34:             PlatformParityError::MissingFirewallHook => f.write_str("missing firewall hook"),
  35:             PlatformParityError::LeakMatrixFailed => f.write_str("leak matrix did not pass"),
  36:         }
  37:     }
  38: }
  39: 
  40: impl std::error::Error for PlatformParityError {}
  41: 
  42: pub fn validate_platform_parity(
  43:     status: PlatformIntegrationStatus,
  44: ) -> Result<(), PlatformParityError> {
  45:     if !status.route_hook_ready {
  46:         return Err(PlatformParityError::MissingRouteHook);
  47:     }
  48:     if !status.dns_hook_ready {
  49:         return Err(PlatformParityError::MissingDnsHook);
  50:     }
  51:     if !status.firewall_hook_ready {
  52:         return Err(PlatformParityError::MissingFirewallHook);
  53:     }
  54:     if !status.leak_matrix_passed {
  55:         return Err(PlatformParityError::LeakMatrixFailed);
  56:     }
  57:     Ok(())
  58: }
  59: 
  60: #[cfg(test)]
  61: mod tests {
  62:     use super::{
  63:         ClientPlatform, PlatformIntegrationStatus, PlatformParityError, validate_platform_parity,
  64:     };

  66:     #[test]
  67:     fn macos_and_windows_parity_checks_pass_when_hooks_are_ready() {
  68:         for platform in [ClientPlatform::MacOs, ClientPlatform::Windows] {

  70:                 platform,
  71:                 route_hook_ready: true,
  72:                 dns_hook_ready: true,
  73:                 firewall_hook_ready: true,
  74:                 leak_matrix_passed: true,
  75:             };
  76:             assert!(validate_platform_parity(status).is_ok());
  77:         }
  78:     }

  86:             firewall_hook_ready: true,
  87:             leak_matrix_passed: false,
  88:         };

  60:     Ip,
  61:     Nft,
  62:     Wg,

  66:     Pfctl,
  67:     WireguardGo,

  70: 
  71: impl PrivilegedCommandProgram {
  72:     pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
  73:         match self {
  74:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip => "ip",
  75:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft => "nft",
  76:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Wg => "wg",
  77:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Sysctl => "sysctl",
  78:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ifconfig => "ifconfig",
  79:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Route => "route",
  80:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl => "pfctl",
  81:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::WireguardGo => "wireguard-go",
  82:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Kill => "kill",
  83:         }
  84:     }
  85: 
  86:     fn parse(value: &str) -> Option<Self> {
  87:         match value {
  88:             "ip" => Some(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip),
  89:             "nft" => Some(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft),
  90:             "wg" => Some(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Wg),
  91:             "sysctl" => Some(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Sysctl),
  92:             "ifconfig" => Some(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ifconfig),
  93:             "route" => Some(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Route),
  94:             "pfctl" => Some(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl),
  95:             "wireguard-go" => Some(PrivilegedCommandProgram::WireguardGo),
  96:             "kill" => Some(PrivilegedCommandProgram::Kill),
  97:             _ => None,
  98:         }
  99:     }
 100: 
 101:     fn binary_candidates(self) -> &'static [&'static str] {
 102:         match self {
 103:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip => &["/usr/sbin/ip", "/sbin/ip", "/usr/bin/ip"],
 104:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft => &["/usr/sbin/nft", "/sbin/nft", "/usr/bin/nft"],
 105:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Wg => &["/usr/bin/wg", "/usr/sbin/wg", "/sbin/wg"],
 106:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Sysctl => {
 107:                 &["/usr/sbin/sysctl", "/sbin/sysctl", "/usr/bin/sysctl"]
 108:             }
 109:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ifconfig => {
 110:                 &["/sbin/ifconfig", "/usr/sbin/ifconfig", "/usr/bin/ifconfig"]
 111:             }
 112:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Route => {
 113:                 &["/sbin/route", "/usr/sbin/route", "/usr/bin/route"]
 114:             }
 115:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl => &["/sbin/pfctl", "/usr/sbin/pfctl"],
 116:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::WireguardGo => &[
 117:                 "/usr/local/bin/wireguard-go",
 118:                 "/opt/homebrew/bin/wireguard-go",
 119:                 "/usr/bin/wireguard-go",
 120:             ],
 121:             PrivilegedCommandProgram::Kill => &["/bin/kill", "/usr/bin/kill"],
 122:         }
 123:     }
 124: 
 125:     fn resolve_binary(self) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 126:         for candidate in self.binary_candidates() {
 127:             let candidate_path = Path::new(candidate);
 128:             if !candidate_path.exists() {
 129:                 continue;
 130:             }
 131:             return validate_privileged_program_binary(candidate_path, self.as_str());
 132:         }
 133:         Err(format!("no supported binary path found for {self}"))
 134:     }
 135: }

 150: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 151: pub struct PrivilegedCommandClient {
 152:     socket_path: PathBuf,
 153:     timeout: Duration,
 154: }
 155: 
 156: impl PrivilegedCommandClient {
 157:     pub fn new(socket_path: PathBuf, timeout: Duration) -> Result<Self, String> {
 158:         if socket_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 159:             return Err("privileged helper socket path must not be empty".to_string());
 160:         }
 161:         #[cfg(windows)]
 162:         {
 163:             validate_windows_pipe_path(&socket_path, WindowsLocalIpcRole::PrivilegedHelper)?;
 164:         }
 165:         #[cfg(not(windows))]
 166:         if !socket_path.is_absolute() {
 167:             return Err("privileged helper socket path must be absolute".to_string());
 168:         }
 169:         Ok(Self {
 170:             socket_path,
 171:             timeout,
 172:         })
 173:     }
 174: 
 175:     pub fn run_capture(
 176:         &self,
 177:         program: PrivilegedCommandProgram,
 178:         args: &[&str],
 179:     ) -> Result<PrivilegedCommandOutput, String> {
 180:         validate_request(program, args)?;
 181:         #[cfg(windows)]
 182:         {
 183:             validate_windows_pipe_path(&self.socket_path, WindowsLocalIpcRole::PrivilegedHelper)?;
 184:             let _ = program;
 185:             let _ = args;
 186:             let _ = self.timeout;
 187:             return Err(windows_ipc_blocker_reason(
 188:                 WindowsLocalIpcRole::PrivilegedHelper,
 189:             ));
 190:         }
 191:         #[cfg(not(windows))]
 192:         {
 193:             validate_privileged_helper_socket_security(&self.socket_path)?;
 194:             let mut stream = UnixStream::connect(&self.socket_path).map_err(|err| {
 195:                 format!(
 196:                     "privileged helper connect failed ({}): {err}",
 197:                     self.socket_path.display()
 198:                 )
 199:             })?;
 200:             stream
 201:                 .set_read_timeout(Some(self.timeout))
 202:                 .map_err(|err| format!("privileged helper read-timeout failed: {err}"))?;
 203:             stream
 204:                 .set_write_timeout(Some(self.timeout))
 205:                 .map_err(|err| format!("privileged helper write-timeout failed: {err}"))?;
 206: 
 207:             let request = HelperRequest {
 208:                 program: program.as_str().to_string(),
 209:                 args: args
 210:                     .iter()
 211:                     .map(|value| value.to_string())
 212:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
 213:             };
 214:             write_request_frame(&mut stream, &request)?;
 215:             let response = read_response_frame(&mut stream)?;
 216:             if !response.ok {
 217:                 return Err(response.error.unwrap_or_else(|| {
 218:                     "privileged helper reported an unknown failure".to_string()
 219:                 }));
 220:             }
 221:             Ok(PrivilegedCommandOutput {
 222:                 status: response.status.unwrap_or(-1),
 223:                 stdout: response.stdout.unwrap_or_default(),
 224:                 stderr: response.stderr.unwrap_or_default(),
 225:             })
 226:         }
 227:     }
 228: }
 229: 
 230: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 231: fn rustynetd_service_gid_for_socket(path: &Path) -> Option<u32> {
 232:     if !path.starts_with("/run/rustynet") {
 233:         return None;
 234:     }
 235:     Group::from_name("rustynetd")
 236:         .ok()
 237:         .flatten()
 238:         .map(|group| group.gid.as_raw())
 239: }
 240: 
 241: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 242: fn validate_privileged_helper_socket_security(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 243:     let expected_uid = Uid::effective().as_raw();
 244:     let allowed_owner_uids = [expected_uid, 0];
 245:     if let Some(service_gid) = rustynetd_service_gid_for_socket(path) {
 246:         return validate_root_managed_shared_runtime_socket(
 247:             path,
 248:             "privileged helper socket",
 249:             &allowed_owner_uids,
 250:             &allowed_owner_uids,
 251:             service_gid,
 252:         );
 253:     }
 254:     validate_owner_only_socket(
 255:         path,
 256:         "privileged helper socket",
 257:         &allowed_owner_uids,
 258:         &allowed_owner_uids,
 259:     )
 260: }
