 262: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 263: pub struct PrivilegedHelperConfig {
 264:     pub socket_path: PathBuf,
 265:     pub allowed_uid: u32,
 266:     pub allowed_gid: Option<u32>,
 267:     pub io_timeout: Duration,
 268: }
 269: 
 270: impl Default for PrivilegedHelperConfig {
 271:     fn default() -> Self {
 272:         Self {
 273:             socket_path: PathBuf::from(DEFAULT_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET_PATH),
 274:             allowed_uid: 0,
 275:             allowed_gid: None,
 276:             io_timeout: Duration::from_millis(DEFAULT_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_TIMEOUT_MS),
 277:         }
 278:     }
 279: }
 280: 
 281: pub fn run_privileged_helper(config: PrivilegedHelperConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
 282:     if config.socket_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 283:         return Err("privileged helper socket path must not be empty".to_string());
 284:     }
 285:     #[cfg(windows)]
 286:     {
 287:         validate_windows_pipe_path(&config.socket_path, WindowsLocalIpcRole::PrivilegedHelper)?;
 288:         let _ = config.allowed_uid;
 289:         let _ = config.allowed_gid;
 290:         let _ = config.io_timeout;
 291:         return Err(windows_ipc_blocker_reason(
 292:             WindowsLocalIpcRole::PrivilegedHelper,
 293:         ));
 294:     }
 295:     #[cfg(not(windows))]
 296:     if !config.socket_path.is_absolute() {
 297:         return Err("privileged helper socket path must be absolute".to_string());
 298:     }
 299: 
 300:     #[cfg(not(windows))]
 301:     {
 302:         if let Some(parent) = config.socket_path.parent() {
 303:             fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 304:                 format!(
 305:                     "create privileged helper socket parent {} failed: {err}",
 306:                     parent.display()
 307:                 )
 308:             })?;
 309:             if let Some(gid) = config.allowed_gid {
 310:                 chown(parent, None, Some(Gid::from_raw(gid))).map_err(|err| {
 311:                     format!(
 312:                         "set privileged helper socket parent group {} failed: {err}",
 313:                         parent.display()
 314:                     )
 315:                 })?;
 316:             }
 317:             let parent_mode = if config.allowed_gid.is_some() {
 318:                 0o770
 319:             } else {
 320:                 0o700
 321:             };
 322:             fs::set_permissions(parent, fs::Permissions::from_mode(parent_mode)).map_err(
 323:                 |err| {
 324:                     format!(
 325:                         "set privileged helper socket parent permissions {} failed: {err}",
 326:                         parent.display()
 327:                     )
 328:                 },
 329:             )?;
 330:         }
 331: 
 332:         if config.socket_path.exists() {
 333:             let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&config.socket_path).map_err(|err| {
 334:                 format!(
 335:                     "inspect existing privileged helper socket {} failed: {err}",
 336:                     config.socket_path.display()
 337:                 )
 338:             })?;
 339:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 340:                 return Err("privileged helper socket path must not be a symlink".to_string());
 341:             }
 342:             if !metadata.file_type().is_socket() {
 343:                 return Err(format!(
 344:                     "privileged helper socket path exists but is not a socket: {}",
 345:                     config.socket_path.display()
 346:                 ));
 347:             }
 348:             fs::remove_file(&config.socket_path).map_err(|err| {
 349:                 format!(
 350:                     "remove existing privileged helper socket {} failed: {err}",
 351:                     config.socket_path.display()
 352:                 )
 353:             })?;
 354:         }
 355: 
 356:         let listener = UnixListener::bind(&config.socket_path).map_err(|err| {
 357:             format!(
 358:                 "bind privileged helper socket {} failed: {err}",
 359:                 config.socket_path.display()
 360:             )
 361:         })?;
 362:         fs::set_permissions(&config.socket_path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o660)).map_err(
 363:             |err| {
 364:                 format!(
 365:                     "set privileged helper socket permissions {} failed: {err}",
 366:                     config.socket_path.display()
 367:                 )
 368:             },
 369:         )?;
 370:         if let Some(gid) = config.allowed_gid {
 371:             chown(&config.socket_path, None, Some(Gid::from_raw(gid))).map_err(|err| {
 372:                 format!(
 373:                     "set privileged helper socket group {} failed: {err}",
 374:                     config.socket_path.display()
 375:                 )
 376:             })?;
 377:         }
 378: 
 379:         loop {
 380:             let (mut stream, _) = listener
 381:                 .accept()
 382:                 .map_err(|err| format!("accept privileged helper connection failed: {err}"))?;
 383:             stream
 384:                 .set_read_timeout(Some(config.io_timeout))
 385:                 .map_err(|err| format!("set privileged helper read-timeout failed: {err}"))?;
 386:             stream
 387:                 .set_write_timeout(Some(config.io_timeout))
 388:                 .map_err(|err| format!("set privileged helper write-timeout failed: {err}"))?;
 389: 
 390:             let authorized = peer_uid(&stream)
 391:                 .map(|uid| uid == config.allowed_uid || uid == 0)
 392:                 .unwrap_or(false);
 393:             if !authorized {
 394:                 let _ = write_response(
 395:                     &mut stream,
 396:                     HelperResponse::error("unauthorized privileged helper peer".to_string()),
 397:                 );
 398:                 continue;
 399:             }
 400: 
 401:             let response = match read_request(&mut stream) {
 402:                 Ok(request) => handle_request_with_timeout(request, config.io_timeout),
 403:                 Err(err) => HelperResponse::error(err),
 404:             };
 405:             let _ = write_response(&mut stream, response);
 406:         }
 407:     }
 408: }
 409: 
 410: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 411: struct HelperRequest {
 412:     program: String,
 413:     args: Vec<String>,
 414: }
 415: 
 416: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 417: struct HelperResponse {
 418:     ok: bool,
 419:     status: Option<i32>,
 420:     stdout: Option<String>,
 421:     stderr: Option<String>,
 422:     error: Option<String>,
 423: }
 424: 
 425: impl HelperResponse {
 426:     fn error(message: String) -> Self {
 427:         Self {
 428:             ok: false,
 429:             status: None,
 430:             stdout: None,
 431:             stderr: None,
 432:             error: Some(message),
 433:         }
 434:     }
 435: 
 436:     fn success(status: i32, stdout: String, stderr: String) -> Self {
 437:         Self {
 438:             ok: true,
 439:             status: Some(status),
 440:             stdout: Some(stdout),
 441:             stderr: Some(stderr),
 442:             error: None,
 443:         }
 444:     }
 445: }
 446: 
 447: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 448: fn read_request(stream: &mut UnixStream) -> Result<HelperRequest, String> {
 449:     let request_bytes = read_frame(stream, HELPER_FRAME_TYPE_REQUEST)?;
 450:     decode_helper_request(&request_bytes).map_err(|err| format!("request decode failed: {err}"))
 451: }
 452: 
 453: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 454: fn write_response(stream: &mut UnixStream, response: HelperResponse) -> Result<(), String> {
 455:     let response_bytes = encode_helper_response(&response)
 456:         .map_err(|err| format!("encode response failed: {err}"))?;
 457:     write_frame(stream, HELPER_FRAME_TYPE_RESPONSE, &response_bytes)
 458: }
 459: 
 460: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 461: fn write_request_frame(stream: &mut UnixStream, request: &HelperRequest) -> Result<(), String> {
 462:     let request_bytes = encode_helper_request(request)
 463:         .map_err(|err| format!("privileged helper request encode failed: {err}"))?;
 464:     write_frame(stream, HELPER_FRAME_TYPE_REQUEST, &request_bytes)
 465:         .map_err(|err| format!("privileged helper request write failed: {err}"))
 466: }
 467: 
 468: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 469: fn read_response_frame(stream: &mut UnixStream) -> Result<HelperResponse, String> {
 470:     let response_bytes = read_frame(stream, HELPER_FRAME_TYPE_RESPONSE)
 471:         .map_err(|err| format!("privileged helper response read failed: {err}"))?;
 472:     decode_helper_response(&response_bytes)
 473:         .map_err(|err| format!("privileged helper response decode failed: {err}"))
 474: }
 475: 
 476: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 477: fn write_frame(stream: &mut UnixStream, message_type: u8, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
 478:     if payload.is_empty() {
 479:         return Err("frame payload must not be empty".to_string());
 480:     }
 481:     if payload.len() > MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES {
 482:         return Err("frame payload exceeds maximum size".to_string());
 483:     }
 484:     let payload_len =
 485:         u32::try_from(payload.len()).map_err(|_| "frame payload length overflow".to_string())?;
 486:     let mut header = [0u8; HELPER_FRAME_HEADER_BYTES];
 487:     header[..4].copy_from_slice(&HELPER_FRAME_MAGIC);
 488:     header[4] = HELPER_FRAME_VERSION;
 489:     header[5] = message_type;
 490:     header[6..10].copy_from_slice(&payload_len.to_be_bytes());
 491:     stream
 492:         .write_all(&header)
 493:         .map_err(|err| format!("write frame header failed: {err}"))?;
 494:     stream
 495:         .write_all(payload)
 496:         .map_err(|err| format!("write frame payload failed: {err}"))?;
 497:     stream
 498:         .flush()
 499:         .map_err(|err| format!("flush frame failed: {err}"))?;
 500:     stream
 501:         .shutdown(Shutdown::Write)
 502:         .map_err(|err| format!("shutdown frame writer failed: {err}"))
 503: }
 504: 
 505: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 506: fn read_frame(stream: &mut UnixStream, expected_message_type: u8) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
 507:     let mut header = [0u8; HELPER_FRAME_HEADER_BYTES];
 508:     stream
 509:         .read_exact(&mut header)
 510:         .map_err(|err| map_read_exact_error(err, "frame header"))?;
 511:     if header[..4] != HELPER_FRAME_MAGIC {
 512:         return Err("invalid frame magic".to_string());
 513:     }
 514:     if header[4] != HELPER_FRAME_VERSION {
 515:         return Err(format!(
 516:             "unsupported frame version {}; expected {}",
 517:             header[4], HELPER_FRAME_VERSION
 518:         ));
 519:     }
 520:     if header[5] != expected_message_type {
 521:         return Err(format!(
 522:             "unexpected frame type {}; expected {}",
 523:             header[5], expected_message_type
 524:         ));
 525:     }
 526:     let payload_len = u32::from_be_bytes([header[6], header[7], header[8], header[9]]) as usize;
 527:     if payload_len == 0 {
 528:         return Err("frame payload must not be empty".to_string());
 529:     }
 530:     if payload_len > MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES {
 531:         return Err("frame payload exceeds maximum size".to_string());
 532:     }
 533:     let mut payload = vec![0u8; payload_len];
 534:     stream
 535:         .read_exact(&mut payload)
 536:         .map_err(|err| map_read_exact_error(err, "frame payload"))?;
 537:     let mut trailing = [0u8; 1];
 538:     match stream.read(&mut trailing) {
 539:         Ok(0) => Ok(payload),
 540:         Ok(_) => Err("trailing bytes after frame payload".to_string()),
 541:         Err(err) => Err(format!("read frame trailer failed: {err}")),
 542:     }
 543: }
 544: 
 545: fn map_read_exact_error(err: std::io::Error, label: &str) -> String {
 546:     if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof {
 547:         return format!("truncated {label}");
 548:     }
 549:     format!("read {label} failed: {err}")
 550: }
 551: 
 552: fn encode_helper_request(request: &HelperRequest) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
 553:     let mut payload = Vec::new();
 554:     encode_string_field(
 555:         &mut payload,
 556:         request.program.as_str(),
 557:         "program",
 558:         MAX_PROGRAM_BYTES,
 559:     )?;
 560:     let arg_count = u16::try_from(request.args.len())
 561:         .map_err(|_| "argument count exceeds protocol limit".to_string())?;
 562:     payload.extend_from_slice(&arg_count.to_be_bytes());
 563:     for arg in &request.args {
 564:         encode_string_field(&mut payload, arg.as_str(), "arg", MAX_ARG_BYTES)?;
 565:     }
 566:     Ok(payload)
 567: }
 568: 
 569: fn decode_helper_request(payload: &[u8]) -> Result<HelperRequest, String> {
 570:     let mut cursor = 0usize;
 571:     let program = decode_string_field(payload, &mut cursor, "program", MAX_PROGRAM_BYTES)?;
 572:     let arg_count = decode_u16(payload, &mut cursor, "arg_count")? as usize;
 573:     if arg_count > MAX_ARGS {
 574:         return Err(format!("argument count exceeds maximum ({MAX_ARGS})"));
 575:     }
 576:     let mut args = Vec::with_capacity(arg_count);
 577:     for _ in 0..arg_count {
 578:         args.push(decode_string_field(
 579:             payload,
 580:             &mut cursor,
 581:             "arg",
 582:             MAX_ARG_BYTES,
 583:         )?);
 584:     }
 585:     ensure_payload_consumed(payload, cursor)?;
 586:     Ok(HelperRequest { program, args })
 587: }
 588: 
 589: fn encode_helper_response(response: &HelperResponse) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
 590:     let mut payload = Vec::new();
 591:     payload.push(u8::from(response.ok));
 592:     encode_optional_i32(&mut payload, response.status);
 593:     encode_optional_string_field(&mut payload, response.stdout.as_deref(), "stdout")?;
 594:     encode_optional_string_field(&mut payload, response.stderr.as_deref(), "stderr")?;
 595:     encode_optional_string_field(&mut payload, response.error.as_deref(), "error")?;
 596:     Ok(payload)
 597: }
 598: 
 599: fn decode_helper_response(payload: &[u8]) -> Result<HelperResponse, String> {
 600:     let mut cursor = 0usize;
 601:     let ok = decode_bool(payload, &mut cursor, "ok")?;
 602:     let status = decode_optional_i32(payload, &mut cursor, "status")?;
 603:     let stdout = decode_optional_string_field(payload, &mut cursor, "stdout", MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES)?;
 604:     let stderr = decode_optional_string_field(payload, &mut cursor, "stderr", MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES)?;
 605:     let error = decode_optional_string_field(payload, &mut cursor, "error", MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES)?;
 606:     ensure_payload_consumed(payload, cursor)?;
 607:     Ok(HelperResponse {
 608:         ok,
 609:         status,
 610:         stdout,
 611:         stderr,
 612:         error,
 613:     })
 614: }
 615: 
 616: fn encode_optional_i32(payload: &mut Vec<u8>, value: Option<i32>) {
 617:     match value {
 618:         Some(value) => {
 619:             payload.push(1);
 620:             payload.extend_from_slice(&value.to_be_bytes());
 621:         }
 622:         None => payload.push(0),
 623:     }
 624: }
 625: 
 626: fn decode_optional_i32(
 627:     payload: &[u8],
 628:     cursor: &mut usize,
 629:     label: &str,
 630: ) -> Result<Option<i32>, String> {
 631:     match decode_bool_flag(payload, cursor, label)? {
 632:         false => Ok(None),
 633:         true => Ok(Some(decode_i32(payload, cursor, label)?)),
 634:     }
 635: }
 636: 
 637: fn encode_optional_string_field(
 638:     payload: &mut Vec<u8>,
 639:     value: Option<&str>,
 640:     label: &str,
 641: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 642:     match value {
 643:         Some(value) => {
 644:             payload.push(1);
 645:             encode_string_field(payload, value, label, MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES)?;
 646:         }
 647:         None => payload.push(0),
 648:     }
 649:     Ok(())
 650: }
 651: 
 652: fn decode_optional_string_field(
 653:     payload: &[u8],
 654:     cursor: &mut usize,
 655:     label: &str,
 656:     max_bytes: usize,
 657: ) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
 658:     match decode_bool_flag(payload, cursor, label)? {
 659:         false => Ok(None),
 660:         true => Ok(Some(decode_string_field(
 661:             payload, cursor, label, max_bytes,
 662:         )?)),
 663:     }
 664: }
 665: 
 666: fn encode_string_field(
 667:     payload: &mut Vec<u8>,
 668:     value: &str,
 669:     label: &str,
 670:     max_bytes: usize,
 671: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 672:     let bytes = value.as_bytes();
 673:     if bytes.len() > max_bytes {
 674:         return Err(format!("{label} exceeds maximum size ({max_bytes} bytes)"));
 675:     }
 676:     let value_len =
 677:         u16::try_from(bytes.len()).map_err(|_| format!("{label} length exceeds protocol limit"))?;
 678:     payload.extend_from_slice(&value_len.to_be_bytes());
 679:     payload.extend_from_slice(bytes);
 680:     Ok(())
 681: }
 682: 
 683: fn decode_string_field(
 684:     payload: &[u8],
 685:     cursor: &mut usize,
 686:     label: &str,
 687:     max_bytes: usize,
 688: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 689:     let len = decode_u16(payload, cursor, label)? as usize;
 690:     if len > max_bytes {
 691:         return Err(format!("{label} exceeds maximum size ({max_bytes} bytes)"));
 692:     }
 693:     let end = cursor
 694:         .checked_add(len)
 695:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} length overflow"))?;
 696:     let value_bytes = payload
 697:         .get(*cursor..end)
 698:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("truncated {label}"))?;
 699:     *cursor = end;
 700:     std::str::from_utf8(value_bytes)
 701:         .map_err(|err| format!("{label} is not valid utf-8: {err}"))
 702:         .map(str::to_string)
 703: }
 704: 
 705: fn decode_bool(payload: &[u8], cursor: &mut usize, label: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
 706:     match decode_u8(payload, cursor, label)? {
 707:         0 => Ok(false),
 708:         1 => Ok(true),
 709:         value => Err(format!("invalid {label} flag {value}")),
 710:     }
 711: }
 712: 
 713: fn decode_bool_flag(payload: &[u8], cursor: &mut usize, label: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
 714:     decode_bool(payload, cursor, label)
 715: }
 716: 
 717: fn decode_u8(payload: &[u8], cursor: &mut usize, label: &str) -> Result<u8, String> {
 718:     let byte = *payload
 719:         .get(*cursor)
 720:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("truncated {label}"))?;
 721:     *cursor += 1;
 722:     Ok(byte)
 723: }
 724: 
 725: fn decode_u16(payload: &[u8], cursor: &mut usize, label: &str) -> Result<u16, String> {
 726:     let bytes = decode_fixed::<2>(payload, cursor, label)?;
 727:     Ok(u16::from_be_bytes(bytes))
 728: }
 729: 
 730: fn decode_i32(payload: &[u8], cursor: &mut usize, label: &str) -> Result<i32, String> {
 731:     let bytes = decode_fixed::<4>(payload, cursor, label)?;
 732:     Ok(i32::from_be_bytes(bytes))
 733: }
 734: 
 735: fn decode_fixed<const N: usize>(
 736:     payload: &[u8],
 737:     cursor: &mut usize,
 738:     label: &str,
 739: ) -> Result<[u8; N], String> {
 740:     let end = cursor
 741:         .checked_add(N)
 742:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} length overflow"))?;
 743:     let bytes = payload
 744:         .get(*cursor..end)
 745:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("truncated {label}"))?;
 746:     *cursor = end;
 747:     bytes
 748:         .try_into()
 749:         .map_err(|_| format!("invalid fixed-width payload for {label}"))
 750: }
 751: 
 752: fn ensure_payload_consumed(payload: &[u8], cursor: usize) -> Result<(), String> {
 753:     if cursor != payload.len() {
 754:         return Err("trailing bytes after helper payload".to_string());
 755:     }
 756:     Ok(())
 757: }
 758: 
 759: #[cfg(test)]
 760: fn handle_request(request: HelperRequest) -> HelperResponse {
 761:     handle_request_with_timeout(
 762:         request,
 763:         Duration::from_millis(DEFAULT_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_TIMEOUT_MS),
 764:     )
 765: }
 766: 
 767: fn handle_request_with_timeout(request: HelperRequest, timeout: Duration) -> HelperResponse {
 768:     let program = match PrivilegedCommandProgram::parse(&request.program) {
 769:         Some(program) => program,
 770:         None => {
 771:             return HelperResponse::error(format!(
 772:                 "unsupported privileged command program: {}",
 773:                 request.program
 774:             ));
 775:         }
 776:     };
 777:     let args = request.args.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 778:     if let Err(err) = validate_request(program, &args) {
 779:         return HelperResponse::error(err);
 780:     }
 781: 
 782:     let binary = match program.resolve_binary() {
 783:         Ok(path) => path,
 784:         Err(err) => return HelperResponse::error(err),
 785:     };
 786: 
 787:     match run_privileged_subprocess(&binary, &request.args, timeout) {
 788:         Ok(output) => {
 789:             let status = exit_status_code(output.status);
 790:             let stdout = truncate_lossy(&output.stdout, MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES);
 791:             let stderr = truncate_lossy(&output.stderr, MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES);
 792:             HelperResponse::success(status, stdout, stderr)
 793:         }
 794:         Err(err) => HelperResponse::error(format!(
 795:             "{program} command execution failed ({}): {err}",
 796:             binary.display(),
 797:         )),
 798:     }
 799: }
 800: 
 801: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 802: fn validate_privileged_program_binary(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 803:     if !path.is_absolute() {
 804:         return Err(format!(
 805:             "{label} binary path must be absolute: {}",
 806:             path.display()
 807:         ));
 808:     }
 809:     let canonical = fs::canonicalize(path)
 810:         .map_err(|err| format!("{label} binary canonicalization failed: {err}"))?;
 811:     let metadata =
 812:         fs::metadata(&canonical).map_err(|err| format!("{label} binary metadata failed: {err}"))?;
 813:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 814:         return Err(format!(
 815:             "{label} binary path must be a regular file: {}",
 816:             canonical.display()
 817:         ));
 818:     }
 819:     let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
 820:     if mode & 0o111 == 0 {
 821:         return Err(format!(
 822:             "{label} binary is not executable: {} ({mode:03o})",
 823:             canonical.display()
 824:         ));
 825:     }
 826:     if mode & 0o022 != 0 {
 827:         return Err(format!(
 828:             "{label} binary must not be group/other writable: {} ({mode:03o})",
 829:             canonical.display()
 830:         ));
 831:     }
 832:     let owner_uid = metadata.uid();
 833:     if owner_uid != 0 {
 834:         return Err(format!(
 835:             "{label} binary must be root-owned: {} (uid={owner_uid})",
 836:             canonical.display()
 837:         ));
 838:     }
 839:     Ok(canonical)
 840: }
 841: 
 842: #[cfg(windows)]
 843: fn validate_privileged_program_binary(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 844:     let _ = path;
 845:     Err(format!(
 846:         "{label} privileged helper binary validation is Unix-only; Windows helper execution remains blocked until reviewed named-pipe IPC and backend support are implemented"
 847:     ))
 848: }
 849: 
 850: fn run_privileged_subprocess(
 851:     binary: &Path,
 852:     args: &[String],
 853:     timeout: Duration,
 854: ) -> Result<std::process::Output, String> {
 855:     let mut child = Command::new(binary)
 856:         .args(args)
 857:         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
 858:         .stderr(Stdio::piped())
 859:         .spawn()
 860:         .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 861:     let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
 862: 
 863:     loop {
 864:         match child.try_wait().map_err(|err| err.to_string())? {
 865:             Some(_status) => {
 866:                 return child
 867:                     .wait_with_output()
 868:                     .map_err(|err| format!("wait for privileged subprocess failed: {err}"));
 869:             }
 870:             None if Instant::now() >= deadline => {
 871:                 let _ = child.kill();
 872:                 let _ = child.wait();
 873:                 return Err(format!("timed out after {} ms", timeout.as_millis()));
 874:             }
 875:             None => sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)),
 876:         }
 877:     }
 878: }
 879: 
 880: fn exit_status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 881:     status.code().unwrap_or(-1)
 882: }
 883: 
 884: fn truncate_lossy(bytes: &[u8], max_bytes: usize) -> String {
 885:     if bytes.len() <= max_bytes {
 886:         return String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes).to_string();
 887:     }
 888:     let mut out = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes[..max_bytes]).to_string();
 889:     out.push_str("...[truncated]");
 890:     out
 891: }
 892: 
 893: fn validate_request(program: PrivilegedCommandProgram, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
 894:     if args.len() > MAX_ARGS {
 895:         return Err(format!(
 896:             "too many arguments for privileged command {program}",
 897:         ));
 898:     }
 899:     if args.is_empty() {
 900:         return Err(format!(
 901:             "missing arguments for privileged command {program}",
 902:         ));
 903:     }
 904:     for arg in args {
 905:         if arg.is_empty() {
 906:             return Err(format!("empty argument in privileged command {program}"));
 907:         }
 908:         if arg.len() > MAX_ARG_BYTES {
 909:             return Err(format!("argument too long in privileged command {program}",));
 910:         }
 911:     }
 912:     match program {
 913:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ip => validate_ip_args(args),
 914:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Nft => validate_nft_args(args),
 915:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Wg => validate_wg_args(args),
 916:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Sysctl => validate_sysctl_args(args),
 917:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Ifconfig => validate_ifconfig_args(args),
 918:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Route => validate_route_args(args),
 919:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Pfctl => validate_pfctl_args(args),
 920:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::WireguardGo => validate_wireguard_go_args(args),
 921:         PrivilegedCommandProgram::Kill => validate_kill_args(args),
 922:     }
 923: }
 924: 
 925: fn is_safe_token(value: &str) -> bool {
 926:     value.chars().all(|ch| {
 927:         ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '-' | '_' | '.' | '/' | ':' | ',' | '=' | '+')
 928:     })
 929: }
 930: 
 931: #[cfg(test)]
 932: fn is_nft_token(value: &str) -> bool {
 933:     matches!(value, "{" | "}" | ";" | "!=") || is_safe_token(value)
 934: }
 935: 
 936: fn is_interface_name(value: &str) -> bool {
 937:     !value.is_empty()
 938:         && value.len() <= 15
 939:         && value
 940:             .chars()
 941:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '_' | '-'))
 942: }
 943: 
 944: fn is_path_token(value: &str) -> bool {
 945:     value.starts_with('/') && is_safe_token(value)
 946: }
 947: 
 948: fn is_u16_token(value: &str) -> bool {
 949:     value
 950:         .parse::<u16>()
 951:         .map(|parsed| parsed != 0)
 952:         .unwrap_or(false)
 953: }
 954: 
 955: fn is_u32_token(value: &str) -> bool {
 956:     value.parse::<u32>().is_ok()
 957: }
 958: 
 959: fn is_ipv4_or_ipv6(value: &str) -> bool {
 960:     value.parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok()
 961: }
 962: 
 963: fn is_cidr_token(value: &str) -> bool {
 964:     let Some((base, prefix)) = value.split_once('/') else {
 965:         return false;
 966:     };
 967:     let Ok(addr) = base.parse::<IpAddr>() else {
 968:         return false;
 969:     };
 970:     let Ok(prefix_value) = prefix.parse::<u8>() else {
 971:         return false;
 972:     };
 973:     match addr {
 974:         IpAddr::V4(_) => prefix_value <= 32,
 975:         IpAddr::V6(_) => prefix_value <= 128,
 976:     }
 977: }
 978: 
 979: fn is_wg_public_key_token(value: &str) -> bool {
 980:     !value.is_empty()
 981:         && value.len() <= 128
 982:         && value
 983:             .chars()
 984:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '+' | '/' | '='))
 985: }
 986: 
 987: fn is_wg_endpoint_token(value: &str) -> bool {
 988:     let Some((host, port)) = value.rsplit_once(':') else {
 989:         return false;
 990:     };
 991:     if host.is_empty() || !is_u16_token(port) {
 992:         return false;
 993:     }
 994:     host.chars()
 995:         .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '.' | ':' | '-' | '[' | ']'))
 996: }
 997: 
 998: fn is_allowed_ips_token(value: &str) -> bool {
 999:     !value.is_empty() && value.split(',').all(is_cidr_token)
1000: }
1001: 
1002: fn is_anchor_name_token(value: &str) -> bool {
1003:     value.starts_with("com.apple/rustynet_g")
1004:         && value
1005:             .chars()
1006:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '_' | '-' | '/' | '.'))
1007: }
1008: 
1009: fn is_owned_nft_table_token(value: &str) -> bool {
1010:     (value.starts_with("rustynet_g") || value.starts_with("rustynet_nat_g"))
1011:         && value
1012:             .chars()
1013:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '_' | '-'))
1014: }
1015: 
1016: fn is_owned_failclosed_table_token(value: &str) -> bool {
1017:     value.starts_with("rustynet_g")
1018:         && value
1019:             .chars()
1020:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '_' | '-'))
1021: }
1022: 
1023: fn is_owned_nat_table_token(value: &str) -> bool {
1024:     value.starts_with("rustynet_nat_g")
1025:         && value
1026:             .chars()
1027:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '_' | '-'))
1028: }
1029: 
1030: fn is_nft_family_token(value: &str) -> bool {
1031:     matches!(value, "inet" | "ip" | "ip6")
1032: }
1033: 
1034: fn is_nft_chain_token(value: &str) -> bool {
1035:     matches!(
1036:         value,
1037:         "killswitch" | "forward" | "input" | "output" | "prerouting" | "postrouting"
1038:     )
1039: }
1040: 
1041: fn is_nft_daddr_family_token(value: &str) -> bool {
1042:     matches!(value, "ip" | "ip6")
1043: }
1044: 
1045: fn is_cidr_for_nft_family(cidr: &str, family: &str) -> bool {
1046:     let Some((base, prefix)) = cidr.split_once('/') else {
1047:         return false;
1048:     };
1049:     let Ok(addr) = base.parse::<IpAddr>() else {
1050:         return false;
1051:     };
1052:     let Ok(prefix_value) = prefix.parse::<u8>() else {
1053:         return false;
1054:     };
1055:     match (family, addr) {
1056:         ("ip", IpAddr::V4(_)) => prefix_value <= 32,
1057:         ("ip6", IpAddr::V6(_)) => prefix_value <= 128,
1058:         _ => false,
1059:     }
1060: }
1061: 
1062: fn is_exact_ip_for_nft_family(address: &str, family: &str) -> bool {
1063:     match family {
1064:         "ip" => address.parse::<Ipv4Addr>().is_ok(),
1065:         "ip6" => address.parse::<Ipv6Addr>().is_ok(),
1066:         _ => false,
1067:     }
1068: }

1329: fn validate_ip_args(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
1330:     match args {
1331:         ["-V"] => Ok(()),
1332:         ["link", "add", "dev", interface, "type", "wireguard"] if is_interface_name(interface) => {
1333:             Ok(())
1334:         }
1335:         [
1336:             "tuntap",
1337:             "add",
1338:             "dev",
1339:             interface,
1340:             "mode",
1341:             "tun",
1342:             "user",
1343:             owner_uid,
1344:             "group",
1345:             owner_gid,
1346:         ] if is_interface_name(interface) && is_u32_token(owner_uid) && is_u32_token(owner_gid) => {
1347:             Ok(())
1348:         }
1349:         ["link", "set", "up", "dev", interface] if is_interface_name(interface) => Ok(()),
1350:         ["link", "set", "down", "dev", interface] if is_interface_name(interface) => Ok(()),
1351:         ["link", "del", "dev", interface] if is_interface_name(interface) => Ok(()),
1352:         ["address", "add", cidr, "dev", interface]
1353:             if is_cidr_token(cidr) && is_interface_name(interface) =>
1354:         {
1355:             Ok(())
1356:         }
1357:         ["route", "del", cidr, "dev", interface]
1358:             if is_cidr_token(cidr) && is_interface_name(interface) =>
1359:         {
1360:             Ok(())
1361:         }
1362:         ["route", "replace", cidr, "dev", interface]
1363:             if is_cidr_token(cidr) && is_interface_name(interface) =>
1364:         {
1365:             Ok(())
1366:         }
1367:         ["route", "replace", cidr, "dev", interface, "table", "51820"]
1368:             if is_cidr_token(cidr) && is_interface_name(interface) =>
1369:         {
1370:             Ok(())
1371:         }
1372:         ["-4", "route", "show", "table", "51820"] => Ok(()),
1373:         [
1374:             "-6",
1375:             "route",
1376:             "replace",
1377:             cidr,
1378:             "dev",
1379:             interface,
1380:             "table",
1381:             "51820",
1382:         ] if is_cidr_token(cidr) && is_interface_name(interface) => Ok(()),
1383:         ["route", "flush", "table", "51820"] => Ok(()),
1384:         ["rule", "show"] => Ok(()),
1385:         ["-4", "route", "get", target] if target.parse::<std::net::Ipv4Addr>().is_ok() => Ok(()),
1386:         ["-6", "route", "flush", "table", "51820"] => Ok(()),
1387:         ["route", "get", target] if is_ipv4_or_ipv6(target) => Ok(()),
1388:         ["-6", "route", "get", target] if target.parse::<std::net::Ipv6Addr>().is_ok() => Ok(()),
1389:         ["rule", "del", "table", "51820"] => Ok(()),
1390:         ["rule", "del", "priority", priority, "table", "51820"] if is_u32_token(priority) => Ok(()),
1391:         ["rule", "add", "priority", priority, "table", "51820"] if is_u32_token(priority) => Ok(()),
1392:         _ => Err("unsupported ip argument schema".to_string()),
1393:     }
1394: }

1396: fn validate_nft_args(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
1397:     match args {
1398:         ["--version"] => Ok(()),
1399:         ["list", "tables"] => Ok(()),
1400:         ["list", "table", family, table]
1401:             if is_nft_family_token(family) && is_owned_nft_table_token(table) =>
1402:         {
1403:             Ok(())
1404:         }
1405:         ["list", "chain", family, table, chain]
1406:             if is_nft_family_token(family)
1407:                 && is_owned_nft_table_token(table)
1408:                 && is_nft_chain_token(chain) =>
1409:         {
1410:             Ok(())
1411:         }
1412:         ["add", "table", family, table]
1413:             if is_nft_family_token(family) && is_owned_nft_table_token(table) =>
1414:         {
1415:             Ok(())
1416:         }
1417:         ["delete", "table", family, table]
1418:             if is_nft_family_token(family) && is_owned_nft_table_token(table) =>
1419:         {
1420:             Ok(())
1421:         }
1422:         _ if args.starts_with(&["add", "chain"]) => validate_nft_add_chain_args(args),
1423:         _ if args.starts_with(&["add", "rule"]) => validate_nft_add_rule_args(args),
1424:         _ => Err("unsupported nft argument schema".to_string()),
1425:     }
1426: }

1428: fn validate_wg_args(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
1429:     match args {
1430:         ["--version"] => Ok(()),
1431:         ["show", interface, "latest-handshakes"] if is_interface_name(interface) => Ok(()),
1432:         [
1433:             "set",
1434:             interface,
1435:             "private-key",
1436:             private_key_path,
1437:             "listen-port",
1438:             port,
1439:         ] if is_interface_name(interface)
1440:             && is_path_token(private_key_path)
1441:             && is_u16_token(port) =>
1442:         {
1443:             Ok(())
1444:         }
1445:         ["set", interface, "private-key", private_key_path]
1446:             if is_interface_name(interface) && is_path_token(private_key_path) =>
1447:         {
1448:             Ok(())
1449:         }
1450:         [
1451:             "set",
1452:             interface,
1453:             "peer",
1454:             public_key,
1455:             "endpoint",
1456:             endpoint,
1457:             "allowed-ips",
1458:             allowed_ips,
1459:         ] if is_interface_name(interface)
1460:             && is_wg_public_key_token(public_key)
1461:             && is_wg_endpoint_token(endpoint)
1462:             && is_allowed_ips_token(allowed_ips) =>
1463:         {
1464:             Ok(())
1465:         }
1466:         ["set", interface, "peer", public_key, "remove"]
1467:             if is_interface_name(interface) && is_wg_public_key_token(public_key) =>
1468:         {
1469:             Ok(())
1470:         }
1471:         _ => Err("unsupported wg argument schema".to_string()),
1472:     }
1473: }

1475: fn validate_sysctl_args(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
1476:     match args {
1477:         ["--version"] => Ok(()),
1478:         ["-w", "net.ipv4.ip_forward=1" | "net.ipv4.ip_forward=0"] => Ok(()),
1479:         [
1480:             "-w",
1481:             "net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6=1" | "net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6=0",
1482:         ] => Ok(()),
1483:         _ => Err("unsupported sysctl argument schema".to_string()),
1484:     }
1485: }
1486: 
1487: fn validate_ifconfig_args(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
1488:     match args {
1489:         ["-l"] => Ok(()),
1490:         [interface, "up"] if is_interface_name(interface) => Ok(()),
1491:         [interface, "down"] if is_interface_name(interface) => Ok(()),
1492:         [
1493:             interface,
1494:             "inet",
1495:             local_ip,
1496:             peer_ip,
1497:             "netmask",
1498:             "255.255.255.255",
1499:         ] if is_interface_name(interface)
1500:             && is_ipv4_or_ipv6(local_ip)
1501:             && is_ipv4_or_ipv6(peer_ip) =>
1502:         {
1503:             Ok(())
1504:         }
1505:         _ => Err("unsupported ifconfig argument schema".to_string()),
1506:     }
1507: }
1508: 
1509: fn validate_route_args(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
1510:     match args {
1511:         ["-n", "get", "default"] => Ok(()),
1512:         [
1513:             "-n",
1514:             "add" | "change",
1515:             "-inet",
1516:             "default",
1517:             "-interface",
1518:             interface,
1519:         ] if is_interface_name(interface) => Ok(()),
1520:         ["-n", "change", "-inet", "default", gateway] if is_ipv4_or_ipv6(gateway) => Ok(()),
1521:         [
1522:             "-n",
1523:             "add",
1524:             "-inet" | "-inet6",
1525:             "-host",
1526:             endpoint,
1527:             gateway,
1528:             "-ifscope",
1529:             interface,
1530:         ] if is_ipv4_or_ipv6(endpoint)
1531:             && is_ipv4_or_ipv6(gateway)
1532:             && is_interface_name(interface) =>
1533:         {
1534:             Ok(())
1535:         }
1536:         ["-n", "delete", "-inet" | "-inet6", "-host", endpoint] if is_ipv4_or_ipv6(endpoint) => {
1537:             Ok(())
1538:         }
1539:         [
1540:             "-n",
1541:             "add",
1542:             "-inet" | "-inet6",
1543:             "-net",
1544:             cidr,
1545:             "-interface",
1546:             interface,
1547:         ] if is_cidr_token(cidr) && is_interface_name(interface) => Ok(()),
1548:         ["-n", "delete", "-inet" | "-inet6", "-net", cidr] if is_cidr_token(cidr) => Ok(()),
1549:         _ => Err("unsupported route argument schema".to_string()),
1550:     }
1551: }
1552: 
1553: fn validate_pfctl_args(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
1554:     for arg in args {
1555:         if !is_safe_token(arg) {
1556:             return Err(format!("unsupported pfctl token: {arg}"));
1557:         }
1558:     }
1559:     match args {
1560:         ["-E"] => Ok(()),
1561:         ["-s", "info"] => Ok(()),
1562:         ["-s", "Anchors"] => Ok(()),
1563:         ["-a", anchor, "-F", "all"] if is_anchor_name_token(anchor) => Ok(()),
1564:         ["-a", anchor, "-f", path] if is_anchor_name_token(anchor) && is_path_token(path) => Ok(()),
1565:         ["-a", anchor, "-s", "rules"] if is_anchor_name_token(anchor) => Ok(()),
1566:         _ => Err("unsupported pfctl argument schema".to_string()),
1567:     }
1568: }
1569: 
1570: fn validate_wireguard_go_args(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
1571:     match args {
1572:         [interface] if is_interface_name(interface) => Ok(()),
1573:         _ => Err("unsupported wireguard-go argument schema".to_string()),
1574:     }
1575: }
1576: 
1577: fn validate_kill_args(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
1578:     match args {
1579:         ["-TERM", pid] if pid.parse::<u32>().map(|value| value > 1).unwrap_or(false) => Ok(()),
1580:         _ => Err("unsupported kill argument schema".to_string()),
1581:     }
1582: }

1584: #[cfg(not(windows))]
1585: fn peer_uid(stream: &UnixStream) -> Option<u32> {
1586:     #[cfg(any(target_os = "linux", target_os = "android"))]
1587:     {
1588:         return getsockopt(stream, PeerCredentials)
1589:             .ok()
1590:             .map(|cred| cred.uid());
1591:     }
1592: 
1593:     #[cfg(any(
1594:         target_os = "macos",
1595:         target_os = "ios",
1596:         target_os = "tvos",
1597:         target_os = "watchos",
1598:         target_os = "visionos"
1599:     ))]
1600:     {
1601:         return getsockopt(stream, LocalPeerCred)
1602:             .ok()
1603:             .map(|cred| cred.uid());
1604:     }
1605: 
1606:     #[allow(unreachable_code)]
1607:     None
1608: }

1629:         encode_helper_request, handle_request, is_nft_token, is_safe_token, read_request,
1630:         read_response_frame, run_privileged_subprocess, validate_privileged_helper_socket_security,

1633: 
1634:     fn helper_request_frame_bytes(payload: &[u8], version: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
1635:         let mut frame = Vec::with_capacity(10 + payload.len());
1636:         frame.extend_from_slice(&HELPER_FRAME_MAGIC);
1637:         frame.push(version);
1638:         frame.push(HELPER_FRAME_TYPE_REQUEST);
1639:         frame.extend_from_slice(&(payload.len() as u32).to_be_bytes());
1640:         frame.extend_from_slice(payload);
1641:         frame
1642:     }
1643: 
1644:     fn write_frame_and_close(stream: &mut UnixStream, frame: &[u8]) {
1645:         stream
1646:             .write_all(frame)
1647:             .expect("frame should be written successfully");
1648:         stream
1649:             .shutdown(Shutdown::Write)
1650:             .expect("frame writer should shut down cleanly");
1651:     }

2011:             .set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(1)))
2012:             .expect("client write timeout should be set");
2013: 
2014:         let server = std::thread::spawn(move || {
2015:             let request = read_request(&mut server_stream).expect("request should decode");
2016:             assert_eq!(request.program, "ip");
2017:             assert_eq!(request.args, vec!["--version".to_string()]);
2018:             write_response(
2019:                 &mut server_stream,
2020:                 HelperResponse::success(0, "ok".to_string(), String::new()),
2021:             )
2022:             .expect("response should encode");
2023:         });
2024: 
2025:         write_request_frame(
2026:             &mut client_stream,
2027:             &HelperRequest {
2028:                 program: "ip".to_string(),
2029:                 args: vec!["--version".to_string()],
2030:             },
2031:         )
2032:         .expect("request should encode");
2033:         let response = read_response_frame(&mut client_stream).expect("response should decode");
2034:         assert!(response.ok);
2035:         assert_eq!(response.status, Some(0));
2036:         assert_eq!(response.stdout.as_deref(), Some("ok"));
2037:         assert_eq!(response.stderr.as_deref(), Some(""));
2038:         assert_eq!(response.error, None);
2039: 
2040:         server.join().expect("server thread should join cleanly");
2041:     }

===== /crates/rustynetd/src/relay_client.rs =====

   1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   2: 
   3: //! Relay client for daemon-side relay path transport.
   4: //!
   5: //! This module provides the client-side relay session management that enables
   6: //! the daemon to establish authenticated sessions with relay servers and
   7: //! forward encrypted WireGuard packets when direct connectivity is unavailable.
   8: //!
   9: //! # Security model
  10: //!
  11: //! - **Ciphertext-only**: packets are WireGuard-encrypted before relay handoff;
  12: //!   the relay cannot see plaintext.
  13: //! - **Signed tokens**: each session requires a control-plane-issued
  14: //!   [`RelaySessionToken`] with a valid ed25519 signature.
  15: //! - **Fail-closed**: if token issuance, relay connection, or session
  16: //!   establishment fails, the relay path remains unavailable.
  17: //! - **Replay protection**: token nonces prevent replay attacks.
  18: //! - **Session binding**: tokens are bound to specific (node_id, peer_node_id,
  19: //!   relay_id) tuples.
  20: 
  21: use std::collections::HashMap;
  22: #[cfg(test)]
  23: use std::collections::VecDeque;
  24: use std::io;
  25: use std::net::{SocketAddr, UdpSocket};
  26: use std::sync::Arc;
  27: use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
  28: 
  29: use ed25519_dalek::SigningKey;
  30: use rustynet_backend_api::{NodeId, SocketEndpoint};
  31: use rustynet_control::RelaySessionToken;
  32: use rustynet_relay::{RelayHello, RelayHelloAck, SessionId};
  33: 
  34: /// Configuration for relay client behavior.
  35: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
  36: pub struct RelayClientConfig {
  37:     /// Maximum time to wait for relay session establishment.
  38:     pub session_timeout: Duration,
  39:     /// How often to send keepalive packets to maintain relay NAT bindings.
  40:     pub keepalive_interval: Duration,
  41:     /// Maximum number of concurrent relay sessions per peer.
  42:     pub max_sessions_per_peer: usize,
  43:     /// Socket receive timeout for relay operations.
  44:     pub recv_timeout: Duration,
  45:     /// Optional local port hint for an authoritative relay transport socket.
  46:     ///
  47:     /// This value is configuration only; it does not establish authority by
  48:     /// itself. A separate daemon-owned socket bound to the same local port is
  49:     /// not equivalent to the backend's authoritative peer-traffic transport
  50:     /// socket and must not be treated as such.
  51:     pub local_port: Option<u16>,
  52: }
  53: 
  54: impl Default for RelayClientConfig {
  55:     fn default() -> Self {
  56:         Self {
  57:             session_timeout: Duration::from_secs(10),
  58:             keepalive_interval: Duration::from_secs(25),
  59:             max_sessions_per_peer: 2,
  60:             recv_timeout: Duration::from_secs(5),
  61:             local_port: None,
  62:         }
  63:     }
  64: }
  65: 
  66: /// Represents an established relay session from the client perspective.
  67: #[derive(Debug)]
  68: pub struct RelayClientSession {
  69:     /// The session ID assigned by the relay.
  70:     pub session_id: SessionId,
  71:     /// The relay server address.
  72:     pub relay_addr: SocketAddr,
  73:     /// The allocated port on the relay for this session.
  74:     pub allocated_port: u16,
  75:     /// The peer this session connects to.
  76:     pub peer_node_id: NodeId,
  77:     /// When the session was established.
  78:     pub established_at: Instant,
  79:     /// When we last sent or received a packet.
  80:     pub last_activity: Instant,
  81:     /// The relay ID this session is bound to.
  82:     pub relay_id: [u8; 16],
  83:     /// When the session token expires according to the control-plane signer.
  84:     pub token_expires_at_unix: u64,
  85: }
  86: 
  87: impl RelayClientSession {
  88:     /// Returns the effective endpoint to use for this relay path.
  89:     pub fn effective_endpoint(&self) -> SocketEndpoint {
  90:         SocketEndpoint {
  91:             addr: self.relay_addr.ip(),
  92:             port: self.allocated_port,
  93:         }
  94:     }
  95: 
  96:     /// Returns true if the session has been idle too long.
  97:     pub fn is_idle(&self, idle_timeout: Duration) -> bool {
  98:         self.last_activity.elapsed() > idle_timeout
  99:     }
 100: 
 101:     /// Returns true if the signed relay session has expired.
 102:     pub fn is_expired(&self, now_unix: u64) -> bool {
 103:         self.token_expires_at_unix <= now_unix
 104:     }
 105: 
 106:     /// Returns true when the session token must be refreshed to avoid expiry.
 107:     pub fn token_refresh_due(&self, now_unix: u64, refresh_margin_secs: u64) -> bool {
 108:         self.token_expires_at_unix <= now_unix.saturating_add(refresh_margin_secs)
 109:     }
 110: 
 111:     /// Returns true when the selected backend endpoint is the live relay
 112:     /// endpoint allocated for this session.
 113:     pub fn matches_selected_endpoint(&self, endpoint: SocketEndpoint) -> bool {
 114:         self.effective_endpoint() == endpoint
 115:     }
 116: }
 117: 
 118: /// Errors that can occur during relay client operations.
 119: #[derive(Debug)]
 120: pub enum RelayClientError {
 121:     /// Socket I/O error.
 122:     Io(io::Error),
 123:     /// Backend authoritative transport operation failed.
 124:     AuthoritativeTransport(String),
 125:     /// Token signing failed.
 126:     TokenSigning(String),
 127:     /// Session establishment was rejected by the relay.
 128:     SessionRejected(String),
 129:     /// Session establishment timed out.
 130:     Timeout,
 131:     /// No suitable relay available.
 132:     NoRelayAvailable,
 133:     /// Session capacity exceeded.
 134:     CapacityExceeded,
 135:     /// Relay returned an invalid response.
 136:     InvalidResponse(String),
 137: }
 138: 
 139: impl std::fmt::Display for RelayClientError {
 140:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
 141:         match self {
 142:             Self::Io(err) => write!(f, "relay I/O error: {err}"),
 143:             Self::AuthoritativeTransport(msg) => {
 144:                 write!(f, "relay authoritative transport error: {msg}")
 145:             }
 146:             Self::TokenSigning(msg) => write!(f, "token signing failed: {msg}"),
 147:             Self::SessionRejected(reason) => write!(f, "relay session rejected: {reason}"),
 148:             Self::Timeout => f.write_str("relay session establishment timed out"),
 149:             Self::NoRelayAvailable => f.write_str("no relay available for path"),
 150:             Self::CapacityExceeded => f.write_str("relay session capacity exceeded"),
 151:             Self::InvalidResponse(msg) => write!(f, "invalid relay response: {msg}"),
 152:         }
 153:     }
 154: }
 155: 
 156: impl std::error::Error for RelayClientError {
 157:     fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {
 158:         match self {
 159:             Self::Io(err) => Some(err),
 160:             _ => None,
 161:         }
 162:     }
 163: }
 164: 
 165: impl From<io::Error> for RelayClientError {
 166:     fn from(err: io::Error) -> Self {
 167:         Self::Io(err)
 168:     }
 169: }
 170: 
 171: /// Manages relay client sessions for the daemon.
 172: ///
 173: /// The `RelayClient` handles session establishment, keepalive, and cleanup
 174: /// for all active relay paths. It integrates with the Phase10Controller to
 175: /// provide relay endpoints when direct connectivity fails.
 176: pub struct RelayClient {
 177:     /// Our node ID.
 178:     node_id: NodeId,
 179:     /// The signing key used to create relay session tokens.
 180:     signing_key: Arc<SigningKey>,
 181:     /// Active sessions indexed by peer node ID.
 182:     sessions: HashMap<NodeId, RelayClientSession>,
 183:     /// Configuration for relay behavior.
 184:     config: RelayClientConfig,
 185:     /// The UDP socket used for relay communication.
 186:     socket: Option<UdpSocket>,
 187:     #[cfg(test)]
 188:     scripted_establishments: VecDeque<Result<u16, RelayClientError>>,
 189:     #[cfg(test)]
 190:     bound_override: bool,
 191: }
 192: 
 193: impl RelayClient {
 194:     /// Creates a new relay client.
 195:     pub fn new(node_id: NodeId, signing_key: Arc<SigningKey>, config: RelayClientConfig) -> Self {
 196:         Self {
 197:             node_id,
 198:             signing_key,
 199:             sessions: HashMap::new(),
 200:             config,
 201:             socket: None,
 202:             #[cfg(test)]
 203:             scripted_establishments: VecDeque::new(),
 204:             #[cfg(test)]
 205:             bound_override: false,
 206:         }
 207:     }
 208: 
 209:     /// Returns the configured local port for the relay client socket, if any.
 210:     pub fn local_port(&self) -> Option<u16> {
 211:         self.config.local_port
 212:     }
 213: 
 214:     /// Binds the relay client to a local socket.
 215:     ///
 216:     /// This must be called only with an authoritative transport socket owned by
 217:     /// the selected backend transport path, or by a test harness explicitly
 218:     /// modeling that authority. A second socket bound to the same local port is
 219:     /// not sufficient.
 220:     pub fn bind(&mut self, socket: UdpSocket) -> Result<(), RelayClientError> {
 221:         socket.set_read_timeout(Some(self.config.recv_timeout))?;
 222:         socket.set_write_timeout(Some(self.config.recv_timeout))?;
 223:         self.socket = Some(socket);
 224:         Ok(())
 225:     }
 226: 
 227:     /// Returns true when the relay client has an authoritative transport socket
 228:     /// bound for live relay control traffic.
 229:     pub fn is_bound(&self) -> bool {
 230:         self.socket.is_some() || {
 231:             #[cfg(test)]
 232:             {
 233:                 self.bound_override
 234:             }
 235:             #[cfg(not(test))]
 236:             {
 237:                 false
 238:             }
 239:         }
 240:     }
 241: 
 242:     /// Establishes a relay session for the given peer.
 243:     ///
 244:     /// This creates a signed session token, sends it to the relay server,
 245:     /// and waits for acknowledgment. On success, the relay path becomes
 246:     /// available for packet forwarding.
 247:     ///
 248:     /// # Arguments
 249:     ///
 250:     /// * `peer_node_id` - The peer to establish a relay path with.
 251:     /// * `relay_addr` - The relay server address.
 252:     /// * `relay_id` - The 16-byte relay identifier.
 253:     /// * `ttl_secs` - Token time-to-live in seconds.
 254:     ///
 255:     /// # Returns
 256:     ///
 257:     /// The effective endpoint to configure in the backend for this peer.
 258:     pub fn establish_session(
 259:         &mut self,
 260:         peer_node_id: &NodeId,
 261:         relay_addr: SocketAddr,
 262:         relay_id: [u8; 16],
 263:         ttl_secs: u64,
 264:     ) -> Result<SocketEndpoint, RelayClientError> {
 265:         #[cfg(test)]
 266:         if !self.scripted_establishments.is_empty() {
 267:             return self.establish_session_with_round_trip(
 268:                 peer_node_id,
 269:                 relay_addr,
 270:                 relay_id,
 271:                 ttl_secs,
 272:                 |_target, _hello_bytes, _timeout| {
 273:                     unreachable!(
 274:                         "scripted relay-client establishment should short-circuit before transport"
 275:                     )
 276:                 },
 277:             );
 278:         }
 279: 
 280:         let socket = self
 281:             .socket
 282:             .as_ref()
 283:             .ok_or(RelayClientError::Io(io::Error::new(
 284:                 io::ErrorKind::NotConnected,
 285:                 "relay socket not bound",
 286:             )))?
 287:             .try_clone()?;
 288:         self.establish_session_with_round_trip(
 289:             peer_node_id,
 290:             relay_addr,
 291:             relay_id,
 292:             ttl_secs,
 293:             |target, hello_bytes, timeout| {
 294:                 socket.set_read_timeout(Some(timeout))?;
 295:                 socket.send_to(hello_bytes, target)?;
 296:                 let mut buf = [0u8; 1500];
 297:                 loop {
 298:                     match socket.recv_from(&mut buf) {
 299:                         Ok((len, from_addr)) if from_addr == relay_addr => {
 300:                             return Ok((buf[..len].to_vec(), from_addr));
 301:                         }
 302:                         Ok(_) => continue,
 303:                         Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => continue,
 304:                         Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::TimedOut => continue,
 305:                         Err(e) => return Err(RelayClientError::Io(e)),
 306:                     }
 307:                 }
 308:             },
 309:         )
 310:     }
 311: 
 312:     pub fn establish_session_with_round_trip<F>(
 313:         &mut self,
 314:         peer_node_id: &NodeId,
 315:         relay_addr: SocketAddr,
 316:         relay_id: [u8; 16],
 317:         ttl_secs: u64,
 318:         mut round_trip: F,
 319:     ) -> Result<SocketEndpoint, RelayClientError>
 320:     where
 321:         F: FnMut(SocketAddr, &[u8], Duration) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, SocketAddr), RelayClientError>,
 322:     {
 323:         if self.sessions.len() >= self.config.max_sessions_per_peer * 16 {
 324:             return Err(RelayClientError::CapacityExceeded);
 325:         }
 326: 
 327:         let token = RelaySessionToken::sign(
 328:             &self.signing_key,
 329:             self.node_id.as_str(),
 330:             peer_node_id.as_str(),
 331:             relay_id,
 332:             ttl_secs,
 333:         );
 334:         let token_expires_at_unix = token.expires_at_unix;
 335: 
 336:         #[cfg(test)]
 337:         if let Some(scripted) = self.scripted_establishments.pop_front() {
 338:             return match scripted {
 339:                 Ok(allocated_port) => {
 340:                     let now = Instant::now();
 341:                     let session = RelayClientSession {
 342:                         session_id: SessionId::from([0xAA; 16]),
 343:                         relay_addr,
 344:                         allocated_port,
 345:                         peer_node_id: peer_node_id.clone(),
 346:                         established_at: now,
 347:                         last_activity: now,
 348:                         relay_id,
 349:                         token_expires_at_unix,
 350:                     };
 351:                     let endpoint = session.effective_endpoint();
 352:                     self.sessions.insert(peer_node_id.clone(), session);
 353:                     Ok(endpoint)
 354:                 }
 355:                 Err(err) => Err(err),
 356:             };
 357:         }
 358: 
 359:         // Build hello message
 360:         let hello = RelayHello {
 361:             node_id: self.node_id.as_str().to_string(),
 362:             peer_node_id: peer_node_id.as_str().to_string(),
 363:             session_token: token,
 364:         };
 365: 
 366:         let hello_bytes = serialize_relay_hello(&hello);
 367:         let (response, from_addr) =
 368:             round_trip(relay_addr, &hello_bytes, self.config.session_timeout)?;
 369:         if from_addr != relay_addr {
 370:             return Err(RelayClientError::InvalidResponse(format!(
 371:                 "unexpected relay response source {from_addr}"
 372:             )));
 373:         }
 374:         match parse_relay_hello_ack(&response) {
 375:             Ok(ack) => {
 376:                 let now = Instant::now();
 377:                 let session = RelayClientSession {
 378:                     session_id: ack.session_id,
 379:                     relay_addr,
 380:                     allocated_port: ack.allocated_port,
 381:                     peer_node_id: peer_node_id.clone(),
 382:                     established_at: now,
 383:                     last_activity: now,
 384:                     relay_id,
 385:                     token_expires_at_unix,
 386:                 };
 387:                 let endpoint = session.effective_endpoint();
 388:                 self.sessions.insert(peer_node_id.clone(), session);
 389:                 Ok(endpoint)
 390:             }
 391:             Err(e) => Err(RelayClientError::SessionRejected(e)),
 392:         }
 393:     }
 394: 
 395:     /// Returns the active session for a peer, if any.
 396:     pub fn session_for_peer(&self, peer_node_id: &NodeId) -> Option<&RelayClientSession> {
 397:         self.sessions.get(peer_node_id)
 398:     }

 401:     pub fn relay_endpoint_for_peer(&self, peer_node_id: &NodeId) -> Option<SocketEndpoint> {
 402:         self.sessions
 403:             .get(peer_node_id)
 404:             .map(|s| s.effective_endpoint())
 405:     }

 407:     /// Returns true if the peer's selected backend endpoint matches the active
 408:     /// relay session endpoint.
 409:     pub fn session_matches_selected_endpoint(
 410:         &self,
 411:         peer_node_id: &NodeId,
 412:         endpoint: SocketEndpoint,
 413:     ) -> bool {

 449:     /// Updates the last activity time for a peer session (e.g., on packet
 450:     /// received).
 451:     pub fn touch_session(&mut self, peer_node_id: &NodeId) {
 452:         if let Some(session) = self.sessions.get_mut(peer_node_id) {
 453:             session.last_activity = Instant::now();
 454:         }
 455:     }

 457:     /// Returns the keepalive interval from config.
 458:     pub fn keepalive_interval(&self) -> Duration {
 459:         self.config.keepalive_interval
 460:     }
 461: 
 462:     /// Returns peer IDs that need keepalive packets sent.
 463:     ///
 464:     /// A session needs keepalive when `last_activity` is older than
 465:     /// `keepalive_interval` but not yet idle (cleanup would handle idle).
 466:     pub fn sessions_needing_keepalive(&self) -> Vec<NodeId> {
 467:         let keepalive_threshold = self.config.keepalive_interval;
 468:         self.sessions
 469:             .iter()
 470:             .filter(|(_, session)| session.last_activity.elapsed() >= keepalive_threshold)
 471:             .map(|(peer_id, _)| peer_id.clone())
 472:             .collect()
 473:     }
 474: 
 475:     /// Sends a keepalive packet to maintain NAT binding for a relay session.
 476:     ///
 477:     /// Keepalives are small UDP packets sent to the relay's allocated port
 478:     /// to refresh NAT mappings. The relay should echo or acknowledge.
 479:     ///
 480:     /// # Returns
 481:     /// `Ok(())` if the keepalive was sent successfully.
 482:     pub fn send_keepalive(&mut self, peer_node_id: &NodeId) -> Result<(), RelayClientError> {
 483:         let session = self
 484:             .sessions
 485:             .get(peer_node_id)
 486:             .ok_or(RelayClientError::NoRelayAvailable)?;
 487: 
 488:         let socket = self
 489:             .socket
 490:             .as_ref()
 491:             .ok_or(RelayClientError::Io(io::Error::new(
 492:                 io::ErrorKind::NotConnected,
 493:                 "relay socket not bound",
 494:             )))?
 495:             .try_clone()?;
 496: 
 497:         // Keepalive is a minimal packet to the allocated port.
 498:         // Use a simple format: [KEEPALIVE_MSG_TYPE, session_id[0..4]]
 499:         // This is enough to keep NAT mappings alive without being a full hello.
 500:         let mut keepalive = [0u8; 5];
 501:         keepalive[0] = RELAY_KEEPALIVE_MSG_TYPE;
 502:         keepalive[1..5].copy_from_slice(&session.session_id.as_bytes()[0..4]);
 503: 
 504:         self.send_keepalive_with_sender(peer_node_id, |target, keepalive| {
 505:             socket.send_to(keepalive, target)?;
 506:             Ok(())
 507:         })
 508:     }
 509: 
 510:     pub fn send_keepalive_with_sender<F>(
 511:         &mut self,
 512:         peer_node_id: &NodeId,
 513:         mut sender: F,
 514:     ) -> Result<(), RelayClientError>
 515:     where
 516:         F: FnMut(SocketAddr, &[u8]) -> Result<(), RelayClientError>,
 517:     {
 518:         let session = self
 519:             .sessions
 520:             .get(peer_node_id)
 521:             .ok_or(RelayClientError::NoRelayAvailable)?;
 522: 
 523:         let mut keepalive = [0u8; 5];
 524:         keepalive[0] = RELAY_KEEPALIVE_MSG_TYPE;
 525:         keepalive[1..5].copy_from_slice(&session.session_id.as_bytes()[0..4]);
 526: 
 527:         let target = SocketAddr::new(session.relay_addr.ip(), session.allocated_port);
 528:         sender(target, &keepalive)?;
 529: 
 530:         if let Some(session) = self.sessions.get_mut(peer_node_id) {
 531:             session.last_activity = Instant::now();
 532:         }
 533: 
 534:         Ok(())
 535:     }
 536: 
 537:     /// Sends keepalives to all sessions that need them.
 538:     ///
 539:     /// Returns the number of keepalives sent and any errors encountered.
 540:     pub fn send_all_keepalives(&mut self) -> (usize, Vec<(NodeId, RelayClientError)>) {
 541:         let peers_needing_keepalive = self.sessions_needing_keepalive();
 542:         let mut sent = 0;
 543:         let mut errors = Vec::new();
 544: 
 545:         for peer_id in peers_needing_keepalive {
 546:             match self.send_keepalive(&peer_id) {
 547:                 Ok(()) => sent += 1,
 548:                 Err(e) => errors.push((peer_id, e)),
 549:             }
 550:         }
 551: 
 552:         (sent, errors)
 553:     }
 554: 
 555:     /// Returns sessions with tokens expiring soon.
 556:     ///
 557:     /// This allows the daemon to proactively refresh tokens before they expire.
 558:     pub fn sessions_needing_token_refresh(&self, now_unix: u64) -> Vec<(NodeId, u64)> {
 559:         let refresh_margin = 60; // 60 seconds before expiry
 560:         self.sessions
 561:             .iter()
 562:             .filter(|(_, session)| session.token_refresh_due(now_unix, refresh_margin))
 563:             .map(|(peer_id, session)| (peer_id.clone(), session.token_expires_at_unix))
 564:             .collect()
 565:     }

 599: 
 600: // Wire format constants for relay protocol
 601: const RELAY_HELLO_MSG_TYPE: u8 = 0x01;
 602: const RELAY_HELLO_ACK_MSG_TYPE: u8 = 0x02;
 603: const RELAY_REJECT_MSG_TYPE: u8 = 0x03;
 604: const RELAY_KEEPALIVE_MSG_TYPE: u8 = 0x04;
 605: 
 606: /// Serializes a RelayHello message for wire transmission.
 607: fn serialize_relay_hello(hello: &RelayHello) -> Vec<u8> {
 608:     let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(512);
 609:     buf.push(RELAY_HELLO_MSG_TYPE);
 610: 
 611:     // Node ID (length-prefixed)
 612:     let node_id_bytes = hello.node_id.as_bytes();
 613:     buf.extend_from_slice(&(node_id_bytes.len() as u16).to_be_bytes());
 614:     buf.extend_from_slice(node_id_bytes);
 615: 
 616:     // Peer node ID (length-prefixed)
 617:     let peer_node_id_bytes = hello.peer_node_id.as_bytes();
 618:     buf.extend_from_slice(&(peer_node_id_bytes.len() as u16).to_be_bytes());
 619:     buf.extend_from_slice(peer_node_id_bytes);
 620: 
 621:     // Session token (serialized via canonical payload + signature)
 622:     let token_bytes = serialize_relay_token(&hello.session_token);
 623:     buf.extend_from_slice(&(token_bytes.len() as u16).to_be_bytes());
 624:     buf.extend_from_slice(&token_bytes);
 625: 
 626:     buf
 627: }
 628: 
 629: /// Serializes a RelaySessionToken for wire transmission.
 630: fn serialize_relay_token(token: &RelaySessionToken) -> Vec<u8> {
 631:     let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(256);
 632: 
 633:     // Version
 634:     buf.push(1);
 635: 
 636:     // Node ID
 637:     let node_id_bytes = token.node_id.as_bytes();
 638:     buf.extend_from_slice(&(node_id_bytes.len() as u16).to_be_bytes());
 639:     buf.extend_from_slice(node_id_bytes);
 640: 
 641:     // Peer node ID
 642:     let peer_node_id_bytes = token.peer_node_id.as_bytes();
 643:     buf.extend_from_slice(&(peer_node_id_bytes.len() as u16).to_be_bytes());
 644:     buf.extend_from_slice(peer_node_id_bytes);
 645: 
 646:     // Relay ID (fixed 16 bytes)
 647:     buf.extend_from_slice(&token.relay_id);
 648: 
 649:     // Scope
 650:     let scope_bytes = token.scope.as_bytes();
 651:     buf.extend_from_slice(&(scope_bytes.len() as u16).to_be_bytes());
 652:     buf.extend_from_slice(scope_bytes);
 653: 
 654:     // Timestamps
 655:     buf.extend_from_slice(&token.issued_at_unix.to_be_bytes());
 656:     buf.extend_from_slice(&token.expires_at_unix.to_be_bytes());
 657: 
 658:     // Nonce (fixed 16 bytes)
 659:     buf.extend_from_slice(&token.nonce);
 660: 
 661:     // Signature (fixed 64 bytes)
 662:     buf.extend_from_slice(&token.signature);
 663: 
 664:     buf
 665: }
 666: 
 667: /// Parses a RelayHelloAck from wire format.
 668: fn parse_relay_hello_ack(data: &[u8]) -> Result<RelayHelloAck, String> {
 669:     if data.is_empty() {
 670:         return Err("empty response".to_string());
 671:     }
 672: 
 673:     match data[0] {
 674:         RELAY_HELLO_ACK_MSG_TYPE => {
 675:             if data.len() < 19 {
 676:                 return Err("ack message too short".to_string());
 677:             }
 678:             // Session ID (16 bytes)
 679:             let session_id_bytes: [u8; 16] =
 680:                 data[1..17].try_into().map_err(|_| "invalid session id")?;
 681:             let session_id = SessionId::from(session_id_bytes);
 682: 
 683:             // Allocated port (2 bytes)
 684:             let port_bytes: [u8; 2] = data[17..19].try_into().map_err(|_| "invalid port")?;
 685:             let allocated_port = u16::from_be_bytes(port_bytes);
 686: 
 687:             Ok(RelayHelloAck {
 688:                 session_id,
 689:                 allocated_port,
 690:             })
 691:         }
 692:         RELAY_REJECT_MSG_TYPE => {
 693:             let reason = if data.len() > 1 {
 694:                 String::from_utf8_lossy(&data[1..]).to_string()
 695:             } else {
 696:                 "unknown".to_string()
 697:             };
 698:             Err(reason)
 699:         }
 700:         other => Err(format!("unexpected message type: {other:#02x}")),
 701:     }
 702: }

1164:     fn relay_client_establish_session_with_round_trip_uses_provided_transport() {
1165:         let signing_key = Arc::new(SigningKey::from_bytes(&[10u8; 32]));
1166:         let mut client = RelayClient::new(
1167:             test_node_id("node-a"),
1168:             signing_key,
1169:             RelayClientConfig::default(),
1170:         );
1171:         let peer_id = test_node_id("peer-b");
1172:         let relay_addr: SocketAddr = "192.168.1.1:4500".parse().unwrap();
1173:         let allocated_port: u16 = 5010;
1174:         let session_id = [0x66; 16];
1175: 
1176:         let endpoint = client
1177:             .establish_session_with_round_trip(
1178:                 &peer_id,
1179:                 relay_addr,
1180:                 [0xAA; 16],
1181:                 60,
1182:                 |target, _payload, _timeout| {
1183:                     assert_eq!(target, relay_addr);
1184:                     let mut ack = vec![RELAY_HELLO_ACK_MSG_TYPE];
1185:                     ack.extend_from_slice(&session_id);
1186:                     ack.extend_from_slice(&allocated_port.to_be_bytes());
1187:                     Ok((ack, relay_addr))
1188:                 },
1189:             )
1190:             .expect("round-trip establish should succeed");
1191: 
1192:         assert_eq!(endpoint.addr, relay_addr.ip());
1193:         assert_eq!(endpoint.port, allocated_port);
1194:         assert!(client.has_session(&peer_id));
1195:     }

1278:     /// Verifies that session cleanup preserves live sessions while removing only
1279:     /// expired/idle ones. This ensures fail-closed behavior during transitions.
1280:     #[test]
1281:     fn relay_client_cleanup_preserves_live_sessions_removes_only_idle() {
1282:         let now_unix = SystemTime::now()
1283:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
1284:             .unwrap()
1285:             .as_secs();
1286:         let signing_key = Arc::new(SigningKey::from_bytes(&[12u8; 32]));
1287:         let mut client = RelayClient::new(
1288:             test_node_id("node-a"),
1289:             signing_key,
1290:             RelayClientConfig::default(),
1291:         );
1292: 
1293:         // Insert a live session (active recently)
1294:         let live_peer = test_node_id("live-peer");
1295:         client.sessions.insert(
1296:             live_peer.clone(),
1297:             RelayClientSession {
1298:                 session_id: SessionId::from([0x11; 16]),
1299:                 relay_addr: "192.168.1.1:4500".parse().unwrap(),
1300:                 allocated_port: 5000,
1301:                 peer_node_id: live_peer.clone(),
1302:                 established_at: Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(10),
1303:                 last_activity: Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(5), // Recent activity
1304:                 relay_id: [0xAA; 16],
1305:                 token_expires_at_unix: now_unix + 300,
1306:             },
1307:         );
1308: 
1309:         // Insert an idle session (inactive for too long)
1310:         let idle_peer = test_node_id("idle-peer");
1311:         client.sessions.insert(
1312:             idle_peer.clone(),
1313:             RelayClientSession {
1314:                 session_id: SessionId::from([0x22; 16]),
1315:                 relay_addr: "192.168.1.1:4500".parse().unwrap(),
1316:                 allocated_port: 5001,
1317:                 peer_node_id: idle_peer.clone(),
1318:                 established_at: Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(120),
1319:                 last_activity: Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(120), // Idle
1320:                 relay_id: [0xBB; 16],
1321:                 token_expires_at_unix: now_unix + 300,
1322:             },
1323:         );
1324: 
1325:         assert_eq!(client.active_session_count(), 2);
1326: 
1327:         // Cleanup with 60-second idle threshold
1328:         client.cleanup_idle_sessions(Duration::from_secs(60));
1329: 
1330:         // Live session should remain, idle session should be removed
1331:         assert_eq!(client.active_session_count(), 1);
1332:         assert!(client.has_session(&live_peer));
1333:         assert!(!client.has_session(&idle_peer));
1334:     }

1377:             },

1393:             },

1397:

1406:     /// Verifies that remove_session correctly removes a specific session,
1407:     /// supporting clean failover transitions.
1408:     #[test]
1409:     fn relay_client_remove_session_supports_clean_failover() {
1410:         let now_unix = SystemTime::now()
1411:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
1412:             .unwrap()
1413:             .as_secs();
1414:         let signing_key = Arc::new(SigningKey::from_bytes(&[14u8; 32]));
1415:         let mut client = RelayClient::new(
1416:             test_node_id("node-a"),
1417:             signing_key,
1418:             RelayClientConfig::default(),
1419:         );
1420: 
1421:         // Create two sessions
1422:         let peer_1 = test_node_id("peer-1");
1423:         let peer_2 = test_node_id("peer-2");
1424: 
1425:         client.sessions.insert(
1426:             peer_1.clone(),
1427:             RelayClientSession {
1428:                 session_id: SessionId::from([0xAA; 16]),
1429:                 relay_addr: "10.0.0.1:4500".parse().unwrap(),
1430:                 allocated_port: 7000,
1431:                 peer_node_id: peer_1.clone(),
1432:                 established_at: Instant::now(),
1433:                 last_activity: Instant::now(),
1434:                 relay_id: [0x11; 16],
1435:                 token_expires_at_unix: now_unix + 300,
1436:             },
1437:         );
1438: 
1439:         client.sessions.insert(
1440:             peer_2.clone(),
1441:             RelayClientSession {
1442:                 session_id: SessionId::from([0xBB; 16]),
1443:                 relay_addr: "10.0.0.2:4500".parse().unwrap(),
1444:                 allocated_port: 7001,
1445:                 peer_node_id: peer_2.clone(),
1446:                 established_at: Instant::now(),
1447:                 last_activity: Instant::now(),
1448:                 relay_id: [0x22; 16],
1449:                 token_expires_at_unix: now_unix + 300,
1450:             },
1451:         );
1452: 
1453:         assert_eq!(client.active_session_count(), 2);
1454: 
1455:         // Remove one session (simulating failover cleanup)
1456:         client.remove_session(&peer_1);
1457: 
1458:         // Only peer_2 should remain
1459:         assert_eq!(client.active_session_count(), 1);
1460:         assert!(!client.has_session(&peer_1));
1461:         assert!(client.has_session(&peer_2));
1462:     }
1463: }

  47: impl fmt::Display for ResilienceError {
  48:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
  49:         match self {
  50:             ResilienceError::Io => f.write_str("i/o error"),
  51:             ResilienceError::IntegrityMismatch => f.write_str("integrity mismatch"),
  52:             ResilienceError::InvalidFormat => f.write_str("invalid format"),

  59: pub fn next_reconnect_delay_ms(policy: ReconnectPolicy, attempt: u32) -> u64 {
  60:     let factor = policy.multiplier.saturating_pow(attempt);
  61:     let backoff = policy.initial_backoff_ms.saturating_mul(u64::from(factor));
  62:     backoff.min(policy.max_backoff_ms)
  63: }
  64: 
  65: pub fn persist_session_snapshot(
  66:     snapshot: &SessionStateSnapshot,
  67:     path: impl AsRef<Path>,
  68: ) -> Result<(), ResilienceError> {
  69:     let path = path.as_ref();
  70:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
  71:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|_| ResilienceError::Io)?;
  72:     }
  73: 
  74:     let peers_csv = snapshot.peer_ids.join(",");
  75:     let mut body = String::new();
  76:     body.push_str(&format!("timestamp_unix={}\n", snapshot.timestamp_unix));
  77:     body.push_str(&format!("peer_ids={peers_csv}\n"));
  78:     body.push_str(&format!(
  79:         "selected_exit_node={}\n",
  80:         snapshot
  81:             .selected_exit_node
  82:             .clone()
  83:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string())
  84:     ));
  85:     body.push_str(&format!(
  86:         "lan_access_enabled={}\n",
  87:         if snapshot.lan_access_enabled {
  88:             "true"
  89:         } else {
  90:             "false"
  91:         }
  92:     ));
  93:     let digest = sha256_hex(body.as_bytes());
  94:     body.push_str(&format!("digest={digest}\n"));
  95: 
  96:     write_atomic_locked(path, body.as_bytes())?;
  97:     Ok(())
  98: }
