 100: pub fn load_session_snapshot(
 101:     path: impl AsRef<Path>,
 102: ) -> Result<SessionStateSnapshot, ResilienceError> {
 103:     let content = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|_| ResilienceError::Io)?;
 104:     if content.len() > 128 * 1024 {
 105:         return Err(ResilienceError::InvalidFormat);
 106:     }
 107:     let mut timestamp: Option<u64> = None;
 108:     let mut peer_ids: Option<Vec<String>> = None;
 109:     let mut selected_exit_node: Option<Option<String>> = None;
 110:     let mut lan_access_enabled: Option<bool> = None;
 111:     let mut digest: Option<String> = None;
 112:     let mut body_without_digest = String::new();
 113: 
 114:     for line in content.lines() {
 115:         if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("timestamp_unix=") {
 116:             timestamp = value.parse::<u64>().ok();
 117:             body_without_digest.push_str(line);
 118:             body_without_digest.push('\n');
 119:             continue;
 120:         }
 121:         if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("peer_ids=") {
 122:             let peers = if value.is_empty() {
 123:                 Vec::new()
 124:             } else {
 125:                 value
 126:                     .split(',')
 127:                     .map(ToString::to_string)
 128:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 129:             };
 130:             peer_ids = Some(peers);
 131:             body_without_digest.push_str(line);
 132:             body_without_digest.push('\n');
 133:             continue;
 134:         }
 135:         if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("selected_exit_node=") {
 136:             selected_exit_node = Some(if value == "none" {
 137:                 None
 138:             } else {
 139:                 Some(value.to_string())
 140:             });
 141:             body_without_digest.push_str(line);
 142:             body_without_digest.push('\n');
 143:             continue;
 144:         }
 145:         if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("lan_access_enabled=") {
 146:             lan_access_enabled = Some(match value {
 147:                 "true" => true,
 148:                 "false" => false,
 149:                 _ => return Err(ResilienceError::InvalidFormat),
 150:             });
 151:             body_without_digest.push_str(line);
 152:             body_without_digest.push('\n');
 153:             continue;
 154:         }
 155:         if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("digest=") {
 156:             digest = Some(value.to_string());
 157:             continue;
 158:         }
 159:         return Err(ResilienceError::InvalidFormat);
 160:     }
 161: 
 162:     let expected = digest.ok_or(ResilienceError::InvalidFormat)?;
 163:     let actual = sha256_hex(body_without_digest.as_bytes());
 164:     if expected != actual {
 165:         return Err(ResilienceError::IntegrityMismatch);
 166:     }
 167: 
 168:     Ok(SessionStateSnapshot {
 169:         timestamp_unix: timestamp.ok_or(ResilienceError::InvalidFormat)?,
 170:         peer_ids: peer_ids.ok_or(ResilienceError::InvalidFormat)?,
 171:         selected_exit_node: selected_exit_node.ok_or(ResilienceError::InvalidFormat)?,
 172:         lan_access_enabled: lan_access_enabled.ok_or(ResilienceError::InvalidFormat)?,
 173:     })
 174: }
 175: 
 176: fn sha256_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
 177:     let digest = Sha256::digest(bytes);
 178:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(digest.len() * 2);
 179:     for byte in digest {
 180:         out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
 181:     }
 182:     out
 183: }

 185: fn write_atomic_locked(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), ResilienceError> {
 186:     let lock_path = lock_path_for(path);
 187:     let _lock_guard = acquire_lock(&lock_path)?;
 188:     write_atomic(path, bytes)
 189: }
 190: 
 191: fn write_atomic(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), ResilienceError> {
 192:     let parent = path.parent().ok_or(ResilienceError::Io)?;
 193:     fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|_| ResilienceError::Io)?;
 194: 
 195:     let temp_path = temp_path_for(path);
 196:     let mut temp_file = create_restricted_file(&temp_path)?;
 197:     if temp_file.write_all(bytes).is_err() {
 198:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 199:         return Err(ResilienceError::Io);
 200:     }
 201:     if temp_file.sync_all().is_err() {
 202:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 203:         return Err(ResilienceError::Io);
 204:     }
 205:     if fs::rename(&temp_path, path).is_err() {
 206:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
 207:         return Err(ResilienceError::Io);
 208:     }
 209: 
 210:     #[cfg(unix)]
 211:     {
 212:         let parent_dir = File::open(parent).map_err(|_| ResilienceError::Io)?;
 213:         parent_dir.sync_all().map_err(|_| ResilienceError::Io)?;
 214:     }
 215:     Ok(())
 216: }
 217: 
 218: fn create_restricted_file(path: &Path) -> Result<File, ResilienceError> {
 219:     let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
 220:     options.write(true).create_new(true);
 221:     #[cfg(unix)]
 222:     {
 223:         options.mode(0o600);
 224:     }
 225:     options.open(path).map_err(|_| ResilienceError::Io)
 226: }
 227: 
 228: fn acquire_lock(path: &Path) -> Result<StateLockGuard, ResilienceError> {
 229:     const MAX_WAIT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);
 230:     const WAIT_MS: u64 = 10;
 231:     let deadline = Instant::now() + MAX_WAIT;
 232: 
 233:     loop {
 234:         let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
 235:         options.write(true).create_new(true);
 236:         #[cfg(unix)]
 237:         {
 238:             options.mode(0o600);
 239:         }
 240:         match options.open(path) {
 241:             Ok(mut handle) => {
 242:                 let stamp = format!("pid={} ts={}\n", std::process::id(), unix_now());
 243:                 let _ = handle.write_all(stamp.as_bytes());
 244:                 let _ = handle.sync_all();
 245:                 return Ok(StateLockGuard {
 246:                     path: path.to_path_buf(),
 247:                     _handle: handle,
 248:                 });
 249:             }
 250:             Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => {
 251:                 if Instant::now() >= deadline {
 252:                     return Err(ResilienceError::Io);
 253:                 }
 254:                 sleep(Duration::from_millis(WAIT_MS));
 255:             }
 256:             Err(_) => return Err(ResilienceError::Io),
 257:         }
 258:     }
 259: }
 260: 
 261: fn lock_path_for(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
 262:     let mut out = path.as_os_str().to_os_string();
 263:     out.push(".lock");
 264:     PathBuf::from(out)
 265: }
 266: 
 267: fn temp_path_for(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
 268:     let mut out = path.as_os_str().to_os_string();
 269:     out.push(format!(
 270:         ".tmp.{}.{}",
 271:         std::process::id(),
 272:         SystemTime::now()
 273:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 274:             .map(|duration| duration.as_nanos())
 275:             .unwrap_or(0)
 276:     ));
 277:     PathBuf::from(out)
 278: }
 279: 
 280: fn unix_now() -> u64 {
 281:     SystemTime::now()
 282:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 283:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
 284:         .unwrap_or(0)
 285: }

 288:     path: PathBuf,
 289:     _handle: File,
 290: }

 292: impl Drop for StateLockGuard {
 293:     fn drop(&mut self) {
 294:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&self.path);
 295:     }
 296: }

  38: /// Result of a STUN query containing full mapped endpoint information.
  39: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
  40: pub struct StunResult {
  41:     /// The full mapped public endpoint (IP + port) as seen by the STUN server.
  42:     pub mapped_endpoint: SocketAddr,
  43:     /// The STUN server that was queried.
  44:     pub server: SocketAddr,
  45:     /// The local address of the socket used for the query.

  49: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]

  51:     pub response: Vec<u8>,
  52:     pub remote_addr: SocketAddr,
  53:     pub local_addr: SocketAddr,
  54: }

  56: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
  57: pub struct StunClient {
  58:     servers: Vec<String>,
  59:     timeout: Duration,
  60: }
  61: 
  62: impl StunClient {
  63:     pub fn new(servers: Vec<String>, timeout: Duration) -> Self {
  64:         Self { servers, timeout }
  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     /// Gather public mapped endpoints from STUN servers.
  68:     ///
  69:     /// This method returns full `SocketAddr` (IP + port) as observed by each STUN server.
  70:     /// Unlike `gather_public_ips`, this method returns the actual mapped port, not a guess.
  71:     ///
  72:     /// # Arguments
  73:     /// * `socket` - Optional socket to use for queries. If provided, the mapped endpoint
  74:     ///   reflects the NAT mapping for that specific socket. If `None`, creates
  75:     ///   ephemeral sockets per query (legacy behavior, not recommended).
  76:     ///
  77:     /// # Returns
  78:     /// A vector of `StunResult` containing the full mapped endpoint information.
  79:     pub fn gather_mapped_endpoints(&self, socket: Option<&UdpSocket>) -> Vec<StunResult> {
  80:         let mut results = Vec::new();
  81:         for server in &self.servers {
  82:             match self.query_stun_server_full(server, socket) {
  83:                 Ok(result) => {
  84:                     // Deduplicate by mapped endpoint
  85:                     if !results
  86:                         .iter()
  87:                         .any(|r: &StunResult| r.mapped_endpoint == result.mapped_endpoint)
  88:                     {
  89:                         results.push(result);
  90:                     }
  91:                 }
  92:                 Err(_) => continue,
  93:             }
  94:         }
  95:         results
  96:     }
  97: 
  98:     /// Gather public mapped endpoints using a backend-owned authoritative
  99:     /// round-trip transport instead of a daemon-owned socket.
 100:     pub fn gather_mapped_endpoints_with_round_trip<F>(&self, mut round_trip: F) -> Vec<StunResult>
 101:     where
 102:         F: FnMut(SocketAddr, &[u8], Duration) -> Result<StunTransportRoundTrip, String>,
 103:     {
 104:         let mut results = Vec::new();
 105:         for server in &self.servers {
 106:             let Ok(server_addrs) = server.to_socket_addrs() else {
 107:                 continue;
 108:             };
 109:             let Some(target) = server_addrs.into_iter().next() else {
 110:                 continue;
 111:             };
 112:             let tx_id = self.generate_tx_id();
 113:             let request = self.build_binding_request(&tx_id);
 114:             let Ok(response) = round_trip(target, &request, self.timeout) else {
 115:                 continue;
 116:             };
 117:             if response.remote_addr != target {
 118:                 continue;
 119:             }
 120:             let Ok(mapped_endpoint) = self.parse_binding_response(&response.response, &tx_id)
 121:             else {
 122:                 continue;
 123:             };
 124:             if !results
 125:                 .iter()
 126:                 .any(|existing: &StunResult| existing.mapped_endpoint == mapped_endpoint)
 127:             {
 128:                 results.push(StunResult {
 129:                     mapped_endpoint,
 130:                     server: target,
 131:                     local_addr: response.local_addr,
 132:                 });
 133:             }
 134:         }
 135:         results
 136:     }

 138:     /// Legacy method that returns only IPs.
 139:     ///
 140:     /// **DEPRECATED**: Use `gather_mapped_endpoints` instead. This method guesses the port
 141:     /// by using the local listen port, which is incorrect for NATs that don't preserve ports.
 142:     pub fn gather_public_ips(&self) -> Vec<IpAddr> {
 143:         let mut ips = Vec::new();
 144:         for server in &self.servers {
 145:             if let Ok(addr) = self.query_stun_server(server)
 146:                 && !ips.contains(&addr.ip())
 147:             {
 148:                 ips.push(addr.ip());
 149:             }
 150:         }
 151:         ips
 152:     }
 153: 
 154:     /// Query a STUN server and return full result with metadata.
 155:     fn query_stun_server_full(
 156:         &self,
 157:         server: &str,
 158:         provided_socket: Option<&UdpSocket>,
 159:     ) -> Result<StunResult, String> {
 160:         let server_addrs = server.to_socket_addrs().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 161:         let target = server_addrs.into_iter().next().ok_or("no server address")?;
 162: 
 163:         if let Some(socket) = provided_socket {
 164:             return self.query_stun_server_with_socket(target, socket);
 165:         }
 166: 
 167:         let owned_socket = UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 168:         self.query_stun_server_with_socket(target, &owned_socket)
 169:     }
 170: 
 171:     fn query_stun_server_with_socket<S: StunQuerySocket>(
 172:         &self,
 173:         target: SocketAddr,
 174:         socket: &S,
 175:     ) -> Result<StunResult, String> {
 176:         socket
 177:             .set_read_timeout(Some(self.timeout))
 178:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 179: 
 180:         let local_addr = socket.local_addr().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 181: 
 182:         let tx_id = self.generate_tx_id();
 183:         let request = self.build_binding_request(&tx_id);
 184: 
 185:         socket
 186:             .send_to(&request, target)
 187:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 188: 
 189:         let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
 190:         let (len, _src) = socket.recv_from(&mut buf).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 191: 
 192:         let mapped_endpoint = self.parse_binding_response(&buf[..len], &tx_id)?;
 193: 
 194:         Ok(StunResult {
 195:             mapped_endpoint,
 196:             server: target,
 197:             local_addr,
 198:         })
 199:     }
 200: 
 201:     fn query_stun_server(&self, server: &str) -> Result<SocketAddr, String> {
 202:         let socket = UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 203:         socket
 204:             .set_read_timeout(Some(self.timeout))
 205:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 206: 
 207:         let server_addrs = server.to_socket_addrs().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 208:         let target = server_addrs.into_iter().next().ok_or("no server address")?;
 209: 
 210:         let tx_id = self.generate_tx_id();
 211:         let request = self.build_binding_request(&tx_id);
 212: 
 213:         socket
 214:             .send_to(&request, target)
 215:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 216: 
 217:         let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
 218:         let (len, _src) = socket.recv_from(&mut buf).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
 219: 
 220:         self.parse_binding_response(&buf[..len], &tx_id)
 221:     }
 222: 
 223:     fn generate_tx_id(&self) -> [u8; 12] {
 224:         let mut tx_id = [0u8; 12];
 225:         rand::rng().fill_bytes(&mut tx_id);
 226:         tx_id
 227:     }
 228: 
 229:     fn build_binding_request(&self, tx_id: &[u8; 12]) -> Vec<u8> {
 230:         let mut packet = Vec::with_capacity(20);
 231:         packet.extend_from_slice(&STUN_BINDING_REQUEST.to_be_bytes());
 232:         packet.extend_from_slice(&0u16.to_be_bytes()); // Length
 233:         packet.extend_from_slice(&STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE.to_be_bytes());
 234:         packet.extend_from_slice(tx_id);
 235:         packet
 236:     }
 237: 
 238:     fn parse_binding_response(&self, buf: &[u8], tx_id: &[u8; 12]) -> Result<SocketAddr, String> {
 239:         if buf.len() < 20 {
 240:             return Err("response too short".to_string());
 241:         }
 242:         let type_ = u16::from_be_bytes([buf[0], buf[1]]);
 243:         if type_ != STUN_BINDING_RESPONSE {
 244:             return Err(format!("unexpected response type: 0x{type_:04x}"));
 245:         }
 246:         let length = u16::from_be_bytes([buf[2], buf[3]]) as usize;
 247:         let cookie = u32::from_be_bytes([buf[4], buf[5], buf[6], buf[7]]);
 248:         if cookie != STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE {
 249:             return Err("invalid magic cookie".to_string());
 250:         }
 251:         if &buf[8..20] != tx_id {
 252:             return Err("transaction id mismatch".to_string());
 253:         }
 254:         if buf.len() < 20 + length {
 255:             return Err("truncated response".to_string());
 256:         }
 257: 
 258:         let mut pos = 20;
 259:         let end = 20 + length;
 260:         let mut mapped_addr = None;
 261:         let mut xor_mapped_addr = None;
 262: 
 263:         while pos + 4 <= end {
 264:             let attr_type = u16::from_be_bytes([buf[pos], buf[pos + 1]]);
 265:             let attr_len = u16::from_be_bytes([buf[pos + 2], buf[pos + 3]]) as usize;
 266:             let attr_end = pos + 4 + attr_len;
 267:             if attr_end > end {
 268:                 return Err("stun attribute exceeds message boundary".to_string());
 269:             }
 270:             let attr_value = &buf[pos + 4..attr_end];
 271: 
 272:             if attr_type == STUN_ATTR_XOR_MAPPED_ADDRESS
 273:                 && let Ok(addr) = self.parse_xor_mapped_address(attr_value, tx_id)
 274:             {
 275:                 xor_mapped_addr = Some(addr);
 276:             } else if attr_type == STUN_ATTR_MAPPED_ADDRESS
 277:                 && let Ok(addr) = self.parse_mapped_address(attr_value)
 278:             {
 279:                 mapped_addr = Some(addr);
 280:             }
 281: 
 282:             // Align to 4 bytes
 283:             let padding = (4 - (attr_len % 4)) % 4;
 284:             pos = attr_end + padding;
 285:         }
 286: 
 287:         if let Some(addr) = xor_mapped_addr {
 288:             Ok(addr)
 289:         } else if let Some(addr) = mapped_addr {
 290:             Ok(addr)
 291:         } else {
 292:             Err("no mapped address attribute found".to_string())
 293:         }
 294:     }
 295: 
 296:     fn parse_xor_mapped_address(&self, val: &[u8], tx_id: &[u8; 12]) -> Result<SocketAddr, String> {
 297:         if val.len() < 8 {
 298:             return Err("xor mapped addr too short".to_string());
 299:         }
 300:         let _reserved = val[0];
 301:         let family = val[1];
 302:         let port_xor = u16::from_be_bytes([val[2], val[3]]);
 303:         let port = port_xor ^ ((STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE >> 16) as u16);
 304: 
 305:         if family == 0x01 {
 306:             // IPv4
 307:             if val.len() < 8 {
 308:                 return Err("ipv4 too short".to_string());
 309:             }
 310:             let ip_xor = u32::from_be_bytes([val[4], val[5], val[6], val[7]]);
 311:             let ip = ip_xor ^ STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE;
 312:             Ok(SocketAddr::new(
 313:                 IpAddr::V4(std::net::Ipv4Addr::from(ip)),
 314:                 port,
 315:             ))
 316:         } else if family == 0x02 {
 317:             // IPv6
 318:             if val.len() < 20 {
 319:                 return Err("ipv6 too short".to_string());
 320:             }
 321:             let cookie = STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE.to_be_bytes();
 322:             let mut addr = [0u8; 16];
 323:             for (index, slot) in addr.iter_mut().enumerate() {
 324:                 let mask = if index < 4 {
 325:                     cookie[index]
 326:                 } else {
 327:                     tx_id[index - 4]
 328:                 };
 329:                 *slot = val[4 + index] ^ mask;
 330:             }
 331:             Ok(SocketAddr::new(
 332:                 IpAddr::V6(std::net::Ipv6Addr::from(addr)),
 333:                 port,
 334:             ))
 335:         } else {
 336:             Err(format!("unknown family: 0x{family:02x}"))
 337:         }
 338:     }
 339: 
 340:     fn parse_mapped_address(&self, val: &[u8]) -> Result<SocketAddr, String> {
 341:         if val.len() < 8 {
 342:             return Err("mapped addr too short".to_string());
 343:         }
 344:         let _reserved = val[0];
 345:         let family = val[1];
 346:         let port = u16::from_be_bytes([val[2], val[3]]);
 347: 
 348:         if family == 0x01 {
 349:             // IPv4
 350:             if val.len() < 8 {
 351:                 return Err("ipv4 too short".to_string());
 352:             }
 353:             let ip = std::net::Ipv4Addr::new(val[4], val[5], val[6], val[7]);
 354:             Ok(SocketAddr::new(IpAddr::V4(ip), port))
 355:         } else if family == 0x02 {
 356:             // IPv6
 357:             // Not supported
 358:             Err("ipv6 mapped addr not supported".to_string())
 359:         } else {
 360:             Err(format!("unknown family: 0x{family:02x}"))
 361:         }
 362:     }
 363: }

 371:     fn build_xor_mapped_binding_response(tx_id: &[u8], mapped_endpoint: SocketAddr) -> Vec<u8> {
 372:         let mut attribute = Vec::new();
 373:         attribute.extend_from_slice(&STUN_ATTR_XOR_MAPPED_ADDRESS.to_be_bytes());
 374:         match mapped_endpoint {
 375:             SocketAddr::V4(endpoint) => {
 376:                 attribute.extend_from_slice(&(8u16).to_be_bytes());
 377:                 attribute.push(0);
 378:                 attribute.push(0x01);
 379:                 let xored_port = endpoint.port() ^ ((STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE >> 16) as u16);
 380:                 attribute.extend_from_slice(&xored_port.to_be_bytes());
 381:                 let cookie = STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE.to_be_bytes();
 382:                 for (byte, mask) in endpoint.ip().octets().iter().zip(cookie.iter()) {
 383:                     attribute.push(byte ^ mask);
 384:                 }
 385:             }
 386:             SocketAddr::V6(endpoint) => {
 387:                 attribute.extend_from_slice(&(20u16).to_be_bytes());
 388:                 attribute.push(0);
 389:                 attribute.push(0x02);
 390:                 let xored_port = endpoint.port() ^ ((STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE >> 16) as u16);
 391:                 attribute.extend_from_slice(&xored_port.to_be_bytes());
 392:                 let cookie = STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE.to_be_bytes();
 393:                 for (index, byte) in endpoint.ip().octets().iter().enumerate() {
 394:                     let mask = if index < 4 {
 395:                         cookie[index]
 396:                     } else {
 397:                         tx_id[index - 4]
 398:                     };
 399:                     attribute.push(byte ^ mask);
 400:                 }
 401:             }
 402:         }
 403: 
 404:         let mut response = Vec::new();
 405:         response.extend_from_slice(&STUN_BINDING_RESPONSE.to_be_bytes());
 406:         response.extend_from_slice(&(attribute.len() as u16).to_be_bytes());
 407:         response.extend_from_slice(&STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE.to_be_bytes());
 408:         response.extend_from_slice(tx_id);
 409:         response.extend_from_slice(&attribute);
 410:         response
 411:     }

 427:     #[test]
 428:     fn test_parse_xor_mapped_address_extracts_full_endpoint() {
 429:         let client = StunClient::new(vec![], Duration::from_secs(1));
 430: 
 431:         // XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS for 192.0.2.1:32853 (RFC 5389 example)
 432:         // Port XOR: 32853 XOR (0x2112 >> 0) = 0x8055 XOR 0x2112 = 0xA147 (unxor'd port)
 433:         // Actually let's use a simpler test value
 434:         // mapped port 51820 = 0xCA6C, cookie upper = 0x2112, xor = 0xEB7E
 435:         // mapped IP 203.0.113.1, xor with cookie 0x2112A442 = ...
 436: 
 437:         // Build test value for 1.2.3.4:5678
 438:         // port 5678 = 0x162E, XOR with 0x2112 = 0x373C
 439:         // ip 1.2.3.4 = 0x01020304, XOR with 0x2112A442 = 0x2010A746
 440:         let val = [
 441:             0x00, // reserved
 442:             0x01, // IPv4
 443:             0x37, 0x3C, // XOR'd port (5678 XOR 0x2112)
 444:             0x20, 0x10, 0xA7, 0x46, // XOR'd IP (1.2.3.4 XOR 0x2112A442)
 445:         ];
 446: 
 447:         let result = client.parse_xor_mapped_address(&val, &[0u8; 12]).unwrap();
 448:         assert_eq!(result.port(), 5678);
 449:         assert_eq!(result.ip().to_string(), "1.2.3.4");
 450:     }

 559:

 562:             .expect("provided socket identity query should succeed");
 563:         assert_eq!(result.server, server_addr);
 564:         assert_eq!(result.local_addr, local_addr);
 565:         assert_eq!(result.mapped_endpoint, local_addr);

 570:     fn binding_response_for_endpoint(endpoint: SocketAddr, tx_id: &[u8; 12]) -> Vec<u8> {
 571:         let mut attr = Vec::with_capacity(8);
 572:         attr.push(0x00);
 573:         attr.push(0x01);
 574:         let xored_port = endpoint.port() ^ ((STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE >> 16) as u16);
 575:         attr.extend_from_slice(&xored_port.to_be_bytes());
 576:         let cookie = STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE.to_be_bytes();
 577:         let octets = match endpoint.ip() {
 578:             IpAddr::V4(addr) => addr.octets(),
 579:             IpAddr::V6(_) => panic!("test helper only supports ipv4"),
 580:         };
 581:         for (index, byte) in octets.iter().enumerate() {
 582:             attr.push(byte ^ cookie[index]);
 583:         }
 584: 
 585:         let mut response = Vec::with_capacity(32);
 586:         response.extend_from_slice(&STUN_BINDING_RESPONSE.to_be_bytes());
 587:         response.extend_from_slice(&(attr.len() as u16 + 4).to_be_bytes());
 588:         response.extend_from_slice(&STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE.to_be_bytes());
 589:         response.extend_from_slice(tx_id);
 590:         response.extend_from_slice(&STUN_ATTR_XOR_MAPPED_ADDRESS.to_be_bytes());
 591:         response.extend_from_slice(&(attr.len() as u16).to_be_bytes());
 592:         response.extend_from_slice(&attr);
 593:         response
 594:     }

 596:     #[derive(Debug)]
 597:     struct ScriptedStunSocket {
 598:         local_addr: SocketAddr,
 599:         expected_server: SocketAddr,
 600:         state: Mutex<ScriptedStunSocketState>,
 601:     }
 602: 
 603:     #[derive(Debug, Default)]
 604:     struct ScriptedStunSocketState {
 605:         last_target: Option<SocketAddr>,
 606:         last_request_len: Option<usize>,
 607:         last_tx_id: Option<[u8; 12]>,
 608:     }
 609: 
 610:     impl ScriptedStunSocket {
 611:         fn new(local_addr: SocketAddr, expected_server: SocketAddr) -> Self {
 612:             Self {
 613:                 local_addr,
 614:                 expected_server,
 615:                 state: Mutex::new(ScriptedStunSocketState::default()),
 616:             }
 617:         }
 618: 
 619:         fn last_target(&self) -> Option<SocketAddr> {
 620:             self.state
 621:                 .lock()
 622:                 .expect("mutex should not be poisoned")
 623:                 .last_target
 624:         }
 625: 
 626:         fn last_request_len(&self) -> Option<usize> {
 627:             self.state
 628:                 .lock()
 629:                 .expect("mutex should not be poisoned")
 630:                 .last_request_len
 631:         }
 632:     }
 633: 
 634:     impl StunQuerySocket for ScriptedStunSocket {
 635:         fn set_read_timeout(&self, _duration: Option<Duration>) -> std::io::Result<()> {
 636:             Ok(())
 637:         }
 638: 
 639:         fn local_addr(&self) -> std::io::Result<SocketAddr> {
 640:             Ok(self.local_addr)
 641:         }
 642: 
 643:         fn send_to(&self, buf: &[u8], target: SocketAddr) -> std::io::Result<usize> {
 644:             assert_eq!(target, self.expected_server);
 645:             assert_eq!(buf.len(), 20, "binding request should be header-only");
 646:             let tx_id: [u8; 12] = buf[8..20]
 647:                 .try_into()
 648:                 .expect("transaction id should be present");
 649:             let mut state = self.state.lock().expect("mutex should not be poisoned");
 650:             state.last_target = Some(target);
 651:             state.last_request_len = Some(buf.len());
 652:             state.last_tx_id = Some(tx_id);
 653:             Ok(buf.len())
 654:         }
 655: 
 656:         fn recv_from(&self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> std::io::Result<(usize, SocketAddr)> {
 657:             let tx_id = self
 658:                 .state
 659:                 .lock()
 660:                 .expect("mutex should not be poisoned")
 661:                 .last_tx_id
 662:                 .expect("send_to should capture transaction id before recv");
 663:             let response = binding_response_for_endpoint(self.local_addr, &tx_id);
 664:             let len = response.len();
 665:             buf[..len].copy_from_slice(&response);
 666:             Ok((len, self.expected_server))
 667:         }
 668:     }
 669: }

  22:         !matches!(self, CandidateSource::Relay)
  23:     }
  24: 
  25:     fn preference_score(self) -> u64 {
  26:         match self {
  27:             CandidateSource::Host => 300,
  28:             CandidateSource::ServerReflexive => 200,
  29:             CandidateSource::Relay => 100,
  30:         }
  31:     }
  32: }
  33:

  39:     pub observed_at_unix: u64,
  40: }

 127: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 128: pub enum TraversalError {
 129:     CandidateCountExceeded {
 130:         side: &'static str,
 131:         count: usize,
 132:         max: usize,
 133:     },
 134:     DuplicateCandidate {
 135:         side: &'static str,
 136:         addr: IpAddr,
 137:         port: u16,
 138:         source: CandidateSource,
 139:     },
 140:     InvalidCandidatePort {
 141:         side: &'static str,
 142:     },
 143:     NoDirectCandidates,
 144:     InvalidConfig(&'static str),
 145:     Stun(String),
 146:     Coordination(String),
 147:     CoordinationSignatureInvalid,
 148:     CoordinationReplayDetected,
 149:     CoordinationExpired,
 150:     CoordinationFutureRejected,
 151:     CoordinationNodeMismatch,
 152: }
 153: 
 154: impl fmt::Display for TraversalError {
 155:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
 156:         match self {
 157:             TraversalError::CandidateCountExceeded { side, count, max } => {
 158:                 write!(
 159:                     f,
 160:                     "candidate count exceeded on {side}: count={count} max={max}"
 161:                 )
 162:             }
 163:             TraversalError::DuplicateCandidate {
 164:                 side,
 165:                 addr,
 166:                 port,
 167:                 source,
 168:             } => write!(
 169:                 f,
 170:                 "duplicate candidate on {side}: addr={addr} port={port} source={source:?}"
 171:             ),
 172:             TraversalError::InvalidCandidatePort { side } => {
 173:                 write!(f, "invalid candidate port on {side}: port must be non-zero")
 174:             }
 175:             TraversalError::NoDirectCandidates => {
 176:                 f.write_str("no direct-eligible candidates available")
 177:             }
 178:             TraversalError::InvalidConfig(message) => {
 179:                 write!(f, "invalid traversal config: {message}")
 180:             }
 181:             TraversalError::Stun(message) => write!(f, "stun error: {message}"),
 182:             TraversalError::Coordination(message) => write!(f, "coordination error: {message}"),
 183:             TraversalError::CoordinationSignatureInvalid => {
 184:                 f.write_str("coordination signature verification failed")
 185:             }
 186:             TraversalError::CoordinationReplayDetected => {
 187:                 f.write_str("coordination nonce replay detected")
 188:             }
 189:             TraversalError::CoordinationExpired => f.write_str("coordination record is expired"),
 190:             TraversalError::CoordinationFutureRejected => {
 191:                 f.write_str("coordination probe start exceeds max future skew")
 192:             }
 193:             TraversalError::CoordinationNodeMismatch => {
 194:                 f.write_str("coordination record does not include local and remote nodes")
 195:             }
 196:         }
 197:     }
 198: }

 200: impl std::error::Error for TraversalError {}

 202: const STUN_BINDING_REQUEST_TYPE: u16 = 0x0001;
 203: const STUN_BINDING_RESPONSE_TYPE: u16 = 0x0101;
 204: const STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE: u32 = 0x2112_A442;
 205: const STUN_ATTR_XOR_MAPPED_ADDRESS: u16 = 0x0020;
 206: 
 207: fn now_unix_secs() -> u64 {
 208:     SystemTime::now()
 209:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 210:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
 211:         .unwrap_or(0)
 212: }

 216: #[derive(Debug)]
 217: pub struct CandidateGatherer {
 218:     local_socket: UdpSocket,
 219:     stun_servers: Vec<SocketAddr>,
 220:     timeout: Duration,
 221:     host_candidates: Vec<SocketEndpoint>,
 222:     rustynet_interface_addrs: BTreeSet<IpAddr>,
 223: }
 224: 
 225: impl CandidateGatherer {
 226:     pub fn new(
 227:         local_socket: UdpSocket,
 228:         stun_servers: Vec<SocketAddr>,
 229:         timeout: Duration,
 230:         host_candidates: Vec<SocketEndpoint>,
 231:         rustynet_interface_addrs: Vec<IpAddr>,
 232:     ) -> Result<Self, TraversalError> {
 233:         if timeout.is_zero() {
 234:             return Err(TraversalError::InvalidConfig(
 235:                 "stun_gather_timeout_ms must be greater than zero",
 236:             ));
 237:         }
 238:         local_socket.set_nonblocking(false).map_err(|err| {
 239:             TraversalError::Stun(format!("failed to configure stun socket: {err}"))
 240:         })?;
 241:         Ok(Self {
 242:             local_socket,
 243:             stun_servers,
 244:             timeout,
 245:             host_candidates,
 246:             rustynet_interface_addrs: rustynet_interface_addrs.into_iter().collect(),
 247:         })
 248:     }
 249: 
 250:     pub fn gather(&self) -> Vec<TraversalCandidate> {
 251:         self.gather_with_observed_at(now_unix_secs())
 252:     }
 253: 
 254:     fn gather_with_observed_at(&self, observed_at_unix: u64) -> Vec<TraversalCandidate> {
 255:         let local_bound_endpoint =
 256:             self.local_socket
 257:                 .local_addr()
 258:                 .ok()
 259:                 .map(|bound_addr| SocketEndpoint {
 260:                     addr: bound_addr.ip(),
 261:                     port: bound_addr.port(),
 262:                 });
 263:         let deadline = Instant::now() + self.timeout;
 264:         let mut srflx_results = Vec::new();
 265:         for server in &self.stun_servers {
 266:             let now = Instant::now();
 267:             if now >= deadline {
 268:                 break;
 269:             }
 270:             let remaining = deadline.saturating_duration_since(now);
 271:             if remaining.is_zero() {
 272:                 break;
 273:             }
 274:             srflx_results.push(self.query_stun_server(*server, remaining));
 275:         }
 276: 
 277:         collect_gathered_candidates(
 278:             local_bound_endpoint,
 279:             &self.host_candidates,
 280:             &self.rustynet_interface_addrs,
 281:             observed_at_unix,
 282:             srflx_results,
 283:         )
 284:     }
 285: 
 286:     fn query_stun_server(
 287:         &self,
 288:         server: SocketAddr,
 289:         timeout: Duration,
 290:     ) -> Result<SocketEndpoint, TraversalError> {
 291:         let mut transaction_id = [0u8; 12];
 292:         rand::rngs::OsRng
 293:             .try_fill_bytes(transaction_id.as_mut_slice())
 294:             .map_err(|err| TraversalError::Stun(format!("os randomness unavailable: {err}")))?;
 295:         let request = build_stun_binding_request(transaction_id);
 296:         self.local_socket
 297:             .set_read_timeout(Some(timeout))
 298:             .map_err(|err| {
 299:                 TraversalError::Stun(format!("failed to set stun read timeout: {err}"))
 300:             })?;
 301:         self.local_socket
 302:             .set_write_timeout(Some(timeout))
 303:             .map_err(|err| {
 304:                 TraversalError::Stun(format!("failed to set stun write timeout: {err}"))
 305:             })?;
 306:         self.local_socket
 307:             .send_to(request.as_slice(), server)
 308:             .map_err(|err| TraversalError::Stun(format!("failed to send stun request: {err}")))?;
 309: 
 310:         let mut buffer = [0u8; 1500];
 311:         let receive_started = Instant::now();
 312:         // loop { // removed to silence clippy: loop never loops
 313:         match self.local_socket.recv_from(&mut buffer) {
 314:             Ok((received, _source)) => {
 315:                 parse_stun_xor_mapped_address(buffer[..received].as_ref(), transaction_id).map(
 316:                     |addr| SocketEndpoint {
 317:                         addr: addr.ip(),
 318:                         port: addr.port(),
 319:                     },
 320:                 )
 321:             }
 322:             Err(err)
 323:                 if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
 324:                     || err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::TimedOut =>
 325:             {
 326:                 Err(TraversalError::Stun("stun response timed out".to_string()))
 327:             }
 328:             Err(err) => {
 329:                 if receive_started.elapsed() >= timeout {
 330:                     return Err(TraversalError::Stun("stun response timed out".to_string()));
 331:                 }
 332:                 Err(TraversalError::Stun(format!(
 333:                     "failed to receive stun response: {err}"
 334:                 )))
 335:             }
 336:         }
 337:         // }
 338:     }
 339: }
 340: 
 341: fn collect_gathered_candidates(
 342:     local_bound_endpoint: Option<SocketEndpoint>,
 343:     host_candidates: &[SocketEndpoint],
 344:     rustynet_interface_addrs: &BTreeSet<IpAddr>,
 345:     observed_at_unix: u64,
 346:     srflx_results: Vec<Result<SocketEndpoint, TraversalError>>,
 347: ) -> Vec<TraversalCandidate> {
 348:     let mut candidates = Vec::new();
 349:     let host_priority = 900;
 350:     let srflx_priority = 850;
 351: 
 352:     if let Some(endpoint) = local_bound_endpoint
 353:         && is_candidate_endpoint_allowed(endpoint, rustynet_interface_addrs)
 354:     {
 355:         candidates.push(TraversalCandidate {
 356:             endpoint,
 357:             source: CandidateSource::Host,
 358:             priority: host_priority,
 359:             observed_at_unix,
 360:         });
 361:     }
 362: 
 363:     for endpoint in host_candidates {
 364:         if is_candidate_endpoint_allowed(*endpoint, rustynet_interface_addrs) {
 365:             candidates.push(TraversalCandidate {
 366:                 endpoint: *endpoint,
 367:                 source: CandidateSource::Host,
 368:                 priority: host_priority,
 369:                 observed_at_unix,
 370:             });
 371:         }
 372:     }
 373: 
 374:     for result in srflx_results {
 375:         if let Ok(endpoint) = result
 376:             && is_candidate_endpoint_allowed(endpoint, rustynet_interface_addrs)
 377:         {
 378:             candidates.push(TraversalCandidate {
 379:                 endpoint,
 380:                 source: CandidateSource::ServerReflexive,
 381:                 priority: srflx_priority,
 382:                 observed_at_unix,
 383:             });
 384:         }
 385:     }
 386: 
 387:     dedup_candidates(candidates)
 388: }
 389: 
 390: fn is_candidate_endpoint_allowed(
 391:     endpoint: SocketEndpoint,
 392:     rustynet_interface_addrs: &BTreeSet<IpAddr>,
 393: ) -> bool {
 394:     if endpoint.port == 0 {
 395:         return false;
 396:     }
 397:     let ip = endpoint.addr;
 398:     #[cfg(not(test))]
 399:     if ip.is_unspecified() || ip.is_loopback() || ip.is_multicast() {
 400:         return false;
 401:     }
 402:     #[cfg(test)]
 403:     if ip.is_unspecified() || ip.is_multicast() {
 404:         return false;
 405:     }
 406:     match ip {
 407:         IpAddr::V4(value) => {
 408:             if value.is_link_local() || value.is_broadcast() {
 409:                 return false;
 410:             }
 411:         }
 412:         IpAddr::V6(value) => {
 413:             if value.is_unicast_link_local() {
 414:                 return false;
 415:             }
 416:         }
 417:     }
 418:     !rustynet_interface_addrs.contains(&ip)
 419: }
 420: 
 421: fn dedup_candidates(mut candidates: Vec<TraversalCandidate>) -> Vec<TraversalCandidate> {
 422:     candidates.sort_by(|left, right| {
 423:         left.endpoint
 424:             .addr
 425:             .cmp(&right.endpoint.addr)
 426:             .then(left.endpoint.port.cmp(&right.endpoint.port))
 427:             .then(left.source.cmp(&right.source))
 428:             .then(right.priority.cmp(&left.priority))
 429:             .then(right.observed_at_unix.cmp(&left.observed_at_unix))
 430:     });
 431: 
 432:     let mut deduped = Vec::new();
 433:     let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
 434:     for candidate in candidates {
 435:         let key = (
 436:             candidate.endpoint.addr,
 437:             candidate.endpoint.port,
 438:             candidate.source,
 439:         );
 440:         if seen.insert(key) {
 441:             deduped.push(candidate);
 442:         }
 443:     }
 444:     deduped
 445: }
 446: 
 447: fn build_stun_binding_request(transaction_id: [u8; 12]) -> [u8; 20] {
 448:     let mut request = [0u8; 20];
 449:     request[0..2].copy_from_slice(&STUN_BINDING_REQUEST_TYPE.to_be_bytes());
 450:     request[2..4].copy_from_slice(&0u16.to_be_bytes());
 451:     request[4..8].copy_from_slice(&STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE.to_be_bytes());
 452:     request[8..20].copy_from_slice(transaction_id.as_slice());
 453:     request
 454: }
 455: 
 456: fn parse_stun_xor_mapped_address(
 457:     message: &[u8],
 458:     transaction_id: [u8; 12],
 459: ) -> Result<SocketAddr, TraversalError> {
 460:     if message.len() < 20 {
 461:         return Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 462:             "stun message is shorter than header".to_string(),
 463:         ));
 464:     }
 465:     let message_type = u16::from_be_bytes([message[0], message[1]]);
 466:     if message_type != STUN_BINDING_RESPONSE_TYPE {
 467:         return Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 468:             "stun message is not a binding response".to_string(),
 469:         ));
 470:     }
 471:     let declared_len = usize::from(u16::from_be_bytes([message[2], message[3]]));
 472:     let expected_len = 20usize.saturating_add(declared_len);
 473:     if expected_len > message.len() {
 474:         return Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 475:             "stun message is truncated".to_string(),
 476:         ));
 477:     }
 478:     let cookie = u32::from_be_bytes([message[4], message[5], message[6], message[7]]);
 479:     if cookie != STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE {
 480:         return Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 481:             "stun magic cookie mismatch".to_string(),
 482:         ));
 483:     }
 484:     if message[8..20] != transaction_id {
 485:         return Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 486:             "stun transaction id mismatch".to_string(),
 487:         ));
 488:     }
 489: 
 490:     let cookie_bytes = STUN_MAGIC_COOKIE.to_be_bytes();
 491:     let mut offset = 20usize;
 492:     while offset.saturating_add(4) <= expected_len {
 493:         let attr_type = u16::from_be_bytes([message[offset], message[offset + 1]]);
 494:         let attr_len = usize::from(u16::from_be_bytes([
 495:             message[offset + 2],
 496:             message[offset + 3],
 497:         ]));
 498:         offset = offset.saturating_add(4);
 499:         let attr_end = offset.saturating_add(attr_len);
 500:         if attr_end > expected_len {
 501:             return Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 502:                 "stun attribute exceeds message boundary".to_string(),
 503:             ));
 504:         }
 505:         let value = &message[offset..attr_end];
 506:         if attr_type == STUN_ATTR_XOR_MAPPED_ADDRESS {
 507:             if attr_len < 8 {
 508:                 return Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 509:                     "xor-mapped-address attribute too short".to_string(),
 510:                 ));
 511:             }
 512:             let family = value[1];
 513:             let x_port = u16::from_be_bytes([value[2], value[3]]);
 514:             let port_mask = u16::from_be_bytes([cookie_bytes[0], cookie_bytes[1]]);
 515:             let port = x_port ^ port_mask;
 516:             let endpoint = match family {
 517:                 0x01 => {
 518:                     if attr_len < 8 {
 519:                         return Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 520:                             "xor-mapped-address ipv4 attribute too short".to_string(),
 521:                         ));
 522:                     }
 523:                     let mut addr = [0u8; 4];
 524:                     for (index, slot) in addr.iter_mut().enumerate() {
 525:                         *slot = value[4 + index] ^ cookie_bytes[index];
 526:                     }
 527:                     SocketAddr::new(IpAddr::V4(Ipv4Addr::from(addr)), port)
 528:                 }
 529:                 0x02 => {
 530:                     if attr_len < 20 {
 531:                         return Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 532:                             "xor-mapped-address ipv6 attribute too short".to_string(),
 533:                         ));
 534:                     }
 535:                     let mut addr = [0u8; 16];
 536:                     for (index, slot) in addr.iter_mut().enumerate() {
 537:                         let mask = if index < 4 {
 538:                             cookie_bytes[index]
 539:                         } else {
 540:                             transaction_id[index - 4]
 541:                         };
 542:                         *slot = value[4 + index] ^ mask;
 543:                     }
 544:                     SocketAddr::new(IpAddr::V6(Ipv6Addr::from(addr)), port)
 545:                 }
 546:                 _ => {
 547:                     return Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 548:                         "xor-mapped-address has unsupported address family".to_string(),
 549:                     ));
 550:                 }
 551:             };
 552:             return Ok(endpoint);
 553:         }
 554:         let padded_len = (attr_len + 3) & !3;
 555:         offset = offset.saturating_add(padded_len);
 556:     }
 557: 
 558:     Err(TraversalError::Stun(
 559:         "stun response does not contain xor-mapped-address".to_string(),
 560:     ))
 561: }
 562: 
 563: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 564: struct ParsedCoordinationPayload {
 565:     session_id: [u8; 16],
 566:     probe_start_unix: u64,
 567:     node_a: String,
 568:     node_b: String,
 569:     issued_at_unix: u64,
 570:     expires_at_unix: u64,
 571:     nonce: [u8; 16],
 572: }
 573: 
 574: fn verify_coordination_record_signature(
 575:     record: &SignedTraversalCoordinationRecord,
 576:     endpoint_hint_verifier_key: &[u8; 32],
 577: ) -> Result<(), TraversalError> {
 578:     let parsed = parse_coordination_payload(record.payload.as_str())?;
 579:     if parsed.session_id != record.session_id
 580:         || parsed.probe_start_unix != record.probe_start_unix
 581:         || parsed.node_a != record.node_a
 582:         || parsed.node_b != record.node_b
 583:         || parsed.issued_at_unix != record.issued_at_unix
 584:         || parsed.expires_at_unix != record.expires_at_unix
 585:         || parsed.nonce != record.nonce
 586:     {
 587:         return Err(TraversalError::Coordination(
 588:             "coordination payload/header mismatch".to_string(),
 589:         ));
 590:     }
 591:     let canonical_payload = serialize_coordination_payload(&parsed);
 592:     if canonical_payload != record.payload {
 593:         return Err(TraversalError::Coordination(
 594:             "coordination payload canonicalization mismatch".to_string(),
 595:         ));
 596:     }
 597: 
 598:     let signature_bytes = decode_hex_to_fixed::<64>(record.signature_hex.as_str())
 599:         .map_err(|_| TraversalError::CoordinationSignatureInvalid)?;
 600:     let signature = Signature::from_bytes(&signature_bytes);
 601:     let verifying_key = VerifyingKey::from_bytes(endpoint_hint_verifier_key)
 602:         .map_err(|_| TraversalError::CoordinationSignatureInvalid)?;
 603:     verifying_key
 604:         .verify(record.payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
 605:         .map_err(|_| TraversalError::CoordinationSignatureInvalid)
 606: }
 607: 
 608: fn parse_coordination_payload(payload: &str) -> Result<ParsedCoordinationPayload, TraversalError> {
 609:     let mut fields = BTreeMap::<String, String>::new();
 610:     for line in payload.lines() {
 611:         let (key, value) = line.split_once('=').ok_or_else(|| {
 612:             TraversalError::Coordination("coordination payload line missing '='".to_string())
 613:         })?;
 614:         if key.trim().is_empty() {
 615:             return Err(TraversalError::Coordination(
 616:                 "coordination payload key is empty".to_string(),
 617:             ));
 618:         }
 619:         if fields.insert(key.to_string(), value.to_string()).is_some() {
 620:             return Err(TraversalError::Coordination(format!(
 621:                 "coordination payload duplicate key: {key}"
 622:             )));
 623:         }
 624:     }
 625:     if fields.len() != 9 {
 626:         return Err(TraversalError::Coordination(
 627:             "coordination payload has unexpected field count".to_string(),
 628:         ));
 629:     }
 630: 
 631:     let version = fields.get("version").ok_or_else(|| {
 632:         TraversalError::Coordination("coordination payload missing version".to_string())
 633:     })?;
 634:     if version != "1" {
 635:         return Err(TraversalError::Coordination(
 636:             "coordination payload version is unsupported".to_string(),
 637:         ));
 638:     }
 639:     let payload_type = fields.get("type").ok_or_else(|| {
 640:         TraversalError::Coordination("coordination payload missing type".to_string())
 641:     })?;
 642:     if payload_type != "traversal_coordination" {
 643:         return Err(TraversalError::Coordination(
 644:             "coordination payload type is unsupported".to_string(),
 645:         ));
 646:     }
 647: 
 648:     let session_id = decode_hex_to_fixed::<16>(
 649:         fields
 650:             .get("session_id")
 651:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 652:                 TraversalError::Coordination("coordination payload missing session_id".to_string())
 653:             })?
 654:             .as_str(),
 655:     )
 656:     .map_err(|_| TraversalError::Coordination("coordination session_id is invalid".to_string()))?;
 657:     let nonce = decode_hex_to_fixed::<16>(
 658:         fields
 659:             .get("nonce")
 660:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 661:                 TraversalError::Coordination("coordination payload missing nonce".to_string())
 662:             })?
 663:             .as_str(),
 664:     )
 665:     .map_err(|_| TraversalError::Coordination("coordination nonce is invalid".to_string()))?;
 666:     let probe_start_unix = parse_u64_field(&fields, "probe_start_unix")?;
 667:     let issued_at_unix = parse_u64_field(&fields, "issued_at_unix")?;
 668:     let expires_at_unix = parse_u64_field(&fields, "expires_at_unix")?;
 669:     let node_a = fields
 670:         .get("node_a")
 671:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 672:             TraversalError::Coordination("coordination payload missing node_a".to_string())
 673:         })?
 674:         .trim()
 675:         .to_string();
 676:     let node_b = fields
 677:         .get("node_b")
 678:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 679:             TraversalError::Coordination("coordination payload missing node_b".to_string())
 680:         })?
 681:         .trim()
 682:         .to_string();
 683:     if node_a.is_empty() || node_b.is_empty() {
 684:         return Err(TraversalError::Coordination(
 685:             "coordination payload node ids must not be empty".to_string(),
 686:         ));
 687:     }
 688:     Ok(ParsedCoordinationPayload {
 689:         session_id,
 690:         probe_start_unix,
 691:         node_a,
 692:         node_b,
 693:         issued_at_unix,
 694:         expires_at_unix,
 695:         nonce,
 696:     })
 697: }
 698: 
 699: fn parse_u64_field(fields: &BTreeMap<String, String>, name: &str) -> Result<u64, TraversalError> {
 700:     fields
 701:         .get(name)
 702:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 703:             TraversalError::Coordination(format!("coordination payload missing {name}"))
 704:         })?
 705:         .parse::<u64>()
 706:         .map_err(|_| TraversalError::Coordination(format!("coordination payload invalid {name}")))
 707: }
 708: 
 709: fn serialize_coordination_payload(payload: &ParsedCoordinationPayload) -> String {
 710:     let mut out = String::new();
 711:     out.push_str("version=1\n");
 712:     out.push_str("type=traversal_coordination\n");
 713:     out.push_str(&format!(
 714:         "session_id={}\n",
 715:         encode_hex(payload.session_id.as_slice())
 716:     ));
 717:     out.push_str(&format!("probe_start_unix={}\n", payload.probe_start_unix));
 718:     out.push_str(&format!("node_a={}\n", payload.node_a.trim()));
 719:     out.push_str(&format!("node_b={}\n", payload.node_b.trim()));
 720:     out.push_str(&format!("issued_at_unix={}\n", payload.issued_at_unix));
 721:     out.push_str(&format!("expires_at_unix={}\n", payload.expires_at_unix));
 722:     out.push_str(&format!("nonce={}\n", encode_hex(payload.nonce.as_slice())));
 723:     out
 724: }
 725: 
 726: fn encode_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
 727:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
 728:     for byte in bytes {
 729:         out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
 730:     }
 731:     out
 732: }
 733: 
 734: fn decode_hex_to_fixed<const N: usize>(encoded: &str) -> Result<[u8; N], ()> {
 735:     let mut bytes = [0u8; N];
 736:     let trimmed = encoded.trim();
 737:     if trimmed.len() != N * 2 {
 738:         return Err(());
 739:     }
 740:     let raw = trimmed.as_bytes();
 741:     let mut index = 0usize;
 742:     while index < N {
 743:         let hi = decode_hex_nibble(raw[index * 2])?;
 744:         let lo = decode_hex_nibble(raw[index * 2 + 1])?;
 745:         bytes[index] = (hi << 4) | lo;
 746:         index += 1;
 747:     }
 748:     Ok(bytes)
 749: }
 750: 
 751: fn decode_hex_nibble(value: u8) -> Result<u8, ()> {
 752:     match value {
 753:         b'0'..=b'9' => Ok(value - b'0'),
 754:         b'a'..=b'f' => Ok(value - b'a' + 10),
 755:         b'A'..=b'F' => Ok(value - b'A' + 10),
 756:         _ => Err(()),
 757:     }
 758: }
 759:

 761: pub const MAX_COORDINATION_FUTURE_START_SECS: u64 = 10;

 823: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
 824: pub struct CoordinationReplayWindow {
 825:     seen_nonces: BTreeMap<[u8; 16], u64>,
 826: }
 827: 
 828: impl CoordinationReplayWindow {
 829:     pub fn verify_and_record(
 830:         &mut self,
 831:         nonce: [u8; 16],
 832:         expires_at_unix: u64,
 833:         now_unix: u64,
 834:     ) -> Result<(), TraversalError> {
 835:         self.seen_nonces.retain(|_, expires| *expires >= now_unix);
 836:         if self.seen_nonces.contains_key(&nonce) {
 837:             return Err(TraversalError::CoordinationReplayDetected);
 838:         }
 839:         self.seen_nonces.insert(nonce, expires_at_unix);
 840:         Ok(())
 841:     }
 842: }

 888:     }

 892:             self.filtering,

 895:     }

 898: pub fn direct_udp_viable(local: NatProfile, remote: NatProfile) -> bool {
 899:     if local.is_symmetric() && remote.is_symmetric() {
 900:         return false;
 901:     }
 902:     if local.is_hard_nat() && remote.is_hard_nat() {
 903:         return false;
 904:     }
 905:     true
 906: }
